abstract.text: CONTEXT: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) recently launched accountable care organization (ACO) programs designed to improve quality and slow cost growth. The ACOs resemble an earlier pilot, the Medicare Physician Group Practice Demonstration (PGPD), in which participating physician groups received bonus payments if they achieved lower cost growth than local controls and met quality targets. Although evidence indicates the PGPD improved quality, uncertainty remains about its effect on costs. OBJECTIVE: To estimate cost savings associated with the PGPD overall and for beneficiaries dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid. DESIGN: Quasi-experimental analyses comparing preintervention (2001-2004) and postintervention (2005-2009) trends in spending of PGPD participants to local control groups. We compared estimates using several alternative approaches to adjust for case mix. SETTING: Ten physician groups from across the United States. PATIENTS AND PARTICIPANTS: The intervention group was composed of fee-for-service Medicare beneficiaries (n = 990,177) receiving care primarily from the physicians in the participating medical groups. Controls were Medicare beneficiaries (n = 7,514,453) from the same regions who received care largely from non-PGPD physicians. Overall, 15% of beneficiaries were dually eligible for Medicare and Medicaid. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURE: Annual spending per Medicare fee-for-service beneficiary. RESULTS: Annual savings per beneficiary were modest overall (adjusted mean $114, 95% CI, $12-$216). Annual savings were significant in dually eligible beneficiaries (adjusted mean $532, 95% CI, $277-$786), but were not significant among nondually eligible beneficiaries (adjusted mean $59, 95% CI, $166 in savings to $47 in additional spending). The adjusted mean spending reductions were concentrated in acute care (overall, $118, 95% CI, $65-$170; dually eligible: $381, 95% CI, $247-$515; nondually eligible: $85, 95% CI, $32-$138). There was significant variation in savings across practice groups, ranging from an overall mean per-capita annual saving of $866 (95% CI, $815-$918) to an increase in expenditures of $749 (95% CI, $698-$799). Thirty-day medical readmissions decreased overall (-0.67%, 95% CI, -1.11% to -0.23%) and in the dually eligible (-1.07%, 95% CI, -1.73% to -0.41%), while surgical readmissions decreased only for the dually eligible (-2.21%, 95% CI, -3.07% to -1.34%). Estimates were sensitive to the risk-adjustment method. CONCLUSIONS: Substantial PGPD savings achieved by some participating institutions were offset by a lack of saving at other participating institutions. Most of the savings were concentrated among dually eligible beneficiaries.

10.1001/2012.jama.10812.abstractZh:
背景：医疗保险与医疗补助服务中心（CMS）最近推出了问责护理组织计划，旨在提高服务质量并减缓成本增长。这些问责护理组织类似于早期的试点项目——医疗保险医师团体实践示范项目，在该项目中，参与的医师团体如果实现比当地对照组更低的成本增长并达到质量目标，就会获得奖励。尽管有证据表明该项目提高了服务质量，但其对成本的影响仍存在不确定性。

目的：估算与医疗保险医师团体实践示范项目相关的成本节约情况，特别是那些同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助条件的受益人。

设计：采用准实验分析，比较干预前（2001-2004年）和干预后（2005-2009年）医疗保险医师团体实践示范项目参与者的支出趋势与当地对照组的情况。我们采用了多种替代方法来调整病例组合。

研究地点：来自美国各地的十个医师团体。

患者与参与者：干预组由接受按服务收费的医疗保险服务的受益人组成，共计990,177人，他们主要接受参与医师团体的医疗服务。对照组为来自同一地区的医疗保险受益人，共计7,514,453人，他们主要接受非医疗保险医师团体的医疗服务。总体而言，15%的受益人是同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助条件的。

主要结果指标：每位医疗保险按服务收费受益人的年度支出。

结果：总体而言，每位受益人的年度节约金额较为适中（调整后平均114美元，95%置信区间12美元至216美元）。对于同时符合医疗保险和医疗补助条件的受益人，年度节约金额显著（调整后平均532美元，95%置信区间277美元至786美元），但对于不符合条件的受益人，年度节约金额并不显著（调整后平均59美元，95%置信区间节约166美元，增加支出47美元）。调整后的平均支出减少主要集中在急性护理领域（总体为118美元，95%置信区间，65-170美元；双重符合条件的患者为381美元，95%置信区间，247-515美元；非双重符合条件的患者为85美元，95%置信区间，32-138美元）。不同实践群体的节省金额存在显著差异，总体人均年节省金额为866美元（95%置信区间，815-918美元），而支出则增加了749美元（95%置信区间，698-799美元）。30天的医疗再入院情况总体有所减少（-0.67%，95%置信区间，-1.11%至-0.23%），双重符合条件的患者再入院情况则减少了1.07%（95%置信区间，-1.73%至-0.41%），而手术再入院情况仅对双重符合条件的患者有所减少，减少了2.21%（95%置信区间，-3.07%至-1.34%）。这些估计结果对风险调整方法的敏感性较高。结论：一些参与机构实现了显著的PGPD节省，但其他参与机构的节省效果则较差。大部分节省金额集中在双重符合条件的受益者身上。

abstract.text: CONTEXT: The extent to which better spending produces higher-quality care and better patient outcomes in a universal health care system with selective access to medical technology is unknown. OBJECTIVE: To assess whether acute care patients admitted to higher-spending hospitals have lower mortality and readmissions. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PATIENTS: The study population comprised adults (>18 years) in Ontario, Canada, with a first admission for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) (n = 179,139), congestive heart failure (CHF) (n = 92,377), hip fracture (n = 90,046), or colon cancer (n = 26,195) during 1998-2008, with follow-up to 1 year. The exposure measure was the index hospital's end-of-life expenditure index for hospital, physician, and emergency department services. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The primary outcomes were 30-day and 1-year mortality and readmissions and major cardiac events (readmissions for AMI, angina, CHF, or death) for AMI and CHF. RESULTS: Patients' baseline health status was similar across hospital expenditure groups. Patients admitted to hospitals in the highest- vs lowest-spending intensity terciles had lower rates of all adverse outcomes. In the highest- vs lowest-spending hospitals, respectively, the age- and sex-adjusted 30-day mortality rate was 12.7% vs 12.8% for AMI, 10.2% vs 12.4% for CHF, 7.7% vs 9.7% for hip fracture, and 3.3% vs 3.9% for CHF; fully adjusted relative 30-day mortality rates were 0.93 (95% CI, 0.89-0.98) for AMI, 0.81 (95% CI, 0.76-0.86) for CHF, 0.74 (95% CI, 0.68-0.80) for hip fracture, and 0.78 (95% CI, 0.66-0.91) for colon cancer. Results for 1-year mortality, readmissions, and major cardiac events were similar. Higher-spending hospitals had higher nursing staff ratios, and their patients received more inpatient medical specialist visits, interventional (AMI cohort) and medical (AMI and CHF cohorts) cardiac therapies, preoperative specialty care (colon cancer cohort), and postdischarge collaborative care with a cardiologist and primary care physician (AMI and CHF cohorts). CONCLUSION: Among Ontario hospitals, higher spending intensity was associated with lower mortality, readmissions, and cardiac event rates.

10.1001/jama.2012.265.abstractZh: 背景：在具有选择性医疗技术获取机制的全民医疗体系中，更好的支出能够在多大程度上带来更高质量的护理和更好的患者治疗效果，目前尚不清楚。目的：评估在支出较高的医院住院的急性病患者是否具有较低的死亡率和再入院率。设计、研究环境和患者：研究对象为1998年至2008年间在加拿大安大略省因急性心肌梗塞（AMI）、充血性心力衰竭（CHF）、髋部骨折或结肠癌而首次住院的成年人（年龄超过18岁），共179,139人、92,377人、90,046人和26,195人，随访时间为1年。暴露指标为医院在临终关怀方面的支出指数，包括医院、医生和急诊部门的服务费用。主要结果指标：主要结果指标包括30天和1年的死亡率、再入院率以及主要心脏事件（如AMI和CHF的再入院、心绞痛、CHF或死亡）。结果：不同医院支出组的患者基线健康状况相似。在支出最高的医院与最低的医院之间，所有不良结果的发病率均较低。在支出最高的医院与最低的医院之间，年龄和性别调整后的30天死亡率分别为：AMI为12.7%对12.8%，CHF为10.2%对12.4%，髋部骨折为7.7%对9.7%，CHF为3.3%对3.9%；完全调整后的相对30天死亡率分别为：AMI为0.93（95%置信区间，0.89-0.98），CHF为0.81（95%置信区间，0.76-0.86），髋部骨折为0.74（95%置信区间，0.68-0.80），结肠癌为0.78（95%置信区间，0.66-0.91）。1年死亡率、再入院率和主要心脏事件的结果相似。支出较高的医院拥有更高的护理人员比例，其患者接受了更多的住院医学专家诊疗、介入性治疗（AMI队列）和医学治疗（AMI及CHF队列），以及术前专科护理（结肠癌队列），并且出院后还能与心脏病专家和初级保健医生进行协作护理（AMI及CHF队列）。结论：在安大略省的医院中，较高的支出强度与较低的死亡率、再入院率和心脏事件发生率相关。

abstract.text: The main purpose of the present study was to test for outcome scope insensitivity. Respondents were initially asked to value one of two severe health states by way of a time-trade-off (TTO) exercise. Subsequent to the TTO exercise all respondents were asked to value an intervention, which offered a reduction in risk of falling into the health state they had evaluated. All respondents were subsequent to this initial CV exercise asked to value the same risk reduction, but in this case the outcome was death. Although our study passes the internal scope test, there is not a high degree of sensitivity to outcome. As many as 68% of respondents stated an identical maximum WTP in first and second CV valuation exercise implying that they value the interventions equally despite the fact that the health state presented in the initial CV question was deemed far better than death according to the TTO responses given by the same respondents. In contrast, the external scope test (comparison of response to initial CV across study arms) fared much better.

10.1002/hec.1690.abstractZh: 本研究的主要目的是检验结果范围不敏感性的问题。参与者最初被要求通过时间权衡实验来评价两种严重健康状况中的一种。在时间权衡实验之后，所有参与者又被要求评价一项能够降低他们所评估的健康状态发生风险的干预措施。在这项初始价值评估实验之后，所有参与者又被要求评价同样的风险降低效果，但这次的结果是死亡。尽管我们的研究通过了内部范围测试，但参与者对结果的敏感度并不高。高达68%的参与者在第一次和第二次价值评估实验中给出了相同的最大支付意愿，这表明尽管在初始价值评估问题中呈现的健康状态被认为比死亡要好得多，但参与者对这两种干预措施的价值评价是相同的。相比之下，外部范围测试（即在不同研究组之间比较对初始价值评估的回应）表现得更好。

abstract.text: This paper examines the labor adjustment costs in the health care industry. Using Japanese data, we find that the cost of hiring new health care workers is the largest component of labor adjustment costs in the health care industry. Hence, it is difficult for employers in this industry to immediately increase the number of workers since this employment adjustment is extremely expensive.

10.1002/hec.1691.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医疗保健行业的劳动力调整成本。通过日本的数据分析，我们发现招聘新的医疗保健工作者的成本是医疗保健行业劳动力调整成本中最大的组成部分。因此，该行业的雇主很难立即增加员工数量，因为这种就业调整的成本非常高。

abstract.text: Randomised controlled trial (RCT)-based cost-effectiveness analyses, which are prone to missing data, are increasingly used in healthcare technology assessment. This has highlighted the need for appropriate methodological approaches to the handling of missing data. This paper reviews missing data methodology used in RCT-based cost-effectiveness analyses since 2003. Complete case analysis, which may lead to inappropriate conclusions, is still the most popular approach and its use has increased with time. The degree of missing data in cost-effectiveness analyses was often poorly reported and the methodology was often unclear. Reporting of missing data sensitivity analyses would improve article transparency.

10.1002/hec.1693.abstractZh: 基于随机对照试验的成本效益分析在医疗技术评估中越来越被使用，但这类分析容易出现数据缺失的问题。这凸显了在处理数据缺失时需要采用适当的方法论。本文回顾了自2003年以来在基于随机对照试验的成本效益分析中使用的数据缺失处理方法。完整的案例分析虽然可能导致不恰当的结论，但仍然是最常用的方法，并且其使用频率随时间增加。成本效益分析中的数据缺失程度往往没有得到充分报告，相关方法论也常常不明确。报告数据缺失的敏感性分析可以提高文章的透明度。

abstract.text: We examine how wealth shocks, in the form of inheritances, affect the mortality rates, health status and health behaviors of older adults, using data from eight waves of the Health and Retirement Survey. Our main finding is that bequests do not have substantial effects on health, although improvements in quality-of-life are possible. This absence occurs despite increases in out-of-pocket spending on healthcare and in the utilization of medical services, especially discretionary and non-lifesaving types such as dental care. Nor can we find a convincing indication of changes in lifestyles that offset the benefits of increased medical care. Inheritances are associated with higher alcohol consumption, but with no change in smoking or exercise and a possible decrease in obesity.

10.1002/hec.1695.abstractZh: 我们研究了以遗产形式出现的财富冲击如何影响老年成年人的死亡率、健康状况和健康行为，使用的是《健康与退休调查》的八次数据。我们的主要发现是，遗产对健康的显著影响并不明显，尽管可能会改善生活质量。这种影响的存在与医疗服务的自付支出增加以及医疗服务利用率的提高有关，尤其是那些非生命拯救类型的医疗服务，如牙科护理。我们也没有发现任何能够抵消医疗改善带来的好处的生活方式变化的可靠证据。遗产与较高的酒精消费有关，但吸烟和锻炼情况没有变化，肥胖率可能有所下降。

abstract.text: The potential link between social capital and health suggests important pathways by which health may be improved. We examine this relationship using a unique data set from Argentina. This national survey allows us to determine whether the relationships between social capital and health that have been found in the US and Europe also apply to countries in South America (Argentina is the second-largest country in South America with a population of approximately 40 million). We estimate a causal effect of individual-level social capital on health using a measure of informal social interactions as our measure of social capital. Using information about access to public transportation as instrumental variables, we find that both men and women with higher levels of social capital report better health.

10.1002/hec.1696.abstractZh: 社会资本与健康状况之间可能存在的关联表明，存在多种途径可以改善健康状况。我们借助来自阿根廷的独特数据集来研究这种关系。这项全国性调查使我们能够确定，在美国和欧洲发现的社会资本与健康状况之间的关系是否也适用于南美洲国家（阿根廷是南美洲第二大国家，人口约4000万）。我们通过非正式社交互动来衡量社会资本，并估算了个体层面的社会资本对健康的因果效应。利用公共交通接入情况作为工具变量，我们发现，拥有较高社会资本的人，无论是男性还是女性，其健康状况都更为良好。

abstract.text: Discrete choice experiments (DCEs) have become a commonly used instrument in health economics. This paper updates a review of published papers between 1990 and 2000 for the years 2001-2008. Based on this previous review, and a number of other key review papers, focus is given to three issues: experimental design; estimation procedures; and validity of responses. Consideration is also given to how DCEs are applied and reported. We identified 114 DCEs, covering a wide range of policy questions. Applications took place in a broader range of health-care systems, and there has been a move to incorporating fewer attributes, more choices and interview-based surveys. There has also been a shift towards statistically more efficient designs and flexible econometric models. The reporting of monetary values continues to be popular, the use of utility scores has not gained popularity, and there has been an increasing use of odds ratios and probabilities. The latter are likely to be useful at the policy level to investigate take-up and acceptability of new interventions. Incorporation of interactions terms in the design and analysis of DCEs, explanations of risk, tests of external validity and incorporation of DCE results into a decision-making framework remain important areas for future research.

10.1002/hec.1697.abstractZh: 离散选择实验已成为健康经济学中常用的工具。本文对1990至2000年间发表的论文进行了更新，涵盖了2001至2008年的研究。基于之前的综述以及其他关键综述论文，本文重点关注三个问题：实验设计、估计方法以及回答的有效性。同时，本文还探讨了离散选择实验的应用与报告方式。我们共识别出114项离散选择实验，涉及广泛的政策问题。这些实验在更广泛的医疗保健系统中进行，并且出现了将更少属性、更多选择以及基于访谈的调查方式纳入其中的趋势。此外，设计上更倾向于采用统计上更有效的模型，以及更灵活的经济计量学模型。货币价值的报告仍然很受欢迎，而效用评分的使用则没有变得普遍。 odds比率和概率的使用则有所增加。后者在政策层面对于调查新干预措施的接受程度非常有用。在离散选择实验的设计与分析中纳入交互项、解释风险、检验外部有效性以及将实验结果纳入决策框架，仍然是未来研究的重要领域。

abstract.text: We develop a model to analyze parallel public and private health-care financing under two alternative public sector rationing rules: needs-based rationing and random rationing. Individuals vary in income and severity of illness. There is a limited supply of health-care resources used to treat individuals, causing some individuals to go untreated. Insurers (both public and private) must bid to obtain the necessary health-care resources to treat their beneficiaries. Given individuals' willingnesses-to-pay for private insurance are increasing in income, the introduction of private insurance diverts treatment from relatively poor to relatively rich individuals. Further, the impact of introducing parallel private insurance depends on the rationing mechanism in the public sector. We show that the private health insurance market is smaller when the public sector rations according to need than when allocation is random.

10.1002/hec.1698.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，用于分析在两种不同的公共部门配给规则下，公共和私人医疗资金的并行分配情况：基于需求的配给和随机配给。个体的收入和疾病严重程度各不相同。用于治疗个体的医疗资源是有限的，导致一些个体无法得到治疗。保险公司（包括公共和私人保险公司）必须竞标以获得必要的医疗资源来为他们的受益人提供治疗。鉴于个体购买私人保险的意愿随着收入的增加而提高，引入私人保险可以将治疗从相对贫困的个体转移到相对富裕的个体身上。此外，引入并行私人保险的影响取决于公共部门的配给机制。我们表明，当公共部门根据需求进行配给时，私人健康保险市场比随机分配时要小。

abstract.text: We describe how a modified Gini index serves as an improved method of estimating health care disparities. The method, although general, is applied to an example of birth weight disparities and to their effect on subsequent mortality. The method provides the between-group results obtainable from current methods (i.e. how Hispanics generally fare relative to non-Hispanic Whites) but adds measures of within-group disparities (i.e. which specific Hispanics experience the greatest disparate treatment). Our application to birth weights and receipt of prenatal care, which may provide an upper bound because of omitted variables, shows that the time-of-birth disparities are associated with increased infant mortality within the first year of life.

10.1002/hec.1699.abstractZh: 我们描述了一种改进的基尼指数如何作为估算医疗差异的改进方法。该方法虽然具有通用性，但被应用于出生体重差异的实例，以及这些差异对后续死亡率的影响。该方法提供了当前方法所能获得的群体间结果（即西班牙裔与非西班牙裔白人相比的一般情况），同时增加了对群体内部差异的衡量（即哪些特定西班牙裔群体遭受了最大的差异待遇）。我们将该方法应用于出生体重和产前护理的获取情况，由于遗漏了某些变量，这种方法可能提供了一个上限。结果表明，出生时间的差异与婴儿在出生后的第一年内的死亡率增加有关。

abstract.text: One of the perceived symptoms of US Medicare inefficiency is the existence of the dramatic variation in spending and utilization in different areas of the country. This study uses the Continuous Medicare History Sample, a large longitudinal 5% sample of all Medicare beneficiaries from 1974 to 2003, to study the issue. We show that the spending and utilization disparities are significant at the aggregate state level. More importantly, the variation shows signs of narrowing over time, particularly in the earlier years of the sample period and in some cases following major reforms. However, it remains significant even after an array of demographic, demand and supply side factors are controlled for.

10.1002/hec.1700.abstractZh: 美国医疗保险体系效率低下的一个明显现象是，全国不同地区的支出和利用率存在巨大差异。本研究采用了连续的医疗保险历史样本数据，该样本涵盖了1974年至2003年间所有医疗保险受益人的5%大样本，以研究这一问题。我们发现，在州级层面上，支出和利用率的差异是显著的。更重要的是，随着时间的推移，这种差异有所缩小，尤其是在样本期的早期，以及在一些重大改革之后。然而，即使控制了各种人口统计、需求和供应方面的因素后，这种差异仍然显著。

abstract.text: Although the relationship between socioeconomic status (SES) and health is well documented for developed countries, less evidence has been presented for developing countries. The aim of this paper is to analyse this relationship at the household level for Fiji, a developing country in the South Pacific, using original household survey data. To allow for the endogeneity of SES status in the household health production function, we utilize a simultaneous equation approach where estimates are achieved by full information maximum likelihood. By restricting our sample to one, relatively small island, and including area and district hospital effects, physical geography effects are unpacked from income effects. We measure SES, as permanent income which is constructed using principal components analysis. An alternative specification considers transitory household income. We find that a 1% increase in wealth (our measure of permanent income) would lead to a 15% decrease in the probability of an incapacitating illness occurring intra-household. Although the presence of a strong relationship indicates that relatively small improvements in SES status can significantly improve health at the household level, it is argued that the design of appropriate policy would also require an understanding of the various mechanisms through which the relationship operates.

10.1002/hec.1703.abstractZh: 尽管在发达国家，社会经济地位与健康状况之间的关系已有充分的研究记录，但在发展中国家这方面的证据却相对较少。本文旨在利用原始的住户调查数据，分析南太平洋发展中国家斐济的家庭层面上的这一关系。为了考虑社会经济地位在家庭健康产出函数中的内生性，我们采用了联立方程方法，并通过全信息最大似然法获得估计值。通过将样本限制在一个相对较小的岛屿上，并纳入地区及区域医院的影响因素，我们能够从收入效应中分离出物理地理因素的影响。我们采用主成分分析来测量社会经济地位，即永久收入。另一种方法则考虑了家庭收入的暂时性特征。研究发现，财富（我们用来衡量永久收入的标准）每增加1%，导致家庭内部发生致残性疾病的概率下降15%。虽然这种强相关性表明社会经济地位的较小改善能够显著改善家庭层面的健康状况，但我们认为，制定适当的政策也需要了解这种关系通过哪些机制发挥作用。

abstract.text: We assessed how much, if anything, people would pay for a laboratory test that predicted their future disease status. A questionnaire was administered via an internet-based survey to a random sample of adult US respondents. Each respondent answered questions about two different scenarios, each of which specified: one of four randomly selected diseases (Alzheimer's, arthritis, breast cancer, or prostate cancer); an ex ante risk of developing the disease (randomly designated 10 or 25%); and test accuracy (randomly designated perfect or 'not perfectly accurate'). Willingness-to-pay (WTP) was elicited with a double-bounded, dichotomous-choice approach. Of 1463 respondents who completed the survey, most (70-88%, depending on the scenario) were inclined to take the test. Inclination to take the test was lower for Alzheimer's and higher for prostate cancer compared with arthritis, and rose somewhat with disease prevalence and for the perfect versus imperfect test [Correction made here after initial online publication.]. Median WTP varied from $109 for the imperfect arthritis test to $263 for the perfect prostate cancer test. Respondents' preferences for predictive testing, even in the absence of direct treatment consequences, reflected health and non-health related factors, and suggests that conventional cost-effectiveness analyses may underestimate the value of testing.

10.1002/hec.1704.abstractZh: 我们评估了人们愿意为一项能够预测未来疾病状态的实验室检测支付多少费用，如果有的话。通过基于互联网的问卷调查，对随机选取的美国成年人样本进行了调查。每位受访者回答了关于两种不同情景的问题，每种情景都包含以下内容：四种随机选定的疾病之一（阿尔茨海默病、关节炎、乳腺癌或前列腺癌）；疾病发生的先验风险（随机指定为10%或25%）；以及检测的准确率（随机指定为完美或不完全准确）。通过双边界二分选择法来测定人们的支付意愿。在完成调查的1463名受访者中，大多数（根据情景的不同，比例在70%到88%之间）倾向于接受这项检测。与关节炎相比，人们更倾向于接受阿尔茨海默病和前列腺癌的检测，而随着疾病患病率的上升，以及检测准确率的不同，这种倾向也有所增加。中位支付意愿从不完美的关节炎检测为109美元到完美的前列腺癌检测为263美元不等。即使在没有直接治疗后果的情况下，受访者对预测性检测的偏好反映了与健康相关的和非健康相关因素，这表明传统的成本效益分析可能低估了检测的价值。

abstract.text: Important assumptions that underlie cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA) are that production technologies are convex and that production processes always perform at constant returns to scale. However, in the short run these assumptions are likely to be violated. Therefore, CEAs might overestimate cost-effectiveness in the short run. To come up with a more precise cost-effectiveness outcome, we present a model that is able to correct the long-run incremental net benefit (INB) for short-run inefficiencies. This provides decision makers with a more realistic view of the expected efficiency gains. This model starts by determining the initial efficiency losses inflicted by inflexible resources. Then the model is made dynamic in order to adjust the efficiency losses by allowing for refilling and writing off freed capacity. Finally, the model calculates the length of the short-run time frame in which such efficiency losses exist, and a correction term with which the usual long-run INB should be adjusted to account for short-run inefficiencies. The model is applied to two cases: dialysis and digitizing a radiography department. The dialysis case shows moderate short-run efficiency losses while in the radiography case short-run efficiency losses are sufficiently large to cause a switch in cost-effectiveness from favorable to inefficient in the short run.

10.1002/hec.1705.abstractZh: 成本效益分析（CEA）的基本假设是，生产技术是凸的，且生产过程始终在规模报酬不变的情况下进行。然而，在短期内，这些假设可能会被违反。因此，CEA可能会在短期内高估成本效益。为了得出更精确的成本效益结果，我们提出了一个模型，该模型能够纠正长期增量净收益（INB）中的短期效率损失。这为决策者提供了更现实的效率提升预期。该模型首先确定由不灵活资源造成的初始效率损失，然后使模型具有动态性，以便通过允许补充和注销释放的容量来调整效率损失。最后，模型计算出存在此类效率损失的短期时间长度，并引入一个修正项，以调整通常的长期INB，从而考虑到短期效率损失。该模型被应用于两个案例：透析和放射科数字化。透析案例显示出中等程度的短期效率损失，而在放射科数字化案例中，短期效率损失足够大，以至于短期内成本效益从有利转变为无利。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of variation in unexpected demand on patient outcomes in acute care German hospitals. Naturally, an unexpected surge in demand may negatively affect the quality of care and thus patient outcomes, such as in-hospital mortality. We estimate models explaining patient outcomes depending on demand, unobservable patient selection and seasonal factors, as well as patient-specific risk factors and unobservable hospital and department fixed-effects. The main message of this analysis is that hospitals are well prepared to deal with this unexpected volatility in demand, as by and large it does not negatively affect patient outcomes. Hospitals seem to deal with high unexpected workload by steering the patients' length of stay relating to their severity of illness. Elective patients are discharged earlier, while discharges of high-risk emergency patients are postponed.

10.1002/hec.1706.abstractZh: 本文探讨了意外需求变化对德国急性护理医院患者治疗效果的影响。显然，意外的需求激增可能会负面影响护理质量，进而影响患者的治疗效果，例如住院死亡率。我们建立了模型来解释与患者需求、不可观测的患者选择、季节因素以及特定患者风险因素相关的治疗效果，同时考虑了医院和科室的固定效应。分析的主要结论是，医院已经做好了应对这种意外需求波动的准备，因为总体而言，这种波动并不会对患者的治疗效果产生负面影响。医院似乎通过根据患者的病情调整患者的住院时间来应对意外的高工作量。择期手术的患者会提前出院，而高风险急诊患者的出院时间则会被推迟。

abstract.text: A large random sample of the Danish general population was asked to value health improvements by way of both the time trade-off elicitation technique and willingness-to-pay (WTP) using contingent valuation methods. The data demonstrate a high degree of heterogeneity across respondents in their relative valuations on the two scales. This has implications for data analysis. We show that the estimates of WTP per QALY are highly sensitive to the analytical strategy. For both open-ended and dichotomous choice data we demonstrate that choice of aggregated approach (ratios of means) or disaggregated approach (means of ratios) affects estimates markedly as does the interpretation of the constant term (which allows for disproportionality across the two scales) in the regression analyses. We propose that future research should focus on why some respondents are unwilling to trade on the time trade-off scale, on how to interpret the constant value in the regression analyses, and on how best to capture the heterogeneity in preference structures when applying mixed multinomial logit.

10.1002/hec.1709.abstractZh: 对丹麦普通人群进行了大规模随机抽样，要求他们通过时间权衡法和意愿支付法来评估健康改善的效益。数据显示，不同受访者对这两个评估指标的估值存在高度异质性。这一结果对数据分析具有重要意义。我们发现，每QALY的意愿支付估计值对分析策略非常敏感。无论是开放式还是二分选择数据，我们均发现，采用聚合方法（均值比率）还是分解方法（比率均值）都会显著影响估计结果，同样，回归分析中常数项的解释方式也会产生影响（常数项的处理方式可以解决两个评估指标之间的不均衡问题）。我们建议未来的研究应重点关注：为何有些受访者不愿意在时间权衡指标上进行权衡；如何解释回归分析中的常数项；以及如何在应用混合多项逻辑模型时最好地捕捉偏好结构的异质性。

abstract.text: This paper introduces a concept called 'demand-induced supply' that reflects the excess supply of services due to an increase in demand initiated by patients. We examine its association with the proportion of information-savvy patients in physicians' practice. Using data from a national representative physician survey, we apply latent class models to analyze this association. Our analyses categorize physicians into three 'types' according to the frequency with which they provided additional medical services at their patients' requests: frequent, occasional, and rare. The proportion of information-savvy patients is significantly and positively correlated with demand-induced supply for the frequent or occasional type, but not among physicians in the rare type. Efforts to contain healthcare costs through utilization control need to recognize the pattern of responses from physicians who treat an increasing number of information-savvy patients.

10.1002/hec.1710.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一种称为“需求引发的供给”的概念，它反映了由于患者需求增加而导致的服务供应过剩现象。我们研究了这一概念与医生诊所中具备信息素养的患者比例之间的关联。通过一项全国性的医生调查数据，我们运用潜在类别模型来分析这一关联。我们的分析将医生分为三种“类型”，根据他们根据患者需求提供额外医疗服务频率的不同：频繁、偶尔和罕见。具备信息素养的患者比例与频繁或偶尔类型的医生因需求引发的供给呈显著正相关，但在罕见类型的医生中则不存在这种相关性。为了控制医疗成本，需要通过利用控制使用率的方式来应对那些治疗越来越多具备信息素养患者的医生的反应模式。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of retirement on various health outcomes. Data stem from the first three waves of the English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA). With these informative data, non-parametric matching and instrumental variable (IV) methods are applied to identify causal effects. It is found that retirement significantly increases the risk of being diagnosed with a chronic condition. In particular, it raises the risk of a severe cardiovascular disease and cancer. This is also reflected in increased risk factors (e.g. BMI, cholesterol, blood pressure) and increased problems in physical activities. Furthermore, retirement worsens self-assessed health and an underlying health stock.

10.1002/hec.1712.abstractZh: 本文研究了退休对多种健康结果的影响。数据来源于英国老龄化纵向研究的前三波调查。利用这些数据，采用非参数匹配和工具变量方法来确定因果效应。研究发现，退休显著增加了被诊断出慢性疾病的风险，尤其是严重心血管疾病和癌症的风险。这一结果还体现在风险因素的增加（如体重指数、胆固醇、血压）以及体力活动问题的增多上。此外，退休还恶化了自我评估的健康状况以及潜在的健康储备。

abstract.text: The aim of this paper is to study (adverse) selection in a labor supply model where potential applicants are characterized by different vocational levels and skills. We look at how the composition of the pool of active workers changes as the wage rate increases. Contrary to what would expect, average productivity does not necessarily increase monotonically in the wage rate. We identify conditions in which a wage increase reduces the average productivity and/or average vocation of active workers. Our results help understand the potential impact of wage increases as a policy designed to resolving shortages in the labor market for nurses.

10.1002/hec.1713.abstractZh: 本文旨在研究在劳动力供应模型中发生的（逆向）选择现象，其中潜在求职者具有不同的职业水平和技能。我们探讨了随着工资率上升，活跃工人群体的构成如何发生变化。与预期相反，平均生产率并不一定会随工资率的增加而单调上升。我们确定了工资增加会降低活跃工人的平均生产率和/或平均职业水平的条件。我们的研究结果有助于理解工资增加作为政策工具的潜在影响，以缓解护士劳动力市场的短缺问题。

abstract.text: Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) reached an all-time high of 40.2 million persons in March 2010, which means the program affects a substantial fraction of Americans. A significant body of research has emerged suggesting that participation in SNAP increases the probability of being obese for adult women and has little effect on the probability for adult men. However, studies addressing the effects of participation on children have produced mixed results. This paper examines the effect of long-term SNAP participation on the Body Mass Index (BMI) percentile and probability of being overweight or obese for children ages 5-18 using data from the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979 Children and Young Adults data set. An instrumental variables identification strategy that exploits exogenous variation in state-level program parameters, as well as state and federal expansions of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC), is used to address the endogeneity between SNAP participation and obesity. SNAP participation is found to significantly reduce BMI percentile and the probability of being overweight or obese for boys and girls ages 5-11 and boys ages 12-18. For girls ages 12-18, SNAP participation appears to have no significant effect on these outcomes.

10.1002/hec.1714.abstractZh: 在2010年3月，参与补充营养援助计划（SNAP）的人数达到了历史最高水平，共有4002万人受益，这意味着该计划影响了相当大比例的美国人。大量研究表明，参与SNAP会增加成年女性肥胖的风险，而对成年男性的肥胖风险影响较小。然而，关于儿童参与SNAP对其肥胖风险影响的研究结果并不一致。本文利用1979年青年纵向调查儿童和年轻人数据集的数据，研究了长期参与SNAP对5-18岁儿童体重指数（BMI）百分位数以及超重或肥胖概率的影响。通过利用州级计划参数以及州和联邦对劳动收入税收抵免政策扩展的外生变量识别策略，本文探讨了SNAP参与与肥胖之间的内生关系。研究发现，对于5-11岁的男孩和女孩以及12-18岁的男孩来说，参与SNAP显著降低了BMI百分位数和超重或肥胖的概率。而对于12-18岁的女孩来说，参与SNAP对这些结果几乎没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This is a first effort to quantify the contribution of different factors in explaining racial difference in low birthweight rate (LBW). Mother's health, child characteristics, prenatal care, socioeconomic status (SES), and the socioeconomic and healthcare environment of mother's community are important inputs into the birthweight production function, and a vast literature has delved into obtaining causal estimates of their effect on infant health. What is unknown is how much of the racial gap in LBW is explained by all these inputs together. We apply a nonlinear extension of the Oaxaca-Blinder method proposed by Fairlie to decompose this gap into the portion explained by differences in observed characteristics and the portion that remains unexplained. Data are obtained from several sources in order to capture as many observables as possible, although the primary data source is the Natality Detail Files. Results show that of the 6.8 percentage point racial gap in LBW, only 0.9-1.9 points are explained by white-black differences in endowments across those measures, and of those endowments, most of the gap in LBW is explained by the differences in SES. The unexplained difference is attributed to racial differences in the returns to or the marginal product of investments in infant health.

10.1002/hec.1715.abstractZh: 这是首次尝试量化不同因素在解释种族间低出生体重率差异中的贡献。母亲的健康状况、儿童特征、产前护理、社会经济地位，以及母亲所在社区的社会经济和医疗环境，都是影响出生体重生成函数的重要因素。大量研究已经探讨了这些因素对婴儿健康的因果影响。目前尚不清楚种族间低出生体重率的差异究竟有多少可以通过这些因素共同解释。我们采用了Fairlie提出的Oaxaca-Blinder方法的非线性扩展版本，将这一差异分解为由观察到的特征差异所解释的部分和仍无法解释的部分。数据来自多个来源，以尽可能多地捕捉可观测变量，其中主要数据来源是Natality Detail Files。结果显示，在6.8个百分点的种族间低出生体重率差异中，只有0.9-1.9个百分点可以通过白人与黑人之间在这些指标上的差异来解释，而在这些差异中，大部分低出生体重率的差异是由社会经济地位的差异所解释的。无法解释的差异则归因于种族间在婴儿健康投资回报或边际产品方面的差异。

abstract.text: This paper examines the expenditure choices of local health authorities operating under fixed budget constraints. It applies a theoretical model of budgeting to a data set from 303 English Primary Care Trusts (PCTs) across ten broad programmes of health care to derive estimates of the elasticity of expenditure in each programme with respect to the total income of the PCT. The results suggest quite similar income elasticities across most programmes, in the range 0.644-1.128. The only outlier is the musculoskeletal programme with an elasticity of about 0.46. The modelling also derives estimates of spending elasticities with respect to medical needs and thereby permits calculation of the implicit cost of saving a life year in five programmes of care. The results are important as they indicate to policy makers how specific programme areas might be affected by general budgetary reductions.

10.1002/hec.1716.abstractZh: 本文研究了在固定预算约束下运作的当地卫生当局的支出选择。本文采用预算理论模型，基于303个英格兰初级保健信托机构的数据集，分析了每个保健项目的支出弹性与信托机构总收入之间的关系。结果表明，大多数项目的收入弹性相当接近，范围在0.644到1.128之间。唯一的例外是肌肉骨骼项目，其支出弹性约为0.46。模型还估算了支出对医疗需求的弹性，从而能够计算出在五个保健项目中挽救一条生命所带来的隐性成本。这些结果对于政策制定者来说非常重要，因为它们有助于了解特定项目如何受到整体预算削减的影响。

abstract.text: While highly pertinent to the human welfare consequences of development, the impact of rapid urbanization on population health is not obvious. This paper uses community and individual-level longitudinal data from the China Health and Nutrition Survey to estimate the net health impact of China's unprecedented urbanization. We construct an index of urbanicity from a broad set of community characteristics and define urbanization in terms of movements across the distribution of this index. We use difference-in-differences estimators to identify the treatment effect of urbanization on the self-assessed health of individuals. We find that urbanization raises the probability of reporting of poor health and that a greater degree of urbanization has a larger effect. The effect may, in part, be attributable to changed health expectations, but it also appears to operate through health behaviour. Populations experiencing urbanization tend to consume more fat and smoke more.

10.1002/hec.1717.abstractZh: 虽然城市化对人类福祉的影响非常重要，但城市化对人口健康的影响并不明显。本文利用中国健康与营养调查中的社区和个体层面的纵向数据，估算了中国前所未有的城市化进程对健康的净影响。我们从一个广泛的社区特征集合中构建了一个城市化指数，并根据该指数的分布变化来定义城市化。我们使用差异-差异估计方法来确定城市化对个体自我评估健康状况的影响。研究发现，城市化增加了报告健康状况不佳的概率，而且城市化程度越高，这种影响越明显。这种影响可能部分归因于健康期望的变化，但似乎也通过健康行为来发挥作用。经历城市化的群体往往摄入更多的脂肪并吸烟更多。

abstract.text: We examine the link between employment status and suicide risk using a panel of US states from 1996 to 2005 with monthly data on suicides, the duration of unemployment spells and the number of job losses associated with mass-layoff events. The use of aggregate data at the monthly level along with the distribution of unemployment duration allows us to separate the effect of job loss from the effect of unemployment duration, an important distinction for policy purposes, especially for the timing of potential interventions. Our results are consistent with unemployment duration being the dominant force in the relationship between job loss and suicide. Nevertheless, mass-layoffs may be powerful localized events where suicide risk increases shortly afterward. Implications for the design of unemployment insurance are discussed.

10.1002/hec.1719.abstractZh: 我们研究了就业状况与自杀风险之间的关联，使用了1996至2005年间美国各州的月度数据，这些数据包含了自杀事件的数量、失业时间的长短以及因大规模裁员事件导致的失业人数。通过采用月度级别的总体数据以及失业时间的分布，我们能够区分失业损失的影响与失业持续时间的影响，这对于政策制定非常重要，尤其是在确定潜在干预措施的时间点时。我们的研究结果表明，失业持续时间是失业与自杀之间关系中的主要因素。不过，大规模裁员可能是具有地域性的事件，在这些事件中，自杀风险会在短时间内上升。文章还讨论了关于失业保险设计的启示。

abstract.text: This paper applies latent-class multinomial logit models to the choice of hospital for cataract operations in the UK NHS. We concentrate on the effects of travel time and waiting time and especially on estimating the waiting time elasticity of demand. Models including hospital fixed effects rely on changes over time in waiting time to indentify coefficients. We show how using a latent-class multinomial logit model characterises the unobserved heterogeneity in GP practices' choice behaviour and affects the estimated elasticities of travel time and waiting time. The models estimate waiting time elasticities of demand of approximately -0.1, comparable with previous waiting time-demand models. For the average waiting time elasticity, the simple multinomial logit models are good approximations of the latent-class logit results.

10.1002/hec.1720.abstractZh: 本文采用潜在类别多项式逻辑模型来分析英国国家医疗服务体系下白内障手术选择的决策过程。我们重点关注旅行时间和等待时间的影响，尤其关注等待时间需求弹性的估计。包含医院固定效应的模型依赖于对等待时间随时间的变化来识别系数。我们展示了如何使用潜在类别多项式逻辑模型来描述GP诊所选择行为中的未观测异质性，并影响对旅行时间和等待时间弹性的估计。模型估计出的需求弹性约为-0.1，与之前关于等待时间需求的模型结果相当。对于平均等待时间弹性而言，简单的多项式逻辑模型能够很好地近似潜在类别逻辑模型的估计结果。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence indicates that children living in wealthier households have better health. Food insecurity could be related to lack of adequate nutrition experienced by poor children and may be pointed out as one of the possible explanations for this relationship. This paper investigates the association between food insecurity and children's health and nutrition and the role of the former in the child health income gradient. Using data from the 2006 Brazilian Demographic and Health Survey, the results show that children living in households with food insecurity have worse nutrition and health indicators. In addition, the relationship between household income and many children's health and nutrition measures weakens but remains significant when controlling for food insecurity.

10.1002/hec.1722.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，生活在富裕家庭中的儿童健康状况更好。食物不安全可能与贫困儿童缺乏足够的营养有关，这可能是解释这种关系的一个可能因素。本文研究了食物不安全与儿童健康和营养之间的关联，以及前者在儿童健康与收入关系中的角色。根据2006年巴西人口与健康调查的数据，结果显示，生活在食物不安全家庭中的儿童在营养和健康指标方面表现较差。此外，尽管在控制食物不安全因素后，家庭收入与许多儿童健康和营养指标之间的关系有所减弱，但仍具有显著性。

abstract.text: Newer technologies to treat many mental illnesses have shown substantial heterogeneity in diffusion rates across states. In this paper, I investigate whether variation in the level of managed care penetration is associated with changes in state-level diffusion of three newer classes of psychotropic medications in fee-for-service Medicaid programs from 1991 to 2005. Three different types of managed care programs are examined: capitated managed care, any type of managed care and behavioral health carve-outs. A fourth-order polynomial fixed effect regression model is used to model the diffusion path of newer antidepressant and antipsychotic medications controlling for time-varying state characteristics. Substantial differences are found in the diffusion paths by the degree of managed care use in each state Medicaid program. The largest effect is seen through spillover effects of capitated managed care programs; states with greater capitated managed care have greater initial shares of newer psychotropic medications. The influence of carve-outs and of all types of managed care combined on the diffusion path was modest.

10.1002/hec.1723.abstractZh: 用于处理多种精神疾病的新型技术在不同州之间的传播速度表现出显著的异质性。本文研究了在1991年至2005年间，三种新型精神药物在按服务收费的医疗补助计划中的州级传播情况，以及管理式医疗覆盖程度的差异是否与这些传播情况有关。本文考察了三种不同类型的管理式医疗计划：总额预算管理式医疗、任何类型的管理式医疗以及行为健康领域的独立管理式医疗。采用四阶多项式固定效应回归模型来模拟新型抗抑郁药和抗精神病药的传播路径，同时考虑了随时间变化的州特征。研究发现，各州医疗补助计划中的管理式医疗使用程度对新型精神药物的传播路径产生了显著影响。其中，总额预算管理式医疗计划的溢出效应最为明显；拥有更多总额预算管理式医疗计划的州，新型精神药物的初始使用比例也更高。而独立管理式医疗以及所有类型的管理式医疗对新型精神药物传播路径的影响则较为有限。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the growing body of literature that debates whether the adoption of pharmaceutical innovation increases the overall expenditure on health care. By examining data obtained from Taiwan and focusing on diabetic patients, we use a new class of drugs, namely, thiazolidinediones, as an example to investigate the effect on health expenditure of prescribing new drugs to patients by focusing on the impact of treatment substitution and treatment expansion. Overall, our results indicate that the introduction of new drugs mainly impacts the outpatient drug expenditure and does not give rise to any offsetting effect on other outpatient and inpatient health expenditures. This suggests that the adoption of pharmaceutical innovation in treating diabetic patients is expenditure-increasing. In addition, we find evidence that the treatment substitution channel has a more significant impact on the level of health expenditure than the treatment expansion channel. An important policy implication for our finding is that the justification for increasing health expenditure on the treatment of diabetes is not conditional upon a lowering in the demand for other types of health-care services. By contrast, it is conditional upon the increased health benefits per se.

10.1002/hec.1724.abstractZh: 本文为关于药物创新采用是否会增加整体医疗支出的学术文献做出了贡献。通过研究台湾的数据，并重点关注糖尿病患者，我们以噻唑烷二酮类药物为例，探讨了向患者开具新药物对医疗支出的影响，重点分析了治疗替代和治疗扩展的影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，新药物的引入主要影响门诊用药支出，并未对其他门诊和住院医疗支出产生抵消效应。这表明，在糖尿病治疗中使用药物创新确实会增加医疗支出。此外，我们发现治疗替代渠道对医疗支出水平的影响比治疗扩展渠道更为显著。这一发现的一个重要政策启示是，增加糖尿病治疗的医疗支出的理由并不取决于其他类型医疗服务的需求降低，而是取决于医疗效益本身的增加。

abstract.text: We consider the relationship between health and time allocation in the American Time Use Survey. Better health is associated with large positive effects on home production and larger positive effects on market production, but less consumption of leisure. Theoretically, if market- and home-produced goods are perfect substitutes, the positive correlation between health and home production implies that health exerts larger effects on home than on market efficiency. Notably, these correlations are higher for single people than for married people, perhaps reflecting a lack of market substitutes for the time of married people.

10.1002/hec.1725.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国时间使用调查中的健康与时间分配之间的关系。健康状况越好，对家庭生产的积极影响越大，对市场生产的积极影响也越大，但休闲消费则较少。从理论上讲，如果市场生产和家庭生产的产品是完全替代品，那么健康与家庭生产之间的正相关性意味着健康对家庭效率的影响大于对市场效率的影响。值得注意的是，这种相关性在单身人士中比已婚人士更高，这或许反映了已婚人士缺乏市场替代品。

abstract.text: A physician's own time is a scarce resource in primary care, and the physician must constantly evaluate the gain from spending more time with the current patient against moving to address the health-care needs of the next. We formulate and test two alternative hypotheses. The first hypothesis is based on the premise that with time so scarce, physicians equalize the marginal value of time across patients. The second, alternative hypothesis states that physicians allocate the same time to each patient, regardless of how much the patient benefits from the time at the margin. For our empirical work, we examine the presence of a sharply increasing subjective shadow price of time around the 'target' time using video recordings of 385 visits by elderly patients to their primary care physician. We structure the data at the 'topic' level and find evidence consistent with the alternative hypothesis. Specifically, time elapsed within a visit is a very strong determinant of the current topic being the 'last topic'. This finding implies the physician's shadow price of time is rising during the course of a visit. We consider whether dislodging a target-time mentality from physicians (and patients) might contribute to more productive primary care practice.

10.1002/hec.1726.abstractZh: 在初级医疗中，医生自己的时间是一种稀缺资源，医生必须不断评估将更多时间用于当前患者所带来的收益，与转而去处理下一个患者的医疗需求之间的权衡。我们提出了两个替代假设。第一个假设基于这样的前提：由于时间如此稀缺，医生会在不同患者之间均衡时间的边际价值。第二个替代假设认为，医生会为每个患者分配相同的时间，而不考虑患者从边际时间中获得的收益多少。在我们的实证研究中，我们通过录像记录了385位老年患者与初级医生就诊的过程，观察在“目标时间”前后时间的主观影子价格是否显著增加。我们对数据进行了“主题”层面的分析，发现与替代假设一致的证据。具体来说，就诊期间所花费的时间非常显著地决定了当前“主题”是否为“最后主题”。这一发现意味着医生在就诊过程中的时间影子价格正在上升。我们考虑，从医生（以及患者）身上消除“目标时间”观念，是否有助于实现更高效的初级医疗实践。

abstract.text: Authors of benefit-incidence analyses (BIA) have to impute subsidies using assumptions about the relationship between unobserved subsidies 'captured' by the household and what can be observed at the household and aggregate levels. This paper shows that one of the two assumptions used in BIA studies to date will necessarily produce a more pro-rich (or less pro-poor) picture of government health spending than the other, depending on whether utilization is more pro-rich or pro-poor than fees paid to public providers. Both assumptions have their disadvantages, and the paper suggests a couple of alternatives that explicitly link fees paid to the costliness of care. It shows that in the most likely case where fees are distributed in a more pro-rich fashion than utilization, the two traditional assumptions will produce less pro-rich distributions of subsidies than the two new alternatives. Also considered are three complications that arise in BIA studies, including factoring in social health insurance. The paper's theoretical results are illustrated with an empirical BIA for Vietnam.

10.1002/hec.1727.abstractZh: 进行福利影响分析（BIA）的学者们需要依据一些假设来估算补贴金额，这些假设涉及家庭层面无法观察到的补贴与家庭及整体层面可观察到的补贴之间的关系。本文指出，迄今为止在BIA研究中使用的两个假设中，其中一个假设必然会得出比另一个更偏向富人（或更偏向穷人）的政府医疗支出结果，这取决于医疗服务的利用是否更偏向富人或穷人，而非向公共服务提供者支付的费用。这两种假设都有其局限性，本文提出了一些替代方案，这些方案明确将费用与医疗服务的成本联系起来。研究表明，在费用分配更偏向富人而非利用情况最有可能发生的情形下，传统的两种假设所得出的补贴分配结果将比两种新方案更偏向富人。此外，本文还考虑了BIA研究中出现的三种复杂情况，包括社会医疗保险的考量。通过越南的实证数据对本文的理论结果进行了验证。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to estimate the economic impact of a comprehensive smoking ban in all enclosed public places of work, on bars in Ireland. The demand in bars, represented by a monthly index of sales volume, is explained by relative prices in bars, prices of alcohol sold in off-licences and the aggregate retail sales (ARS) as a proxy for general economic activity and incomes. The smoking ban is included into the model as a step dummy and the modelling is done using ARIMAX strategy. The results show a reduction in the volume of sales in bars by -4.6% (p<0.01) following the ban.

10.1002/hec.1728.abstractZh: 本文首次估算了在爱尔兰所有封闭式工作场所实施全面禁烟令对酒吧经济的影响。酒吧的销售额以月度销售指数表示，其变化受到酒吧内相对价格、专卖店酒精价格以及作为整体经济活动和收入代理指标的零售总额的影响。禁烟令作为虚拟变量被纳入模型中，建模采用ARIMAX策略。结果显示，禁烟令实施后，酒吧的销售额减少了4.6%（p<0.01）。

abstract.text: The objective of this paper is to evaluate the effect of a non-fatal road crash on the health-related quality of life of injured people. A new approach based on the cardinalization of categorical Self-Assessed Health valuations is suggested. Health losses have been estimated by using different Time Trade-off and Visual Analogue Scale tariffs, in order to assess the robustness of the results. The methodology is based on the existing literature about treatment effects. Our main contribution focuses on evaluating the loss of health up to 1 year after the non-fatal accident, for those who are non-institutionalized, which aids the appropriate estimation of the aggregated health losses in quality-of-life terms.

10.1002/hec.1729.abstractZh: 本文的目的是评估非致命性道路事故对受伤者健康相关生活质量的影响。本文提出了一种基于分类自我评估健康价值量化的新方法。通过使用不同的时间权衡和视觉类比量表来估算健康损失，以评估结果的稳健性。该方法基于现有关于治疗效果的文献。我们的主要贡献在于评估非致命事故后1年内健康损失的状况，特别是对于那些未接受住院治疗的人群，这有助于更准确地估算健康损失的综合影响。

abstract.text: Appropriate decisions based on cost-effectiveness evaluations of health-care technologies depend upon the cost-effectiveness threshold and its rate of growth as well as some social rate of time preference for health. A more traditional approach to this problem is outlined before a social decision-making approach is developed, which demonstrates that social time preference for health is revealed through the budget allocations made by a socially legitimate higher authority. The relationship between the social time preference rate for health, the growth rate of the cost-effectiveness threshold and the rate at which the higher authority can borrow or invest is then examined. We establish that the social time preference rate for health is implied by the budget allocation and the health production functions in each period. As such, the social time preference rate for health depends not on the social time preference rate for consumption or growth in the consumption value of health but on growth in the cost-effectiveness threshold and the rate at which the higher authority can save or borrow between periods. The implications for discounting and the policies of bodies such as NICE are then discussed.

10.1002/hec.1730.abstractZh: 基于医疗技术成本效益评估做出的适当决策，取决于成本效益阈值及其增长率，以及社会对健康的一些时间偏好率。在提出社会决策方法之前，先概述了一种更为传统的方法，该方法表明，社会对健康的时间偏好是通过社会合法更高权威机构所做出的预算分配来揭示的。随后，我们探讨了社会对健康的时间偏好率、成本效益阈值增长率以及更高权威机构借贷或投资能力的比率之间的关系。我们确定，社会对健康的时间偏好率是由每个时期的预算分配和健康生产函数所决定的。因此，社会对健康的时间偏好率并不取决于社会对消费或健康消费价值增长的时间偏好率，而是取决于成本效益阈值的增长率以及更高权威机构在不同时期之间的储蓄或借贷能力。最后，我们讨论了这些结论对折现方法以及如NICE等机构政策的影响。

abstract.text: Because of problems with recruiting GPs to deprived areas in Denmark, it has been discussed whether the mixed remuneration scheme is flexible enough to compensate GPs serving patients with high need for services. The objective is to assess how patient heterogeneity affects list size, income and total utility of GPs operating under a mixed remuneration scheme. We adapt the model by Iversen (2004) as a theoretical framework for analysing the consequences of patient heterogeneity in a mixed remuneration system. We use a data set of Danish solo practitioners to analyse the effect of patient complexity on list size and income. From the theoretical model we find that higher levels of patient complexity lead GPs to choose a lower list size, whereas the effect on income is ambiguous. The effect on total utility (income and leisure) is, however, shown to be negative. Using empirical data from 1039 solo practices we find that patient complexity reduces both list size and income and conclude that a mixed per capita and fee for service remuneration system does not fully compensate practices with more complex patients. Differentiated per capita payment may represent a means of ensuring fair and equal income of GPs.

10.1002/hec.1731.abstractZh: 由于丹麦在招募全科医生到贫困地区方面存在困难，人们开始讨论混合薪酬制度是否足够灵活，能够补偿为需求较高的患者服务的全科医生。研究旨在评估患者异质性如何影响在混合薪酬制度下工作的全科医生的名单规模、收入以及总效用。我们采用Iversen（2004）的模型作为理论框架，来分析患者异质性在混合薪酬体系中的影响。我们使用丹麦独立执业医生的数据集来研究患者复杂性对名单规模和收入的影响。从理论模型来看，较高的患者复杂性会导致全科医生选择较小的名单规模，而对收入的影响则不明确。然而，总效用（包括收入和休闲时间）的影响被证明是负面的。通过对1039个独立执业医生的数据分析，我们发现患者复杂性会降低名单规模和收入，因此得出结论：混合按人头付费和按服务收费的薪酬制度无法完全补偿处理更复杂患者的执业机构。按人头付费的差异化安排可能是一种确保全科医生公平平等收入的方式。

abstract.text: Using newly available data from Germany, we study the relationship between parental income and child health. We find a strong gradient between parental income and subjective child health as has been documented earlier in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom. The relationship in Germany is about as strong as in the United States and stronger than in the United Kingdom. However, in contrast to US results, we do not find consistent evidence that the disadvantages associated with low parental income accumulate as the child ages, nor that children from low socioeconomic background are more likely to suffer from doctor-diagnosed conditions. There is some evidence, however, that high-income children are better able to cope with the adverse consequences of chronic conditions. Investigating potential diagnosis bias, we find only weak evidence for health disadvantages for low-income children when using objective health measures, but some evidence for under-utilization of health services among low-income families.

10.1002/hec.1732.abstractZh: 利用德国新获得的数据，我们研究了父母收入与儿童健康之间的关系。我们发现，与父母收入相关的儿童健康状况存在明显的梯度变化，这一趋势在美国、加拿大和英国已有记录。在德国，这种关系与美国相当，甚至比英国更为明显。然而，与美国的研究结果不同，我们没有发现证据表明低父母收入带来的不利因素会随着年龄增长而累积，也没有发现低社会经济背景的儿童更容易患上医生诊断的疾病。不过，有一些证据表明，高收入家庭的孩子更能应对慢性疾病的不良后果。在调查潜在的诊断偏差时，我们发现使用客观健康指标时，低收入儿童面临健康劣势的证据较弱，但有一些证据表明低收入家庭未能充分利用医疗服务。

abstract.text: Since January 2006 all Medicare beneficiaries have been eligible to obtain outpatient prescription drug coverage through private stand-alone drug plans (PDPs). We estimate a model of beneficiary demand for PDPs and use it to compute the loss of consumer surplus due to tightening PDP formularies to the level found in the Veterans Health Administration (VA). Under a generous assumption of cost savings attributed to increased bargaining leverage associated with exclusion of more drugs from formularies, we find the loss in consumer surplus to be smaller than the financial savings that could be shared between Medicare and beneficiaries. According to our estimates, Medicare beneficiaries could be compensated for the loss in consumer surplus associated with tighter PDP formularies with the savings generated by such formularies.

10.1002/hec.1733.abstractZh: 自2006年1月起，所有医疗保险受益人都有资格通过独立的私人药品计划获得门诊处方药品覆盖。我们建立了一个关于受益人购买私人药品计划的需求的模型，并利用该模型计算由于将私人药品计划的条款收紧至与退伍军人健康管理局的条款相同而导致的消费者剩余损失。在假设由于排除了更多药品而使得谈判能力增强，从而带来成本节约的情况下，我们发现消费者剩余的损失小于医疗保险与受益人之间可以共享的财务节约。根据我们的估计，医疗保险受益人可以通过私人药品计划带来的节约来弥补因条款收紧而导致的消费者剩余损失。

abstract.text: This paper examines the hypothesis that greater job status makes a person healthier. It begins by successfully replicating the well-known cross-section association between health and job seniority. Then, however, it turns to longitudinal patterns. Worryingly for the hypothesis, the data-on a large sample of randomly selected British workers through time-suggest that people who start with good health go on later to be promoted. The paper can find relatively little evidence that health improves after promotion. In fact, promoted individuals suffer a significant deterioration in their psychological well-being (on a standard General Health Questionnaire (GHQ) mental ill-health measure).

10.1002/hec.1734.abstractZh: 本文探讨了“更高的职位地位使人更健康”这一假设。首先，成功复制了健康与职位资历之间的已知交叉关联关系。然而，随后通过纵向数据分析发现，这一假设存在令人担忧的情况：对大量随机选取的英国工人进行的时间序列研究表明，那些一开始健康状况良好的人，在后续工作中更容易获得晋升。然而，研究并未发现晋升后健康状况有所改善的证据。事实上，晋升后的个体在心理健康方面出现了显著下降（根据标准综合健康问卷中的心理健康指标衡量）。

abstract.text: Reflecting drug use patterns and criminal justice policies throughout the 1990s and 2000s, prisons hold a disproportionate number of society's drug abusers. Approximately 50% of state prisoners meet the criteria for a diagnosis of drug abuse or dependence, but only 10% receive medically based drug treatment. Because of the link between substance abuse and crime, treating substance abusing and dependent state prisoners while incarcerated has the potential to yield substantial economic benefits. In this paper, we simulate the lifetime costs and benefits of improving prison-based substance abuse treatment and post-release aftercare for a cohort of state prisoners. Our model captures the dynamics of substance abuse as a chronic disease; estimates the benefits of substance abuse treatment over individuals' lifetimes; and tracks the costs of crime and criminal justice costs related to policing, adjudication, and incarceration. We estimate net societal benefits and cost savings to the criminal justice system of the current treatment system and five policy scenarios. We find that four of the five policy scenarios provide positive net societal benefits and cost savings to the criminal justice system relative to the current treatment system. Our study demonstrates the societal gains to improving the drug treatment system for state prisoners.

10.1002/hec.1735.abstractZh: 通过分析1990年代至2000年代的药物使用模式和刑事司法政策，可以发现监狱中吸毒者的数量与社会其他群体相比存在明显的不均衡。大约50%的州级囚犯符合药物滥用或依赖的诊断标准，但只有10%的囚犯接受了基于医学的药物治疗。由于物质滥用与犯罪之间存在关联，对在押中的物质滥用者和依赖者进行治疗，有可能带来显著的经济效益。本文通过模拟模型，计算了改善监狱内物质滥用治疗及释放后护理对一组州级囚犯的生命周期成本和收益。我们的模型能够捕捉物质滥用作为慢性疾病的动态变化，估算物质滥用治疗对个体一生的益处，并追踪与警务、审判和监禁相关的犯罪成本和刑事司法成本。我们估算了当前治疗体系与五种政策方案相比，对刑事司法系统的净社会收益和成本节约。研究发现，五种政策方案中有四种能够带来净社会收益，并为刑事司法系统节省成本。我们的研究证明了改善州级囚犯药物治疗体系的社会效益。

abstract.text: Using the National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1979, we explore the relationship between body mass and wages. We use quantile regression to provide a broad description of the relationship across the wage distribution. We also allow the relationship to vary by the degree of social skills involved in different jobs. Our results find that for female workers body mass and wages are negatively correlated at all points in their wage distribution. The strength of the relationship is larger at higher-wage levels. For male workers, the relationship is relatively constant across wage distribution but heterogeneous across ethnic groups. When controlling for the endogeneity of body mass, we find that additional body mass has a negative causal impact on the wages of white females earning more than the median wages and of white males around the median wages. Among these workers, the wage penalties are larger for those employed in jobs that require extensive social skills. These findings may suggest that labor markets reward white workers for good physical shape differently, depending on the level of wages and the type of job a worker has.

10.1002/hec.1736.abstractZh: 利用1979年青年纵向调查数据，我们探讨了体重与工资之间的关系。通过分位数回归分析，我们得出了整个工资分布中这种关系的广泛描述。我们还考虑了不同工作中所需社交技能程度对关系的影响。研究结果表明，对于女性劳动者而言，在她们工资的各个阶段，体重与工资呈负相关关系。这种关系的强度在较高工资水平时更为明显。对于男性劳动者来说，这种关系在工资分布中相对恒定，但在不同种族群体间存在差异。在控制体重的内生性后，我们发现额外的体重对收入低于中位数工资的白人女性以及收入接近中位数工资的白人男性的工资产生了负面影响。在这些劳动者中，那些从事需要大量社交技能的工作的人的工资损失更为严重。这些发现表明，劳动力市场根据工资水平和职业类型，对白人劳动者体型的评价有所不同。

abstract.text: For many disorders, patient heterogeneity requires physicians to customize their treatment to each patient's needs. We test for the existence of customization in physicians' prescribing for bipolar disorder, using data from a naturalistic clinical effectiveness trial of bipolar disorder treatment (STEP-BD), which did not constrain physician prescribing. Multinomial logit is used to model the physician's choice among five combinations of drug classes. We find that our observed measure of the patient's clinical status played only a limited role in the choice among drug class combinations, even for conditions such as mania that are expected to affect class choice. However, treatment of a patient with given characteristics differed widely depending on which physician was seen. The explanatory power of the model was low. There was variation within each physician's prescribing, but the results do not suggest a high degree of customization in physicians' prescribing, based on our measure of clinical status.

10.1002/hec.1737.abstractZh: 对于许多疾病，患者的异质性要求医生根据每个患者的需求来定制治疗方案。我们使用一项关于双相情感障碍治疗的自然主义临床效果试验（STEP-BD）的数据，来检验医生在开具处方时是否存在定制化。该试验并未对医生的处方行为进行限制。我们使用多项逻辑回归模型来模拟医生在五种药物类别之间的选择。我们发现，我们观察到的患者临床状态指标在药物类别选择中只起到了有限的作用，即使对于如躁狂等预期会影响药物类别选择的情况也是如此。然而，对于具有特定特征的患者，治疗方案的差异很大，这取决于该患者就诊的是哪位医生。该模型的解释力较低。虽然每位医生在处方中存在一定的差异，但我们的研究结果并不表明医生在处方方面存在高度定制化。

abstract.text: Monthly data derived from the Nielsen Homescan Panel for calendar years 1998 through 2003 are used to estimate the effects of a proposed tax on sugar-sweetened beverages (SSBs). Most arguments in describing the ramifications of a tax fail to consider demand interrelationships among various beverages. To circumvent this shortcoming we employ a variation of Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) model. The consumption of isotonics, regular soft drinks and fruit drinks, the set of SSBs, is negatively impacted by the proposed tax, while the consumption of fruit juices, low-fat milk, coffee, and tea is positively affected. Diversion ratios are provided identifying where the volumes of the SSBs are directed as a result of the tax policy. The reduction in the body weight as a result of a 20% tax on SSBs is estimated to be between 1.54 and 2.55 lb per year. However, not considering demand interrelationships would result in higher weight loss. Unequivocally, it is necessary to consider interrelationships among non-alcoholic beverages in assessing the effect of the tax.

10.1002/hec.1738.abstractZh: 本文使用了1998年至2003年Nielsen Homescan面板提供的月度数据，来估算对含糖饮料征收税收的影响。在描述税收影响时，大多数分析未能考虑各种饮料之间的需求关系。为了弥补这一不足，我们采用了二次近似理想需求系统模型。含糖饮料的消费量会受到税收的负面影响，而果汁、低脂牛奶、咖啡和茶的消费量则会受到积极影响。模型还提供了分流比率，说明了由于税收政策，含糖饮料的消费量会被引导到哪里。据估计，对含糖饮料征收20%的税收，每年会导致体重减少1.54至2.55磅。然而，如果不考虑饮料之间的需求关系，体重减轻的幅度将会更高。显然，在评估税收影响时，必须考虑非酒精饮料之间的相互关系。

abstract.text: Attribute generation for discrete choice experiments (DCEs) is often poorly reported, and it is unclear whether this element of research is conducted rigorously. This paper explores issues associated with developing attributes for DCEs and contrasts different qualitative approaches. The paper draws on eight studies, four developed attributes for measures, and four developed attributes for more ad hoc policy questions. Issues that have become apparent through these studies include the following: the theoretical framework for random utility theory and the need for attributes that are neither too close to the latent construct nor too intrinsic to people's personality; the need to think about attribute development as a two-stage process involving conceptual development followed by refinement of language to convey the intended meaning; and the difficulty in resolving tensions inherent in the reductiveness of condensing complex and nuanced qualitative findings into precise terms. The comparison of alternative qualitative approaches suggests that the nature of data collection will depend both on the characteristics of the question (its sensitivity, for example) and the availability of existing qualitative information. An iterative, constant comparative approach to analysis is recommended. Finally, the paper provides a series of recommendations for improving the reporting of this element of DCE studies.

10.1002/hec.1739.abstractZh: 在离散选择实验（DCEs）中，属性生成的研究往往报告不足，且不清楚这一研究环节是否得到了严格的开展。本文探讨了为DCEs开发属性的相关问题，并对比了不同的定性方法。研究基于八项研究，其中四项是为测量目的开发属性，另外四项则是为更具体的政策问题开发属性。通过这些研究可以发现以下问题：随机效用理论的理论框架需要属性既不会过于接近潜在概念，也不会过于体现人的个性特征；属性开发应被视为一个两阶段的过程，包括概念开发以及语言精炼以传达预期含义；在将复杂且细微的定性研究结果简化为精确术语时，存在解决固有矛盾的难度。对比不同的定性方法后，可以认为数据收集的方式将取决于问题的特性（例如问题的敏感性）以及现有定性信息的可用性。建议采用迭代、持续比较的分析方法。最后，本文提出了一系列改进DCE研究这一环节报告的建议。

abstract.text: Previous methods of empirical mapping involve using regressions on patient or general population self-reported data from datasets involving two or more measures. This approach relies on overlap in the descriptive systems of the measures and assumes it is appropriate to use different measures on the same population, which may not always be the case. This paper presents a feasibility study for a new approach to mapping between preference-based measures (PBM) using general population visual analogue scale (VAS) values as a common yardstick. We use data from a valuation study of 502 members of the UK general population, where, using ranking and VAS tasks, interviewees simultaneously valued health states defined by three of six PBM: EQ-5D (generic), SF-6D (generic), HUI2 (generic for children and adults), AQL-5D (asthma specific), OPUS (social care specific) and ICECAP (capabilities). Regression techniques are used to estimate the relationship between these VAS values and the original value set (i.e. 'tariff'). These results are subsequently used to estimate the relationship between all six PBM to enable 'value-based mapping' between measures. This new method of mapping potentially has a useful role in evidence synthesis and cross programme comparisons in studies using different measures.

10.1002/hec.1740.abstractZh: 以往的经验性映射方法涉及对来自包含两个或更多测量指标的数据集中的患者或一般人群自我报告数据进行回归分析。这种方法依赖于这些测量指标在描述体系上的重叠，并假设在同一人群中使用不同的测量指标是合适的，但实际情况可能并非总是如此。本文提出了一种新方法的可行性研究，该方法基于偏好测量指标（PBM），使用一般人群视觉模拟量表（VAS）值作为共同的标准。我们采用了英国一般人群502名成员的数据，通过排序和VAS任务，受访者同时评估了由六个PBM中的三个定义的健康状态：EQ-5D（通用）、SF-6D（通用）、HUI2（儿童和成人的通用）、AQL-5D（哮喘特异性）、OPUS（社会护理特异性）和ICECAP（能力）。通过回归技术来估计这些VAS值与原始值集（即“费率”）之间的关系。随后，这些结果被用来估计所有六个PBM之间的关系，从而实现“基于价值的映射”。这种新的映射方法在采用不同测量指标的研究中，可能在证据综合和跨项目比较中发挥重要作用。

abstract.text: Estimates of cost-effectiveness analyses are typically obtained either directly from 'trial' based analyses or indirectly via surrogate endpoints in 'model' based analyses. Data from clinical trials that include both surrogate and final endpoints can be used in a joint analysis that combines these two approaches. This joint approach allows the inclusion of information regarding the effects of treatment on surrogate endpoints while relaxing the strong assumption of 'conditional independence' associated with indirect model-based analyses. An example cost-effectiveness analysis of Chronic Disease Self-Management Programme is used to compare the different approaches. It is shown that despite using a common data set, the different analytic approaches produce differing estimates of the cost-effectiveness of the intervention and the value of future research. The paper concludes by discussing the selection of the appropriate analytic approach.

10.1002/hec.1741.abstractZh: 成本效益分析的估算通常直接来自基于“试验”的分析，或者通过基于“模型”的分析中的替代终点间接获得。包含替代终点和最终终点的临床试验数据可以用于联合分析，结合这两种方法。这种联合方法允许包含关于治疗对替代终点影响的信息，同时放宽了与间接模型分析相关的“条件独立性”强假设。以慢性疾病自我管理计划的成本效益分析为例，比较了不同的分析方法。结果表明，尽管使用了相同的数据集，不同的分析方法得出的干预措施的成本效益估计和未来研究的价值有所不同。文章最后讨论了选择适当分析方法的议题。

abstract.text: There is great divergence in provincial government health expenditures in China. Real per capita provincial government health expenditures (GHE) over the period 2002-2006 are examined using panel regression analysis. Key determinants of real per capita provincial GHE are real provincial per capita general budget revenue, real provincial per capita transfers from the central government, the proportion of provincial population under age 15, urban employee basic health insurance coverage, and proportion of urban population. Roughly equal and relatively low elasticities of budget revenue and transfers imply that the GHE is a necessity rather than a luxury good, and transfers have yet to become efficient instruments for the fair allocation of health resources by policy makers. Moreover, severe acute respiratory syndrome outbreak has increased the GHE, but we find no statistical evidence that provincial GHE have fluctuated according to the public health status.

10.1002/hec.1742.abstractZh: 中国各省政府的卫生支出存在巨大差异。本文采用面板回归分析方法，研究了2002-2006年期间各省政府人均卫生支出的实际数值。人均卫生支出的主要决定因素包括各省人均一般预算收入、来自中央政府的转移支付、15岁以下人口比例、城市雇员基本医疗保险覆盖情况以及城市人口比例。预算收入和转移支付的弹性大致相等且较低，这表明卫生支出是一种必需品而非奢侈品，而转移支付尚未成为政策制定者公平分配卫生资源的有效工具。此外，严重急性呼吸综合征的爆发增加了卫生支出，但我们未发现统计证据表明各省卫生支出因公共卫生状况而波动。

abstract.text: As the USA expands health insurance coverage, comparing utilization of healthcare services with countries like Taiwan that already have universal coverage can highlight problematic areas of each system. The universal coverage plan of Taiwan is the newest among developed countries, and it is known for readily providing access to care at low costs. However, Taiwan experiences problems on the supply side, such as inadequate compensation for providers, especially in the area of preventive care. We compare the use of preventive, hospital, and emergency care between the USA and Taiwan. The rate of preventive care use is much higher in the USA than in Taiwan, whereas the use of hospital and emergency care is about the same. Results of our decomposition analysis suggest that higher levels of education and income, along with inferior health status in the USA, are significant factors, each explaining between 7% and 15% of the gap in preventive care use. Our analysis suggests that, in addition to universal coverage, proper remuneration schemes, education levels, and cultural attitudes towards health care are important factors that influence the use of preventive care.

10.1002/hec.1743.abstractZh: 随着美国扩大医疗保险覆盖范围，将美国与台湾等已实现全民医保的国家在医疗服务使用方面的比较，可以揭示各自体系中的问题所在。台湾的全民医保计划是发达国家中最新的一项，以低成本提供医疗服务而著称。然而，台湾在供应方面存在一些问题，例如对医疗服务提供者的补偿不足，尤其是在预防保健领域。我们比较了美国与台湾在预防保健、医院服务和急诊服务方面的使用情况。美国的预防保健使用率远高于台湾，而医院服务和急诊服务的使用率则大致相同。我们的分解分析结果表明，较高的教育水平和收入，以及较差的健康状况，是美国与台湾在预防保健使用方面差异的重要因素，分别解释了7%到15%的差距。我们的分析表明，除了全民医保之外，合理的薪酬制度、教育水平以及对医疗保健的文化态度，也是影响预防保健使用的重要因素。

abstract.text: In cost-effectiveness analyses (CEA) that use randomized controlled trials (RCTs), covariates of prognostic importance may be imbalanced and warrant adjustment. In CEA that use non-randomized studies (NRS), the selection on observables assumption must hold for regression and matching methods to be unbiased. Even in restricted circumstances when this assumption is plausible, a key concern is how to adjust for imbalances in observed confounders. If the propensity score is misspecified, the covariates in the matched sample will be imbalanced, which can lead to conditional bias. To address covariate imbalance in CEA based on RCTs and NRS, this paper considers Genetic Matching. This matching method uses a search algorithm to directly maximize covariate balance. We compare Genetic and propensity score matching in Monte Carlo simulations and two case studies, CEA of pulmonary artery catheterization, based on an RCT and an NRS. The simulations show that Genetic Matching reduces the conditional bias and root mean squared error compared with propensity score matching. Genetic Matching achieves better covariate balance than the unadjusted analyses of the RCT data. In the NRS, Genetic Matching improves on the balance obtained from propensity score matching and gives substantively different estimates of incremental cost-effectiveness. We conclude that Genetic Matching can improve balance on measured covariates in CEA that use RCTs and NRS, but with NRS, this will be insufficient to reduce bias; the selection on observables assumption must also hold.

10.1002/hec.1748.abstractZh: 在采用随机对照试验（RCT）的成本效益分析（CEA）中，具有预后重要性的协变量可能会出现不平衡，需要进行调整。在采用非随机对照研究（NRS）的CEA中，为了使回归和匹配方法无偏，必须保持观测变量选择的假设。即使在这种假设看似合理的情况下，如何调整观测混杂因素的不平衡仍是一个关键问题。如果倾向评分的设定有误，匹配样本中的协变量将出现不平衡，从而导致条件性偏差。为了解决基于RCT和NRS的CEA中协变量不平衡的问题，本文提出了遗传匹配方法。该匹配方法通过搜索算法直接实现协变量的平衡。我们通过蒙特卡洛模拟和两个案例研究对遗传匹配与倾向评分匹配进行了比较，这两个案例研究分别基于RCT和NRS的肺动脉导管插入术CEA。模拟结果显示，与倾向评分匹配相比，遗传匹配能够减少条件性偏差和均方根误差。遗传匹配在协变量平衡方面优于未调整的RCT数据分析。在NRS中，遗传匹配进一步改善了倾向评分匹配所达到的平衡，并提供了不同的增量成本效益估计值。我们得出结论，遗传匹配可以改善基于RCT和NRS的CEA中测量协变量的平衡，但在NRS情况下，仅使用遗传匹配不足以减少偏差；必须保持观测变量选择的假设。

abstract.text: We use panel data on household consumption combined with information taken from the medical records of women who gave birth in health facilities to explore the economic consequences of maternal ill health, in the context of a rural population in Bangladesh. The findings suggest that there is a large reduction in household resources associated with maternal illness, driven almost entirely by spending on health care. In spite of this loss of resources, we find that households are able to fully insure consumption against maternal ill health, although confidence intervals are unable to rule out a small effect. Households in our study area are shown to have good access to informal credit (whether it be from local money lenders or family relatives), and this appears critical in helping to smooth consumption in response to these health shocks, at least in the short term.

10.1002/hec.1749.abstractZh: 我们采用了家庭消费的数据面板，并结合了在医疗机构分娩的女性医疗记录中的信息，来探讨孟加拉国农村人口中母亲健康状况不佳所带来的经济后果。研究发现，母亲患病会导致家庭资源大幅减少，这一减少几乎完全是由医疗保健支出所驱动的。尽管存在资源损失，我们发现家庭能够完全通过保险来应对母亲健康状况不佳带来的消费风险，尽管置信区间无法完全排除这种小幅度影响。我们的研究区域中的家庭能够获得良好的非正式信贷支持（无论是来自当地放贷者还是家族亲戚），这在短期内有助于平滑消费，以应对这些健康冲击。

abstract.text: This paper considers the role of ownership form for the financial sustainability of German acute care hospitals over time. We measure financial sustainability by a hospital-specific yearly probability of default (PD) trying to mirror the ability of hospitals to survive in the market in the long run. The results show that private ownership is associated with significantly lower PDs than public ownership. Moreover, path dependence in the PD is substantial but far from 100%, indicating a large number of improvements and deteriorations in financial sustainability over time. Yet, the general public hospitals have the highest path dependence. Overall, this indicates that public hospitals, which are in a poor financial standing, remain in that state or even deteriorate over time, which may be conflicting with financial sustainability.

10.1002/hec.1750.abstractZh: 本文探讨了所有权形式对德国急性护理医院长期财务可持续性的影响。我们通过医院特定的年度违约概率来衡量财务可持续性，这一指标试图反映医院长期在市场上的生存能力。研究结果表明，私有制与较低的违约概率相关，而公有制则不然。此外，违约概率的路径依赖性相当明显，但远未达到100%，这表明财务可持续性随时间经历了多次改善和恶化。然而，公立医院的路径依赖性最高。总体而言，这表明财务状况不佳的公立医院可能会持续处于这种状态，甚至恶化，这与财务可持续性可能相矛盾。

abstract.text: In light of the widespread phenomena of diet failure and excessive dieting, this paper presents a theoretical economic analysis of the decision-making process of weight-loss dieting. The paper incorporates behavioral elements involved in the process of dieting: effort exerted in dieting, influence of social norms concerning body weight, time-inconsistent present biased preferences, and a distinction between naiveté and sophistication. The model explains cyclic dieting and provides interesting insights on the extent of weight-loss dieting. The extent of dieting is an increasing function of initial body weight and a decreasing function of the effort exerted in dieting and the strength of social norms concerning ideal weight. Income and diet strictness have an ambiguous effect. In addition, greater dieting efforts are not necessarily balanced against a slowdown in body metabolism or a higher initial body weight.

10.1002/hec.1751.abstractZh: 鉴于饮食失败和过度节食现象的普遍存在，本文对减肥节食的决策过程进行了理论经济分析。文章纳入了节食过程中涉及的行为要素：节食所付出的努力、关于体重的社会规范影响、时间不一致的偏好选择，以及天真与成熟之间的区别。该模型解释了节食的周期性变化，并对减肥节食的程度提供了有趣的见解。节食的程度是初始体重的增函数，而节食所付出的努力以及关于理想体重的社会规范强度则是减函数。收入与节食的严格程度具有模糊的影响。此外，更大的节食努力并不一定能够抵消身体代谢的减缓或较高的初始体重。

abstract.text: A feature of hospitals is that they face uncertain demand for the services they offer. To cover fluctuations in demand, they need to maintain reserve service capacity in the form of beds, equipment, personnel, etc. to minimize the probability of excess queuing or turning away patients, creating a trade-off between reserve service capacity and economic costs. Using a simple theoretical framework, we show how the reserve capacity established depends on institutional characteristics that can affect the objective of the hospital. In particular, we show that private and public hospitals may provide different levels of reserve capacity. In an empirical application using a panel data set of Spanish hospitals over the period 1996-2006, we model reserve service capacity using a distance frontier approach. Our results show that private hospitals generally react to a lesser extent to demand uncertainty than public hospitals.

10.1002/hec.1755.abstractZh: 医院的一个特点是，它们所提供的服务面临不确定的需求。为了应对需求的波动，它们需要保持一定数量的备用服务能力，包括床位、设备、人员等，以尽量减少患者排队或被拒诊的情况，从而在备用服务能力与经济成本之间做出权衡。通过一个简单的理论框架，我们展示了备用能力的大小取决于医院的制度特征，而这些特征会影响医院的目标。具体来说，我们发现私立医院和公立医院在提供备用能力方面可能存在差异。在一项基于1996-2006年西班牙医院面板数据的实证研究中，我们采用了距离前沿方法对备用服务能力进行了建模。研究结果表明，私立医院对需求不确定性的反应通常不如公立医院那么强烈。

abstract.text: We use invoices for hospital services from a regional hospital in Croatia to test for adverse selection and moral hazard. There are three categories of patients: with no supplemental insurance, who bought it, and who are entitled to it for free. Our identification procedure relies on the premise that the difference in the observed medical care consumption between the patients who bought the insurance and those entitled to free insurance is caused by pure selection effect, whereas the difference in healthcare consumption between the group that received the free insurance and the group that has no insurance is due to moral hazard. Results show favorable selection for patients in 20- to 30-year-old cohort and significant moral hazard for all age cohorts. The selection effect reverses its sign in older cohorts explained by the differences in risk aversion across cohorts caused by the timing of transition from socialism to market economy.

10.1002/hec.1756.abstractZh: 我们使用克罗地亚某地区医院提供的医院服务发票，来测试逆向选择和道德风险现象。患者分为三类：没有补充保险、购买了保险以及享有免费保险的患者。我们的识别程序基于这样一个假设：购买保险的患者与享有免费保险的患者在医疗消费上的差异是由纯粹的选择效应造成的；而享受免费保险的患者与没有保险的患者在医疗消费上的差异则是由道德风险引起的。结果显示，20至30岁年龄段的患者的选择效应较为有利，而所有年龄段的患者都存在显著的道德风险。选择效应的符号在较年长的年龄段发生了逆转，这可能是由于从社会主义向市场经济转型过程中，不同年龄段的风险偏好差异所导致的。

abstract.text: We used a principal-agent framework to examine the feasibility of two proposed modifications to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program with the goal of encouraging healthier food choices among program participants. Specifically, we analyzed two types of contract: a restricted contract and an incentive contract. The restricted contract did not allow the purchase of unhealthy foods with program benefits, but compensated participants by increasing total benefits. The incentive contract provided increased benefits that varied according to the percentage of healthy foods purchased with program benefits. The theoretical results revealed the mechanisms for the two alternative contracts, the conditions under which each would be effective, and the key empirical questions to be examined for future policy analysis.

10.1002/hec.1758.abstractZh: 我们采用委托-代理框架来研究对补充营养援助计划进行两项修改的可行性，目的是鼓励项目参与者做出更健康的食品选择。具体来说，我们分析了两种类型的合同：限制性合同和激励性合同。限制性合同不允许使用项目福利购买不健康食品，但会通过增加总福利来补偿参与者。激励性合同则根据使用项目福利购买的健康食品的比例提供不同的福利增加。理论结果揭示了这两种替代合同的运作机制、每种合同生效的条件，以及未来政策分析需要探讨的关键实证问题。

abstract.text: Objectives Outpatient visit co-payments have increased in recent years. We estimate the patient response to a price change for specialty care, based on a co-payment increase from $15 to $50 per visit for veterans with hypertension. Design, setting, and patients A retrospective cohort of veterans required to pay co-payments was compared with veterans exempt from co-payments whose nonequivalence was reduced via propensity score matching. Specialty care expenditures in 2000-2003 were estimated via a two-part mixed model to account for the correlation of the use and level outcomes over time, and results from this correlated two-part model were compared with an uncorrelated two-part model and a correlated random intercept two-part mixed model. Results A $35 specialty visit co-payment increase had no impact on the likelihood of seeking specialty care but induced lower specialty expenditures over time among users who were required to pay co-payments. The log ratio of price responsiveness (semi-elasticity) for specialty care increased from -0.25 to -0.31 after the co-payment increase. Estimates were similar across the three models. Conclusion A significant increase in specialty visit co-payments reduced specialty expenditures among patients obtaining medications at the Veterans Affairs medical centers. Longitudinal expenditure analysis may be improved using recent advances in two-part model methods.

10.1002/hec.1759.abstractZh: 近年来，门诊就诊的共付额有所增加。我们基于一项研究，对高血压退伍军人就诊时共付额从15美元增加到50美元的变化对患者的影响进行了估算。研究设计、样本选取及患者特征：本研究选取了需要支付共付额的退伍军人作为对照组，同时选取了无需支付共付额的退伍军人作为实验组，并通过倾向评分匹配来消除两组之间的非等价性。2000-2003年间，通过双部分混合模型估算了专科医疗的支出情况，以考虑使用率和支出水平随时间的变化相关性。将这一相关双部分模型的结果与不相关双部分模型以及相关随机截距双部分混合模型的结果进行了比较。研究结果显示，将专科就诊的共付额增加到35美元后，并未显著影响患者寻求专科医疗的可能性，但使得需要支付共付额的患者的专科医疗支出随时间减少。共付额增加后，专科医疗的价格响应性（半弹性）从-0.25增加到-0.31。三种模型中的估算结果相似。结论：在退伍军人事务医疗中心，显著增加的专科就诊共付额有效降低了患者的专科医疗支出。利用双部分模型方法的近期进展，纵向支出分析可能会得到改进。

abstract.text: Using the Annenberg Perception of Tobacco Risk Survey 2, this paper finds that perceived risk deters smoking among persons aged 14-22 years who think that it is relatively difficult to quit smoking and that onset of deleterious health effects occurs relatively quickly. Perceived health risk, however, does not affect the smoking status of young people who hold the opposite beliefs. These results are consistent with predictions of rational addiction models and suggest that young people, who view smoking as more addictive and health effects as more immediate, may have greater incentive to consider long-term health effects in their decision to smoke.

10.1002/hec.1760.abstractZh: 利用安嫩伯格烟草风险感知调查2的数据，本文发现，对于那些认为戒烟相对困难且认为健康危害会迅速显现的14-22岁人群来说，感知到的风险确实会抑制他们吸烟的意愿。然而，感知到的健康风险并不会影响那些持有相反信念的年轻人的吸烟状况。这些结果与理性成瘾模型的预测一致，表明那些认为吸烟更具成瘾性且健康危害更为直接的年轻人，可能会更有动力在决定是否吸烟时考虑长期健康影响。

abstract.text: Although there is much talk about whether or not the current health care reform will 'bend' the health care expenditure 'curve', exactly which 'curve' is to be 'bent' is often ill-specified. This essay notes that the 'curve' defined by the log of US national health care expenditures per capita plotted against the log of the US gross domestic product per capita has been remarkably straight since 1929 despite Medicare and Medicaid and all of the more recent reform attempts. After establishing stationarity and considering cointegration and endogeneity, the slope of this log-log relationship suggests a per capita expenditure-income elasticity of 1.388. The authors suggest two explanatory hypotheses consistent with the observed constant slope. First, many new technologies are endogenous because their introduction is determined by their expected market, which is in turn dependent on GDP per capita. Second, the authors emphasize the potential utility gained by spending disproportionately larger proportions of our growing income on hope, uncertainty-reducing information, and consumer amenities, all of which may be independent of any improved health outcome.
