10.1002/hec.1765.abstractZh: 尽管关于当前医疗改革是否会“弯曲”医疗支出“曲线”的讨论很多，但究竟要“弯曲”哪条“曲线”往往没有明确说明。本文指出，自1929年以来，美国人均国民医疗支出对数与人均国内生产总值对数之间的关系一直非常稳定，尽管有医疗保险和医疗补助计划以及所有较新的改革尝试。在确认了这种对数-对数关系的稳定性，并考虑了协整性和内生性之后，该关系的斜率表明人均支出-收入的弹性为1.388。作者提出了两个与观察到的恒定斜率一致的解释假设。首先，许多新技术是内生的，因为它们的引入取决于预期的市场状况，而预期的市场状况又取决于人均国内生产总值。其次，作者强调，将越来越多的收入用于希望、减少不确定性的信息和消费设施可能会带来潜在的效用，而这些可能独立于任何改善的健康结果。

abstract.text: This paper presents the findings of a systematic review of full or partial economic evaluations that included questions to service users or their carers to elicit information on the types, amounts or costs of community-based formal social care support provided to people 65 years and older. We have found that studies seldom report use of published validated questions for eliciting information from older people in the UK about their use of formal social care services. Given the political prominence of the debate over funding social care for older people, there remains a need for analysis of policy options. This requires reliable data on the receipt and payment for care. We recommend the development of improved questions on care that are clear, robust and up-to-date with developments in policy and practice.

10.1002/hec.1766.abstractZh: 本文呈现了一项系统性回顾的研究结果，该回顾涉及了全面或部分的经济评估，其中向服务使用者或其护理人员提出了问题，以收集有关为65岁及以上人群提供的社区型正式社会护理服务的类型、数量或成本的信息。我们发现，很少有研究使用已验证的问卷来收集英国老年人关于其使用正式社会护理服务的相关信息。鉴于关于为老年人提供社会护理的资助问题的政治重要性，仍需对政策选项进行分析。这需要对护理服务的接收和支付情况有可靠的数据。我们建议开发更清晰、更可靠且能反映政策与实践发展的改进型护理问卷。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the longer-term effects of childhood conduct disorder on human capital accumulation and violent and criminal behavior later in life using data of Australian twins. We measure conduct disorder with a rich set of indicators based on diagnostic criteria from psychiatry. Using ordinary least squares and twin fixed effects estimation approaches, we find that early-age (pre-18) conduct disorder problems significantly affect both human capital accumulation and violent and criminal behavior over the life course. In addition, we find that conduct disorder is more deleterious if these behaviors occur earlier in life.

10.1002/hec.1767.abstractZh: 本文利用澳大利亚双胞胎的数据，估计了儿童行为障碍对人力资本积累以及日后暴力与犯罪行为影响的长期效应。我们通过一套基于精神病学诊断标准的丰富指标来衡量行为障碍。采用普通最小二乘法和双胞胎固定效应估计方法，我们发现，早期（18岁之前）的行为障碍问题会显著影响人生过程中的人力资本积累以及暴力与犯罪行为。此外，我们还发现，如果这些行为在生命早期出现，行为障碍带来的负面影响会更为严重。

abstract.text: Vietnam aims to achieve full coverage of health insurance in 2015. An increasing type of health insurance in Vietnam is voluntary health insurance. Although there are many studies on the implementation of voluntary health insurance in Vietnam, little is known on the causal impact of voluntary health insurance. This paper measures the impact of voluntary health insurance on health care utilization and out-of-pocket payments using Vietnam Household Living Standard Surveys in 2004 and 2006. It was found out that voluntary health insurance helps the insured people increase the annual outpatient and inpatient visits by around 45% and 70%, respectively. However, the effect of voluntary health insurance on out-of-pocket expenses on health care services is not statistically significant.

10.1002/hec.1768.abstractZh: 越南计划在2015年实现医疗保险的全覆盖。在越南，越来越多的医疗保险属于自愿性保险。尽管关于越南自愿性保险实施情况的研究很多，但对其因果影响的研究却很少。本文利用2004年和2006年的越南家庭生活水平调查数据，研究了自愿性保险对医疗利用和自付费用的影响。研究发现，自愿性保险使参保人的年度门诊和住院次数分别增加了约45%和70%。然而，自愿性保险对医疗服务的自付费用的影响并不具有统计学意义。

abstract.text: Cognitive impairment has emerged as a major driver of disability in old age, with profound effects on individual well-being and decision making at older ages. In the light of policies aimed at postponing retirement ages, an important question is whether continued labour supply helps to maintain high levels of cognition at older ages. We use data of older men from the US Health and Retirement Study to estimate the effect of continued labour market participation at older ages on later-life cognition. As retirement itself is likely to depend on cognitive functioning and may thus be endogenous, we use offers of early retirement windows as instruments for retirement in econometric models for later-life cognitive functioning. These offers of early retirement are legally required to be nondiscriminatory and thus, inter alia, unrelated to cognitive functioning. At the same time, these offers of early retirement options are significant predictors of retirement. Although the simple ordinary least squares estimates show a negative relationship between retirement duration and various measures of cognitive functioning, instrumental variable estimates suggest that these associations may not be causal effects. Specifically, we find no clear relationship between retirement duration and later-life cognition for white-collar workers and, if anything, a positive relationship for blue-collar workers.

10.1002/hec.1771.abstractZh: 认知障碍已成为老年残疾的主要诱因，对老年人的个人福祉和决策能力产生深远影响。鉴于政策旨在推迟退休年龄，一个重要的问题是持续参与劳动力市场是否有助于在老年时期保持较高的认知水平。我们利用美国健康与退休研究中的老年男性数据，来估算在老年时期持续参与劳动力市场对后期认知的影响。由于退休本身可能取决于认知功能，因此具有内生性，我们在计量经济模型中将提前退休的提议作为退休的替代变量。这些提前退休的提议在法律上要求不得存在歧视性，因此与认知功能无关联。同时，这些提前退休的提议也是退休的重要预测因素。尽管简单的普通最小二乘估计显示退休期限与各种认知功能指标之间存在负相关关系，但工具变量估计表明这些关联可能不是因果关系。具体来说，我们发现白领工人的退休期限与后期认知之间没有明显关系，而蓝领工人则存在正相关关系。

abstract.text: Delays in receipt of necessary diagnostic and therapeutic medical procedures related to the timing of Medicare initiation at age 65 years have potentially broad welfare implications. We use 2005-2007 data from Florida and North Carolina to estimate the effect of initiation of Medicare benefits on healthcare utilization across procedures that differ in urgency and coverage. In particular, we study trends in the use of elective procedures covered by Medicare to treat conditions that vary in symptoms; these are compared with elective surgical procedures not eligible for Medicare reimbursement, and to a set of urgent and emergent procedures. We find large discontinuities in health services utilization at age 65 years concentrated among low-urgency, Medicare-reimbursable procedures, most pronounced among screening interventions and treatments for minimally symptomatic disease.

10.1002/hec.1772.abstractZh: 在65岁时开始享受医疗保险时，相关诊断和治疗程序的延迟可能会对福利产生广泛影响。我们利用2005-2007年佛罗里达州和北卡罗来纳州的数据，来估算医疗保险福利的启动对不同紧急程度和治疗范围的医疗服务的使用效果。具体来说，我们研究了医疗保险覆盖的择期手术在症状不同的疾病治疗中的使用趋势，并将这些趋势与不符合医疗保险报销条件的择期外科手术以及紧急和急诊手术进行了比较。我们发现，在65岁时，医疗服务使用的巨大差异主要集中在低紧急程度、可获得医疗保险报销的手术上，尤其是在筛查干预和针对症状轻微的疾病的治疗方面。

abstract.text: A three-equation model is used to estimate the multiple effects of antiretroviral medications (ARVs) on the quality of life (QoL) of the elderly with HIV in New York City. The transmission mechanism involves the ARVs having a direct effect on QoL via the side effects of the medications and two other effects (one indirect and one reverse) both working through feelings of depression. On a scale of 0 to 100, ARVs raise the QoL by 1 percentage point. This was because there was a large positive indirect effect of ARVs on QoL of 28 percentage points via the reduction in depression, which offsets both the 24 percentage-point reduction due to the direct effect and the 3 percentage-point decline from the reverse effect. Now, QoL effects can be applied to the additional life years generated by ARVs to form the quality adjusted life years outcome measure for use in economic evaluations of ARVs.

10.1002/hec.1774.abstractZh: 本研究采用三方程模型来估算抗逆转录病毒药物对纽约市HIV感染者生活质量的多重影响。该传播机制表明，抗逆转录病毒药物通过药物的副作用直接影响生活质量，同时还有两种间接影响及一种反向影响，这两种间接影响均通过抑郁情绪来发挥作用。在0到100的评分体系中，抗逆转录病毒药物使生活质量提高1个百分点。这一结果源于抗逆转录病毒药物对生活质量具有显著的间接积极影响，其效果为28个百分点，这抵消了因直接效应导致的24个百分点的下降以及反向效应导致的3个百分点的下降。现在，这些生活质量的影响可以被应用于抗逆转录病毒药物带来的额外寿命年数，从而形成用于抗逆转录病毒药物经济评估的质量调整寿命年结果指标。

abstract.text: For the 10% to 15% of American married couples who experience reproductive problems, in vitro fertilization (IVF) is the leading technologically advanced treatment procedure. However, IVF's expense may prevent many couples from receiving treatment, and those who are treated may take an overly aggressive approach to reduce the probability of failure. Aggressive treatment, which occurs through an increase in the number of embryos transferred during IVF, can lead to medically dangerous multiple births. We evaluated the principle policy proposal-insurance mandates-for improving IVF access and outcomes. We used data from US markets during 1995-2003 to show that broad insurance mandates for IVF result in not only large increases in treatment access but also significantly less aggressive treatment. More limited insurance mandates, which may apply to a subset of insurers or provide weaker guidelines for insurer behavior, generally have little effect on IVF markets.

10.1002/hec.1776.abstractZh: 在10%到15%经历生殖问题的美国已婚夫妇中，体外受精（IVF）是技术先进的治疗手段。然而，IVF的高昂费用可能使许多夫妇无法接受治疗，而接受治疗的人可能会采取过于激进的方法以降低失败的概率。通过增加IVF过程中移植的胚胎数量来实施激进治疗，可能会导致医学上危险的多重妊娠。我们评估了通过保险强制规定来改善IVF治疗机会和效果的原则性提案。利用1995年至2003年的美国市场数据表明，广泛的IVF保险强制规定不仅大大增加了治疗机会，还显著减少了激进治疗的使用。而较为有限的保险强制规定，可能仅适用于部分保险公司，或为保险公司行为提供较弱的指导，通常对IVF市场的影响较小。

abstract.text: Approximately 690000-1790000 Salmonella cases, 20000 hospitalizations, and 400 deaths occur in the USA annually, costing approximately $2.6bn. Existing models estimate morbidity, mortality, and cost solely from incidence. They do not estimate illness duration or use time as an independent cost predictor. Existing models may underestimate physician visits, hospitalizations, deaths, and associated costs. We developed a Markov chain Monte Carlo model to estimate illness duration, physician/emergency room visits, inpatient hospitalizations, mortality, and resultant costs for a given Salmonella incidence. Interested parties include society, third-party payers, health providers, federal, state and local governments, businesses, and individual patients and their families. The marginal approach estimates individual disease behavior for every patient, explicitly estimates disease duration and calculates separate time-dependent costs. The aggregate approach is a Markov equivalent of the existing models; it assumes average disease behavior and cost for a given morbidity/mortality. Transition probabilities were drawn from a meta-analysis of 53 Salmonella studies. Both approaches were tested using the 1993 Salmonella typhimurium outbreak in Gideon, Missouri. This protocol can be applied to estimate morbidity, mortality and cost of specific outbreaks, provide better national Salmonella burden estimates, and estimate the benefits of reducing Salmonella risk.

10.1002/hec.1779.abstractZh: 在美国，每年大约有690,000至1,790,000例沙门氏菌感染病例，导致2万次住院治疗和400人死亡，相关费用约为26亿美元。现有的模型仅根据发病率来估算发病率、死亡率和成本，并未考虑疾病持续时间或时间作为独立的成本预测因素。这些模型可能会低估医生就诊次数、住院次数、死亡人数及相关成本。我们开发了一种马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛模型，用于估算特定沙门氏菌感染情况下的疾病持续时间、医生/急诊室就诊次数、住院次数、死亡率以及相应的成本。相关方包括社会机构、第三方支付方、医疗服务提供者、联邦、州和地方政府、企业以及个人患者及其家属。边际方法能够明确估算每位患者的疾病行为，计算疾病持续时间，并分别估算时间依赖的成本。整体方法则是现有模型的马尔可夫等价模型，它假设平均疾病行为和成本。转移概率来自对53项沙门氏菌研究的荟萃分析。这两种方法都通过1993年密苏里州吉迪恩沙门氏菌疫情进行了测试。该协议可用于估算特定疫情的发病率、死亡率和成本，提供更准确的全国沙门氏菌负担估算，并评估降低沙门氏菌风险的效益。

abstract.text: Although it has been shown that gaining Medicare coverage at age 65 years increases health service use among the uninsured, difficulty in changing habits or differences in the characteristics of previously uninsured compared with insured individuals may mean that the previously uninsured continue to use the healthcare system differently from others. This study uses Medicare claims data linked to two different surveys--the National Health Interview Survey and the Health and Retirement Study--to describe the relationship between insurance status before age 65 years and the use of Medicare-covered services beginning at age 65 years. Although we do not find statistically significant differences in Medicare expenditures or in the number of hospitalizations by previous insurance status, we do find that individuals who were uninsured before age 65 years continue to use the healthcare system differently from those who were privately insured. Specifically, they have 16% fewer visits to office-based physicians but make 18% and 43% more visits to hospital emergency and outpatient departments, respectively. A key question for the future may be why the previously uninsured seem to continue to use the healthcare system differently from the previously insured. This question may be important to consider as health coverage expansions are implemented.

10.1002/hec.1780.abstractZh: 尽管研究表明，65岁时获得医疗保险覆盖会增加未投保人群的健康服务使用率，但改变习惯的难度或之前未投保者与已投保者之间的特征差异可能导致后者继续以不同于其他人的方式使用医疗体系。本研究利用与两项调查相关的医疗保险索赔数据——全国健康访谈调查和健康与退休研究——来描述65岁之前保险状态与65岁后使用医疗保险覆盖服务之间的关系。虽然我们没有发现因保险状态不同而导致的医疗保险支出或住院次数的统计学显著差异，但我们发现65岁之前未投保的人继续以不同于已投保者的方式使用医疗体系。具体来说，他们就诊于诊所的频率降低了16%，而就诊于医院急诊和门诊部门的频率分别增加了18%和43%。未来一个关键问题可能是，为什么之前未投保的人似乎继续以不同于已投保者的方式使用医疗体系。在实施健康覆盖扩展政策时，这个问题值得考虑。

abstract.text: Previous applications of value of information methods for determining optimal sample size in randomized clinical trials have assumed no between-study variation in mean incremental net benefit. By adopting a hierarchical model, we provide a solution for determining optimal sample size with this assumption relaxed. The solution is illustrated with two examples from the literature. Expected net gain increases with increasing between-study variation, reflecting the increased uncertainty in incremental net benefit and reduced extent to which data are borrowed from previous evidence. Hence, a trial can become optimal where current evidence is sufficient assuming no between-study variation. However, despite the expected net gain increasing, the optimal sample size in the illustrated examples is relatively insensitive to the amount of between-study variation. Further percentage losses in expected net gain were small even when choosing sample sizes that reflected widely different between-study variation.

10.1002/hec.1781.abstractZh: 在之前的应用中，信息价值方法用于确定随机临床试验中的最优样本规模时，假设各研究之间的平均增量净收益没有差异。通过采用分层模型，我们为在放宽这一假设的情况下确定最优样本规模提供了解决方案。该解决方案通过两个文献中的例子进行了说明。随着各研究之间差异的增加，预期净收益也会增加，这反映了增量净收益的不确定性增加，以及从先前证据中借用数据的程度降低。因此，在假设各研究之间无差异的情况下，只要当前证据足够，试验就可以达到最优规模。然而，尽管预期净收益有所增加，但在所举例子的最优样本规模对各研究之间差异的大小相对不敏感。即使在选择反映较大差异的样本规模时，预期净收益的进一步百分比损失也较小。

abstract.text: Health policy evaluations estimate the response of population aggregate outcomes to interventions. However, clarity on the form of the expected causal relationship, the parameter identification strategy, and the mode of hypothesis testing is required to overcome a number of conceptual and methodological problems. We use the New Jersey statewide smoking ban as an example. We examine statewide admission rates for acute myocardial infarctions, strokes and lower limb fractures, and emergency room encounter rates for asthma exacerbations before and after the smoking ban. We discuss the identification options and show the sensitivity of estimates of the response function to different specifications of the stochastic and intervention components and to different modes of inference. Model misspecification is demonstrated by rolling Chow tests for structural breaks in repeated observations.

10.1002/hec.1783.abstractZh: 健康政策评估旨在衡量干预措施对人群整体结果的影响。然而，要克服许多概念和方法上的问题，就需要明确预期因果关系的表现形式、参数识别策略以及假设检验的方式。我们以新泽西州禁烟令为例，研究了急性心肌梗塞、中风和下肢骨折的住院率，以及哮喘加重情况下的急诊就诊率，在禁烟令实施前后进行了对比分析。我们讨论了参数识别的多种方法，并展示了响应函数估计对随机因素和干预因素不同设定方式以及不同推断方法的敏感性。通过滚动Chow检验来检测重复观测数据中的结构突变，可以证明模型的误设问题。

abstract.text: Screening is seen by many as a key element in cancer control strategies. Differences in uptake of screening related to socio-economic status exist and may contribute to differences in morbidity and mortality across socio-economic groups. Although a number of factors are likely to underlie differential uptake, differential access to subsequent diagnostic tests and/or treatment may have a pivotal role. This study examines differences in the uptake of cancer screening in Ireland related to socio-economic status. Data were extracted from SLÁN 2007 concerning uptake of breast, cervical, colorectal and prostate cancer screening in the preceding 12 months. Concentration indices were calculated and decomposed. Particular emphasis was placed in the decomposition upon the impact of private health insurance, evidenced in other work to impact on access to care within the mixed public-private Irish health system. This study found that significant differences related to socio-economic status exist with respect to uptake of cancer screening and that the main determinant of difference for breast, colorectal and prostate cancer screening was possession of private insurance. This may have profound implications for the design of cancer control strategies in countries where private insurance has a significant role, even where screening services are publicly funded and population based.

10.1002/hec.1784.abstractZh: 许多人认为筛查是癌症控制策略中的关键要素。与社会经济状况相关的筛查接受度存在差异，这可能会导致不同社会经济群体之间的发病率和死亡率有所不同。尽管有多种因素可能导致接受度的差异，但后续诊断测试和/或治疗的获取差异可能起着关键作用。本研究探讨了爱尔兰癌症筛查接受度与社会经济状况之间的关系。数据来源于SLÁN 2007，涉及过去12个月内乳腺癌、宫颈癌、结直肠癌和前列腺癌筛查的接受情况。计算了集中指数并进行了分解分析。在分解分析中特别强调了私人健康保险的影响，这一点在其他研究中也得到了证实，即私人健康保险对爱尔兰混合公私医疗体系中的医疗服务获取有着重要影响。研究发现，癌症筛查接受度与社会经济状况存在显著差异，其中乳腺癌、结直肠癌和前列腺癌筛查接受度的差异主要由是否拥有私人保险决定。这对于那些私人保险发挥重要作用的国家来说，对于癌症控制策略的设计具有重要意义，即使筛查服务是由公共资金资助的，且基于人口统计的。

abstract.text: In the absence of a 'gold standard' to estimate the economic burden of disease, a decision about the most appropriate costing method is required. Researchers have employed various methods to cost hospital stays, including per diem or diagnosis-related group (DRG)-based costs. Alternative methods differ in data collection and costing methodology. Using data from Scotland as an illustrative example, costing methods are compared, highlighting the wider implications for other countries with a publicly financed healthcare system. Five methods are compared using longitudinal data including baseline survey data (Midspan) linked to acute hospital admissions. Cost variables are derived using two forms of DRG-type costs, costs per diem, costs per episode-using a novel approach that distinguishes between variable and fixed costs and incorporates individual length of stay (LOS), and costs per episode using national average LOS. Cost estimates are generated using generalised linear model regression. Descriptive analysis shows substantial variation between costing methods. Differences found in regression analyses highlight the magnitude of variation in cost estimates for subgroups of the sample population. This paper emphasises that any inference made from econometric modelling of costs, where the marginal effect of explanatory variables is assessed, is substantially influenced by the costing method.

10.1002/hec.1785.abstractZh: 在缺乏一个“黄金标准”来估算疾病的经济负担的情况下，需要决定最合适的方法来计算成本。研究人员采用了多种方法来估算住院费用，包括按日费用或基于疾病分类组（DRG）的成本估算方法。不同的方法在数据收集和成本计算方式上有所不同。以苏格兰的数据为例，比较了各种成本计算方法，并强调了这些方法对其他公共财政医疗系统的国家的更广泛影响。本文使用纵向数据，包括与急性住院病例相关的基线调查数据（Midspan），比较了五种成本计算方法。成本变量通过两种DRG型成本形式来推导：按日费用和按病例费用——采用一种新颖的方法，区分可变成本和固定成本，并纳入个人住院时间；以及按病例费用，使用全国平均住院时间作为基准。成本估算是通过广义线性模型回归方法得出的。描述性分析显示，不同成本计算方法之间存在显著差异。回归分析发现的差异突显了样本人群中不同子群体的成本估算差异程度。本文强调，从成本的经济计量模型中进行推断时，如果评估解释变量的边际效应，那么结果会受到成本计算方法的显著影响。

abstract.text: Cervical cancer is one of the leading causes of cancer deaths in Taiwan. To investigate the disease cost and then raise awareness of the importance of screening for cervical cancer and promote early detection, this paper employs contingent valuation and willingness to pay (WTP) method to study how health-related quality of life, disease severity, and after-treatment disease status affect patients' WTP for a complete remission of the disease. The inclusive criteria for the study were primary case outpatients at least 3 months after they had received therapy at the time of our study period. Face-to-face interviews were conducted for the retrospective format of the survey. The result of the study indicates a lifetime WTP of $US21 221.96 for Taiwanese cervical cancer patients, which is significantly higher than the cost of screening for early detection. Disease stages do not show a consistent pattern in influencing WTP, but patients with surgery are willing to pay a significantly higher amount for a complete remission from the disease than patients without. In addition, mental health, positive attitudes toward life, and quality of life also are key factors that influence WTP.

10.1002/hec.1786.abstractZh: 宫颈癌是台湾癌症死亡的主要原因之一。为了研究该疾病的成本，并提高人们对宫颈癌筛查重要性的认识，促进早期检测，本文采用条件估值和支付意愿方法，研究健康相关生活质量、疾病严重程度以及治疗后疾病状态如何影响患者对于疾病完全缓解的支付意愿。研究纳入的对象为在研究期间至少接受过治疗3个月的主要门诊患者。调查采用回顾性访谈方式。研究结果显示，台湾宫颈癌患者的终身支付意愿为21,221.96美元，这一数值显著高于早期检测的成本。疾病阶段对支付意愿的影响并不一致，但接受手术的患者愿意支付更高的金额以获得疾病的完全缓解。此外，心理健康、对生活的积极态度以及生活质量也是影响支付意愿的关键因素。

abstract.text: A recent paper estimates the effects of Taiwan's National Health Insurance (NHI) on the elderly and concludes that NHI greatly increased the medical care utilization of the elderly but did not reduce their mortality. Using more recent and more accurate mortality data of the same group of elderly, this note re-estimates the NHI effect on mortality and finds that the mortality hazard of the previously uninsured elderly in the post-NHI period was on average 24% lower than it would have been in the absence of NHI. However, the NHI effect on the mortality hazard is only evident in the first 6 years following the enactment of NHI, suggesting that it may be difficult to undo the damage caused by the lack of insurance in early life.

10.1002/hec.1787.abstractZh: 一篇最近的论文估算了台湾国民健康保险对老年人的影响，结论是国民健康保险显著增加了老年人的医疗利用，但并未降低他们的死亡率。通过使用同一组老年人更近期、更精确的死亡数据，这篇论文重新估算了国民健康保险对死亡率的影响，发现国民健康保险实施后的老年人群体，其死亡风险平均降低了24%。然而，国民健康保险对死亡风险的影响仅在实施后的前6年内明显，这表明早期缺乏保险所带来的损害可能难以逆转。

abstract.text: Individuals can react to financial stress in a variety of ways, such as reducing discretionary spending or engaging in risky behaviors. This article investigates the effect of changing macroeconomic conditions (measured by the unemployment rate in the state of residence) on one type of risky behavior: excessive alcohol consumption. Using unique and recent panel data from waves 1 and 2 of the National Epidemiological Survey on Alcohol and Related Conditions (NESARC) and estimating fixed-effects models, we find that changes in the unemployment rate are positively related to changes in binge drinking, alcohol-involved driving, and alcohol abuse and/or dependence. Some differences are present among demographic groups, primarily in the magnitude of the estimated effects. These results contradict previous studies and suggest that problematic drinking may be an indirect and unfortunate consequence of an economic downturn.

10.1002/hec.1788.abstractZh: 个人在面对财务压力时，可能会采取多种应对方式，例如减少可自由支配的支出或从事冒险行为。本文研究了宏观经济状况的变化（以居住州的失业率来衡量）对一种冒险行为的影响：过度饮酒。通过利用《国家酒精及相关疾病调查》第1和第2波期的独特且最新的面板数据，并采用固定效应模型进行估计，我们发现失业率的变化与酗酒、涉酒驾驶、酒精滥用和/或依赖行为的变化呈正相关。不同人口群体之间存在一些差异，主要体现在估计效应的大小上。这些结果与先前的研究相矛盾，表明问题性饮酒可能是经济衰退的间接且不幸的后果。

abstract.text: Previous analyses of fat taxes have generally worked within an empirical framework in which it is difficult to determine whether consumers benefit from the policy. This note outlines on simple means to determine whether consumers benefit from a fat tax by comparing the ratio of expenditures on the taxed good to the weight effect of the tax against the individual's willingness to pay for a one-pound weight reduction. Our empirical calculations suggest that an individual would have to be willing to pay about $1500 to reduce weight by one pound for a tax on sugary beverages to be welfare enhancing. The results suggest either that a soda tax is very unlikely to increase individual consumer welfare or that the policy must be justified on some other grounds that abandon standard rationality assumptions.

10.1002/hec.1789.abstractZh: 以往对脂肪税的分析通常基于实证框架进行，这些框架难以确定消费者是否真正从这项政策中受益。本文提出了一种简单的方法，通过比较被征税商品支出与税收对体重影响的比率，以及个人愿意支付多少费用来减少一磅体重，从而判断消费者是否从中受益。我们的实证计算表明，如果含糖饮料的税收能够提升个人福利，那么个人至少需要支付约1500美元才能减少一磅体重。这些结果表明，要么对苏打水征税不太可能提高个人消费者福利，要么这项政策必须基于其他理由来证明其合理性，而这些理由需要摒弃标准的理性假设。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of the re-importation of imitated pharmaceuticals as a by-product of an open policy toward parallel import (PI) on process innovation. Foreign investment by a firm to exploit a new unregulated market with weak intellectual property rights can give rise to imitation. These products can potentially re-enter the original country when PI is allowed influencing research and development (R&D) incentives. In an emerging economy with technologically heterogeneous firms, trade costs shift PI-related market share losses from the more to the less R&D efficient firm, inducing the former to strategically increase R&D. PI accompanied by tariffs also induces higher R&D effort by the technologically inferior firm when it results in an expansion of its sales abroad. A tariff on PI is most likely to increase welfare when the technological gap between the two firms at home is sufficiently large.

10.1002/hec.1790.abstractZh: 本文研究了作为对平行进口开放政策副产品而重新进口仿制药品对流程创新的影响。企业投资开发新的、知识产权较弱的市场可能会引发仿制行为。当平行进口允许时，这些产品可能会重新进入原产国，从而影响研发激励。在技术异质的企业构成的新兴经济体中，贸易成本会将与平行进口相关的市场份额损失从研发效率较低的企业转移到研发效率较高的企业，促使前者增加研发投入。如果平行进口伴随着关税，那么技术劣势的企业在扩大海外销售的同时，也会增加研发投入。当国内两企业之间的技术差距足够大时，对平行进口征收关税很可能会提高整体福利。

abstract.text: To date, there has been little data or empirical research on the determinants of doctors' earnings despite earnings having an important role in influencing the cost of health care, decisions on workforce participation and labour supply. This paper examines the determinants of annual earnings of general practitioners (GPs) and specialists using the first wave of the Medicine in Australia: Balancing Employment and Life, a new longitudinal survey of doctors. For both GPs and specialists, earnings are higher for men, for those who are self-employed and for those who do after-hours or on-call work. GPs have higher earnings if they work in larger practices, in outer regional or rural areas, and in areas with lower GP density, whereas specialists earn more if they have more working experience, spend more time in clinical work and have less complex patients. Decomposition analysis shows that the mean earnings of GPs are lower than that of specialists because GPs work fewer hours, are more likely to be female, are less likely to undertake after-hours or on-call work, and have lower returns to experience. Roughly 50% of the income gap between GPs and specialists is explained by differences in unobserved characteristics and returns to those characteristics.

10.1002/hec.1791.abstractZh: 迄今为止，关于医生收入决定因素的数据和实证研究很少。尽管收入在影响医疗保健成本、劳动力参与决策和劳动力供应方面起着重要作用，但相关研究仍然较为匮乏。本文利用澳大利亚医学调查的第一批数据，对全科医生和专业医生的年收入决定因素进行了研究。研究发现，对于全科医生和专业医生而言，男性的收入更高，自雇人员的收入也更高，同时，在夜间或值班期间工作的医生的收入也更高。如果全科医生在规模较大的诊所工作，或者在偏远地区或农村地区的诊所工作，或者工作地点全科医生密度较低，他们的收入也会更高。而专业医生如果有更多的工作经验，在临床工作中花费的时间更多，患者病情较为简单，他们的收入也会更高。分解分析表明，全科医生的平均收入低于专业医生，原因是全科医生的工作时间较少，女性比例较高，不太可能从事夜间或值班工作，且经验带来的收益较低。全科医生和专业医生之间的收入差距，大约有一半可以由未观察到的特征差异以及这些特征带来的收益差异来解释。

abstract.text: This paper presents a new scoring algorithm for the SF-6D, one of the most popular preference-based health status measures. Previous SF-6D value sets have a minimum (a floor), which is substantially higher than the lowest value generated by the EQ-5D model. Our algorithm expands the range of SF-6D utility scores in such a way that the floor is significantly lowered. We obtain the wider range because of the use of a lottery equivalent method through which preferences from a representative sample of Spanish general population are elicited.

10.1002/hec.1792.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的SF-6D评分算法，SF-6D是最流行的基于偏好的健康状况衡量指标之一。以往的SF-6D数值集存在一个最低值，该值远高于EQ-5D模型生成的最低值。我们的算法通过一种类似彩票的方法，从西班牙普通人群的代表性样本中收集偏好信息，从而显著降低了该最低值。通过这种方式，我们获得了更广泛的SF-6D效用评分范围。

abstract.text: Payer (insurer) sharing of savings is a way of motivating providers of medical services to reduce cost growth. A Medicare shared savings program is established for accountable care organizations in the 2010 Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act. However, savings created by providers cannot be distinguished from the normal (random) variation in medical claims costs, setting up a classic principal-agent problem. To lessen the likelihood of paying undeserved bonuses, payers may pay bonuses only if observed savings exceed minimum levels. We study the trade-off between two types of errors in setting minimum savings requirements: paying bonuses when providers do not create savings and not paying bonuses when providers create savings.

10.1002/hec.1793.abstractZh: 支付方（保险公司）共享节省资金是一种激励医疗服务提供者降低成本增长的方式。根据2010年《患者保护与平价医疗法案》，为负责护理组织设立了医疗保险共享节省计划。然而，医疗服务提供者创造的节省与医疗索赔成本的正常（随机）波动难以区分，这就引发了一个典型的委托-代理问题。为了减少支付不公正的奖金的可能性，支付方只有在观察到节省金额超过最低标准时才会支付奖金。我们研究了在设定最低节省要求时两种错误之间的权衡：在医疗服务提供者未创造节省时支付奖金，以及在他们创造节省时不支付奖金。

abstract.text: This paper contributes to the literature on the labor market consequences of unhealthy behaviors and poor health by examining a previously underappreciated consequence of the rise in obesity in the USA: challenges for military recruitment. Specifically, this paper estimates the percentage of the US military-age population that exceeds the US Army's current active duty enlistment standards for weight-for-height and percent body fat, using data from the series of National Health and Nutrition Examination Surveys that spans 1959-2008. We calculate that the percentage of military-age adults ineligible for enlistment because they are overweight and overfat more than doubled for men and tripled for women during that time. As of 2007-2008, 5.7 million men and 16.5 million women exceeded the Army's enlistment standards for weight and body fat. We document disparities across race and education in exceeding the standards and estimate that a further rise of just 1% in weight and body fat would further reduce eligibility for military service by over 850 000 men and 1.3 million women. The paper concludes with a discussion of the implications of these findings for military recruitment and defense policy.

10.1002/hec.1794.abstractZh: 本文通过研究美国肥胖率上升所带来的一个此前被忽视的后果——对军事招募的负面影响，为关于不健康行为和不良健康状况对劳动力市场影响的文献做出了贡献。具体而言，本文利用1959年至2008年间的全国健康与营养调查数据，估算了美国适龄军人中因体重与身高比例及体脂率不符合陆军现役标准而未能入伍的军人比例。结果显示，在此期间，因超重和肥胖而无法入伍的适龄军人比例在男性中翻了一番以上，在女性中则增加了三倍。截至2007-2008年，有570万男性和1650万女性未能达到陆军的入伍标准。文章还揭示了不同种族和教育水平在未能达到标准方面的差异，并估计，如果体重和体脂率再增加1%，将有超过85万男性和130万女性无法入伍。文章最后讨论了这些发现对军事招募和国防政策的影响。

abstract.text: Although the concentration index (CI) and the health achievement index (HAI) have been extensively used, previous studies have relied on bootstrapping to compute the variance of the HAI, whereas competing variance estimators exist for the CI. This paper provides methods of statistical inference for the HAI and compares the available variance estimators for both the CI and the HAI using Monte Carlo simulation. Results for both the CI and the HAI suggest that analytical methods and bootstrapping are well behaved. The convenient regression method gives standard errors close to the other methods, provided the CI is not too large (< 0.2), but otherwise tends to understate the standard errors. In our simulation setting, the improvement from the Newey-West correction over the convenient regression method has mixed evidence when the CI ≤ 0.1 and is modest when the CI > 0.1. Published 2011. This article is a US Government work and is in the public domain in the USA.

10.1002/hec.1796.abstractZh: 尽管浓度指数和健康成就指数已被广泛使用，但以往的研究通常依赖自举法来计算健康成就指数的方差，而浓度指数则有其他更有效的方差估计方法。本文提出了针对健康成就指数的统计推断方法，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟比较了浓度指数和健康成就指数的各种方差估计方法。研究结果表明，分析方法和自举法的表现都相当不错。当浓度指数不超过0.2时，便捷回归法给出的标准误差与其他方法相近，但在浓度指数超过0.1时，便捷回归法的标准误差往往偏低。在模拟实验中，当浓度指数≤0.1时，Newey-West修正法相对于便捷回归法的改进效果并不明显；而当浓度指数>0.1时，其改进效果则较为显著。本文发表于2011年，属于美国政府资助的研究项目，在美国属于公共领域。

abstract.text: This study provides the first comprehensive analysis of the dynamics of labor supply of direct care workers, the lower-skill nursing workers who provide the bulk of long-term care for the elderly in the USA. Our estimates from the 1996 and 2001 panels of the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP) show that the mean (median) duration of employment spells for the same direct care employer is only 9.7 (5.0) months. We find that fewer than one-third of direct care workers leave a job to take another job in the direct care field. There is also little indication of upward mobility in the health sector; direct care workers are approximately equally likely to transition to working as Registered Nurses as they are to working in household service jobs. Additionally, the rate at which spells end in work-limiting disability (5.4%) is very high compared with rates in similar occupations. We estimate duration models of direct care job spell length and find that, after correcting for the endogenous relationship between wages and tenure, wages appear to have a modest effect in preventing turnover; this effect is concentrated among the shortest spells.

10.1002/hec.1798.abstractZh: 本研究首次对直接护理人员的劳动力供应动态进行了全面分析。这些低技能的护理人员为美国老年人提供大部分长期护理服务。根据1996年和2001年《收入与计划参与调查》的估计，同一直接护理雇主的就业平均持续时间仅为9.7个月（中位数5.0个月）。我们发现，直接护理人员中仅有不到三分之一的人会离开当前的工作去从事其他直接护理相关的工作。此外，健康行业中的晋升机会也很少；直接护理人员转行成为注册护士的可能性与转行从事家庭服务工作的可能性大致相同。另外，因残疾而终止工作的比例（5.4%）远高于类似职业的平均水平。我们估算了直接护理工作的持续时间模型，并发现，在纠正了工资与任职时间之间的内生关系后，工资似乎对防止人员流动有轻微的作用；这种效应主要出现在最短的雇佣期间。

abstract.text: In cost-utility analysis, the numbers of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs) gained are aggregated by placing the same weight on each QALY. Deviations from this rubric have been proposed on a number of grounds, including the degree to which persons might be deemed responsible for the illness faced, and inequality in lifetime health between groups. Most research has looked at these factors in isolation. This paper analyses public preferences about the relative importance of these factors. Over 500 members of the general public in the UK are interviewed in their homes. Where "blameworthy" groups experience a moderate drop in quality of life due to their behaviour, they appear to receive higher priority than an otherwise "trustworthy" group if they also experience poorer health prospects because the latter is weighted more heavily than the former.

10.1002/hec.1799.abstractZh: 在成本-效用分析中，通过为每一个质量调整生命年赋予相同的权重，来汇总所获得的额外质量调整生命年数量。对于这一标准的偏差，已经提出了多种理由，包括个人可能被认为应对所面临的疾病负责的程度，以及不同群体之间的终生健康差异。大多数研究都是单独考虑这些因素的。本文分析了公众对这些因素相对重要性的偏好。在英国，有超过500名普通民众在家中接受了访谈。对于那些因行为而生活质量出现适度下降的“有过错”群体，如果它们还面临更糟糕的健康前景，那么这些群体似乎比那些“值得信赖”的群体获得更高的优先级。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the empirical relationship between health knowledge and the probability of adopting the lifestyles known as the 'Alameda Seven'. I test whether having accumulated such knowledge during training in a healthcare profession changes individual lifestyles using the Swiss Health Survey. The results suggest that there are indeed effects of health knowledge on smoking for university graduates and on alcohol consumption and eating behavior for graduates of both university level and vocational medical training programs.

10.1002/hec.1800.abstractZh: 本文分析了健康知识与采用被称为“阿拉米达七项”的生活方式之间的实证关系。通过瑞士健康调查，我们检验了在医疗职业培训过程中积累此类知识是否会影响个人的生活方式。研究结果表明，对于大学毕业生而言，健康知识确实对吸烟行为有影响；而对于大学水平及职业医学培训项目的毕业生来说，健康知识则对饮酒和饮食行为有影响。

abstract.text: The bivariate probit model is frequently used for estimating the effect of an endogenous binary regressor (the 'treatment') on a binary health outcome variable. This paper discusses simple modifications that maintain the probit assumption for the marginal distributions while introducing non-normal dependence using copulas. In an application of the copula bivariate probit model to the effect of insurance status on the absence of ambulatory health care expenditure, a model based on the Frank copula outperforms the standard bivariate probit model.

10.1002/hec.1801.abstractZh: 双变量Probit模型常被用于估计一个内生二元回归变量（“处理变量”）对二元健康结果变量的影响。本文讨论了在保持边际分布Probit假设的前提下，通过Copula函数引入非正态依赖性的简单改进方法。在将Copula双变量Probit模型应用于保险状态对门诊医疗支出缺失影响的研究中，基于Frank Copula的模型表现优于标准双变量Probit模型。

abstract.text: This paper argues that health economists should consider the costs and benefits of preventing rather than treating disease. It sketches a developmental approach to health that examines the costs and benefits of interventions over the life cycle.

10.1002/hec.1802.abstractZh: 本文认为，健康经济学家应当考虑预防疾病而非治疗疾病的成本和收益。文章提出了一种发展性健康策略，旨在考察干预措施在整个生命周期中的成本和收益。

abstract.text: Epidemic diseases afflict all countries, and all epidemics are costly to society. The present paper examines optimal vaccination trajectories before and after an outbreak of a special class of epidemics where the disease normally eradicates itself. The focus is on epidemics where mortality may be ignored, influenza being the prime example. One important insight is that there may be increasing returns to scale in vaccination.

10.1002/hec.1803.abstractZh: 流行病困扰着所有国家，而所有流行病都会给社会带来高昂的成本。本文探讨了在某一特殊类型的流行病爆发之前和之后的最佳疫苗接种方案。这类流行病通常能够自行消亡，因此可以忽略其导致的死亡问题。以流感为例，这类流行病尤其值得关注。一个重要的发现是，疫苗接种可能具有规模效应。

abstract.text: Gesundheitsvorsorge, Leistungsanreiz, Öffentliche Dienstleistung, Wettbewerb, Großbritannien

10.1002/hec.1804.abstractZh: 健康保障、绩效激励、公共服务、竞争、英国

abstract.text: Using microdata, that is, representative samples of 114,403 German long-term care dependants (LTCDs) observed from 2000 to 2009, we give a comprehensive insight into the length of stay (LOS) in long-term care (LTC). Furthermore, this paper evaluates the effects of longevity on the LOS, thus revisiting the debate on the validity of the competing theories of compression or expansion of morbidity in LTC. The analysis finds significant effects on the LOS when AGE is controlled for, albeit do not confirm the time-to-death hypothesis. However, controlling for ASSESSMENT LEVEL suggests an improved health status of LTCDs over time, thus supporting the time-to-death hypothesis. An analysis of the mortality rates of LTCDs is to give insight into the opposing results. But the regression of mortality shows a divergence in the development of mortality rates for different disability levels. This is evidence to suggest that the 'improved' health status in LTC is not only due to actual changes in the health status, but also a consequence of political intervention.

10.1002/hec.1805.abstractZh: 通过利用微数据，即2000至2009年间收集的114,403名德国长期护理依赖者的代表性样本，我们对长期护理中的住院时长进行了全面分析。此外，本文还评估了寿命延长对住院时长的影响，从而重新审视了关于长期护理中发病率压缩或扩张理论有效性的争论。分析发现，在控制年龄因素后，寿命延长对住院时长有显著影响，尽管这一结果并未证实“死亡时间假说”。然而，在控制评估水平后，发现长期护理依赖者的健康状况随时间有所改善，这支持了“死亡时间假说”。对长期护理依赖者死亡率的分析有助于解释这些相反的结果。但死亡率的回归分析显示，不同残疾等级下的死亡率发展存在差异。这表明，长期护理中“改善”的健康状况不仅源于实际的健康状况变化，还可能源于政治干预的结果。

abstract.text: Product vendors and manufacturers are increasingly aware that purchasers of health care will fund new clinical treatments only if they are perceived to deliver value-for-money. This influences companies' internal commercial decisions, including the price they set for their products. Other things being equal, there is a price threshold, which is the maximum price at which the device will be funded and which, if its value were known, would play a central role in price determination. This paper examines the problem of pricing a medical device from the vendor's point of view in the presence of uncertainty about what the price threshold will be. A formal solution is obtained by maximising the expected value of the net revenue function, assuming a Bayesian prior distribution for the price threshold. A least admissible price is identified. The model can also be used as a tool for analysing proposed pricing policies when no formal prior specification of uncertainty is available.

10.1002/hec.1807.abstractZh: 产品供应商和制造商越来越意识到，只有当人们认为医疗保健产品的性价比高时，购买者才会愿意为其支付费用。这一因素影响着公司的内部商业决策，包括产品定价。在其他条件相同的情况下，存在一个价格门槛，即设备能够被接受支付的最高价格。如果知道该设备的价值，这个价格门槛将在定价中起到核心作用。本文从供应商的角度探讨了在价格门槛不确定的情况下如何为医疗设备定价的问题。通过假设价格门槛的贝叶斯先验分布，并最大化净收入函数的预期价值，得到了一种正式的解决方案。同时，还确定了最低可接受价格。该模型还可以作为分析在没有正式不确定性先验信息的情况下所提出的定价策略的工具。

abstract.text: The derivation of population norms using simple generic health-related quality of life measures to inform policy has been recommended in the literature. This letter illustrates the derivation of population norms for the SF-6D in the United Kingdom. It uses a sample of 22,166 respondents from the 2010 wave of the study Understanding Society. Understanding Society is a national representative sample of British citizens. The survey of this study contains the SF-12. It is possible to derive health state utilities from the SF-12 (and from the SF-36) using a relatively new instrument, the SF-6D. The SF-12 and the SF-36 belong to the most widely used generic health-related quality of life measures. Mean SF-6D utility scores for males and females are 0.81 and 0.79, respectively. Especially the older age categories have lower utility scores. The younger age categories have slightly higher utility scores. From a list of 17 conditions, people with congestive heart failure had the lowest (0.60) and people with diabetes the highest (0.76) SF-6D scores. This letter encourages the health economics research community to derive SF-6D population norms to inform policy.

10.1002/hec.1823.abstractZh: 文献中建议使用简单的通用健康相关生活质量指标来推导人口标准，以指导政策制定。本文展示了在英国使用SF-6D来推导人口标准的方法。研究样本来自2010年“理解社会”调查中的22,166名受访者。“理解社会”是英国公民的一个具有全国代表性的样本。该调查包含了SF-12指标。可以使用相对较新的工具SF-6D从SF-12（以及SF-36）中推导出健康状态效用值。SF-12和SF-36是最常用的通用健康相关生活质量指标。男性和女性的平均SF-6D效用值分别为0.81和0.79，尤其是年龄较大的组别效用值较低，而较年轻的年龄组别的效用值略高。在17种疾病中，充血性心力衰竭患者的SF-6D得分最低（0.60），而糖尿病患者的得分最高（0.76）。本文鼓励健康经济学研究界推导出SF-6D的人口标准，以指导政策制定。

abstract.text: We exploit a brief period of asymmetric information during the implementation of Pennsylvania's 'report card' scheme for coronary artery bypass graft surgery to test for improvements in quality of care and selection of patients by healthcare providers. During the first 3 years of the 1990 s, providers in Pennsylvania had an incentive to bias report cards by selecting patients strategically, with patients having no access to the report cards. This dichotomy enables us to separate providers' selection of patients from patients' selection of providers. Using data from the Nationwide Inpatient Sample, we estimate a nonlinear difference-in-differences model and derive asymptotic standard errors. The mortality rate for bypass patient decreases by only 0.05 percentage points because of the report cards, which we interpret as evidence that quality of bypass surgery did not improve (at least in the short-term) nor did patient selection by providers occur. Our timing, estimation, and asymptotics are readily applicable to many other report card schemes.

10.1002/hec.2775.abstractZh: 我们利用了宾夕法尼亚州“成绩单”计划实施期间信息不对称的一个短暂时期，来检验该计划是否提升了医疗服务的质量以及医疗服务提供者选择患者的能力。在1990年代的头三年里，宾夕法尼亚州的医疗服务提供者有动机通过策略性地选择患者来影响成绩单的编制，而患者则无法获取这些成绩单。这种信息不对称的情况使我们能够区分医疗服务提供者选择患者的行为与患者选择提供者的行为。我们利用全国住院样本的数据，建立了一个非线性差异对差异模型，并推导出了渐近标准误差。结果显示，由于成绩单的存在，搭桥手术患者的死亡率仅下降了0.05个百分点，这被我们解释为：搭桥手术的质量并未改善（至少在短期内如此），同时医疗服务提供者选择患者的行为也没有发生。我们的研究方法和结论可以很容易地应用于许多其他成绩单制度。

abstract.text: HIV/AIDS is a heavily mediatised disease. In this article, we test whether media attention is affecting donors' disbursement of aid for HIV to African countries. We use information available on the number of articles and press documents on HIV issues and other health concerns published in donor countries to construct a proxy of media coverage. This proxy is then included as an explanatory variable in a regression of aid for HIV to Africa. After controlling for several donor characteristics, we find that greater media coverage increases aid disbursement. This may be good news for the HIV campaign but may result in displacement effects to the extent that other diseases that cause greater mortality and morbidity receive less media coverage than HIV and thus less health aid.

10.1002/hec.2776.abstractZh: HIV/AIDS是一种高度媒体化的疾病。在本文中，我们探讨了媒体关注是否会影响捐助者对非洲国家提供的HIV相关援助的分配。我们利用了捐助国发布的关于HIV问题及其他健康问题的文章和新闻文件数量信息，来构建一种媒体覆盖的代理变量。随后，我们将这一代理变量作为解释变量纳入对非洲HIV相关援助分配的回归分析中。在控制了多个捐助国特征后，我们发现媒体覆盖度的增加确实提升了援助的分配。这对HIV防治工作来说可能是个好消息，但也可能引发其他导致更高死亡率和发病率的疾病受到较少媒体关注，从而获得的健康援助也会减少。

abstract.text: The justification bias in the estimated impact of health shocks on retirement is mitigated by using objective health measures from a large, register-based longitudinal data set including medical diagnosis codes, along with labor market status, financial, and socio-economic variables. The duration until retirement is modeled using single and competing risk specifications, observed and unobserved heterogeneity, and flexible baseline hazards. Wealth is used as a proxy for elapsed duration to mitigate the potential selection bias stemming from conditioning on initial participation. The competing risk specification distinguishes complete multiperiod routes to retirement, such as unemployment followed by early retirement. A result on comparison of coefficients across all states is offered. The empirical results indicate a strong impact of health changes on retirement and hence a large potential for public policy measures intended to retain older workers longer in the labor force. Disability responds more to health shocks than early retirement, especially to diseases of the circulatory, respiratory, and musculoskeletal systems, as well as mental and behavioral disorders. Some unemployment spells followed by early retirement appear voluntary and spurred by life style diseases.

10.1002/hec.2811.abstractZh: 通过使用来自大型登记性纵向数据集中的客观健康指标，包括医疗诊断代码，以及劳动力市场状况、财务和社会经济变量，可以减轻对健康冲击对退休影响估计中的合理性偏差。退休年龄的建模采用了单一风险和竞争风险模型，考虑了观察到的和未观察到的异质性，并采用了灵活的基线风险模型。财富被用作衡量时间跨度的代理变量，以缓解基于初始参与情况而产生的潜在选择偏差。竞争风险模型区分了多种多周期退休路径，例如失业后提前退休。文中还提供了各状态之间系数的比较结果。实证结果表明，健康变化对退休有显著影响，因此，旨在延长老年劳动者在劳动力市场中停留时间的公共政策措施具有巨大潜力。与提前退休相比，残疾对健康冲击的反应更为强烈，尤其是循环系统、呼吸系统、肌肉骨骼系统疾病，以及精神和行为障碍。一些失业期后出现的提前退休似乎是自愿的，并且是由生活方式疾病引发的。

abstract.text: Statistical methods have been developed for cost-effectiveness analyses of cluster randomised trials (CRTs) where baseline covariates are balanced. However, CRTs may show systematic differences in individual and cluster-level covariates between the treatment groups. This paper presents three methods to adjust for imbalances in observed covariates: seemingly unrelated regression with a robust standard error, a 'two-stage' bootstrap approach combined with seemingly unrelated regression and multilevel models. We consider the methods in a cost-effectiveness analysis of a CRT with covariate imbalance, unequal cluster sizes and a prognostic relationship that varied by treatment group. The cost-effectiveness results differed according to the approach for covariate adjustment. A simulation study then assessed the relative performance of methods for addressing systematic imbalance in baseline covariates. The simulations extended the case study and considered scenarios with different levels of confounding, cluster size variation and few clusters. Performance was reported as bias, root mean squared error and CI coverage of the incremental net benefit. Even with low levels of confounding, unadjusted methods were biased, but all adjusted methods were unbiased. Multilevel models performed well across all settings, and unlike the other methods, reported CI coverage close to nominal levels even with few clusters of unequal sizes.

10.1002/hec.2812.abstractZh: 已经开发出统计方法，用于对基线协变量平衡的集群随机试验（CRT）进行成本效益分析。然而，CRT在治疗组之间可能会在个体和集群层面的协变量上表现出系统性差异。本文提出了三种调整观察到的协变量不平衡的方法：一种采用稳健标准误差的看似无关回归方法，一种结合看似无关回归和多层次模型的“两阶段”自举法。我们在一个存在协变量不平衡、集群大小不等以及治疗效果差异的CRT成本效益分析中考虑了这些方法。根据协变量调整的方法不同，成本效益结果也有所不同。随后通过模拟研究评估了这些方法在处理基线协变量系统性不平衡方面的相对性能。模拟案例扩展了研究范围，考虑了不同程度的混杂因素、集群大小变化以及少量不同大小的集群情况。性能指标包括偏差、均方根误差以及增量净效益的置信区间覆盖率。即使在混杂程度较低的情况下，未调整的方法仍存在偏差，但所有调整过的方法均无偏差。多层次模型在所有情况下表现良好，与其他方法不同，即使在少量不同大小的集群情况下，其置信区间覆盖率也接近名义水平。

abstract.text: Cross-sectional latent class regression models, also known as switching regressions or hidden Markov models, cannot identify transitions between classes that may occur over time. This limitation can potentially be overcome when panel data are available. For such data, we develop a sequence of models that combine features of the static cross-sectional latent class (finite mixture) models with those of hidden Markov models. We model the probability of movement between categories in terms of a Markovian structure, which links the current state with a previous state, where state may refer to the category of an individual. This article presents a suite of mixture models of varying degree of complexity and flexibility for use in a panel count data setting, beginning with a baseline model which is a two-component mixture of Poisson distribution in which latent classes are fixed and permanent. Sequentially, we extend this framework (i) to allow the mixing proportions to be smoothly varying continuous functions of time-varying covariates, (ii) to add time dependence to the benchmark model by modeling the class-indicator variable as a first-order Markov chain and (iii) to extend item (i) by making it dynamic and introducing covariate dependence in the transition probabilities. We develop and implement estimation algorithms for these models and provide an empirical illustration using 1995-1999 panel data on the number of doctor visits derived from the German Socio-Economic Panel.

10.1002/hec.2813.abstractZh: 横截面潜在类回归模型，也称为切换回归或隐马尔可夫模型，无法识别随时间发生的类间转换。当存在面板数据时，这一限制可以被克服。对于此类数据，我们开发了一系列模型，结合了静态横截面潜在类模型与隐马尔可夫模型的特点。我们通过马尔可夫结构来建模类别间转换的概率，该结构将当前状态与之前的状态联系起来，其中状态可以指个体的类别。本文介绍了一组具有不同复杂度和灵活性的混合模型，适用于面板计数数据环境，从基线模型开始，该模型是双组分泊松分布的混合模型，其中潜在类是固定且永久的。随后，我们逐步扩展这一框架：(i) 允许混合比例随时间变化的连续函数；(ii) 通过建模类别指示变量为一级马尔可夫链，为基准模型添加时间依赖性；(iii) 通过使模型动态化并在转换概率中引入协变量依赖性，进一步扩展上述模型。我们为这些模型开发了估计算法，并使用1995-1999年德国社会经济面板数据中医生就诊次数的面板数据进行了实证验证。

abstract.text: The causal association between absolute income and health is well-established; however, the relationship between income inequality and health is not. The conclusions from the received studies vary across the region or country studied and/or the methodology employed. Using the Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia panel survey, this paper investigates the relationship between mental health and inequality in Australia. A variety of income inequality indices are calculated to test both the income inequality and relative deprivation hypotheses. We find that mental health is only adversely affected by the presence of relative deprivation to a very small degree. In addition, we do not find support for the income inequality hypothesis. Importantly, our results are robust to a number of sensitivity analyses.

10.1002/hec.2814.abstractZh: 绝对收入与健康之间的因果关系已经得到充分证实；然而，收入不平等与健康之间的关系却尚未得到明确结论。不同地区或国家的研究结果存在差异，这可能与研究方法的不同有关。本文利用澳大利亚家庭、收入和劳动动态调查数据，探讨了澳大利亚心理健康状况与收入不平等之间的关系。通过多种收入不平等指标的计算，我们验证了收入不平等和相对剥夺假说。研究发现，心理健康仅受到相对剥夺的轻微影响，而收入不平等假说则未能得到支持。重要的是，我们的研究结果在多次敏感性分析后依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: The paper focuses on the long-term effects of early-life conditions with comparison to lifestyles and educational attainment on health status in a cohort of British people born in 1958. Using the longitudinal follow-up data at age 23, 33, 42 and 46, we build a dynamic model to investigate the influence of each determinant on health and the mediating role of education and lifestyles in the relationship between early-life conditions and later health. Direct and indirect effects of early-life conditions on adult health are explored using auxiliary linear regressions of education and lifestyles and panel Probit specifications of self-assessed health with random effects addressing individual unexplained heterogeneity. Our study shows that early-life conditions are important parameters for adult health accounting for almost 20% of explained health inequality when mediating effects are identified. The contribution of lifestyles reduces from 32% down to 25% when indirect effects of early-life conditions and education are distinguished. Noticeably, the absence of father at the time of birth and experience of financial hardships represent the lead factors for direct effects on health. The absence of obesity at 16 influences health both directly and indirectly working through lifestyles.

10.1002/hec.2815.abstractZh: 本文聚焦于1958年出生的英国人群，通过对比早期生活状况与生活方式及教育成就对健康状况的长期影响。利用23岁、33岁、42岁和46岁时的纵向随访数据，我们构建了一个动态模型来研究各因素对健康的影响，并探讨教育与生活方式在早期生活状况与后期健康关系中的中介作用。通过辅助线性回归分析教育和生活方式对成人健康的直接影响和间接影响，以及采用面板Probit模型对自我评估的健康状况进行随机效应分析，以揭示个体间未解释异质性的影响。研究表明，早期生活状况是成人健康的重要影响因素，在识别中介效应时，其解释健康不平等的比例接近20%。当区分早期生活状况与教育的中间接效应时，生活方式的贡献则从32%降至25%。值得注意的是，父亲在出生时的缺席以及经历财务困难是直接影响健康的首要因素。16岁时肥胖状况的缺失也通过生活方式对健康产生直接和间接影响。

abstract.text: If informal family health care is a substitute for formal health care, then there is a scope to reduce formal health care cost by promoting informal family health care. With the use of Korean data for the elderly, this paper estimates the effects of informal family health care on formal health care, where the former is measured by the number of caregivers and the latter is measured by the formal health care expenditure. This task, however, poses a number of difficulties. The first is that the number of the family caregivers is an endogenous count regressor. The second is that there are too many zeros in the count (85%). The third is that the response variable also has a nontrivial proportion of zeros (14%). This paper overcomes these problems by combining 'control function approach', 'zero-inflated' counts, and a semiparametric estimator for censored models. The resulting procedure avoids strong parametric assumptions and behaves well computationally. Our main empirical finding is that informal family health care has a large substitute effect for diabetics and that there are also weak evidences that informal family health care has substitute effects for high blood pressure and mental diseases.

10.1002/hec.2822.abstractZh: 如果非正式的家族医疗保健能够替代正式的医疗保健，那么通过促进非正式的家族医疗保健，就有机会降低正式的医疗保健成本。本文利用韩国老年人的数据，估计了非正式家族医疗保健对正式医疗保健的影响，其中非正式家族医疗保健的数量作为衡量指标，而正式医疗保健支出则作为另一个衡量指标。然而，这一任务面临许多困难。首先，家族护理人员的数量是内生性的计数变量。其次，计数数据中有太多零值（占85%）。第三，响应变量中也有相当比例的零值（占14%）。本文通过结合“控制函数方法”、“零膨胀计数”以及用于截尾模型的半参数估计器，克服了这些问题。所采用的程序避免了强参数假设，并且在计算上表现良好。我们的主要实证发现是，非正式家族医疗保健对糖尿病患者的替代效应较大，同时也有证据表明非正式家族医疗保健对高血压和精神疾病也有替代效应。

abstract.text: We analysed patient-level data (n = 72,235) from 563 hospitals in 10 European countries to assess the ability of national diagnosis-related group (DRG) systems to account for patient-level variation in cost or lengths of stay of breast cancer surgery patients against a standard set of patient characteristics, treatment and quality variables. We find that European DRG systems use very different types of classification variables and numbers of DRGs (range: 3-7) to classify these patients. In 6 of 10 countries, the set of patient characteristics, treatment and quality variables, which we were able to define across countries, perform better than the set of national DRGs in accounting for patient-level variation in resource consumption. Moreover, there appear to be factors that are consistently significant determinants of cost/length of stay of breast cancer surgery cases but are not, or at least not fully, considered in European DRG systems. Our results therefore raise concerns as to whether all systems rely on the most appropriate classification variables. In several countries, policymakers should reevaluate the appropriateness of their DRG algorithm for breast cancer surgery and of specific DRG weights.

10.1002/hec.2832.abstractZh: 我们分析了来自10个欧洲国家563家医院的72,235名患者的数据，以评估国家诊断相关分组系统能否根据一组标准的患者特征、治疗和质量变量，解释乳腺癌手术患者的成本或住院时间差异。我们发现，欧洲的DRG系统使用不同类型的分类变量，并且使用的DRG数量（范围：3-7）各不相同。在10个国家中的6个国家，我们能够定义一组通用的患者特征、治疗和质量变量，这些变量在解释患者资源消耗差异方面，比国家DRG系统表现得更好。此外，似乎有一些因素对乳腺癌手术的成本和住院时间有持续显著的影响，但这些因素并未被欧洲DRG系统充分考虑或完全纳入考虑范围。因此，我们的研究结果引发了担忧，即所有系统是否都依赖于最合适的分类变量。在几个国家，政策制定者应该重新评估其DRG算法在乳腺癌手术方面的适用性，以及特定DRG权重的合理性。

abstract.text: Cholecystectomy is the surgical removal of the gallbladder. It is the most common method for treating symptomatic gallstones. Despite the existence of well-established treatment guidelines, the rate of cholecystectomy varies widely across Europe. We analyse patients in 10 countries that had undergone surgery for the treatment of symptomatic gallstones. We test the performance of three models in explaining variation in the (log of) cost of the inpatient stay (seven countries) or length of stay (three countries). The first model includes only the diagnosis-related group (DRG) variables to which cholecystectomy patients were coded (M(D)), the second uses a core set of patient characteristics and episode-specific explanatory variables (M(P)), and finally, the third model combines both sets of variables (M(F)). Countries vary both in the number of DRGs used to classify cholecystectomy patients (range: 2-8), and in the percentage of patients covered by a single DRG (range: 50%-92%). The ability of combining both DRGs and patient level variables to explain cost variation among patients ranges from 58% in Spain to over 81% in Finland. The comparison of models' performance suggests that incorporating relevant patient characteristics may significantly improve DRG systems.

10.1002/hec.2833.abstractZh: 胆囊切除术是手术切除胆囊的手术。它是治疗有症状胆结石的最常用方法。尽管存在成熟的治疗指南，但欧洲各国的胆囊切除术发生率差异很大。我们分析了10个国家中因治疗有症状胆结石而接受手术的患者。我们测试了三种模型在解释住院费用（7个国家）或住院时间（3个国家）变化方面的表现。第一个模型仅包括与胆囊切除术相关的诊断组变量（M(D)），第二个模型使用了一组核心患者特征和特定病例解释变量（M(P)），第三个模型则结合了这两组变量（M(F)）。不同国家在用于分类胆囊切除术患者的诊断组数量上有所不同（范围：2-8），同时单个诊断组覆盖的患者比例也有差异（范围：50%-92%）。结合使用诊断组变量和患者层面变量来解释患者费用变化的准确性在西班牙为58%，在芬兰则超过81%。模型性能的比较表明，纳入相关的患者特征可以显著改善诊断组系统的性能。

abstract.text: Childbirth is one of the main causes of hospitalisation for women, accounting for about 5% of hospital activity in most Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development countries. We analysed the factors that explain variations in resource use for child delivery in ten European countries. We compared the performance of three models for explaining the variations in resource use (log cost or length of inpatient stay) at patient and hospital level. The first model used only the DRGs to which child deliveries were coded (M(D) ), the second used a set of 'patient-level' and delivery specific explanatory variables (M(P) ), and the third model combined both sets of variables (M(F) ). Countries vary both in the number of DRGs and the criteria used to classify cases of child delivery (range: 3-8) and in the percentage of deliveries classified as 'delivery without complication' (range: 53-90%). The capacity of DRGs and patient level variables to explain cost variation for child birth ranges from 48% in Sweden to over 70% in Spain. There is room for improving current DRG classification in most countries, but this does not necessary imply multiplying the groups and/or complicating criteria. Countries with a higher number of DRGs do not always perform better.

10.1002/hec.2835.abstractZh: 分娩是女性住院的主要原因之一，在大多数经济合作与发展组织中，约占医院活动的5%。我们分析了十个欧洲国家中分娩资源使用差异的成因。我们比较了三种模型在解释患者和医院层面资源使用差异方面的表现（以住院费用或住院时间对数表示）。第一个模型仅使用将分娩编码到DRGs中的方法（M(D)），第二个模型使用了一组“患者层面”和特定于分娩的解释变量（M(P)），第三个模型则结合了这两组变量（M(F)）。各国在DRGs的数量以及分类分娩的标准方面存在差异（范围：3-8），同时“无并发症分娩”的比例也各不相同（范围：53-90%）。瑞典的DRGs和患者层面变量在解释分娩成本变化方面的能力为48%，而西班牙则超过70%。大多数国家的DRGs分类仍有改进空间，但这并不一定意味着需要增加组别或复杂化分类标准。DRGs数量较多的国家并不总是表现更好。

abstract.text: Appendectomy is a common and relatively simple procedure to remove an inflamed appendix, but the rate of appendectomy varies widely across Europe. This paper investigates factors that explain differences in resource use for appendectomy. We analysed 106,929 appendectomy patients treated in 939 hospitals in 10 European countries. In stage 1, we tested the performance of three models in explaining variation in the (log of) cost of the inpatient stay (seven countries) or length of stay (three countries). The first model used only the diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) to which patients were coded, the second model used a core set of general patient-level and appendectomy-specific variables, and the third model combined both sets of variables. In stage two, we investigated hospital-level variation. In classifying appendectomy patients, most DRG systems take account of complex diagnoses and comorbidities but use different numbers of DRGs (range: 2 to 8). The capacity of DRGs and patient-level variables to explain patient-level cost variation ranges from 34% in Spain to over 60% in England and France. All DRG systems can make better use of administrative data such as the patient's age, diagnoses and procedures, and all countries have outlying hospitals that could improve their management of resources for appendectomy.

10.1002/hec.2836.abstractZh: 阑尾切除术是一种常见且相对简单的手术，用于切除发炎的阑尾，但欧洲各国的阑尾切除术发生率差异很大。本文研究了导致阑尾切除术资源使用差异的因素。我们分析了10个欧洲国家939家医院中接受的106,929名阑尾切除术患者的数据。在第一阶段，我们测试了三种模型在解释住院费用（7个国家）或住院时间（3个国家）变化方面的表现。第一个模型仅使用患者编码的诊断相关分组（DRGs），第二个模型使用了一组通用的患者级变量和阑尾切除术特定变量，第三个模型结合了这两组变量。在第二阶段，我们研究了医院级别的差异。在分类阑尾切除术患者时，大多数DRG系统考虑了复杂的诊断和合并症，但使用的DRGs数量不同（范围从2到8）。DRGs和患者级变量在解释患者级费用变化方面的能力从西班牙的34%到英格兰和法国的60%以上不等。所有DRG系统都能更好地利用行政数据，如患者的年龄、诊断和手术信息，而且所有国家都有一些管理不善的医院，这些医院可以改进阑尾切除术的资源管理。

abstract.text: We set out an analytical strategy to examine variations in resource use, whether cost or length of stay, of patients hospitalised with different conditions. The methods are designed to evaluate (i) how well diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) capture variation in resource use relative to other patient characteristics and (ii) what influence the hospital has on their resource use. In a first step, we examine the influence of variables that describe each individual patient, including the DRG to which the patients are assigned and a range of personal and treatment-related characteristics. In a second step, we explore the influence that hospitals have on the average cost or length of stay of their patients, purged of the influence of the variables accounted for in the first stage. We provide a rationale for the variables used in both stages of the analysis and detail how each is defined. The analytical strategy allows us (i) to identify those factors that explain variation in resource use across patients, (ii) to assess the explanatory power of DRGs relative to other patient and treatment characteristics and (iii) to assess relative hospital performance in managing resources and the characteristics of hospitals that explain this performance.

10.1002/hec.2837.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种分析策略，用于研究不同病情住院患者的资源使用差异，包括成本或住院时间。该方法旨在评估：(i) 诊断相关分组如何捕捉相对于其他患者特征的资源使用差异；(ii) 医院对其资源使用有何影响。首先，我们研究描述每个患者的变量对资源使用的影响，包括患者所属的诊断相关分组以及一系列个人和治疗相关特征。其次，我们探讨医院对其患者平均成本或住院时间的影响，同时排除第一阶段已考虑的变量因素的影响。我们为分析两个阶段使用的变量提供了理由，并详细说明了每个变量的定义。这种分析策略使我们能够：(i) 识别解释患者资源使用差异的因素；(ii) 评估诊断相关分组相对于其他患者和治疗特征的解释能力；(iii) 评估医院在管理资源方面的相对表现，以及能够解释这种表现的医院特征。

abstract.text: Knee replacement is a common surgical procedure performed to relieve pain and disability from degenerative osteoarthritis. This study evaluates the ability of ten European diagnosis-related group (DRG) systems to explain variations in costs or in length of stay for knee replacements. We assessed three different models in predicting variation of cost and length of stay. The first model, M(D), included only DRG groups as explanatory variables; the second, M(P), used a set of patient-level variables; and the third, M(F), included all variables from both M(D) and M(P). The total number of DRGs used to group knee replacement is low, ranging from two to six. All DRG systems except one differentiate between primary knee replacement and revision surgery. Considerable differences exist in the rate of revision surgery. There is also high variation in mean cost (from € 3809 to € 8158) and in mean length of stay (LoS) (from 4.2 to 13.6 days). The explanatory power of DRGs varies from 21.5 to 72.5% with values of around 40% in most countries of the study. Findings suggest that DRG systems could be enhanced either by the inclusion of patient-level variables, by the use of measures of clinical outcome or by improving cost and administrative information.

10.1002/hec.2838.abstractZh: 膝关节置换是一种常见的外科手术，用于缓解因退行性骨关节炎引起的疼痛和残疾。本研究评估了十个欧洲诊断相关组系统在解释膝关节置换手术的成本或住院时间差异方面的能力。我们评估了三种不同的模型来预测成本和住院时间的差异。第一个模型M(D)仅使用诊断相关组作为解释变量；第二个模型M(P)使用了患者层面的变量；第三个模型M(F)则同时使用了M(D)和M(P)中的所有变量。用于分组膝关节置换的DRG数量较少，从两个到六个不等。除一个系统外，所有DRG系统都能区分初次膝关节置换和翻修手术。翻修手术的发生率存在显著差异。平均成本（从3809欧元到8158欧元）和平均住院时间（从4.2天到13.6天）也存在较大差异。DRG的解释能力从21.5%到72.5%不等，在大多数研究国家中这一数值约为40%。研究结果表明，可以通过添加患者层面的变量、使用临床结果指标或改进成本和行政信息来提升DRG系统的性能。

abstract.text: By classifying hospital output into groups of patients with similar clinical characteristics and resource requirements, diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) are designed to be highly correlated with resource utilisation. Using a two-stage approach to control for variation within and between hospitals, we examine the ability of the diverse DRG systems in 10 European countries to explain variability in resource utilisation (costs or length of stay, LoS) for hospital patients undergoing surgical repair of inguinal hernia. Our national regression results suggest that DRGs are statistically significant in explaining cost/LoS variation in the absence of any other regressors and generally remain so in most countries when patient-level characteristics are added to the model. However patient-level characteristics, including those used in DRG assignment, are usually also statistically significant. In nine countries, where the number of relevant DRGs ranges from two (Poland) to seven (France), the inclusion of patient-level characteristics substantially improves model goodness-of-fit compared with that attained with DRGs alone. Only in Sweden is the converse true. If our analysis raises some concerns over the adequacy of DRGs to explain cost/LoS variation in inguinal hernia repair in nine of the 10 European countries, further research is required to consider whether future enhancements may be necessary.

10.1002/hec.2839.abstractZh: 通过将医院产出按具有相似临床特征和资源需求的患者分组，诊断相关分组（DRGs）被设计成与资源利用高度相关。采用两阶段方法来控制医院内部和之间的变异，我们研究了10个欧洲国家中不同的DRG系统在解释腹股沟疝手术患者资源利用变化（成本或住院时间）方面的能力。我们的全国回归结果表明，在没有其他回归变量的情况下，DRGs在解释成本/住院时间变化方面具有统计学意义，并且在大多数国家中，当将患者层面特征加入模型后，这一效果仍然显著。然而，包括用于DRG分配的特征在内的患者层面特征通常也具有统计学意义。在9个国家中，相关DRG的数量从2个（波兰）到7个（法国）不等，加入患者层面特征后，模型的拟合度显著提高，而只有在瑞典情况则相反。如果我们的分析在10个欧洲国家中的9个国家对DRGs解释腹股沟疝手术成本/住院时间变化的充分性提出了一些担忧，那么需要进一步的研究来考虑是否需要进行未来的改进。

abstract.text: This study contributes to the literature on the performance of diagnosis-related groups (DRGs) for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) patients by evaluating in nine countries the factors--in addition to DRGs--that affect costs or length of stay and comparing the variation that can be explained with or without DRGs. We evaluate whether the existing DRGs for AMI patients would benefit from additional patient-related and treatment-related factors that are found in administrative data across countries. In most countries, the set of patient and quality variables performed better than the DRG variables. Our results suggest that DRG systems in all countries could be improved by including additional explanatory factors or by refining the existing DRGs. Our results suggest that for AMI and possibly for other related episodes, a refinement of DRGs to include information on patient severity, procedures and levels of complications could improve the ability of DRGs to explain resource use. It seems possible to improve DRG-like hospital payment systems through the inclusion of episode-specific variables.

10.1002/hec.2840.abstractZh: 本研究通过评估九个国家中除诊断相关分组（DRGs）之外的其他影响成本或住院时间的因素，并比较包含DRGs与不包含DRGs时所能解释的差异，为急性心肌梗塞（AMI）患者诊断相关分组的性能研究做出了贡献。我们探讨了现有的AMI患者DRGs是否可以从跨国家行政数据中发现的额外与患者相关和治疗相关的因素中受益。在大多数国家，患者和医疗质量变量集的表现优于DRGs变量集。我们的研究结果表明，所有国家的DRGs系统都可以通过纳入额外的解释因素或改进现有的DRGs来提升性能。研究还表明，对于AMI以及其他相关病例，通过纳入患者严重程度、手术程序和并发症级别等信息来改进DRGs，可以提高DRGs解释资源使用情况的能力。通过纳入特定病例的变量，似乎有可能改进类似DRGs的医院支付系统。

abstract.text: Stroke is a major cause of death and disability around the world, and the care of stroke patients ties up a great amount of resources in healthcare systems. Stroke severity and the given care may vary substantially between patients, and there is remarkable variation in both the costs and length of stay (LoS) of stroke patients. Using patient level data from 10 European countries on costs and LoS, we explored the ability of the diagnosis-related group (DRG) systems to explain variance in the costs and length of stay of stroke patients. In addition, we evaluated whether the existing DRGs for stroke patients would benefit from additional patient-related and treatment-related factors that are commonly found in the administrative databases across countries. Cost analyses were run using OLS fixed effects models, and LoS analyses with negative binomial models. The descriptive statistics showed that the stroke patients differ remarkably across countries. Large variations in the classification of stroke patients raise concerns about whether all systems rely on the most appropriate classification variables. In all the countries, the DRG classifications' performance could be improved with the introduction of the patient characteristics analysed here.

10.1002/hec.2841.abstractZh: 中风是全球范围内导致死亡和残疾的主要原因之一，对中风患者的护理需要医疗系统投入大量资源。中风的严重程度以及所提供的护理在不同患者之间可能存在显著差异，同时中风患者的治疗成本和住院时间也存在巨大差异。我们利用了10个欧洲国家关于治疗成本和住院时间的数据，探讨了诊断相关分组系统对解释中风患者治疗成本和住院时间差异的能力。此外，我们还评估了现有的中风患者诊断相关分组系统是否可以从跨国家行政数据库中常见的额外患者相关和治疗相关因素中受益。成本分析采用了OLS固定效应模型，住院时间分析则采用了负二项模型。描述性统计数据显示，不同国家的中风患者在分类上存在显著差异。分类结果的巨大差异引发了关于所有系统是否都依赖于最恰当的分类变量的担忧。在所有国家中，通过引入此处分析的患者特征，诊断相关分组系统的性能可以得到改善。

abstract.text: We analyse variations in cost or length of stay (LoS) for 66,587 patients from 10 European countries receiving a coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) procedure. In five of these countries, variations in cost are analysed using log-linear models. In the other five countries, negative binomial regression models are used to explore variations in LoS. We compare how well each country's diagnosis-related group (DRG) system and a set of patient-level characteristics explain these variations. The most important explanatory factors are the total number of diagnoses and procedures, although no clear effects are evident for our CABG-specific diagnostic and procedural variables. Wound infections significantly increase LoS and costs in most countries. There is no evidence that countries using larger numbers of DRGs to group CABG patients are better at explaining variations in cost or LoS. However, refinements to the construction of DRGs to group CABG patients might recognise first and subsequent CABGs or other specific surgical procedures, such as multiple valve repair.

10.1002/hec.2842.abstractZh: 我们分析了来自10个欧洲国家的66,587名接受冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）患者的费用或住院时间的变化情况。在这10个国家中的5个，我们使用对数线性模型来分析费用的变化。在另外5个国家，我们使用负二项回归模型来研究住院时间的变化。我们比较了每个国家的诊断相关分组系统以及一系列患者层面的特征在解释这些变化方面的效果。最重要的解释因素是诊断和手术的总数量，尽管对于特定的CABG诊断和手术变量，并没有明显的效果。在大多数国家，伤口感染显著增加了住院时间和费用。没有证据表明，使用更多诊断相关分组来分组CABG患者的国家在解释费用或住院时间的变化方面更有优势。然而，对诊断相关分组系统的改进可能会考虑首次和后续CABG手术或其他特定外科手术，如多瓣膜修复手术。

abstract.text: We estimate a health investment equation, derived from a health capital model that is an extension of the well-known Grossman model. Of particular interest is whether the health production function has constant returns to scale, as in the standard Grossman model, or decreasing returns to scale, as in the Ehrlich-Chuma model and extensions thereof. The model with decreasing returns to scale has a number of theoretically and empirically desirable characteristics that the constant returns model does not have. Although our empirical equation does not point-identify the decreasing returns to scale curvature parameter, it does allow us to test for constant versus decreasing returns to scale. The results are suggestive of decreasing returns and in line with prior estimates from the literature. But when we attempt to control for the endogeneity of health by using instrumental variables, the results become inconclusive. This brings into question the robustness of prior estimates in this literature.

10.1002/hec.2843.abstractZh: 我们推导了一个健康投资方程，该方程基于一个健康资本模型，该模型是对著名的Grossman模型的扩展。特别值得关注的是，健康生产函数是否具有与标准Grossman模型相同的规模报酬不变特性，还是如Ehrlich-Chuma模型及其扩展模型所呈现的规模报酬递减特性。具有规模报酬递减特性的模型在理论和实证上都具有一些理想特性，而这些特性是规模报酬不变模型所不具备的。尽管我们的实证方程并未明确识别出规模报酬递减的曲率参数，但它确实允许我们测试规模报酬不变与递减之间的关系。研究结果暗示了规模报酬递减的可能性，并且与文献中先前的估计结果一致。然而，当我们尝试通过使用工具变量来控制健康问题的内生性时，结果变得不确定。这引发了对于该领域先前估计的稳健性的质疑。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the variations in costs and length of stay for hip replacement cases in Austria, England, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Ireland, Poland, Spain and Sweden and examines the ability of national diagnosis-related group (DRG) systems to explain the variation in resource use against a set of patient characteristic and treatment specific variables. In total, 195,810 cases clustered in 712 hospitals were analyzed using OLS fixed effects models for cost data (n=125,698) and negative binominal models for length-of-stay data (n=70,112). The number of DRGs differs widely across the 10 European countries (range: 2-14). Underlying this wide range is a different use of classification variables, especially secondary diagnoses and treatment options are considered to a different extent. In six countries, a standard set of patient characteristics and treatment variables explain the variation in costs or length of stay better than the DRG variables. This raises questions about the adequacy of the countries' DRG system or the lack of specific criteria, which could be used as classification variables.

10.1002/hec.2848.abstractZh: 本文评估了奥地利、英格兰、爱沙尼亚、芬兰、法国、德国、爱尔兰、波兰、西班牙和瑞典的髋关节置换手术在成本及住院时间方面的差异，并探讨了国家诊断相关分组系统能否通过一系列患者特征和治疗特定变量来解释这些差异。共分析了712家医院中的195,810例病例，其中成本数据采用OLS固定效应模型进行分析（n=125,698），住院时间数据采用负二项模型进行分析（n=70,112）。10个欧洲国家的诊断相关分组数量差异较大（范围：2-14）。这种差异背后是由于分类变量的使用方式不同，尤其是次要诊断和治疗选项被不同程度地考虑在内。在六个国家中，一组标准的患者特征和治疗变量比诊断相关分组变量更能解释成本或住院时间的差异。这引发了关于各国诊断相关分组系统是否足够有效，以及是否存在可用于作为分类变量的具体标准的问题。

abstract.text: Using baseline data from a randomized experiment, this article extends and tests in the context of health, the feasibility of a recently proposed reduced form approach to ex ante evaluations of social programs with an application to a conditional cash transfer program in Nicaragua. It uses a behavioural model to estimate the impact on preventive care utilization outcomes for children younger than 3 years. It validates the model with the results of the experiment and then simulates two alternate policy scenarios. The model performs well in predicting the health related outcomes and shows different results for the two sets of policy scenarios. In addition, simulations are also carried out for the school component of the cash transfer program.

10.1002/hec.2854.abstractZh: 本文利用一项随机实验的基线数据，在健康领域的背景下，对一种新提出的简化形式方法的可行性进行了扩展和测试，该方法用于对社会项目的预先评估，并应用于尼加拉瓜的一项有条件现金转移项目。文章采用行为模型来估算对3岁以下儿童预防保健利用结果的影响。通过实验结果对模型进行了验证，然后模拟了两种不同的政策情景。该模型在预测健康相关结果方面表现良好，并且对于这两种政策情景产生了不同的结果。此外，还对该现金转移项目的学校部分进行了模拟。

abstract.text: We study racial/ethnic disparities in awareness of chronic diseases using biomarker data from the 2006 Health and Retirement Study. We explore two alternative definitions of awareness and estimate a trivariate probit model with selection, which accounts for common, unmeasured factors underlying the following: (1) self-reporting chronic disease; (2) participating in biomarker collection; and (3) having disease, conditional on participating in biomarker collection. Our findings suggest that current estimates of racial/ethnic disparities in chronic disease are sensitive to selection, and also to the definition of disease awareness used. We find that African-Americans are less likely to be unaware of having hypertension than non-Latino whites, but the magnitude of this effect falls appreciably after we account for selection. Accounting for selection, we find that African-Americans and Latinos are more likely to be unaware of having diabetes compared to non-Latino whites. These findings are based on a widely used definition of awareness - the likelihood of self-reporting disease among those who have disease. When we use an alternative definition of awareness, which considers an individual to be unaware if he or she actually has the disease conditional on self-reporting not having it, we find higher levels of unawareness among racial/ethnic minorities versus non-Latino whites for both hypertension and diabetes.

10.1002/hec.2856.abstractZh: 我们研究了2006年健康与退休研究中的生物标志物数据，探讨了关于慢性病认知的种族/族裔差异。我们探讨了两种不同的认知定义，并估计了一个三变量Probit模型，该模型考虑了选择效应，以解释以下因素：(1)自我报告患有慢性病；(2)参与生物标志物收集；(3)在参与生物标志物收集的情况下患有疾病。我们的研究结果表明，目前对种族/族裔在慢性病认知上的差异估计容易受到选择效应的影响，同时也受到疾病认知定义的影响。我们发现，非裔美国人比非拉丁裔白人更不容易不知道自己患有高血压，但在考虑选择效应后，这种效应显著减弱。在考虑选择效应后，我们发现非裔美国人和拉丁裔比非拉丁裔白人更有可能不知道自己患有糖尿病。这些发现基于一种广泛使用的认知定义——即那些确实患有疾病的人自我报告患病的可能性。当我们使用另一种认知定义时，即认为如果个体实际上患有疾病，但在自我报告中没有患病，则该个体处于不知情状态，我们发现种族/族裔少数群体在非拉丁裔白人中对于高血压和糖尿病的认知程度更高。

abstract.text: I estimate the causal impact of Medicaid eligibility on take up, private health insurance coverage, healthcare utilization, and children's health by using a regression discontinuity design. In contrast to a standard regression discontinuity design, identification exploits multiple thresholds that arise from variation across states in income eligibility rules. Using data from the Panel Study of Income Dynamics and its Child Development Study supplement, I find that Medicaid eligibility increases take up by 10-13 percentage points on average, rising to 24-29 percentage points at lower income eligibility thresholds. There are significant crowding out effects of the same magnitude as those on take up rates. Medicaid eligibility increases the use of preventive health care by 11-14 percentage points but only at low income thresholds. Finally, I find that Medicaid eligibility has no significant effects on health outcomes in the short and medium run.

10.1002/hec.2857.abstractZh: 我采用回归不连续设计来估计Medicaid资格对私人健康保险覆盖、医疗利用以及儿童健康的影响。与标准的回归不连续设计不同，该研究利用了因各州收入资格规则差异而产生的多个阈值。通过利用“收入动态面板研究”及其儿童发展研究补充数据，我发现Medicaid资格平均使私人健康保险覆盖率增加了10-13个百分点，而在较低的收入资格门槛下，这一增幅可达24-29个百分点。与覆盖率增长幅度相当，还存在显著的挤出效应。Medicaid资格使预防性医疗保健的使用率增加了11-14个百分点，但这一效应仅在低收入门槛下显现。最后，我发现Medicaid资格在短期和中期对健康结果没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of a major water quality improvement program in rural China on the health of adults and children. Using panel data covering about 4500 households from 1989 to 2006, I estimate the impact of introducing village-level access to water from water plants on various measures of health. The regression results imply that the illness incidence of adults decreased by 11 percent and their weight-for-height increased by 0.835kg/m, and that children's weight-for-height and height itself both rose by 0.446kg/m and 0.962cm respectively, as a result of the program. And these estimates are quite stable across different robustness checks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.08.008.abstractZh: 本文研究了在中国农村实施一项重大水质改善计划对成人和儿童健康的影响。通过涵盖1989年至2006年间约4500户家庭的面板数据，我估计了在村级引入水厂供水对各项健康指标的影响。回归结果表明，成年人的疾病发病率下降了11%，体重与身高比增加了0.835公斤/米；而儿童的体重与身高比以及身高本身分别增加了0.446公斤/米和0.962厘米。这些估计结果在不同稳健性检验中均保持稳定。

abstract.text: It is well-known that pooled insurance coverage can induce people to make inefficiently low investments in self-protective activities. We identify another ex ante moral hazard that runs in the opposite direction. Lower levels of self-protection and the associated chronic conditions and behavioral patterns such as obesity, smoking, and malnutrition increase the incidence of many diseases and consumption of treatments to those diseases. This increases the reward for innovation and thus benefits the innovator. It also increases treatment innovation which benefits all consumers. As individuals do not take these positive externalities into account, their investments in self-protection are inefficiently high. We quantify the lower bound of this externality for obesity. The lower bound is independent of how much additional innovation is generated. The results show that the externality we identify offsets the negative Medicare-induced insurance externality of obesity. The Medicare-induced obesity subsidy is thus not a sufficient rationale for "soda taxes", "fat taxes" or other penalties on obesity. The quantitative finding also implies that the other ex ante moral hazard that we identify can be as important as the ex ante moral hazard that has been a central concept in health economics for decades.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.09.001.abstractZh: 众所周知，集体保险覆盖可能会促使人们在进行自我保护活动时做出低效率的投资。我们发现了另一种相反方向的先验道德风险：较低水平的自我保护以及与之相关的慢性疾病和行为模式，如肥胖、吸烟和营养不良，会增加许多疾病的发病率以及治疗这些疾病的消费。这增加了创新的回报，从而有利于创新者。同时，这也促进了治疗创新，从而惠及所有消费者。由于个人没有考虑到这些积极的外部性，他们在自我保护方面的投资实际上过高。我们对肥胖这一外部性的下限进行了量化分析。该下限与额外产生的创新数量无关。研究结果表明，我们发现的这种外部性抵消了医疗保险制度引发的肥胖相关外部性。因此，医疗保险制度对肥胖的补贴不足以成为实施“苏打税”、“脂肪税”或其他针对肥胖的惩罚措施的充分理由。这一定量研究结果还表明，我们发现的另一种先验道德风险可能与几十年来健康经济学中一直被视为核心概念的先验道德风险同样重要。
