abstract.text: We examine the marginal effects of decentralized public health spending by incorporating estimates of behavioural responses to changes in health spending in benefit incidence analysis. The analysis is based on a panel dataset of 207 Indonesian districts over the period from 2001 to 2004. We show that district public health spending is largely driven by central government transfers, with an elasticity of around 0.9. We find a positive effect of public health spending on utilization of outpatient care in the public sector for the poorest two quartiles. We find no evidence that public expenditures crowd out utilization of private services or household health spending. Our analysis suggests that increased public health spending improves targeting to the poor, as behavioural changes in public health care utilization are pro-poor. Nonetheless, most of the benefits of the additional spending accrued to existing users of services, as initial utilization shares outweigh the behavioural responses.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.09.003.abstractZh: 我们通过纳入对卫生支出变化的行为反应估计值，来研究分散式公共支出边际效应。分析基于2001至2004年期间207个印度尼西亚地区的面板数据集。我们发现，地区公共支出主要由中央政府转移支付驱动，其弹性约为0.9。我们发现，公共支出对最贫困两个四分位群体的公共部门门诊护理利用有积极影响。我们没有发现公共支出会排斥私人服务的利用或家庭卫生支出的情况。我们的分析表明，增加公共支出有助于改善对贫困群体的服务覆盖，因为公共医疗保健利用的行为变化是有利于贫困群体的。尽管如此，额外支出的大部分好处仍然归现有服务使用者所有，因为初始利用比例超过了行为反应的影响。

abstract.text: Estimates of WTP per QALY can be taken as an indication of the monetary value of health gains, which may carry information regarding the appropriate height of the cost-effectiveness threshold. Given the far-reaching consequences choosing a particular threshold, and thus the potential relevance of WTP per QALY estimates, it is important to address the validity of these estimates. This study addresses this issue. Our findings offer little support to the validity of WTP per QALY estimates obtained in this study. Implications for general WTP per QALY estimates and further research are discussed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.09.004.abstractZh: 每QALY的支付意愿估计可以视为健康收益的经济价值指标，这可能包含有关成本效益阈值适当水平的信息。鉴于选择特定阈值所带来的深远影响，以及每QALY支付意愿估计的潜在重要性，评估这些估计的有效性至关重要。本研究探讨了这一问题。我们的研究结果对每QALY支付意愿估计的有效性支持有限。文中还讨论了这些结果对一般每QALY支付意愿估计以及后续研究的影响。

abstract.text: The paper studies the incentive for providers to invest in new health care technologies under alternative payment systems, when the patients' benefits are uncertain. If the reimbursement by the purchaser includes both a variable (per patient) and a lump-sum component, efficiency can be ensured both in the timing of adoption (dynamic) and the intensity of use of the technology (static). If the second instrument is unavailable, a trade-off may emerge between static and dynamic efficiency. In this context, we also discuss how the regulator could use control of the level of uncertainty faced by the provider as an instrument to mitigate the trade-off between static and dynamic efficiency. Finally, we calibrate the model to study a specific technology and estimate the cost of a regulatory failure.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.09.005.abstractZh: 本文研究了在患者收益不确定的情况下，提供者在不同支付体系下投资新型医疗技术的动机。如果购买方的补偿包括一个变量部分（按患者计算）和一个固定金额部分，那么可以在技术的采用时机（动态效率）和使用强度（静态效率）上确保效率。如果后者不可行，静态效率与动态效率之间可能会出现权衡。在此背景下，我们还讨论了监管机构如何利用对提供者面临的不确定性程度的控制来缓解这种权衡。最后，我们对模型进行了校准，以研究特定技术，并估算监管失败的成本。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of outdoor pollution and parental smoking on children's health from birth until the age of three years in Germany. We use representative data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (SOEP), combined with five air pollution levels. These data were provided by the Federal Environment Agency and cover the years 2002-2007. Our work makes two important contributions. First, we use European data to replicate and extend an important US study by following the effects of pollution exposure and parental smoking on child health during the first four years of life. Second, we have health measures not only for infants but for toddlers as well. For infants, as well as for two- to three-year-olds, we are able to account for time-invariant and unobserved neighborhood and maternal characteristics. Our results suggest a significantly negative impact of some pollutants on infant health. High exposure to CO prior to birth causes, on average, a 289g lower birth weight. With respect to toddler health, we find that disorders and in particular those as bronchitis and respiratory illnesses are affected particularly by O3 levels.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.09.006.abstractZh: 本文研究了德国户外污染和父母吸烟对婴儿至三岁期间儿童健康的影响。我们采用了德国社会经济面板数据调查（SOEP）中的代表性数据，并结合了五个空气污染水平的数据。这些数据由联邦环境局提供，涵盖2002至2007年时期。我们的研究有两个重要贡献：首先，我们使用欧洲数据来复制并扩展一项重要的美国研究，追踪污染暴露和父母吸烟对儿童生命前四年的健康影响；其次，我们不仅提供了婴儿的健康指标，还提供了幼儿的健康指标。对于婴儿以及两至三岁幼儿，我们能够考虑时间不变且未观测到的邻里环境和母亲特征。我们的研究结果表明，某些污染物对婴儿健康有显著的负面影响。例如，出生前长期暴露于一氧化碳会导致平均出生体重减少289克。就幼儿健康而言，我们发现支气管炎等呼吸系统疾病特别受到臭氧水平的影响。

abstract.text: The magnitude of the value of a statistical life (VSL) is critical to the evaluation of many health and safety initiatives. To date, the large and rigorous VSL research literature has not explicitly accommodated publication selectivity bias (i.e., the reduced probability that insignificant or negative VSL values are reported). This study demonstrates that doing so is essential. For studies that employ hedonic wage equations to estimate VSL, correction for selection bias reduces the average value of a statistical life by 70-80%. Our meta-regression analysis also identifies several sources for the wide heterogeneity found among reported VSL estimates.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.001.abstractZh: 统计生命值的大小对于评估许多健康和安全举措至关重要。迄今为止，大量且严谨的统计生命值研究文献并未明确考虑发表选择性偏差（即，报告出不显著或负面统计生命值的概率降低）。本研究表明，采取这种措施是必要的。对于使用享乐工资方程来估算统计生命值的研究，纠正选择偏差会使统计生命值的平均值降低70-80%。我们的元回归分析还发现了报告中的统计生命值估计值存在广泛异质性的几个来源。

abstract.text: To date, only a few studies have assessed determinants of health trajectories using longitudinal health survey data. Multilevel models were used to estimate health-related quality of life trajectories and assess factors associated with variations among trajectories, controlling for mortality effects and cohort membership. Four biennial cycles (1996/97-2004/05) of the Canadian National Population Health Survey were used. Information for 13,665 respondents, including those who were subsequently institutionalized and/or died, was used. A typical life-course trajectory was concave with a slow decline until the age of 60, followed by a more rapid decline. Receiving social assistance, lower education and not being married had significant negative impacts on trajectories for young (age 18-39) and middle-aged (40-64). Chronic conditions and health behaviours such as smoking were important for seniors (65+). It is important to focus on the most relevant and important determinants of health in each phase of life.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.002.abstractZh: 迄今为止，仅有少数研究利用纵向健康调查数据来评估健康轨迹的决定因素。多层次模型被用于估算与健康相关的生活质量轨迹，并评估与轨迹变化相关的因素，同时控制死亡率效应和队列成员身份的影响。研究采用了加拿大国家人口健康调查的四个两年周期数据（1996/97-2004/05）。研究使用了13,665名受访者的信息，其中包括后来被收容或去世的人。典型的生命轨迹呈凹形，在60岁之前下降速度较慢，之后下降速度加快。接受社会援助、受教育程度较低以及未婚状态对年轻人群（18-39岁）和中年人群（40-64岁）的轨迹有显著的负面影响。对于老年人（65岁以上），慢性疾病和健康行为如吸烟对其轨迹具有重要影响。因此，关注生命各个阶段最重要的健康决定因素是非常重要的。

abstract.text: This paper is the first to use the method of instrumental variables (IV) to estimate the impact of obesity on medical costs in order to address the endogeneity of weight and to reduce the bias from reporting error in weight. Models are estimated using restricted-use data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey for 2000-2005. The IV model, which exploits genetic variation in weight as a natural experiment, yields estimates of the impact of obesity on medical costs that are considerably higher than the estimates reported in the previous literature. For example, obesity is associated with $656 higher annual medical care costs, but the IV results indicate that obesity raises annual medical costs by $2741 (in 2005 dollars). These results imply that the previous literature has underestimated the medical costs of obesity, resulting in underestimates of the economic rationale for government intervention to reduce obesity-related externalities.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.003.abstractZh: 本文首次采用工具变量方法，来估计肥胖对医疗成本的影响，以解决体重的内生性问题，并减少因体重报告误差导致的偏差。模型基于2000-2005年医疗支出面板调查的限制性数据进行估计。工具变量模型利用体重的遗传变异作为自然实验，得出的肥胖对医疗成本影响的估计值远高于以往文献中的结果。例如，肥胖与每年656美元的医疗成本增加相关，但工具变量模型显示，肥胖导致每年2741美元的医疗成本增加（以2005年美元计算）。这些结果表明，以往文献低估了肥胖带来的医疗成本，从而也低估了政府干预以减少肥胖相关外部性的经济合理性。

abstract.text: Microeconomic theory predicts that if patients are fully insured and providers are paid fee-for-service, utilization of medical services exceeds the efficient level ('moral hazard effect'). In Switzerland, both demand-side and supply-side cost sharing have been introduced to mitigate this problem. Analyzing a panel dataset of about 160,000 adults, we find both types of cost sharing to be effective in curtailing the use of medical services. However, when moral hazard mitigation is traded off against risk selection, the minimum-deductible, supply-side cost sharing option ranks first, followed by the medium-deductible demand-side alternative, making the supply-side option somewhat more effective.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.004.abstractZh: 微观经济理论预测，如果患者完全享有保险，而医疗服务提供者按服务收费，那么医疗服务的使用率会超过有效水平（即出现“道德风险效应”）。在瑞士，为了缓解这一问题，已经引入了需求端和供应端的成本分担机制。通过对约16万成年人的面板数据集进行分析，我们发现这两种成本分担机制在限制医疗服务使用方面都有效。然而，当道德风险缓解与风险选择相权衡时，最低免赔额的供应端成本分担方案最为有效，其次是中等免赔额的需求端方案，因此供应端方案在某种程度上更为有效。

abstract.text: The increasing concern of the policy maker about eating behaviour has focused on the spread of obesity and on the evidence of people dieting despite being underweight. As the latter behaviour is often attributed to the social pressure to be thin, some governments have already taken actions to ban ultra-thin ideals and models. This paper proposes a theoretical framework to assess whether increasing the ideal body weight is socially desirable, both from a welfare and a health point of view. We first show that being underweight and being overweight are possible outcomes of a rational eating model. Then, assuming that people are heterogeneous in their healthy weights but exposed to the same ideal body weight, we show that increasing the thin ideal weight can be welfare improving, but may exacerbate the obesity epidemic.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.005.abstractZh: 政策制定者对饮食行为的关注日益增加，主要集中在肥胖的蔓延以及人们尽管体重不足却仍坚持节食的现象上。由于后一种行为往往源于社会对瘦身的压力，一些政府已经采取措施，禁止对超瘦的理想身材的推崇。本文提出了一个理论框架，以评估提高理想体重是否从福利和健康的角度来看是合乎社会期望的。我们首先指出，体重不足和超重都是理性饮食模型可能产生的结果。然后，假设人们在健康体重方面存在差异，但面临相同的理想体重标准，我们发现提高瘦弱的理想体重可能会改善福利状况，但也可能加剧肥胖问题的蔓延。

abstract.text: This paper explores four alternative indices for measuring health inequalities in a way that takes into account attitudes towards inequality. First, we revisit the extended concentration index which has been proposed to make it possible to introduce changes into the distributional value judgements implicit in the standard concentration index. Next, we suggest an alternative index based on a different weighting scheme. In contrast to the extended concentration index, this new index has the 'symmetry' property. We also show how these indices can be generalized so that they satisfy the 'mirror' property, which may be seen as a desirable property when dealing with bounded variables. We compare the different indices empirically for under-five mortality rates and the number of antenatal visits in developing countries.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.009.abstractZh: 本文探讨了四种用于衡量健康不平等的替代指标，这些指标考虑了人们对不平等的态度。首先，我们重新审视了扩展浓度指数，该指数旨在引入对标准浓度指数所隐含的分配价值判断的修改。接下来，我们提出了一种基于不同权重方案的替代指标。与扩展浓度指数不同，这一新指标具有“对称性”特性。我们还展示了如何将这些指标进行推广，使其满足“镜像”特性，这在处理有限变量时可能是一个理想的特性。我们通过实证方法，比较了这些不同指标在发展中国家对五岁以下儿童死亡率和产前检查次数方面的表现。

abstract.text: Financial incentives are increasingly being advocated as an effective means to influence health-related behaviours. There is, however, limited evidence on whether they work in low-income countries, particularly when implemented at scale. This paper explores the impact of a national programme in Nepal that provides cash incentives to women conditional on them giving birth in a health facility. Using propensity score matching methods, we find that the programme had a positive, albeit modest, effect on the utilisation of maternity services. Women who had heard of the SDIP before childbirth were 4.2 percentage points (17 percent) more likely to deliver with a skilled attendant. The treatment effect is positively associated with the size of the financial package offered by the programme and the quality of care in facilities. Despite the positive effect on those exposed to the SDIP, low coverage of the programme suggests that few women actually benefited in the first few years.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.10.010.abstractZh: 金融激励措施被越来越多地认为是影响健康相关行为的有效手段。然而，关于这些措施在低收入国家是否有效的证据有限，尤其是在大规模实施的情况下。本文探讨了尼泊尔一项全国性计划的影响，该计划向女性提供现金激励，条件是她们在医疗机构分娩。通过倾向评分匹配方法，我们发现该计划对孕产妇服务的利用产生了积极但有限的影响。在分娩前听说过SDIP的女性，与有熟练助产士陪伴分娩的女性相比，其分娩的可能性高出4.2个百分点（17%）。该计划提供的资金规模以及医疗机构的服务质量，与治疗效果呈正相关。尽管对接触SDIP的女性产生了积极影响，但该计划的覆盖率较低，表明在最初几年中，实际上只有少数女性从中受益。

abstract.text: Using the 2006 China Agricultural Census (CAC), we examine whether the introduction of the New Cooperative Medical System (NCMS) has affected child mortality, maternal mortality, and school enrollment of 6-16year olds. Our data cover 5.9 million people living in eight low-income rural counties, of which four adopted the NCMS by 2006 and four did not adopt it until 2007. Raw data suggest that enrolling in the NCMS is associated with better school enrollment and lower mortality of young children and pregnant women. However, using a difference-in-difference propensity score method, we find that most of the differences are driven by endogenous introduction and take-up of the NCMS, and our method overcomes classical propensity score matching's failure to address selection bias. While the NCMS does not affect child morality and maternal mortality, it does help improve the school enrollment of six-year-olds.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.11.001.abstractZh: 我们利用2006年中国农业普查的数据，研究新合作医疗制度的引入是否对6-16岁儿童的死亡率、孕产妇死亡率以及入学率产生了影响。我们的数据涵盖了居住在八个低收入农村县的590万人，其中四个县在2006年之前就采用了新合作医疗制度，另外四个县则是在2007年才采用该制度。原始数据显示，加入新合作医疗制度与儿童入学率提高以及孕妇死亡率降低有关。然而，通过差分倾向得分法分析后发现，这些差异主要源于新合作医疗制度引入和采纳的内生因素，我们的方法克服了传统倾向得分匹配在解决选择偏差方面的不足。虽然新合作医疗制度并未直接影响儿童道德行为和孕产妇死亡率，但它确实有助于提高6岁儿童的入学率。

abstract.text: Past empirical work establishes a wage penalty from being overweight. In this paper, I exploit variation in an individual's weight over time to determine the age when weight has the largest impact on labor market outcomes. For white men, controlling for weight at younger ages does not eliminate the effect of older adult weight on wage: being overweight as a young adult only adds an additional penalty to adult wages. However, for white women, what they weigh in their early twenties solely determines the existence of an adult wage penalty. The female early-twenties weight penalty has a persistent effect on wages, and differences in marital characteristics, occupation status, or education cannot explain it. It also is not a proxy for intergenerational unobservables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.11.002.abstractZh: 以往的研究已经证实，超重会导致工资损失。在本文中，我利用个体体重随时间的变化情况，来探讨体重对劳动力市场结果影响最大的年龄。对于白人男性而言，即使控制了年轻时期的体重，也无法消除老年体重对工资的影响：年轻时期超重只会给成年后的工资带来额外的损失。然而，对于白人女性来说，她们在二十岁出头的体重就决定了成年后是否存在工资损失。这种二十岁出头的体重损失对工资有持续的影响，而婚姻状况、职业身份或教育程度等因素无法解释这一现象。此外，这种影响也不是代际间不可观测变量的替代指标。

abstract.text: In this paper we study individuals' choice of general practitioners (GPs) utilizing revealed preferences data from the introduction of a regular general practitioner scheme in Norway. Having information on relevant travel distances, we compute decision makers' travel costs associated with different modes of travel. Choice probabilities are estimated by means of nested logit regression on a representative sample of Oslo inhabitants. The results support the general hypothesis that patients prefer doctors who resemble themselves on observable characteristics. The hypothesis that GP gender has a stronger influence on females' GP choice than what is the case for males, is rejected.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.11.003.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了个体在挪威引入常规全科医生制度时，基于公开偏好数据对全科医生的选择行为。在掌握了相关出行距离信息的基础上，我们计算了决策者对不同出行方式所承担的出行成本。通过针对奥斯陆居民样本进行的嵌套Logit回归分析，估计了个体选择全科医生的概率。研究结果支持了这样一个一般假设：患者更倾向于选择在可观察特征上与自己相似的医生。而关于全科医生性别对女性选择全科医生的影响比对男性更大的假设，则被否定了。

abstract.text: In this study we explored a novel application of the discrete choice experiment (DCE) that resembles the time trade off (TTO) task to estimate values on the health utility scale for the EQ-5D. The DCE was tested in a survey alongside the TTO in a sample of English-speaking Canadians recruited by a market research company. The study found that the DCE is able to derive logical and consistent values for health states valued on the full health - dead scale. The DCE overcame some issues identified in the version of TTO currently used to value EQ-5D, notably allowing for fewer data exclusions and incorporating values considered worse than dead without introducing a separate valuation procedure. This has important implications for providing robust values that represent the preferences of all respondents.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.11.004.abstractZh: 本研究探索了离散选择实验（DCE）的一种新颖应用，该实验类似于时间权衡任务，用于估算EQ-5D健康效用尺度上的数值。在一项调查中，DCE与TTO一起被用于一组由市场研究公司招募的英语母语加拿大人样本中。研究发现，DCE能够得出在完整健康-死亡尺度上健康状态的逻辑且一致的数值。DCE克服了目前用于评估EQ-5D时遇到的某些问题，特别是减少了数据排除的可能性，并且能够在不引入单独评估程序的情况下，将一些被认为较差的状态纳入评估范围。这对于提供能够代表所有受访者偏好的稳健数值具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We present a class of decomposable inequality indices for ordinal data (e.g. self-reported health survey). It is characterized by well-known inequality axioms (e.g. scale invariance) and a decomposability axiom which states that an index can be represented as a function of inequality values in subgroups and subgroup sizes. The only decomposable indices are strictly monotonic transformations of the weighted average of frequencies in categories. Among the indices proposed in the literature only the absolute value index (Abul Naga and Yalcin, 2008; Apouey, 2007) is decomposable. As an empirical illustration we calculate regional contributions to overall health inequality in Switzerland.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.11.005.abstractZh: 我们提出了一类适用于序数数据（例如自我报告的健康调查）的可分解不平等指数。这类指数具有众所周知的不平等公理（例如尺度不变性），以及一个可分解公理，即指数可以表示为子组中的不平等值及其大小的函数。唯一可分解的指数是频率加权平均值的严格单调变换。在文献中提出的指数中，只有绝对值指数（Abul Naga和Yalcin，2008；Apouey，2007）是可分解的。作为实证示例，我们计算了瑞士地区对整体健康不平等的贡献。

abstract.text: The quality-adjusted life-years (QALY) model assumes quality and quantity of life can be multiplied into a single index and requires quality and quantity to be mutually independent, which need not hold empirically. This paper proposes a new test for measuring independence of utility of life duration from quality of life in a riskless setting. We use a large representative sample of Dutch citizens and include two health states generally considered better than dead (BTD) and one health state considered worse than dead (WTD). Independence cannot be rejected when comparing the BTD health states, but is rejected when comparing the BTD states with the WTD state. In particular, utility of life duration becomes more concave for the WTD state. This may suggest that independence holds only for BTD health states. This has implications for the QALY model and would require using sign-dependent utility of life duration functions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.001.abstractZh: 质量调整生命年（QALY）模型假设生命的质量与数量可以合并为一个单一指标，并认为两者相互独立，但这一假设在现实中未必成立。本文提出了一种新的测试方法，用于在无风险环境下衡量生命持续时间的效用与生活质量之间的独立性。我们选取了大量荷兰公民的样本，并包含了两种通常被认为优于死亡的健康状态（BTD）以及一种被认为劣于死亡的健康状态（WTD）。在比较BTD健康状态时，独立性不会被否定；但在比较BTD状态与WTD状态时，独立性会被否定。特别是，对于WTD状态而言，生命持续时间的效用变得更加凹形。这可能表明，独立性仅适用于BTD健康状态。这一发现对QALY模型具有启示意义，并需要使用与符号相关的生命持续时间效用函数。

abstract.text: The attitudes of the general British population towards Muslims changed post 2001, and this change led to a significant increase in Anti-Muslim discrimination. We use this exogenous attitude change to estimate the causal impact of increased discrimination on a range of objective and subjective health outcomes. The difference-in-differences estimates indicate that discrimination worsens blood pressure, cholesterol, BMI and self-assessed general health. Thus, discrimination is a potentially important determinant of the large racial and ethnic health gaps observed in many countries. We also investigate the pathways through which discrimination impacts upon health, and find that discrimination has a negative effect on employment, perceived social support, and health-producing behaviours. Crucially, our results hold for different control groups and model specifications.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.002.abstractZh: 2001年之后，英国普通民众对穆斯林的态度发生了变化，这一变化导致反穆斯林歧视现象显著增加。我们利用这种外生态度变化来估计歧视增加对一系列客观和主观健康结果的影响。差异估计表明，歧视会恶化血压、胆固醇、体重指数以及自我评估的整体健康状况。因此，歧视可能是许多国家中存在的巨大种族和族裔健康差距的一个重要因素。我们还研究了歧视影响健康的途径，发现歧视对就业、感知的社会支持以及健康行为有负面影响。重要的是，我们的研究结果适用于不同的控制组和模型设定。

abstract.text: The concentration index is widely used to measure income-related inequality in health. No insight exists, however, whether the concentration index connects with people's preferences about distributions of income and health and whether a reduction in the concentration index reflects an increase in social welfare. We explored this question by testing the central assumption underlying the concentration index and found that it was systematically violated. We also tested the validity of alternative health inequality measures that have been proposed in the literature. Our data showed that decreases in the spread of income and health were considered socially desirable, but decreases in the correlation between income and health not necessarily. Support for a condition implying that the inequality in the distribution of income and in the distribution of health can be considered separately was mixed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.003.abstractZh: 浓度指数被广泛用于衡量与收入相关的健康不平等问题。然而，目前尚无研究探讨该指数是否与人们对收入与健康状况分配的偏好有关，以及浓度指数的降低是否意味着社会福利的提高。我们通过检验浓度指数背后的核心假设来探讨这个问题，结果发现这一假设被系统性地违反了。我们还测试了文献中提出的其他健康不平等衡量方法的有效性。我们的数据显示，减少收入与健康状况之间的差距被认为是社会所期望的，但减少收入与健康状况之间的相关性则未必如此。对于一种认为收入分配与健康状况分配可以分别考虑不平等条件的支持意见并不一致。

abstract.text: Not only does economic theory predict high-risk individuals to be more likely to purchase insurance, but insurance coverage is also thought to crowd out precautionary activities. In spite of stark theoretical predictions, there is conflicting empirical evidence on adverse selection, and evidence on ex ante moral hazard is very scarce. Using data from the Seguro Popular Experiment in Mexico, this paper documents patterns of selection on observables into health insurance as well as the existence of non-negligible ex ante moral hazard. More specifically, the findings indicate that (i) agents in poor self-assessed health prior to the intervention have, all else equal, a higher propensity to take up insurance; and (ii) insurance coverage reduces the demand for self-protection in the form of preventive care. Curiously, however, individuals do not sort based on objective measures of their health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.004.abstractZh: 经济理论不仅预测高风险个体更有可能购买保险，而且认为保险覆盖会抑制预防性行为。尽管理论预测如此明确，但关于逆向选择问题的实证证据却存在矛盾，而关于事前道德风险的证据则非常稀少。本文利用墨西哥“大众保险实验”的数据，揭示了健康保险选择中的模式，以及事前道德风险的存在。具体而言，研究结果表明：（i）在干预之前，自我评估健康状况较差的个体在同等条件下更倾向于购买保险；（ii）保险覆盖减少了以预防性护理形式出现的自我保护需求。然而，有趣的是，个体并不会根据客观的健康指标进行分类。

abstract.text: This paper exploits the discontinuity created by the minimum legal drinking age of 21 years to estimate the causal effect of increased alcohol availability on marijuana use. We find that consumption of marijuana decreases sharply at age 21, while consumption of alcohol increases, suggesting that marijuana and alcohol are substitutes. We further find that the substitution effect between alcohol and marijuana is stronger for women than for men. Our results suggest that policies designed to limit alcohol use have the unintended consequence of increasing marijuana use.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.005.abstractZh: 本文利用最低法定饮酒年龄设为21岁这一不连续性，来估算酒精供应增加对大麻使用的影响。我们发现，大麻的消费在21岁时急剧下降，而酒精的消费则有所增加，这表明大麻和酒精是替代品。此外，我们还发现，对于女性而言，酒精与大麻之间的替代效应比男性更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，旨在限制酒精使用的政策反而会导致大麻使用的增加。

abstract.text: Despite high rates of HIV in Sub-Saharan Africa, and the corresponding high mortality risk associated with risky sexual behavior, behavioral response has been limited. This paper explores three explanations for this: bias in OLS estimates, limited non-HIV life expectancy and limited knowledge. I find support for the first two. First, using a new instrumental variable strategy I find that OLS estimates of the relationship between risky sex and HIV are biased upwards, and IV estimates indicate reductions in risky behavior in response to the epidemic. Second, I find these reductions are larger for individuals who live in areas with higher life expectancy, suggesting high rates of non-HIV mortality suppress behavioral response; this is consistent with optimizing behavior. Using somewhat limited knowledge proxies, I find no evidence that areas with higher knowledge of the epidemic have greater behavior change.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2011.12.006.abstractZh: 尽管撒哈拉以南非洲地区的HIV感染率很高，且与危险性行为相关的死亡风险也很高，但行为反应却相对有限。本文探讨了三个解释这一现象的原因：普通最小二乘法估计的偏差、非HIV相关寿命预期的有限性以及知识的有限性。我发现前两个解释得到了支持。首先，通过采用新的工具变量策略，我发现普通最小二乘法估计的危险性行为与HIV感染之间的关系存在向上偏差，而工具变量估计则表明，在疫情影响下，危险性行为有所减少。其次，我发现生活在预期寿命较高的地区的人群，其危险行为减少幅度更大，这表明非HIV相关死亡率的高水平抑制了行为反应；这与行为优化的观点一致。通过使用较为有限的知识代理变量，我发现那些对疫情有较高了解的地区，行为变化并不明显。

abstract.text: Public reporting of quality information is designed to address information asymmetry in health care markets. Without public reporting, consumers may have little information to help them differentiate quality among providers, giving providers little incentive to compete on quality. Public reporting enables consumers to choose highly ranked providers. Using a four-year (2000-2003) panel dataset, we examine the relationship between report card scores and patient choice of nursing home after the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services began publicly reporting nursing home quality information on post-acute care in 2002. We find that the relationship between reported quality and nursing home choice is positive and statistically significant suggesting that patients were more likely to choose facilities with higher reported post-acute care quality after public reporting was initiated. However, the magnitude of the effect was small. We conclude that there has been minimal consumer response to information in the post-acute care market.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.001.abstractZh: 公开披露质量信息旨在解决医疗保健市场中的信息不对称问题。如果没有公开披露，消费者可能缺乏足够的信息来区分不同医疗服务提供者的质量，这就会使医疗服务提供者缺乏基于质量的竞争动力。公开披露使消费者能够选择排名较高的医疗服务提供者。我们利用一个为期四年的（2000-2003年）面板数据集，研究了报告卡评分与患者选择养老院之间的关系，这一研究是在医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心于2002年开始公开披露养老院在急性后期护理方面的质量信息之后进行的。我们发现，报告的质量与养老院选择之间存在正相关关系，并且这种关系在统计上显著，这表明在公开披露开始后，患者更有可能选择那些报告中的急性后期护理质量较高的机构。然而，这种影响的幅度很小。我们得出结论，在急性后期护理市场中，消费者对信息的反应非常有限。

abstract.text: Using a discrete choice experiment, this paper estimates the willingness to pay for biofortified orange maize in rural Zambia. The study design has five treatment arms, which enable an analysis of the impact of nutrition information, comparing the use of simulated radio versus community leaders in transmitting the nutrition message, on willingness to pay, and to account for possible novelty effects in the magnitude of premiums or discounts. The estimation strategy also takes into account lexicographic preferences of a subset of our respondents. The results suggest that (a) orange maize is not confused with yellow maize, and has the potential to compete with white maize in the absence of a nutrition campaign, (b) there is a premium for orange maize with nutrition information, and (c) different modes of nutritional message dissemination have the same impact on consumer acceptance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.002.abstractZh: 本文通过离散选择实验，估算了赞比亚农村地区对生物强化玉米的支付意愿。研究设计了五个处理组，以便分析营养信息的影响，比较使用模拟广播与社区领袖传播营养信息对支付意愿的影响，并考虑溢价或折扣幅度可能的新奇效应。估计策略还考虑了我们部分受访者的 lexicographic 偏好。研究结果表明：(a) 人们不会将生物强化玉米与黄色玉米混淆，在没有营养宣传活动的情况下，生物强化玉米有与白色玉米竞争的可能性；(b) 带有营养信息的生物强化玉米存在溢价；(c) 不同的营养信息传播方式对消费者接受度的影響是相同的。

abstract.text: In the face of increasing health care costs, taxing not-for-profit hospitals may be seen as the right choice to increase government revenues if not-for-profit hospitals are not different from their for-profit counterparts. This study investigates how hospital ownership type affects treatment choices to show whether ownership type and teaching status are correlated with choosing a procedure as the treatment and how these choices relate to patient insurance type. Not-for-profit hospitals significantly differ from for-profits in terms of treatment choices of less profitable patients and all hospitals are more likely to accord the procedure when the patient is privately insured than uninsured though teaching government hospitals are the most likely to accord the procedures for all insurance types. Considering treatment choices, not-for-profit hospitals have different objectives than for-profit and government hospitals and in terms of profit-seeking behavior, not-for-profit hospitals seem to lie between for-profit and government hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.003.abstractZh: 面对不断上升的医疗保健成本，如果非营利医院与营利性医院没有区别，那么对非营利医院征税可能被视为增加政府收入的正确选择。本研究探讨了医院所有权类型对治疗选择的影响，以揭示所有权类型和教学地位是否与选择特定治疗程序有关，以及这些选择与患者保险类型之间的关系。非营利医院在对待利润较低患者的治疗选择方面与营利性医院有显著不同，而且所有医院在患者拥有私人保险时更倾向于提供该治疗程序，尽管教学型政府医院在所有保险类型下最有可能提供该治疗程序。从治疗选择的角度来看，非营利医院的目标与营利性医院和政府医院不同，在盈利行为方面，非营利医院似乎介于营利性医院和政府医院之间。

abstract.text: Observers worry that generic patent challenges are on the rise and reduce the effective market life of drugs. A related concern is that challenges disproportionately target high-sales drugs, reducing market life for these "blockbusters." To study these questions, we examine new data on generic entry over the past decade. We show that challenges are more common for higher sales drugs. We also demonstrate a slight increase in challenges over this period, and a sharper increase for early challenges. Despite this, effective market life is stable across drug sales categories, and has hardly changed over the decade. To better understand these results, we examine which patents are challenged on each drug, and show that lower quality and later expiring patents disproportionately draw challenges. Overall, this evidence suggests that challenges serve to maintain, not reduce, the historical baseline of effective market life, thereby limiting the effectiveness of "evergreening" by branded firms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.004.abstractZh: 观察人士担心，仿制药专利挑战正在增加，这缩短了药品的有效市场寿命。另一个相关的问题是，这些挑战往往针对销量较高的药品，从而缩短了这些“畅销药”的市场寿命。为了研究这些问题，我们分析了过去十年仿制药进入市场的相关数据。结果显示，针对销量较高的药品提出的专利挑战更为常见。此外，在此期间，专利挑战的数量略有增加，而早期提出的挑战增幅更为明显。尽管如此，不同药品销售类别的有效市场寿命保持稳定，且在这十年间几乎没有变化。为了更好地理解这些结果，我们进一步分析了每种药品面临的专利挑战情况，发现质量较低且到期时间较晚的专利更容易受到挑战。总体而言，这些证据表明，专利挑战实际上有助于维持而非缩短药品的有效市场寿命，从而限制了品牌企业“持续创新”策略的有效性。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of California Assembly Bill 394, which mandated maximum levels of patients per nurse in the hospital setting. When the law was passed, some hospitals already met the requirements, while others did not. Thus changes in staffing ratios from the pre- to post-mandate periods are driven in part by the legislation. We find persuasive evidence that AB394 had the intended effect of decreasing patient/nurse ratios in hospitals that previously did not meet mandated standards. However, these improvements in staffing ratios do not appear to be associated with relative improvements in measured patient safety in affected hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.005.abstractZh: 我们评估了加州议会法案394号的影响，该法案规定了医院环境中每名护士最多可照顾的患者数量。在法案通过时，一些医院已经满足了这一要求，而另一些医院则没有。因此，从法案实施前的人员配置比例到实施后的变化，部分是由该立法所推动的。我们发现有令人信服的证据表明，法案394号确实起到了降低那些之前未满足规定标准的医院中患者与护士比例的作用。然而，这些人员配置比例的改善似乎并未伴随着受影响医院中患者安全状况的改善。

abstract.text: Recent research into end of life and palliative care has focused on the development of a replacement for the quality adjusted life year (QALY) as an outcome measure. Reasons given range from the lack of anticipated survival benefit from treatment to the inappropriateness of death as an anchor for valuing health states, or the increased value of time to the individual at the end of life. The Palliative Care Yardstick, has been proposed as an alternative. In this paper, I argue that the QALY should not be abandoned as an outcome measure in end of life and palliative care populations and suggest possible methods for generating empirical data to support or refute this. I show why the arguments made for replacement of the QALY are not supported by current evidence and how in some cases the abandonment of the QALY framework would lead to an unjustifiable inequitable distribution of resources.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.01.006.abstractZh: 近期关于临终关怀和姑息治疗的研究主要集中在寻找替代质量调整生命年（QALY）作为结果衡量指标的方法上。提出的理由包括：治疗未能带来预期的生存益处，死亡作为评估健康状态的指标并不恰当，以及临终时个体所拥有的时间价值增加。因此，提出了“姑息治疗标准”作为替代方案。在本文中，我主张不应放弃将QALY作为临终关怀和姑息治疗领域的结果衡量指标，并提出了一些可能的方法来生成实证数据以支持或反驳这一观点。我解释了为什么替代QALY的论点缺乏现有证据支持，并说明了在某些情况下放弃QALY框架会导致资源分配的不公平。

abstract.text: A necessary condition for competition to promote quality in hospital markets is that patients are sensitive to differences in hospital quality. In this paper we examine the relationship between hospital quality, as measured by publicly available quality ratings, and patient hospital choice for angioplasty using individual claims data from a large health insurer. We find that Dutch patients have a high propensity to choose hospitals with a good reputation, both overall and for cardiology, and a low readmission rate after treatment for heart failure. Relative to a mean readmission rate of 8.5% we find that a 1%-point lower readmission rate is associated with a 12% increase in hospital demand. Since readmission rates are not adjusted for case-mix they may not provide a correct signal of hospital quality. Insofar patients base their hospital choice on such imperfect quality information, this may result in suboptimal choices and risk selection by hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.001.abstractZh: 在医院市场中，竞争促进质量提升的一个必要条件是，患者能够感知到医院质量的差异。本文利用大型健康保险公司的个人索赔数据，研究了以公开可用的质量评级为衡量标准的医院质量与患者选择医院之间的关系，特别是关于血管成形术的治疗选择。研究发现，荷兰患者倾向于选择声誉良好、在心脏病治疗方面也有良好记录的医院，并且这些医院在心力衰竭治疗后的再入院率较低。与平均8.5%的再入院率相比，再入院率降低1个百分点，会导致医院需求增加12%。由于再入院率并未根据病例差异进行调整，因此可能无法准确反映医院的质量状况。在如此不完美的质量信息基础上做出医院选择，可能会导致医院做出次优的选择，并增加风险。

abstract.text: Watchfully waiting involves monitoring a patient's health state over time and deciding whether to undertake a medical intervention, or to postpone it and continue observing the patient. In this paper, we consider the timing of medical intervention as an optimal stopping problem. The development of the patient's health state in the absence of intervention follows a stochastic process (geometric Brownian motion). Spontaneous recovery occurs in case the absorbing state of "good health" is reached. We determine optimal threshold values for initiating the intervention, and derive comparative statics results with respect to the model parameters. In particular, an increase in the degree of uncertainty over the patient's development in most cases makes waiting more attractive. However, this may not hold if the patient's health state has a tendency to improve. The model can be extended to allow for risk aversion and for sudden, Poisson-type shocks to the patient's health state.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.002.abstractZh: 密切观察涉及随时间监测患者的健康状况，并决定是否进行医疗干预，或者推迟干预并继续观察患者。在本文中，我们将医疗干预的时机视为一个最优停止问题。在缺乏干预的情况下，患者的健康状况遵循随机过程（几何布朗运动）发展。如果达到“健康”状态，则会出现自发恢复。我们确定了启动干预的最佳阈值，并得出了关于模型参数的比较静态结果。具体而言，在大多数情况下，患者健康状况的不确定性增加会使等待更具吸引力。然而，如果患者的健康状况有改善的趋势，这一结论可能不成立。该模型还可以扩展以考虑风险厌恶以及患者健康状况的突发泊松型冲击。

abstract.text: Tradeoffs between health and wealth are among the most important decisions individuals make, and are central to social and economic policy. Yet, only a few studies have investigated the utility of health and wealth empirically. This paper investigates this utility function both theoretically and empirically. We conduct detailed personal interviews with 180 cancer patients, and also obtain questionnaires from 132 diabetes patients. We find strong support for the utility function U(h, w)=h·log(w), where h denotes health and w denotes wealth.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.003.abstractZh: 健康与财富之间的权衡是个体面临的最重要的决策之一，也是社会和经济政策的核心问题。然而，仅有少数研究对健康与财富的效用进行了实证分析。本文从理论和实证两个方面探讨了这一效用函数。我们与180名癌症患者进行了详细的个人访谈，并从132名糖尿病患者那里获取了问卷数据。研究发现，健康与财富的效用函数可以表示为U(h, w)=h·log(w)，其中h表示健康，w表示财富。

abstract.text: In this paper, we examine the role of insurance coverage in explaining the generic competition paradox in a two-stage game involving a single producer of brand-name drugs and n quantity-competing producers of generic drugs. Independently of brand loyalty, which some studies rely upon to explain the paradox, we show that heterogeneity in insurance coverage may result in higher prices of brand-name drugs following generic entry. With market segmentation based on insurance coverage present in both the pre- and post-entry stages, the paradox can arise when the two types of drugs are highly substitutable and the market is quite profitable but does not have to arise when the two types of drugs are highly differentiated. However, with market segmentation occurring only after generic entry, the paradox can arise when the two types of drugs are weakly substitutable, provided, however, that the industry is not very profitable. In both cases, that is, when market segmentation is present in the pre-entry stage and when it is not, the paradox becomes more likely to arise as the market expands and/or insurance companies decrease deductibles applied on the purchase of generic drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了保险覆盖在解释两阶段博弈中品牌药品生产商与数量竞争的非通用竞争悖论中的作用。与某些研究依赖的品牌忠诚度解释不同，我们指出，保险覆盖的异质性可能导致品牌药品在仿制药进入市场后价格上涨。当市场分割基于保险覆盖，且这种分割存在于仿制药进入前后的两个阶段时，这种悖论可能出现在两种药品高度可替代且市场相当盈利的情况下；而当两种药品高度差异化时，这种悖论则不一定出现。然而，如果市场分割仅在仿制药进入后才出现，且两种药品的可替代性较低，那么这种悖论也可能出现，前提是该行业并非非常盈利。无论市场分割存在于仿制药进入前的阶段还是之后，随着市场的扩大以及保险公司对仿制药购买所适用的免赔额降低，这种悖论出现的可能性都会增加。

abstract.text: This study is the second to use national survey data to assess the effect of comprehensive state tobacco control programs on adult cigarette smoking. Data are drawn from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (1991-2006) and reveal consistent evidence that these programs have a statistically significant effect to reduce prevalence of cigarette smoking among adults. Simulations indicate that had all states spent the CDC recommended level of funding from 1991 to 2006 then cigarette smoking prevalence would have been 1.40-8.07% lower in 2006, translating to between 635,000 and 3.7 million fewer adult cigarette smokers.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.005.abstractZh: 本研究是第二项利用全国调查数据来评估综合性州级烟草控制计划对成人吸烟影响的研究。数据来源于行为风险因素监测系统（1991-2006年），结果显示这些计划在降低成人吸烟率方面具有统计学上的显著效果。模拟分析表明，如果所有州在1991至2006年间都按照CDC的建议投入相应资金，那么2006年的吸烟率将降低1.40%至8.07%，这意味着成年吸烟者的数量将减少635,000至3.7百万人。

abstract.text: In several economic fields, such as those related to health or education, the individuals' characteristics are measured by bounded variables. Accordingly, these characteristics may be indistinctly represented by achievements or shortfalls. A difficulty arises when inequality needs to be assessed. One may focus either on achievements or on shortfalls but the respective inequality rankings may lead to contradictory results. In this note we propose a procedure to define indicators that measure equally the achievement and shortfall inequality. Specifically, we derive measures which are invariant under ratio-scale or translation transformations, and a decomposable measure is also obtained. As the indicators proposed depend on the distribution bounds, families of indices that guarantee the same inequality rankings regardless of the distribution maximal levels are identified.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.006.abstractZh: 在多个经济领域，如与健康或教育相关的领域，个人的特征是通过有界变量来衡量的。因此，这些特征可以通过成就或不足来 indistinctly 表示。在需要评估不平等问题时，会出现一个困难。人们可能会关注成就或不足，但相应的不平等排名可能会导致矛盾的结果。在这篇论文中，我们提出了一种方法，用于定义能够同时衡量成就和不足不平等的指标。具体来说，我们推导出了在比例尺度或平移变换下保持不变的度量方法，并且还得到了一个可分解的度量。由于所提出的指标依赖于分布界限，因此找到了一系列指标，这些指标能够确保无论分布的最大水平如何，都能得到相同的不平等排名。

abstract.text: The Medicare program, which provides insurance coverage to the elderly in the United States, does not protect them fully against high out-of-pocket costs. For this reason private supplementary insurance, named Medigap, has been available to cover Medicare gaps. This paper studies how Medigap affects the utilization of inpatient care, separating the incentive and selection effects of supplementary insurance. For this purpose, we use two alternative estimation methods: a standard recursive bivariate probit and a discrete multivariate finite mixture model. We find that estimated incentive effects are modest and quite similar across models. There seems to be very significant selection, with the presence of both adversely and advantageously selected individuals, stemming from the multidimensional nature of residual heterogeneity.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.02.007.abstractZh: 美国Medicare计划为老年人提供保险覆盖，但并不能完全防止他们承担过高的自付费用。因此，市场上存在名为Medigap的私人补充保险，用于弥补Medicare的不足。本文研究了Medigap对住院护理利用的影响，并区分了补充保险的激励效应和选择效应。为此，我们采用了两种不同的估计方法：标准递归双变量Probit模型和离散多变量有限混合模型。研究发现，估计出的激励效应较为温和，且在不同模型中的表现相当一致。选择效应则非常显著，既有被不利选择的个体，也有被有利选择的个体，这源于剩余异质性的多维特性。

abstract.text: We investigate whether job loss due to plant closure causes an increased risk of (cause-specific) mortality and hospitalization for male workers having strong labour market attachment. We use administrative data: a panel of all persons in Denmark in the period 1980-2006, containing records on health and work status, and a link from workers to plants. We use propensity score weighting combined with non-parametric duration analysis. We find that job loss increases the risk of overall mortality and mortality caused by circulatory disease; of suicide and suicide attempts; and of death and hospitalization due to traffic accidents, alcohol-related disease, and mental illness.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.001.abstractZh: 我们研究了由于工厂关闭而导致的失业是否会增加那些对劳动力市场有强烈依赖的男性工人的（特定原因的）死亡和住院风险。我们使用的是行政数据：1980-2006年间丹麦所有人员的面板数据，其中包含健康和工作状态的记录，以及工人与工厂之间的关联信息。我们采用了倾向得分加权法结合非参数持续时间分析的方法。研究发现，失业会增加总体死亡风险、由循环系统疾病引起的死亡风险、自杀及自杀企图的风险，以及因交通事故、酒精相关疾病和精神疾病导致的死亡和住院风险。

abstract.text: In this paper, we take a bibliometric tour of the last forty years of health economics using bibliographic "metadata" from EconLit supplemented by citation data from Google Scholar and our own topical classifications. We report the growth of health economics (we find 33,000 publications since 1969-12,000 more than in the economics of education) and list the 300 most-cited publications broken down by topic. We report the changing topical and geographic focus of health economics (the topics 'Determinants of health and ill-health' and 'Health statistics and econometrics' both show an upward trend, and the field has expanded appreciably into the developing world). We also compare authors, countries, institutions and journals in terms of the volume of publications and their influence as measured through various citation-based indices (Grossman, the US, Harvard and the JHE emerge close to or at the top on a variety of measures).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.002.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过使用EconLit数据库中的文献“元数据”，并结合Google Scholar的引用数据以及我们自己的主题分类，对过去四十年健康经济学的文献进行了梳理。我们报告了健康经济学的发展情况（自1969年以来，健康经济学的出版物数量增加了33,000篇，比教育经济学多出12,000篇），并列出了按主题分类的300篇被引用最多的出版物。我们还报告了健康经济学在主题和地理上的变化趋势（“健康与不健康因素的决定因素”和“健康统计与计量经济学”这两个主题的引用数量均呈上升趋势，该领域在发展中国家也得到了显著扩展）。此外，我们还从出版物的数量以及通过各种引用指数衡量的影响程度等方面，对作者、国家、机构和期刊进行了比较（Grossman、美国、哈佛大学和JHE在多种指标上均位居前列）。

abstract.text: This article investigates the determinants of the prices of pharmaceuticals and their impact on the demand for prescription drugs in the context of Taiwan's pharmaceutical market where medical providers earn profit directly from prescribing and dispensing drugs. Based on product-level data, we find evidence that the profit-seeking behavior of the medical providers in the prescription drug market transfers the force of competition from the unregulated wholesale market to the regulated retail market and hence market competition still plays an important role in the determination of the regulated price. We also find that the profit-seeking behavior plays a similar role to advertising in that it increases the brand loyalty and hence lowers price elasticity. An important implication of our study is that the institutional features in the pharmaceutical market matter in shaping the nature of pharmaceutical competition and the responsiveness of pharmaceutical consumption with respect to changes in price.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.003.abstractZh: 本文研究了药品价格的决定因素及其对台湾药品市场处方药需求的影响。在台湾的药品市场中，医疗服务提供者通过开处方和配药直接获取利润。基于产品层面的数据，我们发现医疗服务提供者在处方药市场中的盈利行为将竞争压力从不受监管的批发市场转移到了受监管的零售市场，因此市场竞争在决定受监管价格方面仍然起着重要作用。我们还发现，盈利行为的效果类似于广告，它增加了品牌忠诚度，从而降低了价格弹性。本研究的一个重要结论是，药品市场的制度特征在塑造药品竞争的本质以及药品消费对价格变化的反应方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: This paper examines how priority setting in health care expenditures is influenced by the presence of uncertainty about the severity of the illness and the effectiveness of medical treatment. We provide necessary and sufficient conditions on social preferences under which a social planner will allocate more health care resources to populations at higher risk. Changes in risk are defined by the concept of stochastic dominance up to order n. The shape of the social utility function and an equity weighting function are used to model the inequality aversion of the social planner. We show that for higher order risk changes, the usual conditions on preferences such as prudence or relative risk aversion are not necessarily required to prioritise health care when there are different levels of uncertainty associated with otherwise similar patient groups.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.004.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在疾病严重程度和医疗治疗效果存在不确定性的情况下，医疗保健支出的优先级设定如何受到影响。我们提出了社会偏好所必需且充分条件，使得社会规划者会向风险较高的群体分配更多的医疗资源。风险的变化通过n阶随机优势概念来定义。社会效用函数和公平权重函数的形状被用来模拟社会规划者的不平等厌恶心理。我们表明，对于更高阶的风险变化，通常关于偏好的条件，如谨慎性或相对风险厌恶性，并不一定是优先分配医疗保健所必需的。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the effect of retirement on cognitive functioning using a longitudinal survey among older Americans, which allows controlling for individual heterogeneity and endogeneity of the retirement decision by using the eligibility age for social security as an instrument. The results highlight a significant negative effect of retirement on cognitive functioning. Our findings suggest that reforms aimed at promoting labour force participation at an older age may not only ensure the sustainability of social security systems but may also create positive health externalities for older individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.005.abstractZh: 本文通过一项针对美国老年人的纵向调查，分析了退休对认知功能的影响。该研究通过使用社会保障资格年龄作为工具变量，控制了退休决策的个体异质性和内生性。研究结果表明，退休对认知功能有显著的负面影响。我们的研究发现表明，旨在促进老年人参与劳动力市场的改革，不仅有助于确保社会保障系统的可持续性，还可能为老年人带来积极的健康效益。

abstract.text: The literature on mergers between private hospitals suggests that such mergers often produce little benefit. Despite this, the UK government has pursued an active policy of hospital mergers, arguing that such consolidations will bring improvements for patients. We examine whether this promise is met. We exploit the fact that between 1997 and 2006 in England around half the short term general hospitals were involved in a merger, but that politics means that selection for a merger may be random with respect to future performance. We examine the impact of mergers on a large set of outcomes including financial performance, productivity, waiting times and clinical quality and find little evidence that mergers achieved gains other than a reduction in activity. Given that mergers reduce the scope for competition between hospitals the findings suggest that further merger activity may not be the appropriate way of dealing with poorly performing hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.03.006.abstractZh: 关于私立医院合并的文献表明，此类合并往往带来的好处有限。尽管如此，英国政府仍积极推行医院合并政策，认为这种整合能够为患者带来改善。我们研究这种承诺是否能够实现。我们发现，在1997年至2006年间，英格兰约有一半的短期综合医院参与了合并，但由于政治因素，合并选择可能随机影响未来的表现。我们考察了合并对一系列结果的影响，包括财务绩效、生产力、等待时间以及临床质量，发现合并除了减少医院活动外，并未带来其他显著收益。鉴于合并减少了医院之间的竞争，这些研究结果表明，进一步的合并活动可能不是处理表现不佳的医院的有效方式。

abstract.text: Diabetes is a very common and serious chronic disease, and one of the fastest growing disease burdens in the United States. Further, health behaviors, such as exercise, smoking, drinking, as well as weight status, are instrumental to diabetes management and the reduction of its medical consequences. Nine waves of the Health and Retirement Study are used to model the role of a recent diabetes diagnosis and medication on present and subsequent weight status, exercise, drinking and smoking activity. Several non-linear dynamic population average probit models are estimated. Results suggest that compared to non-diagnosed individuals at risk for high blood sugar, diagnosed diabetics respond initially in terms of increasing exercise, losing weight, and curbing smoking and drinking behavior, but the effect diminishes after diagnosis. Evidence of recidivism is also found in these outcomes, especially weight status and physical activity, suggesting that some behavioral responses to diabetes may be short-lived.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.001.abstractZh: 糖尿病是一种非常常见且严重的慢性疾病，也是美国疾病负担增长最快的疾病之一。此外，健康行为，如运动、吸烟、饮酒以及体重状况，对糖尿病的管理和减轻其医疗后果至关重要。本研究利用“健康与退休研究”的九次调查数据，来模拟近期糖尿病诊断及药物治疗对当前及后续体重状况、运动、饮酒和吸烟行为的影响。通过估计多个非线性动态群体平均概率模型，研究结果表明，与未诊断但有高血糖风险的人群相比，被诊断为糖尿病的患者在初期会表现出增加运动、减轻体重以及减少吸烟和饮酒行为等积极反应，但这些效应在诊断后会逐渐减弱。研究结果还发现，这些结果中存在复发现象，尤其是在体重状况和身体活动方面，这表明对糖尿病的一些行为反应可能是短暂的。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the regulation of payment schemes for health care providers competing in both quality and product differentiation of their services. The regulator uses two instruments: a prospective payment per patient and a cost reimbursement rate. When the regulator can only use a prospective payment, the optimal price involves a trade-off between the level of quality provision and the level of horizontal differentiation. If this pure prospective payment leads to underprovision of quality and overdifferentiation, a mixed reimbursement scheme allows the regulator to improve the allocation efficiency. This is true for a relatively low level of patients' transportation costs. We also show that if the regulator cannot commit to the level of the cost reimbursement rate, the resulting allocation can dominate the one with full commitment. This occurs when the transportation cost is low or high enough, and the full commitment solution either implies full or zero cost reimbursement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.002.abstractZh: 本文分析了在服务质量与产品差异化方面竞争的医疗提供者的支付方案监管机制。监管机构采用两种手段：按患者数量预拨的支付额和成本补偿率。当监管机构只能使用预拨支付时，最优价格需要在服务质量水平与横向差异化程度之间进行权衡。如果单纯的预拨支付导致服务质量不足或过度差异化，那么混合补偿方案能够提升分配效率。这一结论适用于患者交通成本相对较低的情况。我们还指出，如果监管机构无法确定成本补偿率的具体水平，那么由此产生的分配结果可能会优于完全承诺的解决方案。这种情况发生在交通成本较低或较高时，而完全承诺的解决方案要么意味着全额补偿，要么意味着零补偿。

abstract.text: This paper investigates whether cannabis use affects physical and mental health. To do so, information on prime aged individuals living in Amsterdam in 1994 is used. Dutch data offer a clear advantage in estimating the health impacts of cannabis use because the legal status of cannabis in the Netherlands ensures that estimates are free from confounding with the physical and psychological effects of engaging in a criminal activity. Accounting for selection into cannabis use and shared frailties in mental and physical health, the results suggest that cannabis use reduces the mental wellbeing of men and women and the physical wellbeing of men. Although statistically significant, the magnitude of the effect of using cannabis on mental and physical health is found to be small.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了大麻使用是否会影响身心健康。为此，研究采用了1994年阿姆斯特丹地区成年个体的数据。荷兰的数据在估算大麻使用的健康影响方面具有明显优势，因为荷兰对大麻的法律规定确保了估算结果不会受到从事犯罪活动所带来的身体和心理影响的干扰。在考虑选择使用大麻的因素以及身心健康的共同缺陷后，研究结果表明，大麻使用会降低男性和女性的心理健康水平，并降低男性的身体健康状况。尽管这种影响在统计上显著，但其幅度相对较小。

abstract.text: In this paper, I examine the impact of uninsured patients on the in-hospital mortality rate of insured heart attack patients. I employ panel data models using patient discharge and hospital financial data from California (1999-2006). My results indicate that uninsured patients have an economically significant effect that increases the mortality rate of insured heart attack patients. I show that these results are not driven by alternative explanations, including reverse causality, patient composition effects, sample selection or unobserved trends and that they are robust to a host of specification checks. The primary channel for the observed spillover effects is increased hospital uncompensated care costs. Although data limitations constrain my capacity to check how hospitals change their provision of care to insured heart attack patients in response to reduced revenues, the evidence I have suggests a modest increase in the quantity of cardiac services without a corresponding increase in hospital staff.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.004.abstractZh: 在本文中，我研究了无保险患者对有保险心脏病患者院内死亡率的影响。我使用了加利福尼亚州1999-2006年的患者出院数据和医院财务数据，通过面板数据模型进行分析。研究结果表明，无保险患者对有保险心脏病患者的死亡率有显著的经济影响。这些结果并非由其他解释因素所驱动，包括反向因果关系、患者构成效应、样本选择或未观察到的趋势等。此外，这些结果在多种规格检验中均保持稳定。观察到的溢出效应的主要渠道是医院未补偿护理成本的增加。尽管数据限制使我无法检验医院如何因收入减少而改变对有保险心脏病患者的护理方式，但我的证据表明，心脏服务的数量略有增加，而医院员工数量却没有相应增加。

abstract.text: Youth smoking can biologically reduce learning productivity. It can also reduce youths' expected returns to education and lower their motivation to go to school, where smoking is forbidden. Using rich household survey data from rural China, this study investigates the effect of youth smoking on educational outcomes. Youth smoking is clearly an endogenous variable; to obtain consistent estimates of its impact, we use counts of registered alcohol vendors and a food price index as instrumental variables. Since the variable that measures smoking behavior is censored for non-smoking adolescents, we implement a two-step estimation strategy to account for the censored nature of this endogenous regressor. The estimates indicate that smoking one cigarette per day during adolescence can lower students' scores on mathematics tests by about 0.08 standard deviations. However, we find no significant effect of youth smoking on either Chinese test scores or total years of schooling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.005.abstractZh: 青少年吸烟会在生物学上降低学习效率。它还会减少青少年对教育的预期回报，降低他们上学的积极性，尤其是在学校禁止吸烟的情况下。本研究利用中国农村丰富的家庭调查数据，探讨了青少年吸烟对教育成果的影响。青少年吸烟显然是一个内生变量；为了获得其影响的稳定估计值，我们使用了注册酒精销售商的数量和食品价格指数作为工具变量。由于衡量吸烟行为的变量会剔除不吸烟的青少年，我们采用了两步估计策略来应对这种内生回归变量的被剔除问题。估计结果显示，青少年时期每天吸烟一支，会使学生的数学测试成绩降低约0.08个标准差。然而，我们发现青少年吸烟对中国学生的测试成绩或总受教育年限并没有显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper attempts to quantify the social, private, and public-finance values of reducing obesity through pharmaceutical and medical interventions. We find that the total social value of bariatric surgery is large for treated patients, with incremental social cost-effectiveness ratios typically under $10,000 per life-year saved. On the other hand, pharmaceutical interventions against obesity yield much less social value with incremental social cost-effectiveness ratios around $50,000. Our approach accounts for: competing risks to life expectancy; health care costs; and a variety of non-medical economic consequences (pensions, disability insurance, taxes, and earnings), which account for 20% of the total social cost of these treatments. On balance, bariatric surgery generates substantial private value for those treated, in the form of health and other economic consequences. The net public fiscal effects are modest, primarily because the size of the population eligible for treatment is small. The net social effect is large once improvements in life expectancy are taken into account.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.04.006.abstractZh: 本文试图量化通过药物和医疗干预减少肥胖所带来的社会、私人及公共财政价值。研究发现，对于接受减肥手术的患者而言，其总社会价值较高，每增加一个生命年所带来的社会成本效益比通常低于10,000美元。相比之下，针对肥胖的药物干预所带来的社会价值要低得多，其社会成本效益比约为50,000美元。我们的分析考虑了以下因素：对预期寿命的威胁、医疗保健成本，以及多种非医学经济后果（如养老金、残疾保险、税收和收入），这些后果占这些治疗方法的整体社会成本的20%。总体而言，减肥手术为接受治疗者带来了巨大的私人价值，包括健康和其他经济方面的收益。而公共财政上的净影响则较为有限，主要是因为适合接受治疗的人口数量较少。不过，一旦考虑到预期寿命的改善，净社会效应则相当显著。

abstract.text: We consider a health authority seeking to allocate annual budgets optimally over time to minimize the discounted social cost of infection(s) evolving in a finite set of groups. This optimization problem is challenging since the standard SIS epidemiological model describing the spread of the disease contains a nonconvexity. Neither optimal control nor standard discrete-time dynamic programming can be used to identify the optimal policy. We modify the standard dynamic programming algorithm and show how familiar, elementary arguments can be used to reach conclusions about the optimal policy. We show that under certain conditions it is optimal to focus the entire annual budget on one group at a time rather than divide it among several groups, as is often done in practice. We also show that under certain conditions it remains optimal to focus on one group when faced with a wealth constraint instead of an annual budget.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.001.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个卫生管理部门，该部门试图在有限的多组群体中，通过最优分配年度预算来最小化感染所带来的折现社会成本。这一优化问题具有挑战性，因为描述疾病传播的标准SIS流行病学模型存在非凸性。无论是最优控制还是标准离散时间动态规划都无法用于确定最优策略。我们改进了标准动态规划算法，并展示了如何利用熟悉且基本的论证来得出关于最优策略的结论。我们表明，在某些条件下，将整个年度预算一次性集中用于一个群体，而不是像实践中通常那样分配给多个群体，才是最优选择。我们还表明，在某些条件下，当面临财富限制而非年度预算时，集中资源于一个群体仍然是最优的。

abstract.text: We examine whether exposure to direct-to-consumer advertising (DTCA) for antidepressant drugs affects individual use of these medications among those suffering from depression. Prior studies have almost exclusively relied on making connections between national or market-level advertising volume/expenditures and national or individual-level usage of medications. This is the first study to: estimate the impact of individual-level exposure to DTCA on individual-level use of antidepressants; estimate the impact of individual-level exposure to television DTCA on individual-level use in any drug class; consider the relative and interactive impact of DTCA in two different media in any drug class; and, consider the heterogeneity of impact among different populations in an econometric framework in the antidepressant market. There are also important limitations to note. Unlike prior market level studies that use monthly data, we are limited to aggregated annual data. Our measures of potential advertising exposure are constructed assuming that media consumption patterns are stable during the year. We are also not able to study the impact of advertising on use of antidepressants for conditions other than depression, such as anxiety disorders. We find that: DTCA impacts antidepressant use in a statistically and economically significant manner; that these effects are present in both television and magazine advertising exposure but do not appear to have interactive effects; are stronger for women than for men in the magazine medium, but are about equally strong for men and women in the TV medium; and, are somewhat stronger for groups suffering from more severe forms of depression. The overall size of the effect is a 6-10 percentage point increase in antidepressant use from being exposed to television advertising; the corresponding magazine effects are between 3 and 4 percentage points.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.002.abstractZh: 我们研究了直接面向消费者广告对抑郁症患者个体使用抗抑郁药物的影响。以往的研究几乎只关注了国家或市场层面的广告量/支出与个人或国家层面的药物使用之间的关联。本研究首次尝试：估计个体层面直接面向消费者广告对个体使用抗抑郁药物的影响；估计个体层面电视广告对任何药物类别中个体使用的影响；考虑两种不同媒体中直接面向消费者广告的相对和交互影响；并在计量经济学框架内，考虑不同人群在抗抑郁药物市场中的影响差异。此外，也存在一些重要的局限性。与以往使用月度数据的市场层面研究不同，我们仅能使用年度汇总数据。我们对潜在广告暴露的衡量基于媒体消费模式在一年中相对稳定的假设。我们还无法研究广告对除抑郁症以外的其他疾病（如焦虑障碍）中抗抑郁药物使用的影响。研究发现：直接面向消费者广告对抗抑郁药物的使用有统计上和经济上显著的影响；这些影响在电视广告和杂志广告中均存在，但似乎没有交互效应；在杂志媒体中，这种影响在女性中更为明显，而在电视媒体中男女差异不大；对于患有更严重抑郁症的人群，这种影响更为显著。该效应的总体规模是，在接触电视广告的情况下，抗抑郁药物的使用量增加了6-10个百分点；相应的杂志效应则在3到4个百分点之间。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effect of income inequality on health for a group of particularly disadvantaged individuals: refugees. Our analysis draws on longitudinal hospitalization records coupled with a settlement policy where Swedish authorities assigned newly arrived refugees to their first area of residence. The policy was implemented in a way that provides a source of plausibly random variation in initial location. The results reveal no statistically significant effect of income inequality on the risk of being hospitalized. This finding holds also for most population subgroups and when separating between different types of diagnoses. Our estimates are precise enough to rule out large effects of income inequality on health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.003.abstractZh: 本文探讨了收入不平等对特定弱势群体——难民的健康状况的影响。我们的分析基于纵向住院记录，并结合了瑞典当局将新抵达的难民安置到其最初居住地的政策。该政策的实施方式确保了初始居住地的随机性。研究结果表明，收入不平等对住院风险没有统计学上的显著影响。这一发现适用于大多数人口子群体，并且在不同类型的诊断之间同样成立。我们的估计结果足够精确，可以排除收入不平等对健康产生重大影响的可能性。

abstract.text: Previous work suggests but cannot prove that education improves health behaviors. We exploit a randomized intervention that increased schooling (and reduced working) among male students in the Dominican Republic, by providing information on the returns to schooling. We find that treated youths were much less likely to smoke at age 18 and had delayed onset of daily or regular drinking. The effects appear to be due to changes in peer networks and disposable income. We find no evidence of a direct impact of schooling on rates of time preference, attitudes towards risk or perceptions that drinking or smoking are harmful to health, though our measures of these factors are more limited.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.004.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，教育能够改善健康行为，但未能提供确凿证据。我们利用了一项随机干预实验，该实验在多米尼加共和国的男性学生中增加了教育投入（并减少了工作时间），同时向他们提供了关于教育回报的信息。研究发现，接受干预的青少年在18岁时吸烟的可能性显著降低，日常或定期饮酒的起始年龄也推迟了。这些效果似乎源于同伴网络和可支配收入的变化。我们没有发现教育对时间偏好、风险态度或对饮酒或吸烟有害健康的认知有直接影响，尽管我们对这些因素的测量较为有限。

abstract.text: We propose a method of measuring and decomposing inequity in health care utilisation that allows for heterogeneity in the use-need relationship. This makes explicit inequity that derives from unequal treatment response to variation in need, as well as that due to differential effects of non-need determinants. Under plausible conditions concerning heterogeneity in the use-need relationship and the distribution of need, existing methods that impose homogeneity will underestimate pro-rich inequity. This prediction is confirmed for four middle-income Asian countries. In those countries, around one half of the observed socioeconomic inequality is due to utilisation being more responsive to need among the higher wealth and urban dwelling individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.005.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种衡量和分解医疗保健利用不平等的方法，该方法能够考虑到使用需求关系的异质性。这样可以明确识别出由于对需求变化的不同对待反应而产生的不平等，以及由于非需求因素的不同影响而产生的不平等。在假设使用需求关系存在异质性且需求分布合理的情况下，现有的假设同质性的方法会低估对富人而言的不平等程度。这一预测在四个中等收入亚洲国家得到了验证。在这些国家中，观察到的社会经济不平等中，大约一半是由于高财富人群和城市居民在利用方面对需求更为敏感所导致的。

abstract.text: Using multiple births as source of variation, we study the impact of fertility on the overall wellbeing of mothers. First, using US Census data for the year 1980, we study the impact of number of children on family arrangements, welfare participation and poverty status. Second, using the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) for the period 1982-2003, we study the impact on a series of health risk factors. The findings reveal, first, that an increase in family size increases the likelihood of marital breakdown. Second, we find evidence that mothers facing an increase in family size are not only more likely to live with other family members such as grandparents, aunts and uncles, they are also more likely to receive help from welfare programs. Third, consistent with an increase in welfare participation, families (mothers) are more likely to fall below the poverty line, and they face a reduction in total family income. The results using NHIS confirm a negative impact of fertility on marriage stability and an increase in welfare participation measured by the likelihood of using Medicaid and for some samples a reduction in the take-up of private health insurance. Finally, we find evidence that a shock in fertility increases the likelihood of mothers suffering from high blood pressure and becoming obese.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.006.abstractZh: 通过采用多胎生育作为变异来源，我们研究了生育率对母亲整体福祉的影响。首先，利用1980年美国人口普查数据，我们研究了子女数量对家庭安排、福利参与度和贫困状况的影响。其次，利用1982-2003年的全国健康访谈调查数据，我们研究了这一因素对一系列健康风险因素的影响。研究发现，首先，家庭规模的增加会增加婚姻破裂的可能性。其次，我们发现，面临家庭规模扩大的母亲不仅更有可能与祖父母、姑姑和叔叔等家庭成员同住，而且更有可能获得福利项目的帮助。第三，与福利参与度的增加一致，这些家庭（母亲）更有可能陷入贫困线以下，并且家庭总收入也会减少。使用NHIS数据得出的结果证实，生育率对婚姻稳定性有负面影响，同时增加了福利参与度，表现为使用医疗补助的可能性增加，某些样本还显示出私人健康保险的使用减少。最后，我们发现，生育率的冲击会增加母亲患高血压和肥胖的风险。

abstract.text: Previous studies estimate the average effect of cigarette price on body mass index (BMI), with recent research showing that their different methodologies all point to a negative effect after several years. This literature, however, ignores the possibility that the effect could vary throughout the BMI distribution or across socioeconomic and demographic groups due to differences in underlying obesity risks or preferences for health. We evaluate heterogeneity in the long-run impact of cigarette price on BMI by performing quantile regressions and stratifying the sample by race, education, age, and sex. Cigarette price has a highly heterogeneous negative effect that is more than three times as strong at high BMI levels--where weight loss is most beneficial for health--than at low levels. The effects are also strongest for blacks, college graduates, middle-aged adults, and women. We also assess the implications for disparities, conduct robustness checks, and evaluate potential mechanisms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.05.007.abstractZh: 先前的研究估计了香烟价格对体重指数（BMI）的平均影响，最近的研究表明，不同研究方法均显示，在几年后，香烟价格会对BMI产生负面影响。然而，这些研究忽略了这种影响可能在BMI分布的不同区间或不同社会经济和人口群体中有所不同，这可能是由于潜在的肥胖风险或健康偏好差异所致。我们通过进行分位数回归，并根据种族、教育水平、年龄和性别对样本进行分层，来评估香烟价格对BMI的长期影响是否存在异质性。结果显示，香烟价格对BMI的负面影响在BMI较高水平时更为显著——在BMI较高时，减肥对健康更为有益——其影响强度是BMI较低时的三倍多。此外，这种影响在黑人、大学毕业生、中年人和女性中更为明显。我们还评估了这种差异对公共卫生的影响，进行了稳健性检验，并探讨了潜在的机制。

abstract.text: Effective in 2000, Medicare's Outpatient Prospective Payment System (OPPS) sets pre-determined reimbursement rates for hospital outpatient services, replacing the prior cost-based methods of reimbursement. Using Florida outpatient discharge data, we study the effect of OPPS on hospital outpatient volume. We find that on average Medicare rate cuts either decreased or had no significant effect on Medicare volume, but increased private fee-for-service (FFS) volume. We also find that responses vary with the hospital's "exposure" to Medicare payment changes, where exposure is measured as the baseline Medicare patient share. Compared to less exposed hospitals, highly exposed hospitals responded with larger increases in private FFS volume and with smaller decreases (in some cases, even increases) in Medicare volume when payment rates fell. Our results are consistent with provider demand inducement.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.06.001.abstractZh: 2000年实施的医疗保险门诊预期支付系统（OPPS）为医院门诊服务设定了预先确定的报销费率，取代了之前的基于成本的报销方式。利用佛罗里达州的门诊出院数据，我们研究了OPPS对医院门诊量的影响。研究发现，平均而言，医疗保险费率的降低要么减少了门诊量，要么对门诊量没有显著影响，但增加了私人按服务收费的门诊量。我们还发现，不同医院的应对情况因其对医疗保险支付变化的“暴露程度”而异，这里的暴露程度以基线医疗保险患者份额来衡量。与暴露程度较低的医院相比，暴露程度较高的医院在支付率下降时，私人按服务收费的门诊量增加了，而医疗保险门诊量则减少了（在某些情况下甚至有所增加）。我们的研究结果与医疗服务提供者的需求激励理论相符。

abstract.text: A number of studies report that U.S. state mortality rates, particularly for the elderly, decline during economic downturns. Further, several prior studies use microdata to show that as state unemployment rates rise, physical health improves, unhealthy behaviors decrease, and medical care use declines. We use data on elderly mortality rates and data from the Medicare Current Beneficiary Survey from a time period that encompasses the start of the Great Recession. We find that elderly mortality is countercyclical during most of the 1994-2008 period. Further, as unemployment rates rise, seniors report worse mental health and are no more likely to engage in healthier behaviors. We find suggestive evidence that inpatient utilization increases perhaps because of an increased physician willingness to accept Medicare patients. Our findings suggest that either elderly individuals respond differently to recessions than do working age adults, or that the relationship between unemployment and health has changed.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.06.002.abstractZh: 多项研究指出，美国各州的死亡率，尤其是老年人的死亡率，在经济衰退期间会下降。此外，一些先前的研究使用微观数据表明，随着州失业率的上升，身体健康状况会改善，不健康行为会减少，医疗服务的使用也会下降。我们使用有关老年人死亡率的数据以及涵盖大衰退开始时期的医疗保险当前受益人调查数据。我们发现，在1994年至2008年期间，老年人死亡率呈现反周期性变化。此外，随着失业率上升，老年人报告的精神健康状况恶化，并且他们参与更健康行为的意愿也降低了。我们发现，住院率的增加可能是由于医生更愿意接受医疗保险患者的缘故。我们的研究结果表明，要么老年人对经济衰退的反应与工作年龄成年人不同，要么失业与健康之间的关系已经发生了变化。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of early life malaria exposure on cognition in sample of Mexican adults, using the nationwide introduction of malaria eradication efforts to identify causal impacts. The core findings are that birth year exposure to malaria eradication was associated with increases in Raven Progressive Matrices test scores and consumption expenditures, but not schooling. Additionally, cohorts born after eradication both entered and exited school earlier than their pre-eradication counterparts. These effects were only seen for men and explanations for this are assessed. Collectively, these findings suggest that improvements in infant health help explain secular increases in cognitive test scores, that better cognition may link early life health to adulthood earnings, and that human capital investments through childhood and young adulthood respond sensitively to market returns to early life endowment shocks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.06.003.abstractZh: 本研究考察了早期生活疟疾暴露对墨西哥成年人认知能力的影响，通过全国范围内的疟疾根除行动来识别因果效应。核心发现表明，出生年份处于疟疾根除时期的个体在瑞文渐进矩阵测试成绩和消费支出方面有所提升，但受教育程度并未发生变化。此外，在疟疾根除之后出生的群体，其入学和毕业时间都比根除前的同龄人更早。这些效应仅出现在男性身上，并进行了相应的解释。总体而言，这些发现表明，婴儿健康的改善有助于解释长期以来的认知测试成绩提升，更好的认知能力可能与成年后的收入相关，而通过童年和青年时期的人力资本投资对早期生活禀赋冲击的市场反应非常敏感。

abstract.text: A number of studies suggest that there is an over-supply of specialists and an under-supply of general practitioners in many developed countries. Previous econometric studies of specialty choice from the US suggest that although income plays a role, other non-pecuniary factors may be important. This paper presents a novel application of a choice experiment to identify the effects of expected future earnings and other attributes on specialty choice. We find the implied marginal wage estimated from our discrete choice model is close to the actual wages of senior specialists, but much higher than those of senior GPs. In a policy simulation we find that increasing GPs' earnings by $50,000, or increasing opportunities for procedural or academic work can increase the number of junior doctors choosing general practice by between 8 and 13 percentage points. The simulation implies an earnings elasticity of specialty choice of 0.95.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.001.abstractZh: 多项研究表明，许多发达国家存在专科医生供过于求、全科医生供不应求的现象。之前对美国专科选择进行的经济计量学研究表明，虽然收入起着作用，但其他非经济因素也可能非常重要。本文采用一种新的选择实验方法，来研究预期未来收入及其他属性对专科选择的影响。我们发现，从离散选择模型估算出的边际工资接近高级专科医生的实际工资，但远高于高级全科医生的工资。在政策模拟中，我们发现将全科医生的收入提高50,000美元，或增加程序性或学术性工作的机会，可以使选择全科医学的初级医生数量增加8%到13个百分点。模拟结果显示，专科选择的收入弹性为0.95。

abstract.text: Policymakers in countries around the world are faced with rising health care costs and are debating ways to reform health care to reduce expenditures. Estimates of price elasticity of expenditure are a key component for predicting expenditures under alternative policies. Using unique individual-level data compiled from administrative records from the Chilean private health insurance market, I estimate the price elasticity of expenditures across a variety of health care services. I find elasticities that range between zero for the most acute service (appendectomy) and -2.08 for the most elective (psychologist visit). Moreover, the results show that at least one third of the elasticity is explained by the number of visits; the rest is explained by the intensity of each visit. Finally, I find that high-income individuals are five times more price sensitive than low-income individuals and that older individuals are less price-sensitive than young individuals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.002.abstractZh: 世界各地的政策制定者面临着不断上升的医疗保健成本，正在讨论改革医疗保健体系以减少支出的方法。对支出价格弹性的估计是预测不同政策下支出变化的关键因素。我利用来自智利私人健康保险市场的行政记录中收集到的独特个体级数据，估算了各种医疗保健服务的支出价格弹性。我发现，从最紧急的服务（如阑尾切除术）的零到最非必要的服务（如心理学家咨询）的-2.08，各种服务的价格弹性各不相同。此外，结果显示，至少三分之一的弹性可以由就诊次数来解释；其余的则可以由每次就诊的频繁程度来解释。最后，我发现高收入个体的价格敏感度是低收入个体的五倍，而年长个体的价格敏感度则低于年轻个体。

abstract.text: The combination of economic and biological factors is likely to result in overeating in the current environment of cheap and readily available food. This propensity is shown using a "dual decision" approach where choices reflect the interaction of a "deliberative" system, operating as in standard economic models, and an "affective" system that responds rapidly to stimuli without considering long-term consequences. This framework is characterized by excess food consumption and body weight, in that individuals prefer both ex-ante and ex-post to eat and weigh less than they actually do, with weight loss attempts being common but often unsuccessful or only partially successful. As in the standard model, weight is related to prices. However, another potentially important reason for rising obesity is that food producers have incentives to engineer products to stimulate the affective system so as to encourage overeating. Data from several sources are used to investigate predictions of the dual decision model, with the evidence providing broad support for at least some irrationality in food consumption. Most importantly, there is little indication that the large secular increases in body mass index have been accompanied by corresponding growth in utility-maximizing weight. One result is that efforts to reduce weight have become more common as obesity has increased.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.004.abstractZh: 在食物廉价且易于获取的环境中，经济因素与生物因素的结合可能导致过度进食。这种倾向可以通过“双重决策”模型来体现，其中选择反映了“ deliberative ”系统的运作，类似于标准经济模型中的运作方式，以及快速响应刺激而不考虑长期后果的“ affective ”系统的运作。该框架的特点是食物消费和体重超标，因为个体在事前和事后都倾向于进食，并且体重比实际值要轻，减肥尝试很常见，但往往不成功或仅部分成功。与标准模型一样，体重与价格有关。然而，肥胖率上升的另一个重要原因可能是食品生产商有动机设计产品以刺激情感系统，从而鼓励过度进食。来自多个来源的数据被用来验证双重决策模型的预测，这些证据为食物消费中的某些非理性行为提供了广泛支持。最重要的是，几乎没有迹象表明，长期增长的体重指数伴随着效用最大化体重的相应增长。一个结果是，随着肥胖率的上升，减少体重的努力变得更加普遍。

abstract.text: Existing studies suggest that individual and household level economic shocks affect the demand for and supply of risky sex. However, little evidence exists on the effects of an aggregate shock on equilibrium risky sexual behavior. This paper examines the effects of the early twenty-first century copper boom on risky sexual behavior in Zambian copper mining cities. The results suggest that the copper boom substantially reduced rates of transactional sex and multiple partnerships in copper mining cities. These effects were partly concentrated among young adults and copper boom induced in-migration to mining cities appears to have contributed to these reductions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.07.007.abstractZh: 现有研究表明，个体和家庭层面的经济冲击会影响风险性性行为的需求和供应。然而，关于整体经济冲击对风险性性行为均衡影响的研究却很少。本文探讨了21世纪初铜价上涨对赞比亚铜矿城市风险性性行为的影响。研究结果表明，铜价上涨显著降低了铜矿城市中的交易性性行为以及多重伴侣关系的发生率。这些影响主要集中在年轻人群中，而铜价上涨导致的向铜矿城市的移民现象似乎也促进了这些行为的减少。

abstract.text: When adult children are financially responsible for their parents, they can take considerable interest in the amount of their parents' long-term care (LTC) insurance. In this paper, we look at the optimal levels of LTC insurance and of informal care, and at the link between these two decisions when the child, who provides informal care, is also the decision-maker with regard to LTC insurance. Interestingly, results differ depending on the degree of both parental and child altruism and indicate either complementarity or substitutability between insurance and informal care. In particular, we show in the presence of child altruism that insurance stimulates the offer of informal care, contrary to the case where the insurance decision is made by the elderly parent. We also investigate how exogenous shocks with respect to the opportunity cost of informal care, initial wealth levels and bequests modify simultaneously the optimal level of insurance and informal care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.001.abstractZh: 当成年子女在经济上负责父母时，他们会非常关心父母的长期护理保险金额。本文探讨了长期护理保险以及非正式护理的最佳水平，并研究了这两个决策之间的联系——特别是当提供非正式护理的子女同时也是长期护理保险决策者的情形。有趣的是，研究结果取决于父母和子女之间的利他主义程度，表明保险与非正式护理之间存在互补性或可替代性。特别是，在子女表现出利他主义的情况下，保险会促进非正式护理的提供，这与老年父母独自做出保险决策的情况相反。我们还研究了外部冲击对非正式护理的机会成本、初始财富水平和遗产分配的影响，这些冲击如何同时改变保险和非正式护理的最佳水平。

abstract.text: This paper examines how estimates of the price elasticity of demand for beer vary with the choice of alcohol price series examined. Our most important finding is that the commonly used ACCRA price data are unlikely to reliably indicate alcohol demand elasticities-estimates obtained from this source vary drastically and unpredictably. As an alternative, researchers often use beer taxes to proxy for alcohol prices. While the estimated beer taxes elasticities are more stable, there are several problems with using taxes, including difficulties in accounting for cross-price effects. We believe that the most useful estimates reported in this paper are obtained using annual Uniform Product Code (UPC) "barcode" scanner data on grocery store alcohol prices. These estimates suggest relatively low demand elasticity, probably around -0.3, with evidence that the elasticities are considerably overstated in models that control for beer but not wine or spirits prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.002.abstractZh: 本文探讨了啤酒需求价格弹性估计值如何随着所研究的酒精价格系列的选取而发生变化。我们最重要的发现是，常用的ACCRA价格数据不太可能可靠地反映酒精需求弹性——从这一来源获得的估计值变化幅度巨大且难以预测。作为替代方案，研究人员经常使用啤酒税来代表酒精价格。虽然通过啤酒税估计出的弹性值更为稳定，但使用税收存在几个问题，包括难以考虑交叉价格效应。我们认为，本文报道的最有用的估计值是通过年度统一产品代码“条形码”扫描仪数据获得的，这些数据涉及杂货店酒精价格。这些估计表明，啤酒需求弹性相对较低，大约在-0.3左右，并且有证据表明，在控制啤酒价格而不控制葡萄酒或烈酒价格的情况下，这些弹性值被严重高估了。

abstract.text: Although the effect of time to death (TTD) on health care expenditures (HCE) has been investigated using individual level data, the most profound implications of TTD have been for the forecasting of macro-level HCE. Here we estimate the TTD model using macro-level data from the Netherlands consisting of mortality rates and age- and gender-specific per capita health expenditures for the years 1981-2007. Forecasts for the years 2008-2020 of this macro-level TTD model were compared to forecasts that excluded TTD. Results revealed that the effect of TTD on HCE in our macro model was similar to those found in micro-econometric studies. As the inclusion of TTD pushed growth rate estimates from unidentified causes upwards, however, the two models' forecasts of HCE for the 2008-2020 were similar. We argue that including TTD, if modeled correctly, does not lower forecasts of HCE.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.003.abstractZh: 尽管已有研究使用个体层面的数据探讨了死亡时间对医疗保健支出的影响，但死亡时间对医疗保健支出最深远的影响体现在宏观层面的预测上。本研究采用荷兰的宏观数据，包括1981至2007年的死亡率以及按年龄和性别划分的人均医疗保健支出，来估算死亡时间模型。我们将该宏观死亡时间模型的2008至2020年预测结果，与未考虑死亡时间因素的预测结果进行了对比。结果表明，死亡时间对医疗保健支出的影响与微观计量经济学研究中的发现相似。不过，由于纳入死亡时间因素后，未明确定义的原因导致的增长率估计值有所上升，因此两个模型在2008至2020年期间的医疗保健支出预测结果较为一致。我们认为，如果死亡时间因素被正确纳入模型，并不会降低医疗保健支出的预测结果。

abstract.text: We use a social experiment to estimate the impact of expanding health insurance coverage on the health and mortality of newly entitled SSDI beneficiaries who lacked health insurance. Our intent-to-treat estimates show that expanding health insurance has significant effects on self-reported health at one year following health insurance enrollment, positive effects on mental health and physical health at one year following health insurance enrollment, and no significant effects on mortality within our observation period. About 30% of control group members obtained health insurance coverage within one year following enrollment. We use two-stage least square models to estimate the impact on those who would not have obtained health insurance coverage without the demonstration project and find larger effects on self-reported health and mental health among these SSDI beneficiaries. Finally, we examine distributional impacts to show that mean impacts miss meaningful effects.
