10.1016/j.jhealeco.2012.08.004.abstractZh: 我们通过一项社会实验来估计扩大医疗保险覆盖范围对没有医疗保险的新获得社会保障福利金资格者的健康和死亡率的影响。我们的实验结果显示，在医疗保险注册后的一年内，扩大医疗保险对自我报告的健康的积极影响显著，对心理健康和身体健康也有积极影响，但在我们的观察期内，对死亡率的影响并不显著。大约30%的对照组成员在注册后的一年内获得了医疗保险。我们使用两阶段最小二乘法模型来估计那些如果没有示范项目就不会获得医疗保险的人所受到的影响，发现这些社会保障福利金资格者自我报告和心理健康方面的影响更大。最后，我们考察了分布影响，结果表明平均影响未能捕捉到重要的效应。

abstract.text: Interview with Susan Edgman-Levitan on patient-experience measures and their relationship to health outcomes. (00:00)Download Despite criticism of patient-satisfaction measures, patient-experience surveys that are designed and administered appropriately provide robust measures of the quality of health care and offer insight into a dimension that's otherwise difficult to measure objectively.

10.1056/nejmp1211775.abstractZh: 与Susan Edgman-Levitan的访谈，主题是关于患者体验指标及其与健康结果之间的关系。（00:00）尽管对患者满意度指标存在批评，但设计和实施得当的患者体验调查能够提供可靠的医疗质量衡量标准，并有助于了解那些难以客观测量的维度。

abstract.text: Free-riding is at the core of environmental problems. If a climate coalition reduces its emissions, world prices change and nonparticipants typically emit more; they may also extract the dirtiest type of fossil fuel and invest too little in green technology. The coalition's second-best policy distorts trade and is not time consistent. However, suppose that the countries can trade the rights to exploit fossil-fuel deposits: As soon as the market clears, the above-mentioned problems vanish and the first-best is implemented. In short, the coalition's best policy is to simply buy foreign deposits and conserve them.

10.1086/665405.abstractZh: 搭便车行为是环境问题的核心。如果气候联盟减少排放，全球价格会发生变化，非参与者通常会排放更多；他们还可能开采最脏的化石燃料，并对绿色技术的投资不足。联盟的第二优政策会扭曲贸易，且不具备时间一致性。然而，假设各国可以交易开采化石燃料资源的权利：一旦市场达到清算状态，上述问题就会消失，最优政策就能得以实施。简而言之，联盟的最佳政策就是直接购买外国资源并加以保护。

abstract.text: Under the Articles of Confederation, the central government of the United States had limited power to tax. Therefore, large debts accumulated during the US War for Independence traded at deep discounts. That situation framed a US fiscal crisis in the 1780s. A political revolution--for that was what scuttling the Articles of Confederation in favor of the Constitution of the United States of America was--solved the fiscal crisis by transferring authority to levy tariffs from the states to the federal government. The Constitution and acts of the First Congress of the United States in August 1790 gave Congress authority to raise enough revenues to service a big government debt. In 1790, the Congress carried out a comprehensive bailout of state governments' debts, part of a grand bargain that made creditors of the states become advocates of ample federal taxes. That bailout created expectations about future federal bailouts that a costly episode in the early 1840s proved to be unwarranted.

10.1086/665415.abstractZh: 在《邦联条例》下，美国的中央政府征税权力有限。因此，美国独立战争期间积累的大量债务以极低的价格出售。这种情况导致了1780年代的美国财政危机。一场政治革命——正是这场革命推翻了《邦联条例》，并取代了它，以《美利坚合众国宪法》为新的国家宪法——通过将征税权从各州转移到联邦政府，解决了财政危机。1790年8月，《宪法》和美国第一届国会通过的法案赋予国会足够的收入来偿还巨额政府债务。1790年，国会对州政府的债务进行了全面的救助，这是一项重大交易的一部分，使得各州的债权人成为支持联邦政府征收更多税收的倡导者。这一救助措施引发了人们对未来联邦政府救助的期望，而1840年代初期发生的昂贵事件证明这些期望是不必要的。

abstract.text: Price controls lead to misallocation of goods and encourage rent seeking. The misallocation effect alone ensures that a price control always reduces consumer surplus in an otherwise-competitive market with convex demand if supply is more elastic than demand or with log-convex demand (e.g., constant elasticity) even if supply is inelastic. The same results apply whether rationed goods are allocated by costless lottery or whether costly rent seeking and/or partial decontrol mitigates the inefficiency. Our analysis exploits the observation that in any market, consumer surplus equals the area between the demand curve and the industry marginal revenue curve.

10.1086/665416.abstractZh: 价格管制会导致商品分配不当，并鼓励寻租行为。仅这种分配不当的影响就足以证明，在原本具有凸需求且供给弹性大于需求的竞争性市场中，价格管制总会减少消费者剩余；而在需求为对数凸形（例如，弹性恒定）的情况下，即使供给缺乏弹性，价格管制同样会降低消费者剩余。无论配给商品是通过无成本的抽签方式进行的，还是通过昂贵的寻租行为和部分解除管制来减轻效率低下问题，结果都是相同的。我们的分析基于这样一个观察：在任何市场中，消费者剩余等于需求曲线与行业边际收益曲线之间的区域。

abstract.text: A lot. We derive common and conflicting predictions from models in which agents face information constraints and then assess their validity using surveys of consumers, firms, central bankers, and professional forecasters. We document that mean forecasts fail to completely adjust on impact to shocks, leading to statistically and economically significant deviations from the null of full information. The dynamics of forecast errors after shocks are consistent with the predictions of models with information rigidities. The conditional responses of forecast errors and disagreement among agents can also be used to differentiate between some of the most prominent models of information rigidities.

10.1086/665662.abstractZh: 我们从模型中得出一些共同且相互矛盾的预测结果。在这些模型中，个体面临信息限制，然后通过对消费者、企业、中央银行官员和专业预测者的调查来评估这些预测的有效性。我们发现，平均预测结果在受到冲击后未能完全调整，导致在统计和经济层面上与完全信息假设存在显著的偏差。冲击后预测误差的动态与具有信息刚性模型的预测结果一致。预测误差的条件响应以及个体之间的分歧，还可以用来区分一些最著名的关于信息刚性的模型。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the causal link between the ethnic diversity in a society and its inhabitants' preferences for redistribution. We exploit exogenous variation in immigrant shares stemming from a nationwide program placing refugees in municipalities throughout Sweden during 1985-94 and match data on refugee placement to panel survey data on inhabitants of the receiving municipalities. We find significant, negative effects of increased immigration on the support for redistribution. The effect is especially pronounced among high-income earners. We also establish that estimates from earlier studies failing to identify causal effects are likely to be positively biased (i.e., less negative).

10.1086/665800.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社会中的种族多样性与其居民对再分配偏好之间的因果关系。我们利用1985-1994年间一项全国性计划将难民安置在瑞典各市镇所带来的移民比例变化，并将难民安置数据与接收市镇居民的人口调查数据进行匹配分析。研究发现，移民数量的增加对再分配的支持程度有显著的负面影响，这种影响在高收入人群中尤为明显。此外，我们还发现，早期研究中未能识别出因果效应的估计结果可能存在正向偏差（即，负面影响被低估了）。

abstract.text: This paper builds a framework for the analysis of macroeconomic fluctuations that incorporates the endogenous determination of the number of producers and products over the business cycle. Economic expansions induce higher entry rates by prospective entrants subject to sunk investment costs. The sluggish response of the number of producers generates a new and potentially important endogenous propagation mechanism for business cycle models. The return to investment determines household saving decisions, producer entry, and the allocation of labor across sectors. Our framework replicates several features of business cycles and predicts procyclical profits even for preference specifications that imply countercyclical markups.

10.1086/665825.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个分析宏观经济波动的框架，该框架考虑了企业在商业周期中数量和产品的内生性决定因素。经济扩张会促使潜在进入者以较高的投资成本进入市场。生产者数量的缓慢增长形成了一种新的、可能具有重要意义的内生传播机制，这对商业周期模型具有重要意义。投资回报决定了家庭的储蓄决策、生产者的进入以及各部门之间的劳动力分配。我们的框架再现了商业周期的若干特征，并预测了顺周期性利润的存在，即使是在那些暗示逆周期加价的偏好假设下也是如此。

abstract.text: Investors value the liquidity and safety of US Treasuries. We document this by showing that changes in Treasury supply have large effects on a variety of yield spreads. As a result, Treasury yields are reduced by 73 basis points, on average, from 1926 to 2008. Both the liquidity and safety attributes of Treasuries are driving this phenomenon. We document this by analyzing the spread between assets with different liquidity (but similar safety) and those with different safety (but similar liquidity). The low yield on Treasuries due to their extreme safety and liquidity suggests that Treasuries in important respects are similar to money.

10.1086/666526.abstractZh: 投资者看重美国国债的流动性和安全性。我们通过研究国债供应变化对各类收益率差的影响来证实这一点。结果显示，从1926年到2008年，国债收益率平均下降了73个基点。国债的流动性和安全性这两个属性共同推动了这一现象。我们通过分析不同流动性（但安全性相似）的资产与安全性不同（但流动性相似）的资产之间的收益率差异来进一步验证这一点。由于国债具有极高的流动性和安全性，其低收益率表明国债在诸多方面与货币类似。

abstract.text: I show that the pricing of a broad class of long-dated assets is driven by the possibility of extraordinarily bad news. This result does not depend on any assumptions about the existence of disasters, nor does it apply only to assets that hedge bad outcomes; indeed, it applies even to long-dated claims on the market in a lognormal world if the market's Sharpe ratio is higher than its volatility, as appears to be the case in practice.

10.1086/666527.abstractZh: 我证明了，一大批长期资产的价格变动是由极端糟糕的消息的可能性所驱动的。这一结果并不依赖于关于灾难存在的任何假设，也不仅适用于那些对冲不良结果的资产；实际上，只要市场的夏普比率高于其波动性，这一结论就适用于在对数正态世界中的长期资产，而实际情况似乎也确实如此。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates that the option to move in and out of the parental home is a valuable insurance channel against labor market risk, which facilitates the pursuit of jobs with the potential for high earnings growth. Using monthly panel data, I document an empirical relationship among coresidence, individual labor market events, and subsequent earnings growth. I estimate the parameters of a dynamic game between youths and parents to show that the option to live at home can account for features of aggregate data for low-skilled young workers: small consumption responses to shocks, high labor elasticities, and low savings rates.

10.1086/666588.abstractZh: 本文表明，选择是否居住于父母家中是一种有价值的保险渠道，能够抵御劳动力市场的风险，从而有助于追求具有高收益增长潜力的工作。通过月度面板数据，我证实了居住状况、个人劳动力市场事件与后续收入增长之间的实证关系。我通过动态博弈模型估计了 youths与父母之间的参数，以表明居住在家中的选择可以解释低技能年轻工人总体数据中的特征：对冲击的消费需求较小、劳动力弹性较高以及储蓄率较低。

abstract.text: This paper studies the maturity composition and the term structure of interest rate spreads of government debt in emerging markets. In the data, when interest rate spreads rise, debt maturity shortens and the spread on short-term bonds rises more than the spread on long-term bonds. We build a dynamic model of international borrowing with endogenous default and multiple debt maturities. Long-term debt provides a hedge against future fluctuations in spreads, whereas short-term debt is more effective at providing incentives to repay. The trade-off between these hedging and incentive benefits is quantitatively important for understanding the maturity structure in emerging markets.

10.1086/666589.abstractZh: 本文研究了新兴市场中政府债务利率差值的到期构成和期限结构。数据显示，当利率差值上升时，债务到期时间缩短，短期债券的利率差值上升幅度大于长期债券的利率差值。我们构建了一个包含内生违约和多种债务到期时间的国际借贷动态模型。长期债务能够对冲未来利率差值的波动，而短期债务则更能有效激励债务人按时还款。这种对冲与激励效益之间的权衡对于理解新兴市场的到期结构具有重要意义。

abstract.text: We construct a simple model, consistent with Becker and Tomes, that decomposes the intergenerational income elasticity into the causal effect of financial resources, the mechanistic transmission of human capital, and the role that human capital plays in the determination of fathers' permanent incomes. We show how a particular set of instrumental variables could separately identify the money and human capital transmission effects. Using data from a 35 percent sample of Swedish sons and their fathers, we show that only a minority of the intergenerational income elasticity can be plausibly attributed to the causal effect of fathers' financial resources.

10.1086/666590.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个与Becker和Tomes观点一致的简单模型，将代际收入弹性分解为金融资源的因果效应、人力资本的机制性传递，以及人力资本在决定父亲永久收入中的作用。我们展示了如何通过一组特定的工具变量分别识别货币和人力资本传递效应。利用瑞典35%的儿子的数据及其父亲的数据，我们发现只有少数代际收入弹性可以合理地归因于父亲金融资源的因果效应。

abstract.text: We examine a dynamic model of up-or-down problem solving. A decision maker can either spend resources investigating a new problem before deciding what to do or decide on the basis of similarity with precedent problems. Over time, a decision-making framework, or jurisprudence, develops. We focus on the model's application to judge-made law. We show that judges summarily apply precedent in some cases. The law may converge to efficient or inefficient rules. With positive probability, identical cases are treated differently. As the court learns over time, inconsistencies become less likely. We discuss the existing empirical evidence and the model's testable implications.

10.1086/666655.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态模型，用于解决“上策或下策”问题。决策者可以在决定采取何种行动之前，投入资源调查新的问题，或者根据与以往问题的相似性来做出决策。随着时间的推移，一种决策框架或司法原则会逐渐形成。我们重点关注该模型在法官制定法律中的应用。我们发现，法官在某些情况下会直接适用先例判决。法律可能会趋向于高效或低效的规则。以正概率来看，相同的案件可能会得到不同的处理。随着法院经验的积累，不一致的情况会变得不那么常见。我们讨论了现有的实证证据以及该模型的可验证性含义。

abstract.text: Banks finance illiquid assets with demandable deposits, which discipline bankers but expose them to damaging runs. Authorities may not want to stand by and watch banks collapse. However, unconstrained direct bailouts undermine the disciplinary role of deposits. Moreover, competition forces banks to promise depositors more, increasing intervention and making the system worse off. By contrast, constrained central bank intervention to lower rates maintains private discipline, while offsetting contractual rigidity. It may still lead banks to make excessive liquidity promises. Anticipating this, central banks should raise rates in normal times to offset distortions from reducing rates in adverse times.

10.1086/666669.abstractZh: 银行通过可变现存款来为流动性不足的资产提供融资，这虽然对银行家有所约束，但也使他们面临潜在的挤兑风险。当局可能不愿坐视银行倒闭。然而，无限制的直接救助会削弱存款的约束作用。此外，竞争迫使银行向储户承诺更多的回报，从而增加干预力度，使系统状况更加恶化。相比之下，受限制的中央银行干预以降低利率，可以维持私人部门的自律性，同时缓解契约的刚性。不过，这仍可能导致银行过度承诺流动性。鉴于此，中央银行应在正常时期提高利率，以抵消在困难时期降低利率带来的扭曲效应。

abstract.text: This paper experimentally analyzes the schooling decisions of poor households in urban Brazil. We elicit parents' choices between monthly government transfers conditional on their adolescent child attending school and guaranteed, unconditional transfers of varying sizes. In the baseline treatment, an overwhelming majority of parents prefer conditional transfers to larger unconditional transfers. However, few parents prefer conditional payments if they are offered text message notifications whenever their child misses school. These findings suggest important intergenerational conflicts in these schooling decisions, a lack of parental control and observability of school attendance, and an additional rationale for conditional cash transfer programs--the monitoring they provide.

10.1086/666746.abstractZh: 本文通过实验分析巴西城市贫困家庭的教育决策。我们研究了父母在青少年子女是否上学这一条件下，选择政府每月提供的转移支付与选择不同金额的无条件转移支付之间的权衡。在基线处理中，绝大多数父母更倾向于选择条件性转移支付，而非较大的无条件转移支付。然而，如果父母在子女缺课时收到短信通知，只有少数父母会偏好条件性支付。这些发现表明，在这些教育决策中存在重要的代际冲突，父母对子女出勤情况的监控和了解存在不足，这也进一步说明了条件性现金转移计划存在的必要性——即它们所提供的监督机制。

abstract.text: Economies with private information provide a rationale for capital taxation. In this paper we ask what the welfare gains from following this prescription are. We develop a method to answer this question in standard general equilibrium models with idiosyncratic uncertainty and incomplete markets. We find that general equilibrium forces are important and greatly reduce the welfare gains. Once these effects are taken into account, the gains are relatively small in our benchmark calibration. These results do not imply that dynamic aspects of social insurance design are unimportant, but they do suggest that capital taxation may play a modest role.

10.1086/666747.abstractZh: 具有私人信息的经济模型为资本征税提供了理论依据。在本文中，我们探讨了遵循这一政策所带来的福利收益。我们开发了一种方法，可以在具有特质不确定性和不完全市场的标准一般均衡模型中回答这个问题。我们发现，一般均衡因素非常重要，并且大大降低了福利收益。一旦考虑到这些效应，我们的基准校准显示，福利收益相对较小。这些结果并不意味着社会保险设计的动态方面不重要，但它们确实表明，资本征税可能只能发挥较小的作用。

abstract.text: We construct a marriage market model of matching along multiple dimensions, some of which are unobservable, in which individual preferences can be summarized by a one-dimensional index combining the various characteristics. We show that, under testable assumptions, these indices are ordinally identified and that the male and female trade-offs between their partners' characteristics are overidentified. Using PSID data on married couples, we recover the marginal rates of substitution between body mass index (BMI) and wages or education: men may compensate 1.3 additional units of BMI with a 1 percent increase in wages, whereas women may compensate two BMI units with 1 year of education.

10.1086/667941.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个多维匹配的市场模型，其中一些维度是不可观测的，个人偏好可以通过一个一维指标来概括，该指标结合了各种特征。我们证明，在可检验的假设下，这些指标是序贯识别的，并且男性和女性在伴侣特征之间的权衡是过度识别的。利用已婚夫妇的PSID数据，我们得出了身体质量指数与工资或教育程度之间的替代率：男性可能用1%的工资增长来补偿额外的1.3个身体质量指数单位，而女性则可能用1年的教育来补偿2个身体质量指数单位。

abstract.text: We argue that active management's popularity is not puzzling despite the industry's poor track record. Our explanation features decreasing returns to scale: As the industry's size increases, every manager's ability to outperform passive benchmarks declines. The poor track record occurred before the growth of indexing modestly reduced the share of active management to its current size. At this size, better performance is expected by investors who believe in decreasing returns to scale. Such beliefs persist because persistence in industry size causes learning about returns to scale to be slow. The industry should shrink only moderately if its underperformance continues.

10.1086/667987.abstractZh: 我们认为，尽管该行业的业绩表现不佳，主动管理策略仍然受到欢迎。我们的解释基于规模报酬递减的原理：随着行业规模的增加，每个管理者超越被动基准的能力会下降。这些业绩不佳的情况发生在指数化投资的发展使得主动管理策略的份额下降到当前水平之前。在目前的规模下，相信规模报酬递减的投资者会期待更好的表现。这种信念之所以持续存在，是因为行业规模的持续变化导致关于规模报酬的知识积累变得缓慢。如果该行业的表现持续不佳，那么其规模应该只会适度缩小。

abstract.text: We develop a competitive equilibrium theory of a market for votes. Before voting on a binary issue, individuals may buy and sell their votes with each other. We define the concept of ex ante vote-trading equilibrium and show by construction that an equilibrium exists. The equilibrium we characterize always results in dictatorship if there is any trade, and the market for votes generates welfare losses, relative to simple majority voting, if the committee is large enough or the distribution of values is not very skewed. We test the theoretical implications in the laboratory using a continuous open-book multiunit double auction.

10.1086/667988.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种关于投票市场的竞争均衡理论。在投票决定一个二元问题时，个体可以相互买卖自己的投票权。我们定义了“事前投票交易均衡”的概念，并通过构造证明这种均衡是存在的。我们所描述的均衡在任何交易情况下都会导致独裁统治，而且如果委员会规模较大或价值分布不是非常偏斜，投票市场会导致相对于简单多数投票的福利损失。我们在实验室中使用连续开放式多单位双边拍卖来测试这一理论在实践中的适用性。

abstract.text: Measures of real consumption based on the ownership of durable goods, the quality of housing, the health and mortality of children, the education of youths, and the allocation of female time in the household indicate that sub-Saharan living standards have, for the past two decades, been growing about 3.4-3.7 percent per year, that is, three and a half to four times the rate indicated in international data sets.

10.1086/668501.abstractZh: 基于耐用商品的所有权、住房质量、儿童的健康与死亡率、青少年的教育水平以及女性在家庭中的时间分配等指标所衡量的人均消费水平显示，过去二十年里，撒哈拉以南非洲地区的生活水平年均增长3.4%至3.7%，这一增长率是国际数据体系中所示增长率的三到四倍。

abstract.text: We empirically study the impact of interim rank on risk taking and performance using data on professionals competing in tournaments for large rewards. As we observe both the intended action and the performance of each participant, we can measure risk taking and performance separately. We present two key findings. First, risk taking exhibits an inverted-U relationship with interim rank. Revealing information on relative performance induces individuals trailing just behind the interim leaders to take greater risks. Second, competitors systematically underperform when ranked closer to the top, despite higher incentives to perform well. Disclosing information on relative ranking hinders interim leaders.

10.1086/668502.abstractZh: 我们通过研究参加大型比赛以获得丰厚奖励的专业人士的数据，实证分析了中期排名对风险承担和表现的影响。由于我们能够同时观察到每个参与者的意图和表现，因此可以将风险承担和表现分开进行衡量。我们得到了两个关键发现：首先，风险承担与中期排名呈现倒U型关系。了解相对表现的信息会促使紧随领先者之后的参与者承担更大的风险。其次，尽管有更高的表现激励，但当排名接近顶尖者时，竞争者通常会表现不佳。公开相对排名的信息会阻碍领先者的表现。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic theory of managerial turnover in a world in which the quality of the match between a firm and its managers changes stochastically over time. Shocks to managerial productivity are anticipated at the time of contracting but privately observed by the managers. Our key positive result shows that the firm's optimal retention decisions become more permissive with time. Our key normative result shows that, compared to what is efficient, the firm's contract induces either excessive retention at all tenure levels or excessive firing at the early stages of the relationship, followed by excessive retention after sufficiently long tenure.

10.1086/668836.abstractZh: 我们发展了一个动态理论，研究在一种情况下管理者的流动问题，即企业与其管理者之间的匹配质量会随时间随机变化。管理者在离职时已经预见到生产力方面的冲击，但这些冲击是管理者私下观察到的。我们的主要实证结果表明，随着时间的推移，企业的最佳保留决策会变得更加宽松。我们的主要规范性结果表明，与效率最高的情况相比，企业的合同安排要么导致所有职位的员工都被过度保留，要么导致关系初期出现过度解雇，而在足够长的任期之后又会出现过度保留。

abstract.text: The optimality of tax smoothing is reexamined using frictional labor markets. In a calibrated matching model that generates empirically relevant labor market fluctuations conditional on exogenous fiscal policy, the Ramsey-optimal policy calls for extreme labor tax rate volatility. Purposeful tax volatility induces dramatically smaller, but efficient, fluctuations of labor markets by keeping distortions constant over the business cycle. We relate the results to standard Ramsey theory by developing welfare-relevant concepts of efficiency and distortions based on primitive matching frictions. Although the basic Ramsey principles of "wedge smoothing" and zero intertemporal distortions hold, tax smoothing depends on whether wages are set efficiently.

10.1086/668837.abstractZh: 本文重新探讨了税收平滑的最优性，采用摩擦性劳动力市场作为研究背景。在一个经过校准的匹配模型中，该模型在外部财政政策条件下产生具有实证意义的劳动力市场波动。根据拉姆齐最优政策，劳动力税收率的极端波动是必要的。有目的的税收波动通过保持经济周期中的扭曲不变，使得劳动力市场的波动幅度显著减小，但效率更高。我们通过基于原始匹配摩擦的概念，将研究结果与标准拉姆齐理论联系起来。尽管基本的拉姆齐原则——即“楔形平滑”和零时间扭曲——仍然成立，但税收平滑的效果取决于工资是否得到了有效的设定。

abstract.text: We study a Condorcet jury model where voters are driven by instrumental and expressive motives. We show that arbitrarily small amounts of expressive motives significantly affect equilibrium behavior and the optimal size of voting bodies. Enlarging voting bodies always reduces accuracy over some region. Unless conflict between expressive and instrumental preferences is very low, information does not aggregate in the limit, and large voting bodies perform no better than a coin flip in selecting the correct outcome. Thus, even when adding informed voters is costless, smaller voting bodies often produce better decisions.

10.1086/668838.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个康德赛特陪审团模型，其中选民受到工具性和表达性动机的驱动。我们表明，任意小的表达性动机都会显著影响均衡行为和投票机构的最佳规模。扩大投票机构总是会在某个范围内降低决策的准确性。除非表达性和工具性偏好之间的冲突非常低，否则信息在极限情况下不会聚集，而大型投票机构在选择正确结果方面并不比抛硬币更优。因此，即使增加知情选民的成本为零，较小的投票机构往往也能做出更好的决策。

abstract.text: This paper considers a simple model of credit cycles driven by moral hazard in financial intermediation. Financial agents or bankers must earn moral-hazard rents, but the cost of these rents can be efficiently spread over an agent's entire career by promising large late-career rewards if the agent has a consistently successful record. Dynamic interactions among different generations of financial agents can create credit cycles with repeated booms and recessions. In recessions, a scarcity of trusted financial intermediaries limits investment and reduces employment. Under such conditions, taxing workers to subsidize bankers may increase employment enough to make the workers better off.

10.1086/668839.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一个由金融中介中的道德风险驱动的信贷周期的简单模型。金融中介或银行家必须赚取道德风险租金，但这些租金的成本可以通过承诺在代理人整个职业生涯中提供丰厚的后期回报来有效分摊。不同代际的金融中介之间的动态互动可以引发反复出现的信贷周期，包括繁荣与衰退。在衰退时期，可信金融中介的稀缺会限制投资并减少就业。在这种情况下，对工人征税以补贴银行家可能会增加就业，从而使工人的状况得到改善。

abstract.text: We study an over-the-counter (OTC) market in which the usefulness of assets as a means of payment or collateral is limited by the threat of fraudulent practices. Agents can produce fraudulent assets at a positive cost, which generates upper bounds on the quantity of each asset that can be traded in the OTC market. Each of these endogenous, asset-specific, resalability constraints depends on the cost of fraud, on the frequency of trade, and on the asset price. In equilibrium, assets are partitioned into three liquidity tiers, which differ in their resalability, prices, haircuts, sensitivity to shocks, and responses to policies.

10.1086/668864.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个场外交易市场，在该市场中，资产作为支付或抵押手段的实用性受到欺诈行为的威胁而受到限制。交易方可以以一定的正成本制造出欺诈性资产，这决定了场外市场中每种资产可交易的量有上限。这些内生性的、特定于资产的再销售限制取决于欺诈成本、交易频率以及资产价格。在均衡状态下，资产被划分为三个流动性等级，这些等级在再销售能力、价格、折扣率、对冲击的敏感性以及对政策的反应方面存在差异。

abstract.text: A new model of persuasion is presented. A listener first announces and commits to a codex (i.e., a set of conditions). The speaker then presents a (not necessarily true) profile that must satisfy the codex in order for the listener to be persuaded. The speaker is boundedly rational in the sense that his ability to come up with a persuasive profile is limited and depends on the true profile and the content and framing of the codex. The circumstances under which the listener can design a codex that will implement his goal are fully characterized.

10.1086/669160.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的说服模型。首先，听众宣布并承诺遵循一套条件。随后，演讲者提出一个（不一定真实的）个人资料，该资料必须满足这些条件，才能说服听众。演讲者的理性是有限的，因为他提出有说服力的个人资料的能力是受限制的，这取决于真实的个人资料以及条件的内容和表述方式。文中详细描述了听众能够设计出实现其目标的条件的各种情况。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a new mechanism by which country size and international trade affect macroeconomic volatility. We study a model with heterogeneous firms that are subject to idiosyncratic firm-specific shocks, calibrated to data for the 50 largest economies in the world. When the firm size distribution follows a power law with an exponent close to minus one, idiosyncratic shocks to large firms have an impact on aggregate volatility. Smaller countries have fewer firms and, thus, higher volatility. Trade opening makes the large firms more important, thus raising macroeconomic volatility. Trade can increase aggregate volatility by 15-20 percent in some small open economies.

10.1086/669161.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的机制，通过这种机制，国家规模与国际贸易会影响宏观经济波动性。我们研究了一个包含异质企业的模型，这些企业受到特定企业 shocks 的影响，该模型是根据全球50个最大经济体的数据进行校准的。当企业规模分布遵循幂律分布，且指数接近负一时，对大型企业的特定冲击会对总体波动性产生影响。较小的国家拥有较少的企业，因此波动性更高。贸易开放使得大型企业变得更加重要，从而提升了宏观经济波动性。在一些小型开放经济体中，贸易可能会使总体波动性增加15-20%。

abstract.text: We conduct a field experiment to measure cooperation among groups of recreational fishermen at a privately owned fishing facility. Group earnings are greater when group members catch fewer fish. Consistent with classical economic theory, though in contrast to prior results from laboratory experiments, we find no cooperation. A series of additional treatments identifies causes of the difference. We rule out the subject pool and the laboratory setting as potential causes and identify the type of activity involved as the source of the lack of cooperation in our field experiment. When cooperation requires reducing fishing effort, individuals are not cooperative.

10.1086/669253.abstractZh: 我们进行了一项实地实验，以测量私人拥有的渔业设施中休闲渔民群体之间的合作情况。当群体成员捕获的鱼类数量较少时，群体的收益更高。尽管与经典经济理论一致，但与实验室实验的先前结果不同，我们发现并没有合作现象。一系列额外的处理因素有助于确定这种差异的原因。我们排除了受试者群体和实验室环境作为潜在原因，并确定所涉及的活動类型是我们实地实验中缺乏合作的原因。当合作需要减少捕鱼努力时，个体并不会表现出合作行为。

abstract.text: Sellers of perishable goods increasingly use dynamic pricing strategies as technology makes it easier to change prices and track inventory. This paper tests how accurately theoretical models of dynamic pricing describe sellers' behavior in secondary markets for event tickets, a classic example of a perishable good. It shows that the simplest dynamic pricing models describe very accurately both the pricing problem faced by sellers and how they behave, explaining why sellers cut prices dramatically, by 40 percent or more, as an event approaches. The estimates also imply that dynamic pricing is valuable, raising the average seller's expected payoff by around 16 percent.

10.1086/669254.abstractZh: 随着技术使得价格调整和库存跟踪变得更加容易，易腐商品的销售商越来越多地采用动态定价策略。本文测试了理论上的动态定价模型在描述易腐商品——活动门票的二级市场销售商行为时的准确性。研究表明，最简单的动态定价模型能够非常准确地描述销售商面临的定价问题以及他们的行为方式，解释了为什么在活动临近时，销售商会大幅降价，幅度可达40%或更多。这些估计还表明，动态定价具有价值，能够使平均销售商的预期收益增加约16%。

abstract.text: Most new consumer durable goods experience rapid prices declines and quality improvements, suggesting the importance of modeling dynamics. This paper specifies a dynamic model of consumer preferences for new durable goods with persistently heterogeneous consumer tastes, rational expectations, and repeat purchases over time. We estimate the model on the digital camcorder industry using panel data on prices, sales, and characteristics. We find that the 1-year elasticity in response to a transitory industrywide price shock is about 25 percent less than the 1-month elasticity. Standard cost-of-living indices overstate welfare gain in later periods due to a changing composition of buyers.

10.1086/669540.abstractZh: 大多数新的耐用消费品在价格下降和质量提升方面都表现出快速的变化，这表明对动态变化的建模非常重要。本文提出了一个动态模型，用于描述具有持续异质消费者偏好、理性预期以及随时间重复购买的新型耐用消费品消费者偏好。我们采用关于价格、销售和特征的面板数据，对数字摄像机行业进行了模型估计。研究发现，面对行业整体价格冲击时，1年内的弹性比1个月内的弹性低约25%。由于买家构成的不断变化，标准的生活成本指数高估了后期福利的改善。

abstract.text: Despite their importance, there is limited evidence on how institutions can be strengthened. Evaluating the effects of specific reforms is complicated by the lack of exogenous variation in institutions, the difficulty of measuring institutional performance, and the temptation to “cherry pick” estimates from among the large number of indicators required to capture this multifaceted subject. We evaluate one attempt to make local institutions more democratic and egalitarian by imposing participation requirements for marginalized groups (including women) and test for learning-by-doing effects. We exploit the random assignment of a governance program in Sierra Leone, develop innovative real-world outcome measures, and use a preanalysis plan (PAP) to bind our hands against data mining. The intervention studied is a “community-driven development” program, which has become a popular strategy for foreign aid donors. We find positive short-run effects on local public goods and economic outcomes, but no evidence for sustained impacts on collective action, decision making, or the involvement of marginalized groups, suggesting that the intervention did not durably reshape local institutions. We discuss the practical trade-offs faced in implementing a PAP and show how in its absence we could have generated two divergent, equally erroneous interpretations of program impacts on institutions.

10.1093/qje/qje027.abstractZh: 尽管制度的重要性不言而喻，但关于如何加强制度的证据却十分有限。评估特定改革的效果因制度缺乏外部变量、衡量制度绩效的困难以及从众多指标中“选择性”提取数据而变得复杂。我们研究了通过为边缘群体（包括女性）实施参与要求来提升当地制度民主性和平等性的尝试，并检验了“实践学习”效应。我们利用塞拉利昂一项治理计划的随机分配数据，开发了创新的现实世界结果衡量方法，并采用预分析计划来防止数据被数据挖掘。所研究的干预措施是一种“社区驱动的发展”计划，这一策略已成为外国援助机构的常用手段。我们发现，该计划在短期内对当地公共物品和经济成果产生了积极影响，但并未发现对集体行动、决策或边缘群体参与产生持续影响的证据，这表明该干预措施并未真正重塑当地制度。我们讨论了实施预分析计划所面临的实际权衡，并展示了在没有该计划的情况下，我们可能会得出两种截然不同的、同样错误的关于该计划对制度影响的解释。

abstract.text: We argue that social capital as proxied by trust increases aggregate productivity by affecting the organization of firms. To do this we collect new data on the decentralization of investment, hiring, production, and sales decisions from corporate headquarters to local plant managers in almost 4,000 firms in the United States, Europe, and Asia. We find that firms headquartered in high-trust regions are significantly more likely to decentralize. To help identify causal effects, we look within multinational firms and show that higher levels of bilateral trust between the multinational’s country of origin and subsidiary’s country of location increases decentralization, even after instrumenting trust using religious similarities between the countries. Finally, we show evidence suggesting that trust raises aggregate productivity by facilitating reallocation between firms and allowing more efficient firms to grow, as CEOs can decentralize more decisions.

10.1093/qje/qje029.abstractZh: 我们认为，通过信任来衡量的社会资本能够通过影响企业的组织方式来提高整体生产力。为此，我们收集了来自美国、欧洲和亚洲近4000家企业的新数据，这些数据涉及投资、招聘、生产和销售决策从企业总部向当地工厂管理者层面的分散程度。研究发现，总部位于信任度较高的地区的企业更有可能实现决策分散。为了进一步确认因果效应，我们研究了跨国企业内部的情况，发现跨国企业所在国家与其子公司所在国家之间的双边信任水平越高，决策分散程度也越高，即使在使用国家间的宗教相似性作为信任指标的情况下也是如此。最后，我们发现了一些证据，表明信任能够通过促进企业之间的资源重新分配，使效率更高的企业得以成长，从而提升整体生产力，因为首席执行官可以更多地下放决策权。

abstract.text: We develop a dynamic theory of resource wars and study the conditions under which such wars can be prevented. Our focus is on the interaction between the scarcity of resources and the incentives for war in the presence of limited commitment. We show that a key parameter determining the incentives for war is the elasticity of demand. Our first result identifies a novel externality that can precipitate war: price-taking firms fail to internalize the impact of their extraction on military action. In the case of inelastic resource demand, war incentives increase over time and war may become inevitable. Our second result shows that in some situations, regulation of prices and quantities by the resource-rich country can prevent war, and when this is the case, there will also be slower resource extraction than the Hotelling benchmark (with inelastic demand). Our third result is that because of limited commitment and its implications for armament incentives, regulation of prices and quantities might actually precipitate war even in some circumstances where wars would not have arisen under competitive markets.

10.1093/qje/qjr048.abstractZh: 我们发展了一种动态资源战争理论，并研究了能够预防此类战争的条件。我们的重点在于资源稀缺性与有限承诺下战争激励之间的相互作用。我们发现，决定战争激励的一个关键参数是需求的弹性。我们的第一个结果表明，存在一种可能引发战争的新外部性：接受价格的企业未能将自身开采行为对军事行动的影响内部化。在资源需求缺乏弹性的情况下，战争激励会随时间增加，战争可能变得不可避免。我们的第二个结果表明，在某些情况下，资源丰富的国家通过调控价格和数量可以防止战争；在这种情况下，资源开采的速度也会低于Hotelling基准值（在需求缺乏弹性的情况下）。我们的第三个结果表明，由于有限承诺对武器获取的激励作用，即使在竞争市场下不会引发战争的情况下，调控价格和数量实际上也可能引发战争。

abstract.text: Every year, 90% of Americans give money to charities. Is such generosity necessarily welfare enhancing for the giver? We present a theoretical framework that distinguishes two types of motivation: individuals like to give, for example, due to altruism or warm glow, and individuals would rather not give but dislike saying no, for example, due to social pressure. We design a door-to-door fund-raiser in which some households are informed about the exact time of solicitation with a flyer on their doorknobs. Thus, they can seek or avoid the fund-raiser. We find that the flyer reduces the share of households opening the door by 9% to 25% and, if the flyer allows checking a Do Not Disturb box, reduces giving by 28% to 42%. The latter decrease is concentrated among donations smaller than $10. These findings suggest that social pressure is an important determinant of door-to-door giving. Combining data from this and a complementary field experiment, we structurally estimate the model. The estimated social pressure cost of saying no to a solicitor is $3.80 for an in-state charity and $1.40 for an out-of-state charity. Our welfare calculations suggest that our door-to-door fund-raising campaigns on average lower the utility of the potential donors.

10.1093/qje/qjr050.abstractZh: 每年，90%的美国人会向慈善机构捐款。这种慷慨行为是否一定对捐赠者有益呢？我们提出了一个理论框架，区分了两种动机：一种是出于利他主义或愉悦感而愿意捐款；另一种则是由于社会压力而不愿捐款，但又不愿意拒绝请求。我们设计了一种挨家挨户募捐的方式，其中一些家庭会在门把手上收到一张传单，告知募捐的具体时间。这样，他们就可以选择是否参与募捐。研究发现，传单使得9%到25%的家庭选择不打开门，如果传单还设有“请勿打扰”选项，则捐款比例会降低28%到42%。后一种减少主要出现在捐款金额低于10美元的情况下。这些发现表明，社会压力是挨家挨户募捐的重要影响因素。结合这一实验以及另一项补充性实验的数据，我们对模型进行了结构性估计。估计结果显示，对于本地慈善机构，拒绝募捐的社会成本约为3.80美元；对于外地慈善机构，这一成本则降至1.40美元。我们的福利计算表明，这种挨家挨户募捐的方式平均会降低潜在捐赠者的效用。

abstract.text: This article establishes six stylized facts about firms' export prices using detailed customs data on the universe of Chinese trade flows. First, across firms selling a given product, exporters that charge higher prices earn greater revenues in each destination, have bigger worldwide sales, and enter more markets. Second, firms that export more, enter more markets, and charge higher export prices import more expensive inputs. Third, across destinations within a firm-product, firms set higher prices in richer, larger, bilaterally more distant and overall less remote countries. Fourth, across destinations within a firm-product, firms earn bigger revenues in markets where they set higher prices. Fifth, across firms within a product, exporters with more destinations offer a wider range of export prices. Finally, firms that export more, enter more markets, and offer a wider range of export prices pay a wider range of input prices and source inputs from more origin countries. We propose that trade models should incorporate two features to rationalize these patterns in the data: more successful exporters use higher quality inputs to produce higher quality goods (stylized facts 1 and 2), and firms vary the quality of their products across destinations by using inputs of different quality levels (stylized facts 3, 4, 5, and 6).

10.1093/qje/qjr051.abstractZh: 本文利用详细的中国贸易流海关数据，确立了关于企业出口价格的六个典型事实。首先，对于销售同一产品的企业而言，收取更高价格的出口商在每一个目的地都能获得更高的收入，其全球销售额更大，进入的市场也更多。其次，出口更多的企业会进入更多的市场，并收取更高的出口价格，这意味着它们会进口更昂贵的投入品。第三，在同一产品类别内，企业在较富裕、规模较大、双边距离较远且整体距离较远的国家的出口价格更高。第四，在同一产品类别内，企业在价格较高的市场能获得更高的收入。第五，在同一产品类别内的企业，拥有更多出口目的地的企业能提供更广泛的出口价格。最后，出口更多的企业会进入更多的市场，并提供更广泛的出口价格，这意味着它们会支付更不同的投入品价格，并从更多的原产国获取投入品。我们提出，贸易模型应包含两个特征来解释这些数据中的这些模式：更成功的出口商会使用更高质量的投入品来生产更高质量的产品（典型事实1和2），而企业则通过使用不同质量的投入品来在不同目的地调整产品的质量（典型事实3、4、5和6）。

abstract.text: This article analyzes the response of earnings to payroll tax rates using a cohort-based reform in Greece. Individuals who started working on or after 1993 face permanently a much higher earnings cap for payroll taxes, creating a large and permanent discontinuity in marginal payroll tax rates by date of entry in the labor force for upper earnings workers. Using full-population administrative social security data and a regression discontinuity design, we estimate the long-term labor supply effects and incidence of payroll tax rates on earnings. Standard theory predicts that in the long run, new regime workers should bear the entire burden of the payroll tax increase (relative to old regime workers). In contrast, we find that employers compensate new regime workers for the extra employer payroll taxes but not for the extra employee payroll taxes. We do not find any evidence of labor supply responses along the extensive or intensive margins around the discontinuity, suggesting low efficiency costs of payroll taxes. We discuss various possible explanations for those results.

10.1093/qje/qjr052.abstractZh: 本文通过分析希腊一项基于队列的改革对工资税率的响应，研究了收入对工资税率的反应。1993年及之后开始工作的个体，其工资税的最高收入上限将永久性地提高，这导致高收入工人的边际工资税率在进入劳动力市场的日期上出现了显著且永久性的差异。利用全人口行政社会保障数据以及回归不连续设计，我们估计了工资税率对劳动力供给的长期影响及收入变化。标准理论预测，从长期来看，新制度下的工人应承担全部工资税增加的负担（相对于旧制度下的工人）。然而，我们发现雇主会为新制度下的工人承担额外的雇主工资税，但不会承担额外的雇员工资税。我们没有发现围绕这一不连续点的劳动力供给反应，这表明工资税的效率成本较低。我们讨论了这些结果的各种可能解释。

abstract.text: This article studies market competition when firms can influence consumers' ability to compare market alternatives through their choice of price “formats.” In our model, the ability of a consumer to make a comparison depends on the firms' format choices. Our main results concern the interaction between firms' equilibrium price and format decisions and its implications for industry profits and consumer switching rates. In particular, market forces drive down the firms' profits to a “constrained competitive” benchmark if and only if the comparability structure satisfies a property that we interpret as a form of “frame neutrality.” The same property is necessary for equilibrium behavior to display statistical independence between price and format decisions. We also show that narrow regulatory interventions that aim to facilitate comparisons may have an anticompetitive effect.

10.1093/qje/qjr053.abstractZh: 本文研究了在企业可以通过选择价格“形式”来影响消费者比较市场替代品的能力时的市场竞争情况。在我们的模型中，消费者进行比较的能力取决于企业的价格形式选择。我们的主要研究结果涉及企业均衡价格与形式决策之间的相互作用，以及这对行业利润和消费者转换率的影响。具体而言，市场力量会将企业的利润降低到“受限竞争”的基准水平，当且仅当可比性结构满足我们将其解释为“框架中立性”的一种属性时。同样，这种属性也是均衡行为在价格与形式决策之间表现出统计独立性所必需的。我们还指出，旨在促进比较的狭隘监管干预可能会产生反竞争效应。

abstract.text: This article develops a model that speaks to the goals and methods of financial stability policies. There are three main points. First, from a normative perspective, the model defines the fundamental market failure to be addressed, namely, that unregulated private money creation can lead to an externality in which intermediaries issue too much short-term debt and leave the system excessively vulnerable to costly financial crises. Second, it shows how in a simple economy where commercial banks are the only lenders, conventional monetary policy tools such as open-market operations can be used to regulate this externality, whereas in more advanced economies it may be helpful to supplement monetary policy with other measures. Third, from a positive perspective, the model provides an account of how monetary policy can influence bank lending and real activity, even in a world where prices adjust frictionlessly and there are other transactions media besides bank-created money that are outside the control of the central bank.

10.1093/qje/qjr054.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，旨在探讨金融稳定政策的目标和方法。主要包含三个要点：首先，从规范性的角度来看，该模型指出了需要解决的基本市场失灵问题，即不受监管的私人货币创造可能导致外部性，即中介机构过度发行短期债务，使系统极易受到昂贵的金融危机的影响。其次，在仅由商业银行提供信贷的简单经济体系中，传统的货币政策工具如公开市场操作可以用来调节这种外部性；而在更发达的经济体系中，可能需要结合其他措施来补充货币政策的作用。最后，从积极的角度来看，该模型阐述了货币政策如何影响银行信贷和实体经济活动，即使在一个价格能够无缝调整、且除了中央银行控制的货币之外还有其他交易媒介的世界中也是如此。

abstract.text: Consumers need information to compare alternatives for markets to function efficiently. Recognizing this, public policies often pair competition with easy access to comparative information. The implicit assumption is that comparison friction—the wedge between the availability of comparative information and consumers' use of it—is inconsequential because when information is readily available, consumers will access this information and make effective choices. We examine the extent of comparison friction in the market for Medicare Part D prescription drug plans in the United States. In a randomized field experiment, an intervention group received a letter with personalized cost information. That information was readily available for free and widely advertised. However, this additional step—providing the information rather than having consumers actively access it—had an impact. Plan switching was 28% in the intervention group, versus 17% in the comparison group, and the intervention caused an average decline in predicted consumer cost of about $100 a year among letter recipients—roughly 5% of the cost in the comparison group. Our results suggest that comparison friction can be large even when the cost of acquiring information is small and may be relevant for a wide range of public policies that incorporate consumer choice.

10.1093/qje/qjr055.abstractZh: 消费者需要信息来比较不同的选择，以使市场能够高效运作。鉴于此，公共政策通常将竞争与便捷的比较信息获取相结合。隐含的假设是，比较摩擦——即比较信息可用性与消费者使用信息之间的障碍——并不重要，因为当信息容易获取时，消费者会利用这些信息做出有效的选择。我们研究了美国Medicare Part D处方药计划市场中的比较摩擦程度。在一项随机实地实验中，干预组收到了包含个性化成本信息的信件。这些信息可以免费获取，并且被广泛宣传。然而，这一额外的步骤——提供信息而不是让消费者主动获取信息——确实产生了影响。干预组的计划转换率为28%，而对照组为17%，且干预措施使信件接收者的预计年度成本平均降低了约100美元——这大约相当于对照组成本的5%。我们的结果表明，即使获取信息的成本很低，比较摩擦仍然可能很大，并且对于涉及消费者选择的广泛公共政策来说可能是重要的。

abstract.text: This paper explores the consequences of improving property rights to facilitate the use of fixed assets as collateral, popularly attributed to the influential policy advocate Hernando de Soto. We use an equilibrium model of a credit market with moral hazard to characterize the theoretical effects and also develop a quantitative analysis using data from Sri Lanka. We show that the effects are likely to be nonlinear and heterogeneous by wealth group. They also depend on the extent of competition between lenders. There can be significant increases in profits and reductions in interest rates when credit markets are competitive. However, since these are due to reductions in moral hazard, that is, increased effort, the welfare gains tend to be modest when cost of effort is taken into account. Allowing for an extensive margin where borrowers gain access to the credit market can make these effects larger depending on the underlying wealth distribution.

10.1093/qje/qjr056.abstractZh: 本文探讨了改善产权以促进固定资产作为抵押品使用的后果，这一观点通常归功于有影响力的政策倡导者赫尔南多·德索托。我们采用一个包含道德风险问题的信贷市场均衡模型来描述这些理论效应，并基于斯里兰卡的数据进行了定量分析。研究表明，这些效应可能因财富群体的不同而呈现非线性和异质性。此外，它们还取决于贷款者之间的竞争程度。在信贷市场具有竞争性的情况下，利润可能会显著增加，利率也可能下降。然而，由于这些效应是由于道德风险减少，即增加了努力程度，因此当考虑到努力成本时，福利收益往往较为有限。如果允许借款人拥有广泛的信贷市场准入权，这些效应可能会因基础财富分布的不同而更大。

abstract.text: This article analyzes the heterogeneous reaction of exporters to real exchange rate changes using a very rich French firm-level data set with destination-specific export values and volumes on the period 1995–2005. We find that high–performance firms react to a depreciation by increasing significantly more their markup and by increasing less their export volume. This heterogeneity in pricing-to-market is robust to different measures of performance, samples, and econometric specifications. It is consistent with models where the demand elasticity decreases with firm performance. Since aggregate exports are concentrated on high-productivity firms, precisely those that absorb more exchange rate movements in their markups, heterogeneous pricing-to-market may partly explain the weak impact of exchange rate movements on aggregate exports.

10.1093/qje/qjr057.abstractZh: 本文利用1995至2005年间丰富的法国企业级数据，分析了出口企业对实际汇率变化的异质性反应。研究发现，表现优异的企业在汇率贬值时，不仅提高了销售价格，同时减少了出口量。这种价格与市场的异质性现象在不同绩效指标、样本选择和计量经济学模型下依然显著。这一现象与“需求弹性随企业绩效下降”的模型相符。由于整体出口集中在高生产力企业身上，而这些企业更能承受汇率变动对其销售价格的影响，因此价格与市场的异质性反应可能部分解释了汇率变动对整体出口的微弱影响。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of new private-sector unionization on publicly traded firms' equity value in the United States over the 1961–1999 period using a newly assembled sample of National Labor Relations Board (NLRB) representation elections matched to stock market data. Event-study estimates show an average union effect on the equity value of the firm equivalent to $40,500 per unionized worker, an effect that takes 15 to 18 months after unionization to fully materialize, and one that could not be detected by a short-run event study. At the same time, point estimates from a regression discontinuity design—comparing the stock market impact of close union election wins to close losses—are considerably smaller and close to zero. We find a negative relationship between the cumulative abnormal returns and the vote share in support of the union, allowing us to reconcile these seemingly contradictory findings.

10.1093/qje/qjr058.abstractZh: 我们利用新整理的样本数据，对1961年至1999年间美国上市公司因私营部门工会化而带来的股权价值变化进行了分析。通过匹配股票市场数据，我们发现工会化对上市公司股权价值的平均影响为每位工会化员工约40,500美元。这种影响在工会化后需要15至18个月才能完全显现，且无法通过短期事件研究来检测。同时，通过回归不连续设计得出的点估计值表明，工会选举胜利与失败对股票市场的冲击差异不大，甚至接近于零。我们发现，累积的异常回报与支持工会的投票份额之间存在负相关关系，这使我们能够解释这些看似矛盾的现象。

abstract.text: This article incorporates a time-varying severity of disasters into the hypothesis proposed by Rietz (1988) and Barro (2006) that risk premia result from the possibility of rare large disasters. During a disaster an asset's fundamental value falls by a time-varying amount. This in turn generates time-varying risk premia and, thus, volatile asset prices and return predictability. Using the recent technique of linearity-generating processes, the model is tractable and all prices are exactly solved in closed form. In this article's framework, the following empirical regularities can be understood quantitatively: (i) equity premium puzzle; (ii) risk-free rate puzzle; (iii) excess volatility puzzle; (iv) predictability of aggregate stock market returns with price-dividend ratios; (v) often greater explanatory power of characteristics than covariances for asset returns; (vi) upward-sloping nominal yield curve; (vii) predictability of future bond excess returns and long-term rates via the slope of the yield curve; (viii) corporate bond spread puzzle; (ix) high price of deep out-of-the-money puts; and (x) high put prices being followed by high stock returns. The calibration passes a variance bound test, as normal-times market volatility is consistent with the wide dispersion of disaster outcomes in the historical record. The model extends to a setting with many factors and to Epstein-Zin preferences.

10.1093/qje/qjs001.abstractZh: 本文将灾害的时变严重性纳入Rietz（1988）和Barro（2006）提出的假设中，即风险溢价源于罕见重大灾害的可能性。在灾害发生时，资产的基本价值会随时间变化而下降。这反过来会导致风险溢价的变化，进而使资产价格波动且回报难以预测。利用线性生成过程的最新技术，该模型具有可解性，所有价格都能以封闭形式精确求解。在本文的框架内，可以定量理解以下经验规律：(i) 股权溢价之谜；(ii) 无风险利率之谜；(iii) 过度波动之谜；(iv) 股票市场总回报与股价与股息比率的可预测性；(v) 对于资产回报而言，特征往往比协方差具有更强的解释力；(vi) 名义收益率曲线呈上升趋势；(vii) 通过收益率曲线的斜率可以预测未来债券超额回报和长期利率；(viii) 企业债券利差之谜；(ix) 深度价外看跌期权的高价格；(x) 高看跌期权价格之后往往伴随着高股票回报。该模型的校准通过了方差界限测试，因为正常时期的市场波动性与历史记录中灾害结果的广泛分散性是一致的。该模型还适用于包含多个因素的情况，并适用于Epstein-Zin偏好。

abstract.text: Do labor market opportunities for women affect marriage and fertility decisions? We provided three years of recruiting services to help young women in randomly selected rural Indian villages get jobs in the business process outsourcing industry. Because the industry was so new at the time of the study, there was almost no awareness of these jobs, allowing us in effect to exogenously increase women's labor force opportunities from the perspective of rural households. We find that young women in treatment villages were significantly less likely to get married or have children during this period, choosing instead to enter the labor market or obtain more schooling or postschool training. Women also report wanting to have fewer children and to work more steadily throughout their lifetime, consistent with increased aspirations for a career.

10.1093/qje/qjs002.abstractZh: 女性劳动力市场机会是否会影响她们的婚姻和生育决策？我们提供了三年的招聘服务，帮助印度农村地区的年轻女性在这些随机选择的村庄中找到商业流程外包行业的工作。由于该行业在研究时还处于初期阶段，人们对这些工作的认知几乎为零，这实际上从农村家庭的角度为女性提供了外部性的劳动力机会。研究发现，在这段时间里，接受服务的年轻女性结婚或生育孩子的可能性显著降低，她们更倾向于进入劳动力市场或接受更多的教育或职业培训。女性还表示希望减少子女数量，并希望一生中更稳定地工作，这与她们对职业发展的更高期望是一致的。

abstract.text: We examine urbanization using new data that allow us to track the evolution of population in rural and urban areas in the United States from 1880 to 2000. We find a positive correlation between initial population density and subsequent population growth for intermediate densities, which increases the dispersion of the population density distribution over time. We use theory and empirical evidence to show this pattern of population growth is the result of differences in agriculture's initial share of employment across population densities, combined with structural transformation that shifts employment away from agriculture.

10.1093/qje/qjs003.abstractZh: 我们通过新的数据来研究城市化现象，这些数据使我们能够追踪1880年至2000年间美国农村和城市地区人口的变化。我们发现，对于中等人口密度而言，初始人口密度与随后的人口增长之间存在正相关性，这导致人口密度分布随时间逐渐分散。我们通过理论和实证证据表明，这种人口增长模式是由于不同人口密度下农业在就业中的初始占比存在差异，再加上结构性转型使得就业从农业领域转移出去所导致的。

abstract.text: This article proposes a novel approach to empirically identifying government spending multipliers that relies on two features unique to many low-income countries: (1) borrowing from the World Bank finances a substantial fraction of government spending, and (2) spending on World Bank–financed projects is typically spread out over several years following the original approval of the project. The first fact means that fluctuations in spending on World Bank–financed projects are a significant source of fluctuations in overall government spending in these countries. The second fact means that fluctuations in World Bank–financed spending in a given year are largely determined by fluctuations in project approval decisions made in previous years, and so are unlikely to be correlated with shocks to output in the current year. I use World Bank project-level disbursement data to isolate the component of World Bank–financed government spending in a given year that is associated with past project approval decisions. I use this as an instrument for total government spending to estimate multipliers in a sample of 29 primarily low-income countries where variation in government spending from this source is large relative to the size of the economy. The resulting spending multipliers are small and reasonably precisely estimated to be in the vicinity of 0.5.

10.1093/qje/qjs008.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法，用于实证识别政府支出乘数，该方法依赖于许多低收入国家所独有的两个特征：(1) 从世界银行借款为政府支出的大部分提供资金；(2) 世界银行资助的项目支出通常在项目最初批准后的几年内逐步进行。第一个事实意味着，世界银行资助项目的支出波动是这些国家整体政府支出波动的重要来源。第二个事实意味着，某一年世界银行资助支出的波动主要由前几年做出的项目批准决策所决定，因此不太可能与当年经济产出中的冲击相关。我使用世界银行项目层面的支出数据，来分离出某一年与过去项目批准决策相关的世界银行资助政府支出的部分。我利用这一数据作为总政府支出的工具，在29个主要低收入国家的样本中估计乘数，这些国家的政府支出中，来自这一来源的部分相对于经济规模而言变化较大。得出的支出乘数较小，且估计值较为精确，大约在0.5左右。

abstract.text: Why are episodes of sovereign default accompanied by deep recessions? The existing literature cannot answer this question. On one hand, sovereign default models treat income fluctuations as an exogenous endowment process with ad hoc default costs. On the other hand, emerging markets business cycle models abstract from modeling default and treat default risk as part of an exogenous interest rate on working capital. We propose instead a general equilibrium model of both sovereign default and business cycles. In the model, some imported inputs require working capital financing, and default triggers an efficiency loss as these inputs are replaced by imperfect substitutes, because both firms and the government are excluded from credit markets. Default is an optimal decision of a benevolent planner for whom, even after internalizing the adverse effects of default on economic activity, financial autarky has a higher payoff than debt repayment. The model explains the main features of observed cyclical dynamics around defaults, countercyclical spreads, high debt ratios, and key long-run business cycle moments.

10.1093/qje/qjs009.abstractZh: 为什么主权违约事件往往伴随着严重的经济衰退？现有文献无法回答这个问题。一方面，主权违约模型将收入波动视为一种外生 endowment 过程，并假设违约成本是临时设定的。另一方面，新兴市场的商业周期模型在建模时忽略了违约问题，将违约风险视为一种外生性的营运资金利率。我们提出了一个同时考虑主权违约和商业周期的一般均衡模型。在该模型中，某些进口投入需要营运资金来融资，而违约会导致效率损失，因为这些投入被不完美的替代品所取代，因为企业和政府都被排除在信贷市场之外。违约对于一个仁慈的规划者来说是一个最优决策，即使在内化了违约对经济活动的不利影响之后，金融自给自足所带来的收益仍然高于债务偿还。该模型解释了围绕违约的周期性动态、逆周期利差、高债务比率以及长期商业周期的关键特征。

abstract.text: One goal of extending the duration of unemployment insurance (UI) in recessions is to increase UI coverage in the face of longer unemployment spells. Although it is a common concern that such extensions may themselves raise nonemployment durations, it is not known how recessions would affect the magnitude of this moral hazard. To obtain causal estimates of the differential effects of UI in booms and recessions, this article exploits the fact that in Germany, potential UI benefit duration is a function of exact age which is itself invariant over the business cycle. We implement a regression discontinuity design separately for 20 years and correlate our estimates with measures of the business cycle. We find that the nonemployment effects of a month of additional UI benefits are, at best, somewhat declining in recessions. Yet the UI exhaustion rate, and therefore the additional coverage provided by UI extensions, rises substantially during a downturn. The ratio of these two effects represents the nonemployment response of workers weighted by the probability of being affected by UI extensions. Hence, our results imply that the effective moral hazard effect of UI extensions is significantly lower in recessions than in booms. Using a model of job search with liquidity constraints, we also find that in the absence of market-wide effects, the net social benefits from UI extensions can be expressed either directly in terms of the exhaustion rate and the nonemployment effect of UI durations, or as a declining function of our measure of effective moral hazard.

10.1093/qje/qjs010.abstractZh: 延长失业救济金发放期限的一个目标是在失业时间延长的情况下，增加失业救济金的覆盖范围。尽管人们普遍担心这种延长措施本身可能会增加非就业时间，但尚不清楚经济衰退会对这种道德风险的影响程度产生何种影响。为了获得关于经济繁荣与衰退期间失业救济金差异影响的因果估计，本文利用了德国的一个事实：潜在的失业救济金受益期限与年龄有关，而年龄本身在商业周期中是保持不变的。我们采用了回归不连续设计，分别针对20年数据，并将我们的估计结果与商业周期指标进行了关联分析。研究发现，在衰退期间，额外一个月的失业救济金所带来的非就业影响最多只是有所减少。然而，在经济衰退期间，失业救济金的耗尽率以及由此带来的额外覆盖程度却显著上升。这两种效应的比率代表了受失业救济金延长影响的工人的非就业反应，这一反应与工人受到影响的几率有关。因此，我们的结果表明，在经济衰退期间，失业救济金延长的实际道德风险效应明显低于经济繁荣时期。此外，通过构建具有流动性约束的求职模型，我们还发现，在没有市场范围效应的情况下，失业救济金延长的净社会效益可以直接用失业救济金耗尽率及其非就业影响来表示，或者作为我们测量的有效道德风险下降的函数来表示。

abstract.text: We examine portage sites in the U.S. South, Mid-Atlantic, and Midwest, including those on the fall line , a geomorphological feature in the southeastern U.S. marking the final rapids on rivers before the ocean. Historically, waterborne transport of goods required portage around the falls at these points, while some falls provided water power during early industrialization. These factors attracted commerce and manufacturing. Although these original advantages have long since been made obsolete, we document the continuing importance of these portage sites over time. We interpret these results as path dependence and contrast explanations based on sunk costs interacting with decreasing versus increasing returns to scale.

10.1093/qje/qjs011.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国南部、中大西洋地区和中西部的搬运站点，包括那些位于“瀑布线”上的站点。瀑布线是美国东南部的一种地貌特征，标志着河流在通往海洋前的最后一个急流处。历史上，通过水路运输货物需要在这些瀑布处进行搬运，而一些瀑布在工业化早期提供了水力资源。这些因素吸引了商业和制造业的发展。尽管这些原始优势早已被淘汰，但我们仍然发现这些搬运站点随着时间的推移仍然具有重要意义。我们将这些结果解释为路径依赖现象，并对比了基于沉没成本与规模收益递减或递增之间的解释。

abstract.text: This article characterizes optimal policy when a government uses indirect control to exert its authority. We develop a dynamic principal-agent model in which a principal (a government) delegates the prevention of a disturbance–such as riots, protests, terrorism, crime, or tax evasion–to an agent who has an advantage in accomplishing this task. Our setting is a standard repeated moral hazard model with two additional features. First, the principal is allowed to exert direct control by intervening with an endogenously determined intensity of force which is costly to both players. Second, the principal suffers from limited commitment. Using recursive methods, we derive a fully analytical characterization of the intensity, likelihood, and duration of intervention. The first main insight from our model is that repeated and costly equilibrium interventions are a feature of optimal policy. This is because they are the most efficient credible means for the principal of providing incentives for the agent. The second main insight is a detailed analysis of a fundamental trade-off between the intensity and duration of intervention which is driven by the principal's inability to commit. Finally, we derive sharp predictions regarding the impact of various factors on the optimal intensity, likelihood, and duration of intervention. We discuss these results in the context of some historical episodes.

10.1093/qje/qjs012.abstractZh: 本文描述了政府通过间接控制来行使权力的最优政策。我们建立了一个动态主体-代理人模型，其中主体（政府）将预防骚乱、抗议、恐怖主义、犯罪或逃税等干扰的任务委托给具有执行此任务优势的代理人。我们的模型基于一个标准的重复道德风险模型，但具有两个额外特征：首先，主体可以通过使用由内生决定的力量强度进行直接控制，但这种干预对双方来说都是昂贵的。其次，主体存在有限的承诺能力。通过递归方法，我们得出了关于干预强度、可能性和持续时间的完全解析描述。我们模型的主要启示之一是，重复且昂贵的均衡干预是最优政策的一个特征，因为它们是主体激励代理人的最有效手段。第二个主要启示是对干预强度和持续时间之间基本权衡的详细分析，这种权衡是由主体的承诺能力不足所驱动的。最后，我们得出了关于各种因素对干预最优强度、可能性和持续时间影响的精确预测。我们在一些历史事件的背景下讨论了这些结果。

abstract.text: We report on the experimental results of simple auctions with (i) a median-bid pricing rule and (ii) nonbinding bids (winning bids can be withdrawn)—the two central pillars of the competitive bidding program designed by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS). Comparisons between the performance of the CMS auction and the performance of the excluded-bid auction reveal the problematic nature of the CMS auction. The CMS auction fails to generate competitive prices of goods and fails to satisfy demand. In all proposed efficiency measures, we find the excluded-bid auction significantly outperforms the CMS auction.

10.1093/qje/qjs013.abstractZh: 我们报告了简单拍卖的实验结果，这些拍卖采用了两种机制：(i) 中位数出价定价规则，以及(ii) 非约束性出价（获胜的出价可以被撤回）——这两种机制是医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）设计的竞争性拍卖程序的两个核心要素。通过比较CMS拍卖与排除性出价拍卖的表现，我们发现CMS拍卖存在诸多问题。CMS拍卖无法产生具有竞争力的商品价格，也无法满足需求。在所有提出的效率衡量指标中，我们发现排除性出价拍卖的表现明显优于CMS拍卖。

abstract.text: This article examines the impact of jury racial composition on trial outcomes using a data set of felony trials in Florida between 2000 and 2010. We use a research design that exploits day-to-day variation in the composition of the jury pool to isolate quasi-random variation in the composition of the seated jury, finding evidence that (i) juries formed from all-white jury pools convict black defendants significantly (16 percentage points) more often than white defendants, and (ii) this gap in conviction rates is entirely eliminated when the jury pool includes at least one black member. The impact of jury race is much greater than what a simple correlation of the race of the seated jury and conviction rates would suggest. These findings imply that the application of justice is highly uneven and raise obvious concerns about the fairness of trials in jurisdictions with a small proportion of blacks in the jury pool.

10.1093/qje/qjs014.abstractZh: 本文通过2000至2010年间佛罗里达州的重罪审判数据集，探讨了陪审团种族构成对审判结果的影响。我们采用了一种研究设计，利用陪审团构成在日常中的变化来分离出陪审团构成中的准随机变化，发现以下现象：(i)由全白人组成的陪审团宣判黑人被告有罪的比例明显更高，比宣判白人被告有罪的比例高出16个百分点；(ii)当陪审团中至少包含一名黑人成员时，这种定罪率的差距完全消失。陪审团种族构成的影响远远超出了仅从陪审团种族与定罪率之间的简单相关性得出的结论。这些发现表明，司法的公正性存在很大差异，并引发了关于陪审团中黑人比例较低的司法管辖区审判公平性的明显担忧。

abstract.text: It has been difficult to open up the black box of knowledge production. We use unique international data on the publications, citations, and affiliations of mathematicians to examine the impact of a large, post-1992 influx of Soviet mathematicians on the productivity of their U.S. counterparts. We find a negative productivity effect on those mathematicians whose research overlapped with that of the Soviets. We also document an increased mobility rate (to lower quality institutions and out of active publishing) and a reduced likelihood of producing “home run” papers. Although the total product of the preexisting American mathematicians shrank, the Soviet contribution to American mathematics filled in the gap. However, there is no evidence that the Soviets greatly increased the size of the “mathematics pie.” Finally, we find that there are significant international differences in the productivity effects of the collapse of the Soviet Union, and these international differences can be explained by both differences in the size of the émigré flow into the various countries and in how connected each country is to the global market for mathematical publications.

10.1093/qje/qjs015.abstractZh: 打开知识生产的“黑箱”一直很困难。我们利用独特的国际数据，对数学家的出版物、引用次数和所属机构进行了研究，以考察1992年后大量苏联数学家涌入美国后，对美国数学家生产力的影响。我们发现，那些研究与苏联数学家重叠的数学家，其生产力受到了负面影响。我们还发现，这些数学家更倾向于流动到质量较低的机构，并减少活跃发表论文的机会。尽管美国原有数学家的整体产出有所减少，但苏联数学家对美国数学领域的贡献弥补了这一空缺。然而，没有证据表明苏联数学家大大增加了“数学领域的总量”。最后，我们发现苏联解体后，不同国家在数学生产力方面的差异显著，这些差异可以通过移民流入量的差异以及各国与全球数学出版市场的联系程度来解释。

abstract.text: A firm's productivity depends on how production is organized. To understand this relationship we develop a theory of an economy where firms with heterogeneous demands use labor and knowledge to produce. Entrepreneurs decide the number of layers of management and the knowledge and span of control of each agent. As a result, in the theory, heterogeneity in demand leads to heterogeneity in productivity and other firms' outcomes. We use the theory to analyze the impact of international trade on organization and calibrate the model to the U.S. economy. Our results indicate that, as a result of a bilateral trade liberalization, firms that export will increase the number of layers of management. The new organization of the average exporter results in higher productivity, although the responses of productivity are heterogeneous across these firms. Liberalizing trade from autarky to the level of openness in 2002 results in a 1% increase in productivity for the marginal exporter and a 1.8% increase in its revenue productivity. Endogenous organization increases the gains from trade by 41% relative to standard models.

10.1093/qje/qjs016.abstractZh: 一家企业的生产力取决于生产的组织方式。为了理解这种关系，我们提出了一个经济理论，其中具有不同需求的企业在利用劳动和知识进行生产。企业家决定管理层的层级以及每个代理人的知识和控制范围。因此，在理论中，需求的异质性导致生产力的异质性以及其他企业的产出差异。我们利用这一理论来分析国际贸易对组织方式的影响，并将模型校准到美国经济。我们的研究结果表明，由于双边贸易自由化的结果，出口企业会增加管理层的层级。新的平均出口企业的组织方式使得生产力提高，尽管这些企业之间的生产力反应存在差异。将贸易从自给自足状态提升到2002年的开放水平，边际出口企业的生产力提高了1%，其收入生产力提高了1.8%。与标准模型相比，内生组织方式使贸易带来的收益增加了41%。

abstract.text: Growing concerns about low awareness and take-up rates for government support programs like college financial aid have spurred calls to simplify the application process and enhance visibility. We present results from a randomized field experiment in which low-income individuals receiving tax preparation help were also offered immediate assistance and a streamlined process to complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) for themselves or their children. Treated participants were also provided with aid estimates that were compared against tuition cost amounts for nearby colleges. The combined assistance and information treatment substantially increased FAFSA submissions and ultimately the likelihood of college attendance, persistence, and aid receipt. In particular, high school seniors whose parents received the treatment were 8 percentage points more likely to have completed two years of college, going from 28% to 36%, during the first three years following the experiment. Families who received aid information but no assistance with the FAFSA did not experience improved outcomes. The findings suggest many other opportunities for using personal assistance to increase participation in programs that require filling out forms to become eligible.

10.1093/qje/qjs017.abstractZh: 对于像大学经济援助这样的政府支持项目，人们对其知晓率和接受率普遍较低的担忧日益增加，这促使人们呼吁简化申请流程并提升项目的可见性。我们开展了一项随机实地实验，实验中，接受税务准备帮助的低收入人群还获得了即时协助，并简化了填写联邦学生援助申请表（FAFSA）的过程，以便他们自己或子女能够完成申请。接受实验的参与者还获得了援助估算信息，这些信息与附近大学的学费进行了对比。综合了协助和信息处理措施后，FAFSA的填写率以及获得援助的可能性都得到了显著提升。特别是，接受过援助的高中毕业生，在实验后的三年内，完成两年大学学业的可能性增加了8个百分点，从28%上升到了36%。而仅获得援助信息但未获得FAFSA填写协助的家庭，则没有体验到类似的效果。这些发现表明，还有许多机会可以通过个人协助来增加那些需要填写表格才能获得资格的项目中的参与率。

abstract.text: We present a theory of choice among lotteries in which the decision maker's attention is drawn to (precisely defined) salient payoffs. This leads the decision maker to a context-dependent representation of lotteries in which true probabilities are replaced by decision weights distorted in favor of salient payoffs. By specifying decision weights as a function of payoffs, our model provides a novel and unified account of many empirical phenomena, including frequent risk-seeking behavior, invariance failures such as the Allais paradox, and preference reversals. It also yields new predictions, including some that distinguish it from prospect theory, which we test.

10.1093/qje/qjs018.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于彩票选择的理论，该理论将决策者的注意力引向了（明确定义的）显著收益。这使得决策者能够以一种情境依赖的方式理解彩票，其中真实概率被倾向于显著收益的决策权重所替代。通过以收益为函数指定决策权重，我们的模型提供了一种新颖且统一的解释，适用于许多实证现象，包括频繁的风险寻求行为、如Allais悖论所体现的不变性失败，以及偏好逆转现象。该模型还提出了新的预测，其中一些预测与前景理论有所不同，我们对这些预测进行了测试。

abstract.text: How persistent are cultural traits? Using data on anti-Semitism in Germany, we find local continuity over 600 years. Jews were often blamed when the Black Death killed at least a third of Europe’s population during 1348–50. We use plague-era pogroms as an indicator for medieval anti-Semitism. They reliably predict violence against Jews in the 1920s, votes for the Nazi Party, deportations after 1933, attacks on synagogues, and letters to Der Stürmer . We also identify areas where persistence was lower: cities with high levels of trade or immigration. Finally, we show that our results are not driven by political extremism or by different attitudes toward violence.

10.1093/qje/qjs019.abstractZh: 文化特征具有多持久性？通过研究德国反犹太主义的数据，我们发现这种文化特征在600多年间具有持续性。在1348年至1350年间，黑死病导致欧洲至少三分之一的人口死亡时，犹太人常常成为指责的对象。我们将瘟疫时期的暴行作为中世纪反犹太主义的指标。这些暴行可靠地预示了1920年代针对犹太人的暴力行为、纳粹党的选举支持率、1933年后的驱逐行动、对犹太教堂的袭击，以及寄给《冲锋队》杂志的信件。我们还发现了一些文化特征持续性较低的地区：那些贸易或移民活动频繁的城市。最后，我们的研究结果表明，这些结果并非由政治极端主义或对暴力的不同态度所驱动。

abstract.text: In 2008, a group of uninsured low-income adults in Oregon was selected by lottery to be given the chance to apply for Medicaid. This lottery provides an opportunity to gauge the effects of expanding access to public health insurance on the health care use, financial strain, and health of low-income adults using a randomized controlled design. In the year after random assignment, the treatment group selected by the lottery was about 25 percentage points more likely to have insurance than the control group that was not selected. We find that in this first year, the treatment group had substantively and statistically significantly higher health care utilization (including primary and preventive care as well as hospitalizations), lower out-of-pocket medical expenditures and medical debt (including fewer bills sent to collection), and better self-reported physical and mental health than the control group.

10.1093/qje/qjs020.abstractZh: 2008年，俄勒冈州的一群未投保的低收入成年人通过抽签被选中，有机会申请医疗补助计划。该抽签活动旨在通过随机对照设计，评估扩大公共健康保险覆盖对低收入成年人医疗使用、经济压力以及健康状况的影响。在随机分配后的第一年，通过抽签被选中的治疗组，其拥有保险的比例比未被选中的对照组高出约25个百分点。研究发现，在这一年里，治疗组的医疗使用量（包括初级和预防性护理以及住院治疗）明显且统计上显著更高，自付医疗费用和医疗债务也较低（包括需要催款处理的账单数量减少），同时他们自我报告的身体和心理健康状况也优于对照组。

abstract.text: We examine how the speed of learning and best-response processes depends on homophily: the tendency of agents to associate disproportionately with those having similar traits. When agents' beliefs or behaviors are developed by averaging what they see among their neighbors, then convergence to a consensus is slowed by the presence of homophily but is not influenced by network density (in contrast to other network processes that depend on shortest paths). In deriving these results, we propose a new, general measure of homophily based on the relative frequencies of interactions among different groups. An application to communication in a society before a vote shows how the time it takes for the vote to correctly aggregate information depends on the homophily and the initial information distribution.

10.1093/qje/qjs021.abstractZh: 我们研究了学习速度和最佳响应过程如何依赖于同质性：即个体倾向于与具有相似特征的人建立联系。当个体的信念或行为是通过平均邻居的行为来形成的时，同质性的存在会减缓达成共识的过程，但并不会受到网络密度的影响（与其他依赖于最短路径的网络过程不同）。在推导这些结果时，我们提出了一种基于不同群体间互动相对频率的新通用同质性度量方法。将这一方法应用于投票前的社会沟通情况，可以观察到投票正确汇总信息所需的时间取决于同质性和初始信息分布。

abstract.text: Previous studies of the U.S. Great Depression find that increased government spending and taxation contributed little to either the dramatic downturn or the slow recovery. These studies include only one type of capital taxation: a business profits tax. The contribution is much greater when the analysis includes other types of capital taxes. A general equilibrium model extended to include taxes on dividends, property, capital stock, excess profits, and undistributed profits predicts patterns of output, investment, and hours worked that are more like those in the 1930s than found in earlier studies. The greatest effects come from the increased taxes on corporate dividends and undistributed profits.

10.1093/qje/qjs022.abstractZh: 先前对美国大萧条时期的研究发现，政府支出的增加和税收的提高对经济急剧下滑或缓慢复苏几乎没有起到任何作用。这些研究仅涉及一种资本税：企业利润税。然而，当分析包括其他类型的资本税时，其影响会显著增强。一个扩展至包括股息、财产、资本存量、超额利润和未分配利润税的一般均衡模型，预测了与1930年代更为相似的产出、投资和劳动小时数的模式。其中，对企业股息和未分配利润征税所带来的影响最为显著。

abstract.text: In this article we present a simple new Keynesian–style model of debt-driven slumps—that is, situations in which an overhang of debt on the part of some agents, who are forced into rapid deleveraging, is depressing aggregate demand. Making some agents debt-constrained is a surprisingly powerful assumption. Fisherian debt deflation, the possibility of a liquidity trap, the paradox of thrift and toil, a Keynesian-type multiplier, and a rationale for expansionary fiscal policy all emerge naturally from the model. We argue that this approach sheds considerable light both on current economic difficulties and on historical episodes, including Japan’s lost decade (now in its 18th year) and the Great Depression itself.

10.1093/qje/qjs023.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个简单的新型凯恩斯式债务驱动衰退模型——即，某些代理人因债务负担过重而被迫快速去杠杆化，从而导致总需求下降的情况。认为某些代理人受到债务约束是一个相当有力的假设。费雪式债务通缩、流动性陷阱的可能性、节俭与辛勤工作的悖论、凯恩斯式乘数效应，以及扩张性财政政策的合理性，这些概念都自然而然地从该模型中浮现出来。我们认为，这种方法不仅有助于理解当前的经济困境，还能为历史时期的经济现象提供解释，包括日本失去的十年（现已持续18年）以及大萧条本身。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of the 2009 Cash for Clunkers program on short- and medium-run auto purchases. Our empirical strategy exploits variation across U.S. cities in ex ante exposure to the program as measured by the number of “clunkers” in the city as of summer 2008. We find that the program induced the purchase of an additional 370,000 cars in July and August 2009. However, we find strong evidence of reversal; high clunker counties bought fewer autos in the 10 months after the program expired, which offset most of the initial purchases. We find no evidence of an effect on employment, house prices, or household default rates in cities with higher exposure to the program.

10.1093/qje/qjs024.abstractZh: 我们评估了2009年“现金换旧车”计划对短期和中期汽车购买行为的影响。我们的实证策略利用了美国各城市在计划实施前受到的影响差异，这一差异通过2008年夏季各城市中的“旧车”数量来衡量。我们发现，该计划在2009年7月和8月促使额外购买了370,000辆汽车。然而，我们发现存在明显的逆转现象：在计划结束后的10个月内，那些原本有大量旧车的县购买的汽车数量减少，这抵消了最初的大部分购买行为。我们没有发现该计划对就业、房价或家庭违约率产生影响的证据，尤其是在那些原本更容易受到该计划影响的城市。

abstract.text: We develop a framework for the analysis of dynamic oligopolies with persistant sources of asymmetric information that enables applied analysis of situations of empirical importance that have been difficult to deal with. The framework generates policies that are “relatively” easy for agents to use while still being optimal in a meaningful sense, and is amenable to empirical research in that its equilibrium conditions can be tested and equilibrium policies are relatively easy to compute. We conclude with an example that endogenizes the maintenance decisions of electricity generators when the costs states of the generators are private information.

10.1093/qje/qjs025.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个框架，用于分析存在持续不对称信息来源的动态寡头市场，该框架能够应用于那些难以处理的实际重要情况。该框架提出的政策对参与者来说“相对”容易实施，同时仍然在有意义的意义上是最优的，并且适用于实证研究，因为其均衡条件可以被测试，而均衡政策也相对容易计算。最后，我们通过一个例子说明了当发电厂的运营成本是私人信息时，如何内生出发电厂维护决策。

abstract.text: We consider the robustness of extensive form mechanisms to deviations from common knowledge about the state of nature, which we refer to as information perturbations . First, we show that even under arbitrarily small information perturbations the Moore-Repullo mechanism does not yield (even approximately) truthful revelation and that in addition the mechanism has sequential equilibria with undesirable outcomes. More generally, we prove that any extensive form mechanism is fragile in the sense that if a non-Maskin monotonic social objective can be implemented with this mechanism, then there are arbitrarily small information perturbations under which an undesirable sequential equilibrium also exists. Finally, we argue that outside options can help improve efficiency in asymmetric information environments, and that these options can be thought of as reflecting ownership of an asset.

10.1093/qje/qjs026.abstractZh: 我们考虑了广泛形式机制对关于自然状态的常见知识偏差的鲁棒性，这些偏差我们称之为信息扰动。首先，我们证明即使在任意小的信息扰动下，Moore-Repullo机制也无法产生（哪怕是近似的）真实信息揭示，并且该机制还存在具有不良结果的序贯均衡。更一般地，我们证明了任何广泛形式机制都是脆弱的，即如果可以用该机制实现非Maskin单调的社会目标，那么存在任意小的信息扰动下也会存在不良序贯均衡。最后，我们认为外部选项可以帮助在信息不对称的环境中提高效率，并且这些选项可以被视为反映了某种资产的所有权。

abstract.text: In this article, we analyze the 1920s Ku Klux Klan, those who joined it, and its social and political impact by combining a wide range of archival data sources with data from the 1920 and 1930 U.S censuses. We find that individuals who joined the Klan in some cities were more educated and more likely to hold professional jobs than the typical American. Surprisingly, we find little evidence that the Klan had an effect on black or foreign-born residential mobility or vote totals. Rather than a terrorist organization, the 1920s Klan is best described as social organization with a very successful multilevel marketing structure fueled by an army of highly incentivized sales agents selling hatred, religious intolerance, and fraternity in a time and place where there was tremendous demand.

10.1093/qje/qjs028.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们通过结合广泛的档案数据来源以及1920年和1930年美国人口普查的数据，分析了1920年代的三K党、加入该组织的人员及其社会和政治影响。我们发现，在一些城市中加入三K党的个体通常受教育程度较高，且更有可能从事专业工作，这与典型的美国人群体有所不同。令人惊讶的是，我们发现几乎没有证据表明三K党对黑人或外国出生的居民迁移或投票总数产生了影响。与其说三K党是一个恐怖组织，不如说它是一个社会组织，其非常成功的多层次营销结构得到了高度激励的销售人员的支持，他们在需求巨大的时期传播仇恨、宗教不宽容和兄弟情谊。

abstract.text: We study the allocation and compensation of human capital in the U.S. finance industry over the past century. Across time, space, and subsectors, we find that financial deregulation is associated with skill intensity, job complexity, and high wages for finance employees. All three measures are high before 1940 and after 1985, but not in the interim period. Workers in finance earn the same education-adjusted wages as other workers until 1990, but by 2006 the premium is 50% on average. Top executive compensation in finance follows the same pattern and timing, where the premium reaches 250%. Similar results hold for other top earners in finance. Changes in earnings risk can explain about one half of the increase in the average premium; changes in the size distribution of firms can explain about one fifth of the premium for executives.

10.1093/qje/qjs030.abstractZh: 我们研究了过去一个世纪美国金融行业人力资本的配置与补偿情况。从时间、空间以及不同子行业来看，我们发现金融行业的放松管制与技能强度、工作复杂性以及金融从业人员的高工资密切相关。在1940年之前和1985年之后，这三个指标都很高，但在中间时期则没有这种情况。直到1990年，金融行业的员工所赚取的工资与其他行业员工相当，但到2006年，金融行业的员工平均工资高出约50%。金融行业的顶级高管薪酬也遵循类似的模式和时机，其薪酬溢价达到了250%。对于金融行业中的其他高收入人群，结果也类似。收入风险的变化可以解释平均薪酬溢价的一半左右；而企业规模分布的变化则可以解释高管薪酬溢价的五分之一左右。

abstract.text: We consider a repeated interaction between a long-run player and a sequence of short-run players, in which the long-run player may either be rational or may be a mechanical type who plays the same (possibly mixed) action in every stage game. We depart from the classical model in assuming that the short-run players make inferences by analogical reasoning, meaning that they correctly identify the average strategy of each type of long-run player, but do not recognize how this play varies across histories. Concentrating on 2 × 2 games, we provide a characterization of equilibrium payoffs, establishing a payoff bound for the rational long-run player that can be strictly larger than the familiar “Stackelberg” bound. We also provide a characterization of equilibrium behavior, showing that play begins with either a reputation-building or a reputation-spending stage (depending on parameters), followed by a reputation-manipulation stage.

10.1093/qje/qjs031.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个长期玩家与一系列短期玩家之间的重复互动关系，其中长期玩家可能是理性的，也可能是机械型的，即在每个阶段游戏中采取相同的（可能是混合的）行动。我们基于经典模型假设，认为短期玩家通过类比推理来做出判断，即他们能够准确识别每种长期玩家的平均策略，但无法理解这种策略在不同历史中的变化。在2×2博弈中，我们描述了均衡收益的构成，并为理性长期玩家设定了一个收益界限，该界限可能严格大于常见的“斯塔克伯格”界限。我们还描述了均衡行为的特征，表明玩家的行动首先会经历一个建立声誉的阶段，或者一个消耗声誉的阶段（取决于参数），随后是一个操纵声誉的阶段。

abstract.text: What is the best way to reward innovation? While prizes avoid deadweight loss, intellectual property (IP) selects high social surplus projects. Optimal innovation policy thus trades off the ex ante screening benefit and the ex post distortion. It solves a multidimensional screening problem in the private information held by the innovator: research cost, quality, and market size of the innovation. The appropriate degree of market power is never full monopoly pricing and is determined by measurable market characteristics, the inequality and elasticity of innovation supply, making the analysis open to empirical calibration. The framework has applications beyond IP policy to the optimal pricing of platforms or the optimal procurement of public infrastructure.

10.1093/qje/qjs032.abstractZh: 如何最好地奖励创新？虽然奖项可以避免无谓损失，但知识产权却会选择那些能带来高社会收益的项目。因此，最优的创新政策需要在事前筛选效益与事后扭曲之间做出权衡。这一框架解决了创新者所持有的私人信息中的多维筛选问题：创新的成本、质量以及市场规模。适当的市场力量程度并非完全垄断定价，而是由可测量的市场特征、创新供应的不平等性和弹性来决定，这使得分析可以接受实证校准。该框架的应用不仅限于知识产权政策，还可以用于平台的最优定价或公共基础设施的最优采购。

abstract.text: We analyze a rational-expectations model of price formation in an intermediate-good market under uncertainty. There is a continuum of firms, each consisting of a party who can reduce production cost and a party who can discover information about demand. Both parties can make specific investments at private cost, and there is a machine that either party can control. As in incomplete-contracting models, different governance structures (i.e., different allocations of control of the machine) create different incentives for the parties’ investments. As in rational-expectations models, some parties may invest in acquiring information, which is then incorporated into the market-clearing price of the intermediate good by these parties’ production decisions. The informativeness of the price mechanism affects the returns to specific investments and hence the optimal governance structure for individual firms; meanwhile, the governance choices by individual firms affect the informativeness of the price mechanism. In equilibrium, the informativeness of the price mechanism can induce ex ante homogeneous firms to choose heterogeneous governance structures.
