10.1093/qje/qjs033.abstractZh: 我们分析了一个在不确定性下的中间商品市场中价格形成的理性预期模型。该市场由一系列企业组成，每个企业都包含一个能够降低生产成本的一方，以及一个能够发现需求信息的另一方。双方都可以以私人成本进行特定投资，并且有一台双方都可以控制的机器。与不完全契约模型类似，不同的治理结构（即机器控制权的不同分配）会为双方的决策带来不同的激励。在理性预期模型中，一些企业可能会投资于获取信息，这些信息随后会被纳入中间商品的市场清算价格中，通过双方的生产决策来影响价格。价格机制的信息含量会影响特定投资的回报，从而影响单个企业的最优治理结构；同时，单个企业的治理选择也会影响价格机制的信息含量。在均衡状态下，价格机制的信息含量可以促使原本同质的企业在治理结构上选择不同的结构。

abstract.text: Tropical deforestation accounts for almost one-fifth of greenhouse gas emissions and threatens the world’s most diverse ecosystems. Much of this deforestation is driven by illegal logging. We use novel satellite data that tracks annual deforestation across eight years of Indonesian institutional change to examine how local officials’ incentives affect deforestation. Increases in the number of political jurisdictions lead to increased deforestation and lower timber prices, consistent with Cournot competition between jurisdictions. Illegal logging and local oil and gas rents are short-run substitutes, but this effect disappears over time with political turnover. The results illustrate how local officials’ incentives affect deforestation and show how standard economic theories can explain illegal behavior.

10.1093/qje/qjs034.abstractZh: 热带森林的砍伐几乎占温室气体排放量的五分之一，并威胁着世界上最为多样的生态系统。这种森林砍伐行为很大程度上是由非法伐木所驱动的。我们利用新颖的卫星数据，通过印度尼西亚八年来的制度变化来研究地方官员的激励措施如何影响森林砍伐。政治管辖区的数量增加会导致森林砍伐加剧和木材价格下降，这与各管辖区之间的Cournot竞争理论相符。非法伐木与当地石油和天然气租金在短期内可以替代，但随着政治更替，这种效应会逐渐消失。研究结果说明了地方官员的激励措施如何影响森林砍伐，并表明标准经济理论能够解释非法行为。

abstract.text: In this paper, we use an economic model to analyse data from a major randomized social experiment, namely PROGRESA in Mexico, and to evaluate its impact on school participation. We show the usefulness of using experimental data to estimate a structural economic model as well as the importance of a structural model in interpreting experimental results. The availability of the experiment also allows us to estimate the program's general equilibrium effects, which we then incorporate into our simulations. Our main findings are (i) the program's grant has a much stronger impact on school enrolment than an equivalent reduction in child wages; (ii) the program has a positive effect on the enrollment of children, especially after primary school; this result is well replicated by the parsimonious structural model; (iii) there are sizeable effects of the program on child wages, which, however, reduce the effectiveness of the program only marginally; and (iv) a revenue neutral change in the program that would increase the grant for secondary school children while eliminating for the primary school children would have a substantially larger effect on enrollment of the latter, while having minor effects on the former.

10.1093/restud/rdr015.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们使用一个经济模型来分析来自墨西哥一项重要随机社会实验的数据，即PROGRESA实验，并评估其对学校参与率的影响。我们展示了使用实验数据来估计结构经济模型的有效性，以及结构模型在解释实验结果中的重要性。该实验的可用性还使我们能够估算该计划的总体均衡效应，并将其纳入我们的模拟中。我们的主要发现包括：(i) 该计划的资助对入学率的影响远大于同等程度的儿童工资降低；(ii) 该计划对儿童的入学率有积极影响，尤其是在小学之后；这一结果被简约结构模型很好地再现；(iii) 该计划对儿童工资有显著的影响，但这种影响仅略微降低了该计划的成效；(iv) 如果对该计划进行一种收入中性的调整，即增加中等教育的资助，同时取消对小学教育的资助，那么对后者的入学率会产生更大的影响，而对前者则只有较小的影响。

abstract.text: How does trade liberalization affect wages? This is the first paper to consider in theory and data how the impact of final and intermediate input tariff cuts on workers' wages varies with the global engagement of their firm. Our model predicts that a fall in output tariffs lowers wages at import-competing firms but boosts wages at exporting firms. Similarly, a fall in input tariffs raises wages at import-using firms relative to those at firms that only source inputs locally. Using highly detailed Indonesian manufacturing census data for the period 1991–2000, we find considerable support for the model's predictions.

10.1093/restud/rdr016.abstractZh: 贸易自由化如何影响工资？这是第一篇从理论和数据角度探讨最终产品和中间投入关税削减对工人工资影响的论文，同时考虑了企业参与全球贸易的程度。我们的模型预测，出口竞争型企业的产出关税下降会降低其工资，而出口型企业的工资则会上升。同样，使用投入关税下降时，使用进口产品的企业相对于仅本地采购投入的企业，其工资会上升。通过利用1991年至2000年间印尼制造业的详细普查数据，我们发现该模型的预测得到了相当程度的支持。

abstract.text: This paper examines the dynamic implications of social networks for the labour market outcomes of refugees resettled in the U.S. A theoretical model of job information transmission shows that the relationship between social network size and labour market outcomes is heterogeneous and depends on the vintage of network members: an increase in network size can negatively impact some cohorts in a network while benefiting others. To test this prediction, I use new data on political refugees resettled in the U.S. and exploit the fact that these refugees are distributed across cities by a resettlement agency, precluding individuals from sorting. The results indicate that an increase in the number of social network members resettled in the same year or one year prior to a new arrival leads to a deterioration of outcomes, while a greater number of tenured network members improves the probability of employment and raises the hourly wage.

10.1093/restud/rdr017.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社交网络对在美国重新安置的难民劳动力市场结果的动态影响。一个关于工作信息传递的理论模型表明，社交网络规模与劳动力市场结果之间的关系是异质的，并取决于网络成员的年龄：网络规模的扩大可能会对某些群体产生负面影响，而对其他群体则带来益处。为了验证这一预测，我使用了关于在美国重新安置的政治难民的新数据，并利用了这些难民由重新安置机构按城市分布的信息，从而避免了个体之间的排序效应。研究结果表明，在同一年份或新移民前一年重新安置的社交网络成员数量增加会导致结果恶化，而更多的长期在网络的成员则能够提高就业概率并提高时薪。

abstract.text: In the context of a “beauty-contest” coordination game (in which pay-offs depend on the quadratic distance of actions from an unobserved state variable and from the average action), players choose how much costly attention to pay to various informative signals. Each signal has an underlying accuracy (how precisely it identifies the state) and a clarity (how easy it is to understand). The unique linear equilibrium has interesting properties: the signals which receive attention are the clearest available, even if they have poor underlying accuracy; the number of signals observed falls as the complementarity of players' actions rises; and, if actions are more complementary, the information endogenously acquired in equilibrium is more public in nature. The consequences of “rational-inattention” constraints on information transmission and processing are also studied.

10.1093/restud/rdr018.abstractZh: 在“美丽竞赛”协调游戏的背景下（其中收益取决于行为与未观测状态变量以及平均行为的二次距离），参与者会决定为各种信息信号投入多少成本。每个信号都具备一定的准确性（其识别状态的精确度）和清晰度（其理解的难易程度）。独特的线性均衡具有一些有趣的特性：即使某些信号的准确性较低，那些获得更多关注的信号也是最清晰的信息；随着参与者行为的互补性增加，被观察到的信号数量也会减少；如果行为更加互补，均衡状态下内源获得的信息会更具公开性。本文还研究了“理性忽视”约束对信息传输和处理的后果。

abstract.text: This paper addresses two questions: What accounts for the gender gap in labour-market outcomes? What are the driving forces behind the changes in the gender labour-market outcomes over the period 1968–1997? It formulates a dynamic general equilibrium model of labour supply, occupational sorting, and human-capital accumulation in which gender discrimination and an earnings gap arise endogenously. It uses this model to quantify the driving forces behind the decline in the gender earnings gap and the increase in female labour-force participation, the proportion of women working in professional occupations, and hours worked. It finds that labour-market experience is the most important factor explaining the gender earnings gap. In addition, statistical discrimination accounts for a large fraction of the observed gender earnings gap and its decline. It also finds that a large increase in aggregate productivity in professional occupations plays a major role in the increase in female labour-force participation, number of hours worked, and the proportion of females working in professional occupations. Although of less importance, demographic changes account for a substantial part of the increase in female labour-force participation and hours worked, whereas home production technology shocks do not.

10.1093/restud/rdr019.abstractZh: 本文探讨了两个问题：是什么导致了劳动力市场结果中的性别差距？在1968年至1997年期间，性别劳动力市场结果变化的驱动力是什么？本文构建了一个动态一般均衡模型，涉及劳动力供给、职业选择以及人力资本积累，其中性别歧视和收入差距是内生产生的。该模型用于量化导致性别收入差距缩小以及女性劳动力参与率、从事专业职业的女性比例以及工作小时数增加的驱动力。研究发现，劳动力市场经验是解释性别收入差距的最重要因素。此外，统计性歧视在观察到的性别收入差距及其缩小中占很大比例。研究还发现，专业职业的整体生产率大幅上升在增加女性劳动力参与率、工作小时数以及从事专业职业的女性比例方面起着重要作用。虽然重要性较低，但人口变化在增加女性劳动力参与率和工作小时数方面也起到了重要作用，而家庭生产技术的冲击则没有这种作用。

abstract.text: We investigate the empirical content of the Nash solution to two-player bargaining games. The bargaining environment is described by a set of variables that may affect agents' preferences over the agreement sharing, the status quo outcome, or both. The outcomes (i.e. whether an agreement is reached, and if so the individual shares) and the environment (including the size of the pie) are known, but neither are the agents' utilities nor their threat points. We consider both a deterministic version of the model in which the econometrician observes the shares as deterministic functions of the variables under consideration and a stochastic one in which because of latent disturbances only the joint distribution of incomes and outcomes is recorded. We show that in the most general framework any outcome can be rationalized as a Nash solution. However, even mild exclusion restrictions generate strong implications that can be used to test the Nash bargaining assumption. Stronger conditions further allow to recover the underlying structure of the bargaining, and in particular, the cardinal representation of individual preferences in the absence of uncertainty. An implication of this finding is that empirical works entailing Nash bargaining could (and should) use much more general and robust versions than they usually do.

10.1093/restud/rdr020.abstractZh: 我们研究了两人讨价还价游戏中纳什解的经验内容。讨价还价环境由一组变量描述，这些变量可能影响代理人对协议共享、现状结果或两者的偏好。结果（即是否达成协议，以及如果达成协议，个体分享多少）和环境（包括蛋糕的大小）是已知的，但代理人的效用和威胁点却未知。我们考虑了模型的确定性版本和随机版本：在确定性版本中，计量经济学家将份额视为所考虑变量的确定性函数；在随机版本中，由于潜在的干扰，仅记录收入和结果的联合分布。我们表明，在最一般的框架下，任何结果都可以被合理化为纳什解。然而，即使是轻微的排除限制也会产生重要的推论，这些推论可以用来检验纳什讨价还价假设。更严格的条件可以进一步揭示讨价还价的基本结构，特别是在没有不确定性的情况下，个体偏好的基数表示。这一发现的一个含义是，涉及纳什讨价还价的实证研究应该使用更通用和稳健的版本，而不是通常使用的版本。

abstract.text: Drawing on uncommonly rich and representative data from the Colombian manufacturing census, this paper documents new empirical relationships between input prices, output prices, and plant size and proposes a model of endogenous input and output quality choices by heterogeneous firms to explain the observed patterns. The key empirical facts are that, on average within narrowly defined sectors, (1) larger plants charge more for their outputs and (2) larger plants pay more for their material inputs. The latter fact generalizes the well-known positive correlation between plant size and wages. Similar correlations hold between prices and export status. We show that the empirical patterns are consistent with a parsimonious extension of the Melitz (2003, “The Impact of Trade on Intra-Industry Reallocations and Aggregate Industry Productivity,” Econometrica, 71, 1695–1725) framework to include endogenous choice of input and output quality. Using a measure of the scope for quality differentiation from Sutton (1998, Technology and Market Structure: Theory and History. Cambridge: MIT Press), we show that differences across sectors in the relationships between prices and plant size are consistent with our model. Available evidence suggests that differences in observable measures of market power do not provide a complete explanation for the empirical patterns. We interpret the results as supportive of the hypothesis that quality differences of both inputs and outputs play an important role in generating the price–plant size correlations.

10.1093/restud/rdr021.abstractZh: 本文基于哥伦比亚制造业普查中异常丰富且具有代表性的数据，揭示了投入价格、产出价格与工厂规模之间的新实证关系，并提出了一种模型，用于解释异质企业内生性投入与产出质量选择的行为。主要实证发现是：在狭义定义的行业中，平均而言，（1）规模较大的工厂对其产品的收费更高；（2）规模较大的工厂对其原材料投入的支付也更高。后一个事实扩展了工厂规模与工资之间众所周知的正相关关系。类似的相关性也存在于价格与出口状况之间。我们表明，这些实证模式与Melitz（2003年，《贸易对行业内部重新分配和整体行业生产力的影响》，Econometrica，71卷，1695-1725页）框架的简约扩展相一致，该框架包括了投入与产出质量的内生选择。通过利用Sutton（1998年，《技术与市场结构：理论史》剑桥：MIT出版社）提出的衡量质量差异的指标，我们证明了不同行业在价格与工厂规模之间的关系上存在的差异与我们的模型一致。现有证据表明，可观察的市场力量差异并不能完全解释这些实证模式。我们将这些结果解释为支持这样一个假设：投入与产出质量的差异在形成价格与工厂规模之间的相关性方面起着重要作用。

abstract.text: In this paper, we decompose city size wage premia into various components. We base these decompositions on an estimated on-the-job search model that incorporates latent ability, search frictions, firm-worker match quality, human capital accumulation and endogenous migration between large, medium and small cities. Counterfactual simulations of the model indicate that variation in returns to experience and differences in wage intercepts across location type are the most important mechanisms contributing to observed city size wage premia. Variation in returns to experience is more important for generating wage premia between large and small locations while differences in wage intercepts are more important for generating wage premia betwen medium and small locations. Sorting on unobserved ability within education group and differences in labor market search frictions and distributions of firm-worker match quality contribute little to observed city size wage premia. These conclusions hold for separate samples of high school and college graduates.

10.1093/restud/rdr022.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们将城市规模工资溢价分解为多个组成部分。这些分解基于一个估算的在职搜索模型，该模型考虑了潜在能力、搜索摩擦、企业与员工匹配质量、人力资本积累以及大、中、小城市之间的内生迁移等因素。对该模型的反事实模拟表明，经验回报的变化以及不同地点类型的工资起始值差异是导致观察到的城市规模工资溢价的最重要机制。经验回报的变化对于产生大与小之间的工资溢价更为重要，而工资起始值的差异则对于产生中与小之间的工资溢价更为关键。在教育群体内部基于未观察到的能力的排序，以及劳动力市场搜索摩擦的差异以及企业与员工匹配质量的分布，对观察到的城市规模工资溢价贡献较小。这些结论适用于高中毕业生和大学毕业生这两个不同的样本群体。

abstract.text: An individual displays various preference orderings in different payoff-irrelevant circumstances. It is assumed that the variation in the observed preference orderings is the outcome of some cognitive process that distorts the underlying preferences of the individual. We introduce a framework for eliciting the individual's underlying preferences in such cases and then demonstrate it for two cognitive processes—satisficing and small assessment errors.

10.1093/restud/rdr024.abstractZh: 在不同的收益无关情况下，个体会表现出不同的偏好排序。假设观察到的偏好排序的变化是某种认知过程的结果，这种过程扭曲了个体的潜在偏好。我们提出了一个框架，用于在这种情况下引出个体的潜在偏好，并针对两种认知过程——满意化决策和小评估错误进行了验证。

abstract.text: This paper measures the role of quality-adjusted years of schooling in accounting for cross-country output per worker differences. While data on years of schooling are readily available, data on education quality are not. I use the returns to schooling of foreign-educated immigrants in the U.S. to measure the education quality of their birth country. Immigrants from developed countries earn higher returns than do immigrants from developing countries. I show how to incorporate this measure of education quality into an otherwise standard development accounting exercise. The main result is that cross-country differences in education quality are roughly as important as cross-country differences in years of schooling in accounting for output per worker differences, raising the total contribution of education from 10% to 20% of output per worker differences.

10.1093/restud/rdr025.abstractZh: 本文研究了质量调整后的受教育年限在解释各国每工人产出差异中的作用。虽然受教育年限的数据容易获取，但教育质量的数据却并不常见。我利用在美国接受外国教育移民的受教育回报来衡量其出生国的教育质量。来自发达国家的移民获得的回报高于来自发展中国家的移民。我展示了如何将这种教育质量衡量方法纳入标准的发展会计分析中。主要结论是，教育质量的跨国差异与受教育年限的跨国差异在解释每工人产出差异方面同样重要，这使得教育对每工人产出差异的贡献从10%增加到20%。

abstract.text: We study a novel dynamic principal–agent setting with moral hazard and adverse selection (persistent as well as repeated). In the model, an agent whose skills are his private information faces a finite sequence of tasks, one after the other. Upon arrival of each task, the agent learns its level of difficulty and then chooses whether to accept or refuse each task in turn and how much effort to exert. Although his decision to accept or refuse a task is publicly known, the agent's effort level is his private information. We characterize optimal contracts and show that the per-period utility of the agent approaches his per-period utility when his skills are publicly known, as the discount factor and the time horizon increase.

10.1093/restud/rdr026.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有道德风险与逆向选择问题的新型动态主体-代理人模型（包括持续性和重复性情况）。在该模型中，代理人的技能属于其私人信息，需要依次完成一系列任务。每当任务到来时，代理人会了解任务的难度，然后决定是否接受该任务以及付出多少努力。尽管代理人接受或拒绝任务的决策是公开的，但他的努力程度却是其私人信息。我们描述了最优合同的形式，并表明：当代理人的技能是公开信息时，随着折现因子和时间范围的扩大，代理人的每期效用趋近于其每期效用。

abstract.text: Recent theories endogenize the attitude endowments of individuals, assuming that they are shaped by the attitudes of parents and other role models. This paper tests empirically for the relevance of three aspects of the attitude transmission process highlighted in this theoretical literature: (1) transmission of attitudes from parents to children; (2) an impact of prevailing attitudes in the local environment on child attitudes; and (3) positive assortative mating of parents, which enhances the ability of a parent to pass on his or her attitudes to the child. We focus on two fundamentally important attitudes, willingness to take risks and willingness to trust others. We find empirical support for all three aspects, providing an empirical underpinning for the literature. An investigation of underlying mechanisms shows that socialization is important in the transmission process. Various parental characteristics and aspects of family structure are found to strengthen the socialization process, with implications for modeling the socialization production function and for policies focused on affecting children's non-cognitive skills. The paper also provides evidence that the transmission of risk and trust attitudes affects a wide variety of child outcomes, implying a potentially large total effect on children's economic situation.

10.1093/restud/rdr027.abstractZh: 近期理论将个体的态度禀赋视为内生的，认为这些态度是由父母和其他榜样的行为所塑造的。本文通过实证方法检验了这些理论文献中强调的态度传递过程的三个方面的相关性：（1）父母将态度传递给子女的过程；（2）当地环境中普遍存在的态度对儿童态度的影响；（3）父母之间的正向选择性行为，这增强了父母将自身态度传递给子女的能力。我们重点关注两种基本重要的态度：冒险意愿和信任他人意愿。我们发现这三个方面的相关性都有实证支持，为相关文献提供了实证依据。对潜在机制的探究表明，社会化在态度传递过程中起着重要作用。各种父母特征和家庭结构因素都被发现能够加强社会化过程，这对建模社会化生产函数以及制定影响儿童非认知技能的政策具有重要意义。本文还提供了证据，表明风险与信任态度的传递会影响多种儿童发展结果，从而可能对儿童的经济状况产生重大影响。

abstract.text: We explore how allowing votes to be traded separately of shares may affect the efficiency of corporate control contests. Our basic set-up and the nature of the questions continue the work of Grossman and Hart (1980), Harris and Raviv (1988), and Blair, Golbe and Gerard (1989). We consider three cases with respect to the allowable price offers (for shares and for votes when they can be traded separately): unrestricted price offers, quantity-restricted price offers, and price offers contingent on winning. Our main results are characterizations of the equilibria and of the circumstances under which vote buying is harmful. We show that allowing votes to be traded separately of shares results in inefficiencies in all the cases we study. Similarly allowing quantity-restricted offers is also harmful, but allowing conditional offers is not in itself detrimental to efficiency. The paper also makes a methodological contribution to the analysis of takeover games with atomless shareholders. It provides a way of dealing with asymmetric equilibria that must be dealt with for a complete analysis and it proves existence of an equilibrium.

10.1093/restud/rdr028.abstractZh: 我们探讨了将投票与股份分开交易是否会影响企业控制权争夺的效率。我们的基本设定和问题性质延续了Grossman和Hart（1980年）、Harris和Raviv（1988年）以及Blair、Golbe和Gerard（1989年）的工作。我们考虑了三种情况下允许的价格报价（对于可以分开交易的股份和投票）：无限制的价格报价、数量限制的价格报价，以及取决于胜负的报价。我们的主要结果是描述了均衡状态以及投票收购有害的情况。我们发现，在研究的所有情况下，允许投票与股份分开交易都会导致效率低下。同样，允许数量限制的报价也是有害的，但允许取决于胜负的报价本身并不对效率产生负面影响。本文还为分析具有原子化股东的收购博弈提供了方法论上的贡献。它提供了一种处理必须考虑的不对称均衡的方法，并证明了均衡的存在。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes peer e¤ects among university scientists. Specifically, it investigates whether peer quality and the number of peers a¤ect the productivity of researchers in physics, chemistry, and mathematics. The usual endogeneity problems related to estimating peer e¤ects are addressed by using the dismissal of scientists by the Nazi government as a source of exogenous variation in the peer group of scientists staying in Germany. Using a newly constructed panel dataset covering the universe of physicists, chemists, and mathematicians at all German universities from 1925 until 1938 I investigate localized peer e¤ects. There is no evidence for peer e¤ects at the local level. This surprising finding is robust for a large number of specification and robustness checks. In a second part of the analysis, I investigate peer e¤ect among co-authors and find that co-author quality is very important for scientific productivity. Alternative version: Waldinger, Fabian (2007). Peer effects in science : evidence from the dismissal of scientists in Nazi Germany. In: Invited Speaker : LSE. 10.1093/restud/rdr029.abstractZh: 本文分析了大学科学家之间的同伴效应。具体而言，本文探讨了同伴的素质以及同伴数量是否会影响物理学、化学和数学领域研究人员的生产力。通过使用纳粹政府驱逐科学家这一外部变量作为解释同伴效应的来源，解决了通常与估计同伴效应相关的内生性问题。本文利用一个新构建的面板数据集，涵盖了1925年至1938年间所有德国大学的物理学家、化学家和数学家，研究了局部性的同伴效应。研究结果表明，在局部层面上并没有同伴效应的证据。这一令人惊讶的发现经过大量模型设定和稳健性检验后依然成立。在分析的第二部分中，本文研究了合著者之间的同伴效应，发现合著者的素质对科学生产力非常重要。其他版本：Waldinger, Fabian (2007)。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被驱逐的证据。在：邀请演讲者：伦敦政治经济学院。伦敦，2007年10月9日。Waldinger, Fabian (2008)。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被驱逐的证据。在：第三届ZEW创新与专利经济学会议。曼海姆，2008年6月13-14日。Waldinger, Fabian (2010)。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被驱逐的证据。在欧洲经济协会与计量经济学会会议上。意大利米兰，2008年8月27-31日。Waldinger, Fabian (2008)。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被驱逐的证据。在：第十届欧洲夏季劳动经济学研讨会（ESSLE 2008）。布赫，阿默尔湖，2008年10月8-12日。Waldinger, Fabian (2008)。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被驱逐的证据。受邀演讲者：伦敦政治经济学院，2008年10月28日，伦敦。瓦林德格，法比安（2008）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：受邀演讲者：伦敦政治经济学院，2008年10月28日，伦敦。瓦林德格，法比安（2008）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：埃塞克斯大学经济系外部研究研讨会，科尔切斯特，2008年12月4日。瓦林德格，法比安（2008）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：乌得勒支大学经济系，2008年12月17日。瓦林德格，法比安（2009）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：博科尼大学经济系，意大利米兰，2009年9月16日。瓦林德格，法比安（2010）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：斯坦福大学经济325社会科学历史课程，2010年3月3日。瓦林德格，法比安（2010）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：意大利银行，意大利，2010年3月10日。瓦林德格，法比安（2010）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：2010年社会政策协会年会，基尔，2010年9月9日。瓦林德格，法比安（2010）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：法国枫丹白露INSEAD，2010年11月9日。瓦林德格，法比安（2010）。科学中的同伴效应：来自纳粹德国科学家被解雇的证据。在：剑桥大学经济系特别研讨会，剑桥，2011年2月3日。

abstract.text: Empirical investigation of the quality interpretation of the Melitz (2003) model of firm heterogeneity and trade has been limited by the lack of direct data on quality. This paper matches firm-level export data with expert assessments of the quality of champagne producers to estimate the key parameters of that model. Quality monotonically increases firm-level prices, the probability of market entry, and export values. The estimated model—which calibrates the relative importance of firm-level quality and idiosyncratic demand—accurately predicts the average quality exported to each country. Simulations show that the data reject the polar alternatives where outcomes are based entirely on either quality or randomness.

10.1093/restud/rdr030.abstractZh: 对Melitz（2003）关于企业异质性和贸易质量模型的实证研究因缺乏关于质量的直接数据而受到限制。本文将企业层面的出口数据与专家对香槟生产商质量的评估相结合，以估算该模型的关键参数。研究表明，质量会同步提高企业层面的价格、市场进入概率以及出口价值。所估算的模型能够准确预测每个国家出口产品的平均质量。模拟结果显示，数据排除了完全基于质量或随机性的极端情况。

abstract.text: We study strategic information transmission in an organization consisting of an infinite sequence of individual decision-makers. Each decision-maker chooses an action and receives an informative but imperfect signal of the once-and-for-all realization of an unobserved state. The state affects all individuals' preferences over present and future decisions. Decision-makers do not directly observe the realized signals or actions of their predecessors. Instead, they must rely on cheap-talk messages in order to accumulate information about the state. Each decision-maker is therefore both a receiver of information with respect to his decision and a sender with respect to all future decisions. We show that if preferences are not perfectly aligned, “full learning” equilibria—ones in which the individuals' posterior beliefs eventually place full weight on the true state—do not exist. This is so both in the case of private communication, in which each individual only hears the message of his immediate predecessor, and in the case of public communication, in which a decision-maker hears the message of all his predecessors. Surprisingly, in the latter case full learning may be impossible even in the limit as all members of the organization become perfectly patient. We also consider the case where all individuals have access to a mediator who can work across time periods arbitrarily far apart. In this case, full learning equilibria exist.

10.1093/restud/rdr031.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由无限序列的个体决策者组成的组织中的战略信息传输问题。每个决策者选择一个行动，并接收一个关于未观察到状态一次性实现的、不完美的信息信号。该状态会影响所有个体对当前和未来决策的偏好。决策者无法直接观察到前任的实际情况或行动，因此必须依赖“廉价信息”来积累关于该状态的信息。因此，每个决策者既是自己决策相关的信息接收者，也是所有未来决策相关的信息发送者。我们证明，如果偏好不完全一致，那么“完全学习”均衡——即个体后验信念最终完全依赖于真实状态的均衡——是不存在的。这一点在私人通信的情况下同样成立，即每个个体只能听到直接前任的信息；而在公共通信的情况下，决策者会听到所有前任的信息。令人惊讶的是，在后者的情况下，即使组织中的所有成员都变得极其耐心，完全学习也可能无法实现。我们还考虑了所有个体都能接触到能够跨越任意长时间间隔进行工作的调解人的情况。在这种情况下，完全学习均衡是存在的。

abstract.text: We discuss a simple model in which parents and children make investments in the children's education and investments for other purposes and parents can transfer cash to their children. We show that for an identifiable set of parent–child pairs, parents will rationally underinvest in their child's education. For these parent–child pairs, additional financial aid will increase educational attainment. The model highlights an important feature of higher education finance, the “expected family contribution” (EFC) that is based on income, assets, and other factors. The EFC is neither legally guaranteed nor universally offered: our model identifies the set of families that are disproportionately likely to not provide their full EFC. Using a common proxy for financial aid, we show, in data from the Health and Retirement Study, that financial aid increases the educational attainment of children whose families are more likely than others to underinvest in education. Financial aid has no effect on the educational attainment of children in other families. The theory and empirical evidence identifies a set of children who face quantitatively important borrowing constraints for higher education.

10.1093/restud/rdr032.abstractZh: 我们讨论了一个简单的模型，在这个模型中，父母和子女会在子女的教育以及其他方面进行投资，父母还可以向子女转移现金。我们指出，对于一组可识别的亲子对来说，父母会理性地减少子女教育的投资。对于这些亲子对而言，额外的经济援助会提升子女的教育水平。该模型强调了高等教育融资的一个重要特征，即“预期家庭贡献”，这一指标基于收入、资产和其他因素。预期家庭贡献既不是法律上的保障，也不是普遍提供的：我们的模型指出了那些不太可能提供全部预期家庭贡献的家庭群体。通过使用一个通用的经济援助指标，我们根据“健康与退休研究”的数据表明，对于那些更有可能减少教育投资的家庭来说，经济援助确实提升了子女的教育水平。而对于其他家庭中的子女来说，经济援助对教育水平则没有显著影响。理论和实证证据都表明，有一组子女面临着在高等教育方面的重要借贷限制。

abstract.text: The Ricardian model predicts that countries should produce and export relatively more in industries in which they are relatively more productive. Though one of the most celebrated insights in the theory of international trade, this prediction has received little attention in the empirical literature since the mid-1960s. The main reason behind this lack of popularity is the absence of clear theoretical foundations to guide the empirical analysis. Building on the seminal work of Eaton and Kortum (“Technology, Geography, and Trade”, Econometrica, 70, 1741–1779 2002), we offer such foundations and use them to quantify the importance of Ricardian comparative advantage. In the process, we also provide a theoretically consistent alternative to Balassa's (1965, “An Empirical Demonstration of Classical Comparative Cost Theory”, Review of Economics and Statistics, 45, 231–238) well-known index of “revealed comparative advantage”.

10.1093/restud/rdr033.abstractZh: 李嘉图模型预测，各国应该在其相对更具生产能力的行业中生产并出口更多的产品。尽管这一理论是国际贸易理论中最著名的见解之一，但自20世纪60年代中期以来，这一预测在实证文献中却鲜受关注。造成这种忽视的主要原因是缺乏明确的理论基础来指导实证分析。基于Eaton和Kortum的开创性研究（《技术、地理与贸易》，Econometrica，70卷，1741-1779页，2002年），我们提出了这样的理论基础，并利用这些理论来量化李嘉图比较优势的重要性。在此过程中，我们还提供了一种理论上与Balassa（1965年，《古典比较成本理论的实证验证》，经济与统计评论，45卷，231-238页）提出的“显性比较优势”指数相一致的替代方案。

abstract.text: The optimal design of low-income support is examined using a structural labour supply model. The approach incorporates unobserved heterogeneity, fixed costs of work, childcare costs and the detailed non-convexities of the tax and transfer system. The analysis considers purely Pareto improving reforms and also optimal design under social welfare functions with different degrees of inequality aversion. We explore the gains from tagging and also examine the case for the use of hours-contingent payments. Using the tax schedule for lone parents in the U.K. as our policy environment, the results point to a reformed non-linear tax schedule with tax credits only optimal for low earners. The results also suggest a welfare improving role for tagging according to child age and for hours-contingent payments, although the case for the latter is mitigated when hours cannot be monitored or recorded accurately by the tax authorities.

10.1093/restud/rdr034.abstractZh: 本文采用结构性劳动力供给模型，探讨了低收入支持的最优设计问题。该模型考虑了未观测的异质性、工作的固定成本、育儿成本以及税收和转移支付系统的非凸特性。分析不仅涵盖了纯粹的帕累托改进性改革，还考虑了在不同不平等厌恶程度下的最优设计。我们探讨了标记制度带来的收益，并研究了按工作时长支付报酬的情况。以英国单亲家庭的税收制度为政策背景，研究结果表明，只有包含税收抵免的非线性税收制度才适合低收入人群。研究结果还表明，根据儿童年龄实施标记制度以及按工作时长支付报酬能够提升福利水平，不过当税务机关无法准确监控或记录工作时长时，后一种方案的效果会减弱。

abstract.text: The game-theoretic literature on collusion has been hard pressed to explain why a cartel should engage in price wars, without resorting to either impatience, symmetry restrictions, inability to communicate, or failure to optimize. This paper introduces a new explanation that relies on none of these assumptions: if the cartel's member firms have private information about their costs, price wars can be optimal in the face of complexity. Specifically, equilibria that are robust to pay-off irrelevant disruptions of the information environment generically cannot attain or approximate efficiency. An optimal robust equilibrium must allocate market shares inefficiently and may call for price wars under certain conditions. For a two-firm cartel, cost interdependence is a sufficient condition for price wars to arise in an optimal robust equilibrium. That optimal equilibria are inefficient generically applies not only to collusion games but also to the entire separable pay-off environment—a class that includes most typical economic models.

10.1093/restud/rdr035.abstractZh: 关于勾结的博弈论文献难以解释为何卡特尔会参与价格战，而不需要借助急躁、对称性限制、沟通障碍或优化失败等假设。本文提出了一种新的解释，该解释不依赖上述任何假设：如果卡特尔成员企业拥有关于自身成本的私人信息，那么在复杂环境下，价格战可能是最优的。具体来说，对于信息环境中的无关紧要干扰，能够保持稳定的均衡通常无法实现或接近最优效率。在某些条件下，最优的稳健均衡可能会导致不有效的市场份额分配，并可能需要价格战。对于两家企业的卡特尔来说，成本相互依赖是价格战在最优稳健均衡中出现的充分条件。这种最优均衡通常是不有效的，这不仅适用于勾结博弈，也适用于整个可分离收益环境——这一类别包括大多数典型的经济模型。

abstract.text: We develop a model in which the capital of the intermediary sector plays a critical role in determining asset prices. The model is cast within a dynamic general equilibrium economy, and the role for intermediation is derived endogenously based on optimal contracting considerations. Low intermediary capital reduces the risk-bearing capacity of the marginal investor. We show how this force helps to explain patterns during financial crises. The model replicates the observed rise during crises in Sharpe ratios, conditional volatility, correlation in price movements of assets held by the intermediary sector, and fall in riskless interest rates.

10.1093/restud/rdr036.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，在该模型中，中介部门的资本在决定资产价格方面起着关键作用。该模型建立在动态一般均衡经济框架内，中介作用是基于最优契约考虑而内生产生的。较低的中介资本会降低边际投资者的风险承担能力。我们展示了这一因素如何有助于解释金融危机期间出现的现象。该模型再现了危机期间观察到的夏普比率、条件波动性、中介部门持有的资产价格变动相关性以及无风险利率下降等现象。

abstract.text: We model a long-run relationship as an infinitely repeated game played by two equally patient agents. In each period, the agents play an extensive-form stage game of perfect information with either locally non-conflicting interests or strictly conflicting interests. There is incomplete information about the type of Player 1, while Player 2's type is commonly known. We show that a sufficiently patient Player 1 can leverage Player 2's uncertainty about his type to secure his highest pay-off, compatible with Player 2's individual rationality, in any perfect Bayesian equilibrium of the repeated game.

10.1093/restud/rdr037.abstractZh: 我们将长期关系建模为一个无限重复博弈，由两个同样有耐心的参与者进行。在每个时期，参与者都会进行一个完全信息的扩展形式阶段博弈，其中一方的利益要么局部不冲突，要么严格冲突。关于玩家1的类型信息是不完整的，而玩家2的类型则是众所周知的。我们证明，一个足够有耐心的玩家1可以利用玩家2对其类型的不确定性，在重复博弈的任何完美贝叶斯均衡中，获得与玩家2的个体理性相容的最高收益。

abstract.text: Why is it difficult to restructure sovereign debt in a timely manner? In this paper, we present a theory of the sovereign debt-restructuring process in which delay arises as individual creditors hold up a settlement in order to extract greater payments from the sovereign. We then use the theory to analyse recent policy proposals aimed at ensuring equal repayment of creditor claims. Strikingly, we show that such collective action policies may increase delay by encouraging free riding on negotiation costs, even while preventing hold-up and reducing total negotiation costs. A calibrated version of the model can account for observed delays and finds that free riding is quantitatively relevant: whereas in simple low-cost debt-restructuring operations, collective mechanisms will reduce delay by more than 60%, in high-cost complicated restructurings, the adoption of such mechanisms results in a doubling of delay.

10.1093/restud/rdr038.abstractZh: 为何及时重组主权债务如此困难？本文提出了一种关于主权债务重组过程的理论，其中延迟现象的出现是由于个别债权人为了从主权政府那里获得更多回报而拖延结算。我们运用这一理论来分析近期旨在确保债权人债权平等偿还的政策提案。有趣的是，我们发现这类集体行动政策可能会通过鼓励利用谈判成本来延长延迟时间，同时还能防止操纵行为并降低总谈判成本。经过调整的模型可以解释观察到的延迟现象，并发现利用谈判成本的行为具有显著的负面影响：在简单的低成本债务重组操作中，集体机制可以将延迟时间减少60%以上；而在成本高昂的复杂债务重组中，采用此类机制反而会导致延迟时间翻倍。

abstract.text: This paper analyses the possibility and the consequences of rational bubbles in a dynamic economy where financially constrained firms demand and supply liquidity. Bubbles are more likely to emerge, the scarcer the supply of outside liquidity and the more limited the pledgeability of corporate income; they crowd investment in (out) when liquidity is abundant (scarce). We analyse extensions with firm heterogeneity and stochastic bubbles.

10.1093/restud/rdr039.abstractZh: 本文分析了在动态经济中，财务受限的企业在需求与供应流动性时，理性泡沫出现的可能性及其后果。外部流动性的供应越稀缺，企业收入的质押能力越有限，泡沫出现的可能性就越大；而当流动性充裕时，这些泡沫会挤占其他投资。我们还分析了包含企业异质性和随机泡沫的扩展情况。

abstract.text: We investigate the dynamics of prices, information, and expectations in a competitive, noisy, dynamic asset pricing equilibrium model with long-term investors. We argue that the fact that prices can score worse or better than consensus opinion in predicting the fundamentals is a product of endogenous short-term speculation. For a given positive level of residual pay-off uncertainty, if liquidity trades display low persistence, rational investors act like market makers and accommodate the order flow and prices are farther away from fundamentals compared to consensus. This defines a “Keynesian” region; the complementary region is “Hayekian” in that rational investors chase the trend and prices are systematically closer to fundamentals than average expectations. The standard case of no residual uncertainty and liquidity trading following a random walk is on the frontier of the two regions and identifies the set of deep parameters for which rational investors abide by Keynes' dictum of concentrating on an asset “long-term prospects and those only”. The analysis also explains momentum and reversal in stock returns and how accommodation and trend-chasing strategies differ from these phenomena.

10.1093/restud/rdr040.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有长期投资者的竞争性、噪声性、动态资产定价均衡模型中价格、信息和预期的动态变化。我们认为，价格在预测基本面时可能比共识意见表现得更好或更差，这是短期投机行为的结果。在剩余收益不确定性的一定水平下，如果流动性交易的持续性较低，理性投资者就会像市场做市商一样调整订单流，导致价格与基本面的差距大于共识预期。这就定义了一个“凯恩斯主义”区域；另一个区域则属于“哈耶克主义”，即理性投资者追逐趋势，价格系统性地更接近基本面。在没有剩余不确定性且流动性交易遵循随机游走的标准情况下，理性投资者遵循凯恩斯关于专注于资产“长期前景”的原则。该分析还解释了股票回报的波动性和反转现象，以及调整策略和追逐趋势策略与这些现象之间的关系。

abstract.text: The classic model of Becker (1965, “A Theory of the Allocation of Time”, Economic Journal, 125, 493–517) suggests that labour supply decisions should be analysed within the broader context of time allocation and market good consumption choices, but most empirical work on policy has focused exclusively on measuring impacts on market work. This paper examines how income taxes affect time allocation during the entire day and how these time allocation decisions interact with expenditure patterns. Using the Panel Study of Income Dynamics from 1975 to 2004, we analyse the response of single women's housework, labour supply, and other time to variation in tax and transfer schedules across income levels, number of children, states, and time. We find that when the economic reward to participating in the labour force increases, market work increases and housework decreases, with the decrease in housework accounting for approximately two-thirds of the increase in market work. Analysis of repeated cross sections of time diary data from 1975 to 2004 shows that “home production” decreases substantially when market hours of work increase in response to policy changes. Data on expenditures show some evidence that expenditures on market goods likely to substitute for housework increase in response to a greater incentive to join the labour force. The baseline estimates imply that the elasticity of substitution between consumption of home and market goods is 2·61. The results are consistent with the Becker model. Meanwhile, single men show little response to changes in tax policy, and we are able to rule out an elasticity of substitution between home and market goods for this group of more than 1·66.

10.1093/restud/rdr041.abstractZh: Becker在1965年的经典论文《时间分配理论》中提出，劳动力供给决策应放在时间分配和市场商品消费选择的更广泛背景下进行分析。然而，大多数关于政策的实证研究仅关注对市场工作的影响进行衡量。本文探讨了所得税如何影响全天的时间分配，以及这些时间分配决策如何与支出模式相互作用。我们利用1975至2004年的收入动态面板研究数据，分析了单身女性家务劳动、劳动力供给及其他时间分配对税收和转移支付变化的不同反应，这些变化涉及收入水平、子女数量、州别以及时间因素。研究发现，当参与劳动力市场的经济回报增加时，市场工作会增加，而家务劳动则会减少，其中家务劳动的减少贡献了市场工作增加量的大约三分之二。对1975至2004年间重复横截面时间日记数据的分析表明，随着政策变化导致工作时间增加，家庭生产活动显著减少。支出数据表明，随着加入劳动力市场的激励增加，用于市场商品的支出也可能增加。基线估计显示，家庭商品与市场商品之间的替代弹性为2.61。这些结果与Becker模型一致。与此同时，单身男性对税收政策变化的反应很小，我们排除了这一群体家庭商品与市场商品之间替代弹性的可能性，该群体的替代弹性低于1.66。

abstract.text: Starting in the 1970's, wage inequality and the number of hours worked by employed U.S. prime-age male workers have both increased. We argue that these two facts are related. We use a labour market model with on-the-job search where by working longer hours individuals acquire greater skills. Since job candidates are ranked by productivity, greater skills not only increase worker's productivity in the current job but also help the worker to obtain better jobs. When job offers become more dispersed, wage inequality increases and workers work longer hours to obtain better jobs. As a result, average hours per worker in the economy increase. This mechanism accounts for around two-thirds of the increase in hours observed in data. Part of the increase is inefficient since workers obtain better jobs at the expense of other workers competing for the same jobs.

10.1093/restud/rdr042.abstractZh: 自20世纪70年代起，美国成年男性工人的工资不平等程度以及工作小时数均有所上升。我们认为这两个现象之间存在关联。我们采用了一个包含在职搜寻机制的劳动力市场模型，根据该模型，工作时间越长，个人的技能水平就越高。由于求职者是根据生产力进行排名的，更高的技能不仅提升了当前工作的生产效率，还能帮助工人获得更好的工作机会。当工作机会变得更加分散时，工资不平等程度加剧，工人为了获得更好的工作机会而延长工作时间。因此，整个经济中每个工人的平均工作时间增加。这一机制解释了数据中观察到的工作时间增加约三分之二的原因。部分增加是低效的，因为工人获得了更好的工作机会，而牺牲了其他竞争相同工作的工人的利益。

abstract.text: We investigate the choice of the bandwidth for the regression discontinuity estimator. We focus on estimation by local linear regression, which was shown to have attractive properties (Porter, J. 2003, “Estimation in the Regression Discontinuity Model” (unpublished, Department of Economics, University of Wisconsin, Madison)). We derive the asymptotically optimal bandwidth under squared error loss. This optimal bandwidth depends on unknown functionals of the distribution of the data and we propose simple and consistent estimators for these functionals to obtain a fully data-driven bandwidth algorithm. We show that this bandwidth estimator is optimal according to the criterion of Li (1987, “Asymptotic Optimality for Cp, CL, Cross-validation and Generalized Cross-validation: Discrete Index Set”, Annals of Statistics, 15, 958–975), although it is not unique in the sense that alternative consistent estimators for the unknown functionals would lead to bandwidth estimators with the same optimality properties. We illustrate the proposed bandwidth, and the sensitivity to the choices made in our algorithm, by applying the methods to a data set previously analysed by Lee (2008, “Randomized Experiments from Non-random Selection in U.S. House Elections”, Journal of Econometrics, 142, 675–697) as well as by conducting a small simulation study.

10.1093/restud/rdr043.abstractZh: 我们研究了回归不连续估计量带宽的选择问题。我们重点关注局部线性回归估计方法，该方法已被证明具有吸引人的特性（Porter, J. 2003，《回归不连续模型中的估计》（未发表，威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校经济系））。我们在平方误差损失下推导了渐近最优带宽。这个最优带宽取决于数据分布的未知函数，我们提出了简单且一致的估计量来估计这些函数，从而得到一个完全基于数据的带宽算法。我们证明，根据Li（1987，《Cp、CL、交叉验证和广义交叉验证的渐近最优性：离散索引集》，统计年鉴，15，958–975）的标准，这个带宽估计量是最优的，尽管它并不是唯一的，因为对于未知函数的其他一致估计量也会得到具有相同最优性质的带宽估计量。我们通过将所提出的方法应用于Lee（2008，《美国众议院选举中非随机选择的随机实验》，计量经济学杂志，142，675–697）之前分析过的数据集，以及进行一个小规模的模拟研究，来说明所提出的带宽算法以及其对算法选择的敏感性。

abstract.text: We study the identification of panel models with linear individual-specific coefficients when T is fixed. We show identification of the variance of the effects under conditional uncorrelatedness. Identification requires restricted dependence of errors, reflecting a trade-off between heterogeneity and error dynamics. We show identification of the probability distribution of individual effects when errors follow an Autoregressive Moving Average process under conditional independence. We discuss Generalized Method of Moments estimation of moments of effects and errors and construct non-parametric estimators of their densities. As an application, we estimate the effect that a mother smoking during pregnancy has on her child's birth weight.

10.1093/restud/rdr045.abstractZh: 我们研究了在T固定的情况下，具有线性个体特定系数的面板模型的识别问题。我们证明了在条件不相关的情况下，效应方差的识别问题。识别要求误差具有限制性依赖关系，这反映了异质性与误差动态之间的权衡。我们还证明了在条件独立的情况下，当误差遵循自回归移动平均过程时，个体效应概率分布的识别问题。我们讨论了效应和误差矩的广义矩估计方法，并构建了它们密度的非参数估计器。作为应用案例，我们估计了母亲在怀孕期间吸烟对其孩子出生体重的影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies gender interactions within hierarchical organizations using a large data set on the duration of Italian municipal governments elected between 1993 and 2003. A municipal government can be viewed as a hierarchy, whose stability over time depends on the degree of cooperation between and within ranks. We find that in municipalities headed by female mayors, the probability of early termination of the legislature is higher. This result persists and becomes stronger when we control for municipality fixed effects as well as for non-random sorting of women into municipalities using regression discontinuity in gender-mixed electoral races decided by a narrow margin. The likelihood that a female mayor survives until the end of her term is lowest when the council is entirely male and in regions with less favourable attitudes towards working women. This evidence is suggestive that group dynamics are an important factor in driving the gender difference. Other interpretations receive less support in the data. Our results may provide an alternative explanation for the underrepresentation of women in leadership positions.

10.1093/restud/rdr046.abstractZh: 本文利用1993至2003年间意大利市政政府任期数据，研究了层级组织中性别互动的现象。可以将市政政府视为一个层级结构，其长期稳定性取决于不同层级之间以及内部成员之间的合作程度。研究发现，由女性市长领导的市政政府，其立法机构提前终止的可能性更高。这一结果在控制了市政政府固定效应以及通过回归不连续性分析女性在不同市政政府中的非随机排序后，依然成立且更为显著。女性市长在委员会完全由男性组成或所在地区对女性工作者的态度较为不利的情况下，能够坚持到任期结束的可能性最低。这些证据表明，群体动态是推动性别差异的重要因素。其他解释在数据中获得的支持则较少。我们的研究结果可能为解释女性在领导职位中代表性不足的问题提供另一种解释。

abstract.text: We propose a new inverse probability weighting (IPW) estimator for moment condition models with missing data. Our estimator is easy to implement and compares favourably with existing IPW estimators, including augmented IPW estimators, in terms of efficiency, robustness, and higher-order bias. We illustrate our method with a study of the relationship between early Black–White differences in cognitive achievement and subsequent differences in adult earnings. In our data set, the early childhood achievement measure, the main regressor of interest, is missing for many units.

10.1093/restud/rdr047.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的逆概率加权估计方法，适用于存在缺失数据的矩条件模型。我们的估计方法易于实施，在效率、稳健性以及高阶偏差方面，均优于现有的逆概率加权估计方法，包括增强型逆概率加权估计方法。我们通过一个研究案例来说明我们的方法，该案例探讨了认知成就的早期黑人与白人差异与后续成人收入差异之间的关系。在我们的数据集中，作为主要解释变量的早期儿童成就指标，在许多单位中缺失。

abstract.text: We examine the welfare effects of provision of local public goods in an empirically relevant setting using a multi-community model with mobile and heterogeneous households and with flexible housing supplies. We characterize the first-best allocation and show efficiency can be implemented with decentralization using head taxes. We calibrate the model and compare welfare in property-tax equilibria, both decentralized and centralized, to the efficient allocation. Inefficiencies with decentralization and property taxation are large, dissipating most if not all the potential welfare gains that efficient decentralization could achieve. In property-tax equilibrium, centralization is frequently more efficient! An externality in community choice underlies the failure to achieve efficiency with decentralization and property taxes: poorer households crowd richer communities and free ride by consuming relatively little housing thereby avoiding taxes.

10.1093/restud/rdr048.abstractZh: 我们在一个具有实证相关性的环境中，使用多社区模型来研究提供本地公共物品的福利效应。该模型包含流动性和异质性的家庭，以及灵活的住房供应。我们描述了最优分配方案，并表明通过采用人头税来实现分权可以提升效率。我们对模型进行了校准，并比较了在财产税均衡状态下，无论是分权还是集权，与高效分配方案相比的福利状况。结果表明，分权和财产税带来的效率低下非常显著，几乎消耗了高效分权可能带来的所有潜在福利收益。在财产税均衡状态下，集权往往更为高效！社区选择中的外部性是导致分权和财产税无法实现效率的原因：较贫困的家庭聚集在较富裕的社区，通过相对较少的住房消费来逃避税收。

abstract.text: We evaluate reforms to the U.S. tax system in a life cycle set-up with heterogeneous married and single households and with an operative extensive margin in labour supply. We restrict our model with observations on gender and skill premia, labour-force participation of married females across skill groups, children, and the structure of marital sorting. We concentrate on two revenue-neutral tax reforms: a proportional income tax and a reform in which married individuals file taxes separately (separate filing). Our findings indicate that tax reforms are accompanied by large increases in labour supply that differ across demographic groups, with the bulk of the increase coming from married females. Under a proportional income tax reform, married females account for more than 50% of the changes in hours across steady states, while under separate filing reform, married females account for all the change in hours.

10.1093/restud/rdr049.abstractZh: 我们评估了美国税收制度的改革，该改革是在一个生命周期框架下进行的，涉及不同情况的已婚家庭和单身家庭，且劳动力供应存在广泛的弹性。我们的模型受到关于性别和技能溢价、已婚女性在不同技能组中的劳动力参与率、子女数量以及婚姻选择结构等观测数据的限制。我们重点关注两项收入中性的税收改革：一种比例所得税改革，另一种是将已婚个人的纳税申报分开进行的改革。我们的研究发现，税收改革伴随着劳动力供应的大幅增加，这一增加在不同人口群体中表现不同，其中大部分增加来自已婚女性。在比例所得税改革下，已婚女性占稳态下工作时间变化的50%以上；而在分开申报改革下，所有工作时间的变化都由已婚女性承担。

abstract.text: The paper introduces the problem of unawareness into principal–agent theory and discusses optimal incentive contracts when the agent may be unaware of her action space. Depending on the agent's default behaviour, it can be optimal for the principal to propose an incomplete contract (that keeps the agent unaware) or a complete contract. The key trade-off is that of enlarging the agent's choice set versus adding costly incentive constraints. If agents differ in their unawareness, optimal contracts show a self-reinforcing pattern: if there are few unaware agents in the economy optimal contracts promote awareness, if unawareness is wide spread optimal contracts shroud the contracting environment, thus keeping the agent unaware.

10.1093/restud/rdr050.abstractZh: 本文探讨了主-代理理论中的无知问题，并讨论了当代理人可能不知道自己的行动空间时的最优激励契约。根据代理人的默认行为，委托人提出一个不完整的契约（使代理人保持无知）或一个完整的契约可能是最优的。关键的权衡在于扩大代理人的选择范围与增加昂贵的激励约束之间的平衡。如果代理人之间的无知程度不同，最优契约会呈现出自我强化的模式：如果经济中无知代理人较少，最优契约会促进认知；如果无知现象普遍存在，最优契约则会模糊契约环境，从而保持代理人处于无知状态。

abstract.text: I allow trading horizon heterogeneity across groups in a standard differential information model of a financial market. This approach can explain the well-established phenomenon that, after a public announcement, trading volume increases, more private information is incorporated into prices and volatility increases. In such environments, public information has the important secondary role of helping agents learn about the information of other agents. Therefore, whenever the correlation between the private information of different groups is sufficiently low, a public announcement increases disagreement among short-horizon traders regarding the expected selling price even as it decreases disagreement about the fundamental value of the asset. Additional testable implications are also suggested.

10.1093/restud/rdr051.abstractZh: 我在标准的金融市场差异信息模型中，允许不同群体之间的交易视界存在异质性。这种方法可以解释一个已确立的现象：在公开公告之后，交易量会增加，更多私人信息会被纳入价格中，波动性也会上升。在这种环境下，公开信息具有重要的辅助作用，帮助交易者了解其他交易者的信息。因此，只要不同群体之间的私人信息相关性足够低，公开公告就会增加短期交易者对于预期售价的分歧，同时减少他们对资产基本价值的分歧。此外，还提出了一些可验证的推论。

abstract.text: We study efficient non-linear taxation of labour and capital in a dynamic Mirrleesian model incorporating political economy constraints. Policies are chosen sequentially over time, without commitment. Our main result is that the marginal tax on capital income is progressive, in the sense that richer agents face higher marginal tax rates.

10.1093/restud/rds001.abstractZh: 我们研究了在包含政治经济约束的动态Mirrleesian模型中，对劳动力和资本进行高效的非线性征税问题。政策是随时间依次选择的，没有承诺性。我们的主要结论是，资本收入的边际税率是累进的，即较富裕的代理人面临的边际税率更高。

abstract.text: We study stationary discretionary equilibria in dynamic linear-quadratic rational expectations models. Past papers have assumed that this is uniquely determined; we show that such models can have multiple equilibria in some situations. We demonstrate the existence of multiple discretionary equilibria using a number of examples of increasing complexity and discuss their potential to explain interesting economic phenomena. We investigate the general properties of discretionary equilibria and discuss the design implications for the numerical algorithms needed to find them.

10.1093/restud/rds002.abstractZh: 我们研究了动态线性-二次理性预期模型中的静态自由裁量均衡。以往的研究假设这种均衡是唯一的；我们证明在某些情况下，这样的模型可能存在多个均衡。我们通过一系列复杂度逐渐增加的例子，证明了多个自由裁量均衡的存在，并讨论了它们解释有趣经济现象的潜力。我们还研究了自由裁量均衡的一般性质，并探讨了寻找这些均衡所需的数值算法的设计问题。

abstract.text: What determines which assets are used in transactions? We develop a framework where the extent to which assets are recognizable determines the extent to which they are acceptable in exchange—i.e. it determines their liquidity. Recognizability and liquidity are endogenized by allowing agents to invest in information. We analyse the effects of monetary policy. There can be multiple equilibria, with different transaction patterns, and these patterns are not invariant to policy. We show that small changes in information may generate large responses in asset prices, allocations, and welfare. We also discuss some issues in international economics, including exchange rates and dollarization.

10.1093/restud/rds003.abstractZh: 什么决定了在交易中使用哪些资产？我们提出了一个框架，其中资产的可识别程度决定了它们在交换中的可接受程度，即决定了它们的流动性。通过允许代理人投资于信息，可识别性和流动性被内生化。我们分析了货币政策的影响。可能存在多种均衡状态，这些状态具有不同的交易模式，而这些模式并不受政策的影响。我们表明，信息的微小变化可能会引发资产价格、资产配置和福利方面的巨大反应。我们还讨论了一些国际经济学中的问题，包括汇率和美元化。

abstract.text: We study the interactions among geographical mobility, unemployment and home- ownership in an economy with heterogeneous locations, endogenous construction and search frictions in the markets for both labour and housing. The decision of home- owners to accept job offers from other cities depends on how quickly they can sell their houses (i.e. their liquidity), which in turn depends on local labour market conditions. Consequently, home-owners accept job offers from other cities at a lower rate than do renters, generating a link between home-ownership and aggregate unemployment. When calibrated to match aggregate U.S. statistics on mobility, housing and labour flows, our model predicts that the effect of home-ownership on aggregate unemployment is small. When unemployment is high, however, changes in the rate of home-ownership can have economically significant effects.

10.1093/restud/rds004.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有异质地理位置、建筑市场和劳动力市场存在内生性搜寻摩擦的经济体中，地理流动性、失业与房屋所有权之间的相互作用。房屋所有权者是否接受其他城市的就业机会，取决于他们出售房屋的速度（即流动性），而这一速度又取决于当地劳动力市场状况。因此，房屋所有权者接受其他城市就业机会的意愿低于租房者，这导致了房屋所有权与总体失业之间存在关联。当我们的模型根据美国关于流动性、住房和劳动力流动的总体统计数据进行校准后，预测出房屋所有权对总体失业的影响较小。然而，在失业率较高的情况下，房屋所有权率的变化可能会产生显著的经济效应。

abstract.text: A buyer suggests prices to N sellers in a time period and buys from the seller who accepts the bid first. The number of bidding rounds is determined by how frequently the buyer can make an offer. We show that with no limit on the frequency and without discounting, the price path is either kept flat initially with large jumps at the end or increasing steadily over time. Which class of path occurs in equilibrium depends on the buyer's trade-off between committing to a price ceiling versus finely screening the sellers' costs. With discounting, limiting the number of rounds mitigates the delay caused by the reluctance to raise bids in the first class of equilibrium and therefore can benefit the buyer. This result suggests why, in reality, bargaining parties often take measures to make their offers rigid and consequently force themselves to make fewer offers.

10.1093/restud/rds005.abstractZh: 买家在一段时间内向N个卖家提出价格，并从首先接受报价的卖家处购买。出价轮数的多少取决于买家提出报价的频率。我们证明，在频率没有限制且不进行折扣的情况下，价格路径要么最初保持平稳，在最后出现大幅跳升，要么随时间稳步上升。在均衡状态下出现哪种路径取决于买家在设定价格上限与仔细评估卖家成本之间的权衡。如果进行折扣处理并限制出价轮数，就可以缓解第一类均衡状态下因不愿提高出价而导致的延迟，从而有利于买家。这一结果解释了为什么在现实中，谈判双方通常会采取措施使自己的报价具有刚性，从而减少出价的次数。

abstract.text: We study the behavioural foundation of interdependent preferences, where the outcomes of others affect the welfare of the decision maker. These preferences are taken as given, not derived from more primitive ones. Our aim is to establish an axiomatic foundation providing the link between observation of choices and a functional representation which is convenient, free of inconsistencies and can provide the basis for measurement. The dependence among preferences may take place in two conceptually different ways, expressing two different views of the nature of interdependent preferences. The first is Festinger's view that the evaluation of peers' outcomes is useful to improve individual choices by learning from the comparison. The second is Veblen's view that interdependent preferences keep track of social status derived from a social value attributed to the goods one consumes. Corresponding to these two different views, we have two different formulations. In the first, the decision maker values his outcomes and those of others on the basis of his own utility. In the second, he ranks outcomes according to a social value function. We give different axiomatic foundations to these two different, but complementary, views of the nature of the interdependence. On the basis of this axiomatic foundation, we build a behavioural theory of comparative statics within subjects and across subjects. We characterize preferences according to the relative importance assigned to gains and losses in social domain, that is pride and envy. This parallels the standard analysis of private gains and losses (as well as that of regret and relief). We give an axiomatic foundation of interpersonal comparison of preferences, ordering individuals according to their sensitivity to social ranking. These characterizations provide the behavioural foundation for applied analysis of market and game equilibria with interdependent preferences.

10.1093/restud/rds006.abstractZh: 我们研究了相互依赖偏好行为基础，其中他人的结果会影响决策者的福利。这些偏好被视为既定的，而不是从更基本的偏好中衍生出来的。我们的目标是建立一个公理基础，将选择的观察与方便、无矛盾且能够作为测量基础的职能表示联系起来。偏好之间的依赖可能以两种概念上不同的方式发生，表达了相互依赖偏好本质的两种不同观点。第一种是费斯廷格的观点，即评估同伴的结果有助于通过比较来改进个人选择。第二种是维布伦的观点，即相互依赖的偏好记录了从个人消费的商品所赋予的社会价值中得出的社会地位。对应于这两种不同的观点，我们有两种不同的表述方式。在第一种方式中，决策者根据自己的效用来评估自己的结果以及他人的结果。在第二种方式中，他根据社会价值函数对结果进行排序。我们为这两种不同但互补的观点提供了不同的公理基础。基于这一公理基础，我们构建了一个关于个体内部和个体之间比较静态行为的理论。我们根据社会领域中收益和损失的相对重要性来表征偏好，即自豪感和嫉妒感。这与对私人收益和损失的常规分析（以及对遗憾和宽慰的分析）是平行的。我们为人际偏好比较提供了一个公理基础，根据个体对社会排名的敏感性来排序个体。这些描述为应用分析具有相互依赖偏好下的市场与博弈均衡提供了行为基础。

abstract.text: A search-theoretic model of the retail market for illegal drugs is developed. Trade occurs in bilateral, potentially long-lived matches between sellers and buyers. Buyers incur search costs when experimenting with a new seller. Moral hazard is present because buyers learn purity only after a trade is made. This model is consistent with some new stylized facts about the drugs market, and it is informative for policy design. The effectiveness of different enforcement strategies is evaluated, including some novel ones that leverage the moral hazard present in the market.

10.1093/restud/rds007.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个关于非法药物零售市场的搜索理论模型。交易发生在卖方和买方之间的双边、可能持续较长时间的匹配关系中。买方在尝试与新的卖方进行交易时会产生搜索成本。由于买方只有在交易完成后才能了解产品的纯度，因此存在道德风险。该模型与一些关于药物市场的新颖现象相符，并为政策设计提供了参考。文中还评估了不同执法策略的有效性，包括一些利用市场中存在的道德风险的新策略。

abstract.text: This paper studies the self-sufficiency project (SSP), a controlled randomized experiment concerning welfare, by estimating a model of endogenous skill accumulation, multidimensional job opportunities, and time-varying opportunity costs of labour market time. Methods for estimating dynamic programming models with unobserved heterogeneity are extended to account for unexpected policy interventions and endogenous sample selection and initial conditions. Parameters are identified and consistently estimated by imposing optimal responses to the exact form of the SSP earnings supplement and the experimental program, which induces exogenous variation between treatment groups and within groups as treatment progresses. The estimated model tracks primary outcomes well in and out of sample, except for underestimating trends in the sample of new welfare applicants. Predictions from counterfactual experiments run counter to non-structural results reported elsewhere, and they suggest that details of the SSP's design are critical for interpretation of results. The separate SSP Plus treatment may have longer lasting and more generalized impacts than the in-sample impacts suggest.

10.1093/restud/rds008.abstractZh: 本文研究了自给自足项目（SSP），这是一个关于福利的对照随机实验，通过构建内生技能积累、多维度就业机会以及劳动力市场时间变化的机会成本模型来进行分析。文中扩展了动态规划模型的估计方法，以处理意外的政策干预以及内生性的样本选择和初始条件。通过对SSP收入补充和实验程序的确切形式施加最优响应，参数得以识别并一致估计。随着实验的进行，实验组之间及组内的外生变化被引入。估计的模型在样本内外都能很好地追踪主要结果，除了对新福利申请者样本的趋势估计有所低估。反事实实验的预测结果与其他研究报告的结论相悖，这表明SSP设计的细节对于结果的解释至关重要。单独的SSP Plus处理组可能具有比样本内影响更为持久和广泛的影响。

abstract.text: This paper develops new recursive, set based methods for studying repeated games with private monitoring. For any finite-state strategy profile, we find necessary and sufficient conditions for whether there exists a distribution over initial states such that the strategy, together with this distribution, form a correlated sequential equilibrium (CSE). Also, for any given correlation device for determining initial states (including degenerate cases where players' initial states are common knowledge), we provide necessary and sufficient conditions for the correlation device and strategy to be a CSE, or in the case of a degenerate correlation device, for the strategy to be a sequential equilibrium. We also consider several applications. In these, we show that the methods are computationally feasible, and how to construct and verify equilibria in a secret price-setting game.

10.1093/restud/rds009.abstractZh: 本文提出了新的递归性、基于集合的方法，用于研究具有私人监控的重复博弈。对于任何有限状态策略组合，我们找到了存在一种初始状态分布的条件，使得该策略与这种分布共同构成相关序贯均衡（CSE）的充分必要条件。此外，对于任何给定的确定初始状态的关联装置（包括玩家初始状态为公共知识的退化情况），我们提供了该关联装置和策略构成相关序贯均衡的充要条件，或者在退化关联装置的情况下，提供了策略构成序贯均衡的充要条件。我们还考虑了几种应用案例，在这些案例中，我们证明了这些方法在计算上是可行的，并介绍了如何构建和验证秘密定价博弈中的均衡。

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of interstate highways on the growth of U.S. cities between 1983 and 2003. We find that a 10% increase in a city's initial stock of highways causes about a 1.5% increase in its employment over this 20 year period. To estimate a structural model of urban growth and transportation, we rely on an instrumental variables estimation that uses a 1947 plan of the interstate highway system, an 1898 map of railroads, and maps of the early explorations of the U.S. as instruments for 1983 highways.

10.1093/restud/rds010.abstractZh: 我们估算了州际高速公路对美国城市增长的影响，时间跨度为1983年至2003年。研究发现，一个城市初始高速公路数量增加10%，在这20年间其就业率会相应增加约1.5%。为了构建城市增长和交通发展的结构模型，我们采用了一种工具变量估计方法，该方法以1947年的州际高速公路系统规划、1898年的铁路地图以及美国早期探索的地图作为1983年高速公路数据的工具变量。

abstract.text: Consumers respond positively to products tied to charity, particularly from sellers that are relatively new and hence have limited alternative means of assuring quality. We establish this result using data from a diverse group of eBay sellers who “experiment” with charity by varying the presence of a donation in a set of otherwise matched product listings. Most of charity's benefits accrue to sellers without extensive eBay histories. Consistent with charity serving as a quality signal, we find fewer customer complaints among charity-intensive sellers.

10.1093/restud/rds012.abstractZh: 消费者对与慈善相关的产品表现出积极的反应，尤其是来自相对较新的卖家的产品，因为这些卖家缺乏其他方式来保证产品质量。我们通过一组在eBay上销售产品的卖家的数据来验证这一结果，这些卖家通过改变产品列表中是否包含捐赠信息来“试验”慈善元素。大多数慈善相关的好处都归给了那些在eBay上没有太多销售经验的卖家。与慈善作为质量信号的观点一致，我们发现使用慈善元素的卖家遇到的客户投诉较少。

abstract.text: We study the effects of positive steady-state inflation in New Keynesian models subject to the zero bound on interest rates. We derive the utility-based welfare loss function taking into account the effects of positive steady-state inflation and solve for the optimal level of inflation in the model. For plausible calibrations with costly but infrequent episodes at the zero lower bound, the optimal inflation rate is low, typically <2% even after considering a variety of extensions, including optimal stabilization policy, price indexation, endogenous and state-dependent price stickiness, capital formation, model uncertainty, and downward nominal wage rigidities. On the normative side, price-level targeting delivers large welfare gains and a very low optimal inflation rate consistent with price stability. These results suggest that raising the inflation target is too blunt an instrument to efficiently reduce the severe costs of zero bound episodes.

10.1093/restud/rds013.abstractZh: 我们研究了在利率零下限约束下的新凯恩斯主义模型中，正向稳态通胀的影响。我们推导了基于效用的福利损失函数，同时考虑了正向稳态通胀的影响，并求解了模型中的最优通胀水平。对于在零下限存在成本高但频率低的事件的情况下，最优通胀率较低，通常低于2%。即使考虑各种扩展因素，包括最优稳定政策、价格指数化、内生性和状态依赖性的价格粘性、资本形成、模型不确定性以及名义工资的向下刚性，最优通胀率仍然较低。从规范性的角度来看，价格水平目标设定能够带来巨大的福利收益，并且最优通胀率非常低，这与价格稳定是一致的。这些结果表明，提高通胀目标并不是一个有效的工具，无法有效降低零下限事件带来的严重成本。

abstract.text: This paper studies the long-run properties of intertemporal distortions in a broad class of second-best economies. Our unified framework encompasses and extends many well-known models, such as variants of the Ramsey taxation model with aggregate or idiosyncratic risk, and economies with incentive compatibility constraints due to limited commitment, political economy, self-enforcement or private information, or combinations of these. We identify a sufficient condition that rules out permanent intertemporal distortions: if there exists an allocation that satisfies all constraints and eventually converges to the limiting first-best allocation, then intertemporal distortions are temporary in the second best. This result uncovers a common optimality principle linking the intertemporal allocation of resources with the ability to front-load distortions for this broad class of environments. A series of applications illustrates the significance of these findings.

10.1093/restud/rds014.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类次优经济体内跨时滞扭曲的长期特性。我们的统一框架涵盖了众多知名模型，例如带有总体风险或特定风险的拉姆齐税收模型的变体，以及因有限承诺、政治经济、自我执行或私人信息限制，或这些因素的组合而产生的激励相容性约束的经济体。我们确定了一个充分条件，可以排除永久性跨时滞扭曲的存在：如果存在一个满足所有约束并最终收敛到极限次优配置的分配，那么跨时滞扭曲在次优状态下是暂时的。这一结果揭示了一个共同的最优性原则，即跨时滞资源分配能力与这种环境下提前实施扭曲的能力之间存在联系。一系列应用案例说明了这些发现的重要性。

abstract.text: We analyse political contests (campaigns) between two parties with opposing interests. Parties provide costly information to voters who choose a policy. The information flow is continuous and stops when both parties quit. Parties' actions are strategic substitutes: increasing one party's cost makes that party provide more and its opponent provide less information. For voters, parties' actions are complements and hence raising the advantaged party's cost may be beneficial. Asymmetric information adds a signalling component resulting in a belief threshold at which the informed party's decision to continue campaigning offsets other unfavourable information.

10.1093/restud/rds017.abstractZh: 我们分析了两个利益对立的政党之间的政治竞争（竞选活动）。各政党向选民提供 costly 的信息，选民则根据这些信息选择政策。信息流动是持续的，当两方都退出时才会停止。各政党的行为属于战略性替代：增加某一政党的成本会使其提供更多信息，而对手则提供较少信息。对于选民而言，各政党的行为是互补的，因此提高优势政党的成本可能有益。信息不对称还增加了信号传递的成分，导致存在一个信念阈值，在该阈值下，知情政党继续竞选的决定会抵消其他不利信息的影响。

abstract.text: This article examines the choice of hospital for elective hip replacements amongst patients in England, using patient‐episode level data from the Hospital Episodes Statistics records. The article is primarily methodological: we estimate a demand model that allows for heterogeneity across observed patient characteristics and demonstrate how to use this model to simulate the effect of mergers between hospitals. Our article contributes to the empirical literature on hospital choice and provides a novel method for simulating mergers between hospitals with regulated prices. Importantly, in an industry that competes on quality, our demand model estimations also identify important quality dimensions of choice.

10.1111/j.1468-0297.2012.02496.x.abstractZh: 本文利用《医院事件统计记录》中的患者事件级数据，研究了英格兰患者在选择择期髋关节置换手术时医院的选择情况。本文主要属于方法论范畴：我们建立了一个需求模型，该模型能够考虑不同患者特征之间的异质性，并展示了如何利用该模型模拟医院合并的影响。我们的研究为医院选择领域的实证文献做出了贡献，并提供了一种模拟具有管制价格下的医院合并的新方法。重要的是，在一个以质量为竞争焦点的行业中，我们的需求模型估计还揭示了选择过程中重要的质量维度。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: To test the accuracy of alternative estimators of hospital mortality quality using a Monte Carlo simulation experiment. DATA SOURCES: Data are simulated to create an admission-level analytic dataset. The simulated data are validated by comparing distributional parameters (e.g., mean and standard deviation of 30-day mortality rate, hospital sample size) with the same parameters observed in Medicare data for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) inpatient admissions. STUDY DESIGN: We perform a Monte Carlo simulation experiment in which true quality is known to test the accuracy of the Observed-over-Expected estimator, the Risk Standardized Mortality Rate (RSMR), the Dimick and Staiger (DS) estimator, the Hierarchical Poisson estimator, and the Moving Average estimator using hospital 30-day mortality for AMI as the outcome. Estimator accuracy is evaluated for all hospitals and for small, medium, and large hospitals. DATA EXTRACTION METHODS: Data are simulated. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: Significant and substantial variation is observed in the accuracy of the tested outcome estimators. The DS estimator is the most accurate for all hospitals and for small hospitals using both accuracy criteria (root mean squared error and proportion of hospitals correctly classified into quintiles). CONCLUSIONS: The mortality estimator currently in use by Medicare for public quality reporting, the RSMR, has been shown to be less accurate than the DS estimator, although the magnitude of the difference is not large. Pending testing and validation of our findings using current hospital data, CMS should reconsider the decision to publicly report mortality rates using the RSMR.

10.1111/j.1475-6773.2012.01382.x.abstractZh:
目的：通过蒙特卡洛模拟实验来检验医院死亡率质量的其他估计方法的准确性。  
数据来源：数据通过模拟生成，以创建入院级别的分析数据集。通过比较模拟数据的分布参数（如30天死亡率的平均值和标准差、医院样本量）与医疗保险数据中急性心肌梗塞住院患者的相同参数，来验证模拟数据的准确性。  
研究设计：我们进行了蒙特卡洛模拟实验，在已知真实质量的情况下，测试了观测值相对于预期值的估计方法、风险标准化死亡率（RSMR）、Dimick和Staiger（DS）估计方法、层次泊松估计方法以及移动平均估计方法的准确性。评估了所有医院以及小型、中型和大型医院的估计方法准确性。  
数据提取方法：数据通过模拟生成。  
主要发现：测试结果的估计方法在准确性上存在显著且明显的差异。对于所有医院以及小型医院而言，DS估计方法是最准确的，无论是在两种准确性标准（均方根误差和正确分类到五分位数的医院比例）下都是如此。  
结论：目前医疗保险用于公共质量报告中的死亡率估计方法——RSMR，其准确性低于DS估计方法，尽管差异并不大。在利用当前医院数据对研究结果进行测试和验证之前，CMS应重新考虑使用RSMR公开报告死亡率率的决策。

abstract.text: There is growing concern over the rising share of the US economy devoted to health care spending. Fueled in part by demographic transitions, unchecked increases in entitlement spending will necessitate some combination of substantial tax increases, elimination of other public spending, or unsustainable public debt. This massive increase in health spending might be warranted if each dollar devoted to the health care sector yielded real health benefits, but this does not seem to be the case. Although we have seen remarkable gains in life expectancy and functioning over the past several decades, there is substantial variation in the health benefits associated with different types of spending. Some treatments, such as aspirin, beta blockers, and flu shots, produce a large health benefit per dollar spent. Other more expensive treatments, such as stents for cardiovascular disease, are high value for some patients but poor value for others. Finally, a large and expanding set of treatments, such as proton-beam therapy or robotic surgery, contributes to rapid increases in spending despite questionable health benefits. Moving resources toward more productive uses requires encouraging providers to deliver and patients to consume high-value care, a daunting task in the current political landscape. But widespread inefficiency also offers hope: Given the current distribution of resources in the US health care system, there is tremendous potential to improve the productivity of health care spending and the fiscal health of the United States.

10.1146/annurev-economics-080511-110942.abstractZh: 人们越来越担心美国经济中用于医疗保健支出的比例不断上升。这一趋势部分是由人口结构变化所引发的，如果不加以控制，福利支出的增加将需要采取一些措施，比如大幅增税、削减其他公共支出，或者承担不可持续的公共债务。如果每一美元用于医疗保健能够带来实际的健康效益，那么增加医疗支出可能是合理的。然而，情况似乎并非如此。尽管在过去几十年中，我们的预期寿命和健康状况有了显著改善，但不同类型的支出所带来的健康效益存在很大差异。一些治疗项目，如阿司匹林、β受体阻滞剂和流感疫苗，每花费一美元就能带来巨大的健康效益。而其他更昂贵的治疗项目，如心血管疾病支架手术，对某些患者来说价值很高，但对另一些患者来说则价值较低。最后，一些新兴的治疗项目，如质子束治疗或机器人手术，虽然健康效益值得怀疑，但确实导致了支出的迅速增加。将资源转向更有成效的用途需要鼓励医疗服务提供者提供高价值的医疗服务，而这在当前的政治环境下是一项艰巨的任务。不过，广泛的低效率也带来了希望：鉴于美国医疗保健系统目前的资源分配状况，我们有巨大的潜力来提高医疗保健支出的效率，从而改善美国的财政状况。

abstract.text: We study the design of interventions to stabilize financial markets plagued by adverse selection. Our contribution is to analyze the information revealed by participation decisions. Taking part in a government program carries a stigma, and outside options are mechanism dependent. We show that the efficiency of an intervention can be assessed by its impact on the market interest rate. The presence of an outside market determines the nature of optimal interventions and the choice of financial instruments (debt guarantees in our model), but it does not affect implementation costs. (JEL D82, D86, G01, G20, G31)

10.1257/aer.102.1.1.abstractZh: 我们研究了旨在稳定受逆向选择困扰的金融市场的干预措施设计。我们的贡献在于分析参与决策所揭示的信息。参与政府计划会带有一定的负面标签，而外部选择则取决于机制本身。我们表明，干预措施的效率可以通过其对市场利率的影响来评估。外部市场的存在决定了最优干预措施的性质以及金融工具的选择（在我们的模型中为债务担保），但不会影响实施成本。（JEL D82, D86, G01, G20, G31）

abstract.text: This paper introduces endogenous and directed technical change in a growth model with environmental constraints. The final good is produced from "dirty" and "clean" inputs. We show that: (i) when inputs are sufficiently substitutable, sustainable growth can be achieved with temporary taxes/subsidies that redirect innovation toward clean inputs; (ii) optimal policy involves both "carbon taxes" and research subsidies, avoiding excessive use of carbon taxes; (iii) delay in intervention is costly, as it later necessitates a longer transition phase with slow growth; and (iv) use of an exhaustible resource in dirty input production helps the switch to clean innovation under laissez-faire. (JEL O33, O44, Q30, Q54, Q56, Q58).

10.1257/aer.102.1.131.abstractZh: 本文介绍了一个具有环境约束的增长模型中，内生性和定向的技术变革。最终产品是由“污染性”和“清洁性”投入材料生产的。我们表明：(i) 当投入材料具有足够的可替代性时，可以通过临时性的税收/补贴将创新转向清洁性投入材料，从而实现可持续增长；(ii) 最优政策应包括“碳税”和研究补贴，以避免过度使用碳税；(iii) 延迟干预是有成本的，因为之后需要更长的过渡阶段，导致增长放缓；(iv) 在自由放任的情况下，使用可耗尽的资源进行污染性投入生产有助于转向清洁性创新。(JEL O33, O44, Q30, Q54, Q56, Q58)

abstract.text: US productivity growth accelerated after 1995 (unlike Europe's), particularly in sectors that intensively use information technologies (IT). Using two new micro panel datasets we show that US multinationals operating in Europe also experienced a “productivity miracle.” US multinationals obtained higher productivity from IT than non-US multinationals, particularly in the same sectors responsible for the US productivity acceleration. Furthermore, establishments taken over by US multinationals (but not by non-US multinationals) increased the productivity of their IT. Combining pan-European firm-level IT data with our management practices survey, we find that the US IT related productivity advantage is primarily due to its tougher “people management” practices. (JEL D24, E23, F23, M10, M16, O30)

10.1257/aer.102.1.167.abstractZh: 自1995年以来，美国的生产率增长加速，这与欧洲的情况不同，尤其是在大量使用信息技术的行业中。通过两个新的微观面板数据集分析表明，在美国运营的跨国企业也经历了“生产率奇迹”。美国跨国企业从信息技术中获得的生产率高于非美国跨国企业，尤其是在那些推动美国生产率加速增长的行业中。此外，被美国跨国企业收购的企业（而非非美国跨国企业）也提高了其信息技术的生产率。将全欧洲企业层面的信息技术数据与我们的管理实践调查相结合，我们发现美国在信息技术方面的生产率优势主要源于其更为严格的“人员管理”实践。（JEL D24, E23, F23, M10, M16, O30）

abstract.text: We estimate an equilibrium model of decision making in the US Supreme Court that takes into account both private information and ideological differences between justices. We measure the value of information in the court by the probability that a justice votes differently from how she would have voted without case-specific information. Our results suggest a sizable value of information: in 44 percent of cases, justices' initial leanings are changed by their personal assessments of the case. Our results also confirm the increased politicization of the Supreme Court in the last quarter century. Counterfactual simulations provide implications for institutional design. (JEL D72, D82, D83, K10)

10.1257/aer.102.1.202.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个均衡模型，用于分析美国最高法院的决策过程，该模型考虑了私人信息和法官之间的意识形态差异。我们通过法官在获得特定案件信息后，其投票结果与未获信息时的投票结果之间的差异来衡量信息的价值。研究结果表明，信息的价值相当可观：在44%的案件中，法官的初始倾向会因对案件的个人评估而改变。研究结果还证实了过去四十年内最高法院的政治化程度有所上升。反事实模拟为制度设计提供了启示。（JEL D72, D82, D83, K10）

abstract.text: We document the cyclical properties of US firms' financial flows and show that equity payout is procyclical and debt payout is countercyclical. We then develop a model with debt and equity financing to explore how the dynamics of real and financial variables are affected by “financial shocks.” We find that financial shocks contributed significantly to the observed dynamics of real and financial variables. The recent events in the financial sector show up as a tightening of firms' financing conditions which contributed to the 2008–2009 recession. The downturns in 1990–1991 and 2001 were also influenced by changes in credit conditions. (JEL E23, E32, E44, G01, G32)

10.1257/aer.102.1.238.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国企业的金融流动周期性特征，发现股权支付具有顺周期性，而债务支付则具有逆周期性。随后，我们建立了一个包含债务和股权融资的模型，以探讨“金融冲击”如何影响实际变量和金融变量的动态变化。研究发现，金融冲击对实际变量和金融变量的动态变化产生了显著影响。金融领域的近期事件表现为企业融资条件的收紧，这加剧了2008-2009年的经济衰退。1990-1991年和2001年的经济下滑也受到了信贷条件变化的影响。（JEL E23, E32, E44, G01, G32）

abstract.text: This study estimates the effects of means-tested housing programs on labor supply using data from a randomized housing voucher wait-list lottery in Chicago. Economic theory is ambiguous about the expected sign of any labor supply response. We find that among working-age, able-bodied adults, housing voucher use reduces labor force participation by around 4 percentage points (6 percent) and quarterly earnings by $329 (10 percent), and increases Temporary Assistance for Needy Families program participation by around 2 percentage points (15 percent). We find no evidence that the housing-specific mechanisms hypothesized to promote work, such as neighborhood quality or residential stability, are important empirically. (JEL I38, J22, R23, R38)

10.1257/aer.102.1.272.abstractZh: 本研究利用芝加哥一项随机住房券等待名单抽奖活动的数据，估计了住房计划对劳动力供应的影响。经济理论对于劳动力供应反应的预期符号存在不确定性。我们发现，在劳动年龄、身体健全的成年人中，使用住房券会使劳动力参与率降低约4个百分点（6%），季度收入减少约329美元（10%），并使需要帮助的家庭的临时援助计划参与率增加约2个百分点（15%）。我们没有发现任何证据表明，那些被认为能促进工作的住房特定机制，如社区质量或居住稳定性，在实证研究中具有重要作用。（JEL I38, J22, R23, R38）

abstract.text: The paper provides a first analysis of market jump starting and its two-way interaction between mechanism design and participation constraints. The government optimally overpays for the legacy assets and cleans up the market of its weakest assets, through a mixture of buybacks and equity injections, and leaves the firms with the strongest legacy assets to the market. The government reduces adverse selection enough to let the market rebound, but not too much, so as to limit the cost of intervention. The existence of a market imposes no welfare cost. (JEL D82, D83, G01, G31, H81)

10.1257/aer.102.1.29.abstractZh: 本文首次分析了市场跳跃启动机制，以及机制设计与参与约束之间的双向互动关系。政府通过回购和股权注入相结合的方式，对遗留资产进行最优补偿，并清理市场上最弱的资产，将拥有最强遗留资产的公司留在市场中。政府减少逆向选择行为，使市场能够恢复，但程度不宜过重，以控制干预成本。市场的存在不会带来福利成本。（JEL D82, D83, G01, G31, H81）

abstract.text: Voluntary Standard Setting Organizations (SSOs) use a consensus process to create new compatibility standards. Practitioners have suggested that SSOs are increasingly politicized and perhaps incapable of producing timely standards. This article develops a simple model of standard setting committees and tests its predictions using data from the Internet Engineering Task Force, an SSO that produces many of the standards used to run the Internet. The results show that an observed slowdown in standards production between 1993 and 2003 can be linked to distributional conflicts created by the rapid commercialization of the Internet. (JEL C78, L15, L86)

10.1257/aer.102.1.305.abstractZh: 自愿标准制定组织（SSOs）通过共识过程来制定新的兼容性标准。业界人士指出，这些组织越来越受到政治因素的影响，可能无法及时制定标准。本文建立了一个简单的标准制定委员会模型，并利用互联网工程任务组的数据对其进行验证。互联网工程任务组是一个负责制定许多互联网运行标准的SSO。研究结果表明，1993年至2003年间标准制定速度的放缓与互联网快速商业化带来的分配冲突有关。（JEL C78, L15, L86）

abstract.text: We study prisoners' dilemmas played in continuous time with flow payoffs accumulated over 60 seconds. In most cases, the median rate of mutual cooperation is about 90 percent. Control sessions with repeated matchings over eight subperiods achieve less than half as much cooperation, and cooperation rates approach zero in one-shot sessions. In follow-up sessions with a variable number of subperiods, cooperation rates increase nearly linearly as the grid size decreases, and, with one-second subperiods, they approach continuous levels. Our data support a strand of theory that explains how capacity to respond rapidly stabilizes cooperation and destabilizes defection in the prisoner's dilemma. (JEL C72, C78, C91)

10.1257/aer.102.1.337.abstractZh: 我们研究了在连续时间下进行的囚徒困境游戏，其中收益在60秒内累积。在大多数情况下，相互合作的中位率约为90%。在包含八个子时期的控制性游戏中，合作率不到一半，而在一次性游戏中，合作率接近零。在包含可变子时期的后续游戏中，随着网格大小的减小，合作率几乎呈线性增长，而在一秒子时期的情况下，合作率接近连续水平。我们的数据支持一种理论，该理论解释了快速响应能力如何稳定合作并破坏囚徒困境中的背叛行为。（JEL C72, C78, C91）

abstract.text: The article develops a new theory of pricing to market driven by dynamic frictions of building market shares. Our key innovation is a capital theoretic model of marketing in which relations with customers are valuable. We discipline the introduced friction using data on differences between short-run and long-run price elasticity of international trade flows. We show that the model accounts for several pricing “puzzles” of international macroeconomics. (JEL E13, F14, F31, F41, F44, M31)

10.1257/aer.102.1.364.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新的定价理论，该理论基于构建市场份额的动态摩擦来驱动市场行为。我们的关键创新在于提出了一个以资本理论为基础的营销模型，其中与顾客的关系具有价值。我们通过国际贸易流动的短期与长期价格弹性差异数据来量化引入的摩擦。我们证明该模型能够解释国际宏观经济学中一些定价难题。（JEL E13, F14, F31, F41, F44, M31）

abstract.text: Compulsory licensing allows firms in developing countries to produce foreign-owned inventions without the consent of foreign patent owners. This paper uses an exogenous event of compulsory licensing after World War I under the Trading with the Enemy Act to examine the effects of compulsory licensing on domestic invention. Difference-in-differences analyses of nearly 130,000 chemical inventions suggest that compulsory licensing increased domestic invention by 20 percent. (JEL D45, L24, N42, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.102.1.396.abstractZh: 强制许可允许发展中国家的企业在不经外国专利所有者同意的情况下生产外国拥有的发明。本文以第一次世界大战后《与敌国贸易法》下的强制许可这一外部事件为研究对象，探讨强制许可对国内发明的影响。对近13万项化学发明的差异比较分析表明，强制许可使国内发明增加了20%。（JEL D45, L24, N42, O31, O34）
