abstract.text: We propose a method that enables one to test efficient risk sharing even when households have different risk preferences. The method is composed of three tests. The first one determines whether in the data households have homogeneous risk preferences. The second and third tests evaluate efficient risk sharing when the hypothesis of homogeneous risk preferences is rejected. We use this method to test efficient risk sharing in rural India. Using the first test, we strongly reject the hypothesis of identical risk preferences. Using the second and third tests, we reject efficiency at the village but not at the caste level. (JEL D12, D86, G22, O12, O18, R23, Z13)

10.1257/aer.102.1.428.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法，即使家庭的风险偏好不同，也能测试有效的风险共享。该方法包含三个测试。第一个测试确定数据中的家庭是否具有同质的风险偏好。第二个和第三个测试在拒绝同质风险偏好假设的情况下评估有效风险共享。我们使用该方法在印度农村测试有效风险共享。通过第一个测试，我们强烈拒绝同质风险偏好的假设。通过第二个和第三个测试，我们发现村级层面的效率较低，而 caste 层面的效率则较高。（JEL D12, D86, G22, O12, O18, R23, Z13）

abstract.text: We develop a novel computerized real effort task, based on moving sliders across a screen, to test experimentally whether agents are disappointment averse when they compete in a real effort sequential-move tournament. We predict that a disappointment averse agent, who is loss averse around her endogenous choice-acclimating expectations-based reference point, responds negatively to her rival's effort. We find significant evidence for this discouragement effect, and use the Method of Simulated Moments to estimate the strength of disappointment aversion on average and the heterogeneity in disappointment aversion across the population. (JEL C91, D12, D81, D84)

10.1257/aer.102.1.469.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的计算机化真实努力任务，通过屏幕上的滑块移动来实验性地测试代理人在真实努力顺序移动比赛中竞争时是否厌恶失望。我们预测，一个厌恶失望的代理人，在基于内生选择适应性的参考点附近是厌恶损失的，会对对手的努力做出负面反应。我们发现了这种挫败效应的显著证据，并使用模拟矩方法估计了厌恶失望的平均强度以及人群中厌恶失望的异质性。（JEL C91, D12, D81, D84）

abstract.text: Average living standards are converging among developing countries and faster growing economies see more progress against poverty. Yet we do not find poverty convergence; countries starting with higher poverty rates do not see higher proportionate rates of poverty reduction. The paper tries to explain why. Analysis of a new dataset suggests that, at given mean consumption, high initial poverty has an adverse effect on consumption growth and also makes growth less poverty-reducing. Thus, for many poor countries, the growth advantage of starting out with a low mean is lost due to a high incidence of poverty. JEL: D63, I31, I32, O15

10.1257/aer.102.1.504.abstractZh: 发展中国家的平均生活水平正在趋同，增长较快的经济体在减少贫困方面取得了更多进展。然而，我们并未发现贫困水平的趋同现象；那些初始贫困率较高的国家，其贫困减少的比例并没有更高。本文试图解释这一现象。对新的数据集进行分析后发现，在给定平均消费水平的情况下，较高的初始贫困率会对消费增长产生负面影响，同时也会降低经济增长对减少贫困的作用。因此，对于许多贫困国家来说，由于贫困率较高，以较低的平均消费水平起步所带来的增长优势被抵消了。JEL: D63, I31, I32, O15

abstract.text: Can government policies that increase the monopoly power of firms and the militancy of unions increase output? This paper shows that the answer is yes under certain “emergency” conditions. These emergency conditions—zero interest rates and deflation—were satisfied during the Great Depression in the United States. The New Deal, which facilitated monopolies and union militancy, was therefore expansionary in the model presented. This conclusion is contrary to a large previous literature. The main reason for this divergence is that this paper incorporates rigid prices and the zero bound on the short-term interest rate. JEL: E23, E32, E52, E62, J51, N12, N42

10.1257/aer.102.1.524.abstractZh: 政府政策是否能够通过增强企业的垄断权力和工会的活跃度来提高产出？本文表明，在某些“紧急”条件下，答案是肯定的。这些紧急条件——零利率和通货紧缩——在美国大萧条期间确实存在。因此，在新政期间，促进垄断和工会活跃度的政策在模型中属于扩张性政策。这一结论与以往大量研究的结果不同。造成这种差异的主要原因是本文考虑了刚性价格以及短期利率的零下限。JEL: E23, E32, E52, E62, J51, N12, N42

abstract.text: How did the diffusion of the internet affect regional wage inequality? We examine the relationship between business investment in advanced internet technology and local variation in US wage growth between 1995 and 2000. We identify a puzzle. The internet is widespread, but the economic payoffs are not. Advanced internet technology is only associated with substantial wage growth in the 6 percent of counties that were already highly wealthy, educated, and populated and had IT-intensive industry. Advanced internet and wage growth appear unrelated elsewhere. Overall, advanced internet explains over half the difference in wage growth between already well-off counties and all others. JEL: J31, L86, O33, R11, R23

10.1257/aer.102.1.556.abstractZh: 互联网的传播如何影响了地区间的工资不平等？我们研究了企业在先进互联网技术上的投资与美国各地区的工资增长之间的关系，时间跨度为1995年至2000年。我们发现了一个有趣的现象：虽然互联网已经广泛普及，但其带来的经济收益却并不明显。只有在那些已经拥有高财富、高教育水平和高人口密度的地区，并且拥有信息技术密集型产业的6个州，先进互联网技术才与显著的工资增长相关联。而在其他地区，先进互联网技术与工资增长似乎并无关联。总体而言，先进互联网技术解释了那些已经富裕的州与其他所有州之间工资增长差异的一半以上。JEL分类：J31, L86, O33, R11, R23

abstract.text: We study a natural experiment in the Indian mutual funds sector that created a 22-month period in which closed-end funds were allowed to charge an arguably shrouded fee, whereas open-end funds were forced to charge entry loads. Forty-five new closed-end funds were started during this period, collecting $7.6 billion US, whereas only two closed-end funds were started in the 66 months prior to this period, collecting $42 billion US, and no closed-end funds were started in the 20 months after this period. We estimate that investors lost and fund firms gained approximately $350 million US due to this shrouding. JEL: D14, G23, G28, O16

10.1257/aer.102.1.576.abstractZh: 我们研究了印度共同基金行业的一项自然实验，该实验在22个月内允许封闭式基金收取一种看似模糊的费用，而开放式基金则被迫收取入金费。在此期间，共成立了45家新的封闭式基金，累计收取了76亿美元，而在此之前的66个月里，仅成立了两家封闭式基金，累计收取了420亿美元，而在此之后的20个月里，则没有新的封闭式基金成立。我们估计，由于这种模糊的收费方式，投资者损失了约3.5亿美元，而基金公司则获得了收益。JEL分类：D14, G23, G28, O16

abstract.text: Firms and workers may sign complex contracts that govern many aspects of their interactions. I show that when firms regard contracts as substitutes, bargaining over contracts can be understood as bargaining only over wages. Substitutes is the assumption commonly used to guarantee the existence of stable matchings of workers and firms. JEL: C78, D86, J31, J41

10.1257/aer.102.1.594.abstractZh: 企业和工人可能会签署复杂的合同，这些合同涵盖了他们互动的许多方面。我指出，当企业将合同视为替代品时，关于合同的谈判实际上只涉及工资问题。使用“替代品”这一假设通常是为了确保工人和企业之间存在稳定的匹配关系。JEL: C78, D86, J31, J41

abstract.text: The article shows that time-consistent, imperfectly targeted support to distressed institutions makes private leverage choices strategic complements. When everyone engages in maturity mismatch, authorities have little choice but intervening, creating both current and deferred (sowing the seeds of the next crisis) social costs. In turn, it is profitable to adopt a risky balance sheet. These insights have important consequences, from banks choosing to correlate their risk exposures to the need for macro-prudential supervision. (JEL D82, E52, E58, G01, G21, G28)

10.1257/aer.102.1.60.abstractZh: 本文指出，对陷入困境的机构提供时间上一致且目标不完全明确的支持，会强化私人机构的杠杆选择行为。当所有人都在进行期限错配时，当局别无选择，只能进行干预，从而产生当前和未来的社会成本。反过来，采取风险较高的资产负债表策略也是有利可图的。这些见解具有重要的启示意义，例如银行应根据其风险敞口来选择是否接受宏观审慎监管。（JEL D82, E52, E58, G01, G21, G28）

abstract.text: The cost-effectiveness of cap-and-trade emissions regulations has become widely accepted. A 2009 proposal by Muller and Mendelsohn would replace conventional ton-for-ton trading with trading based on estimates of marginal damages by pollutant and by source. This proposal faces difficulties arising from the negative marginal damage estimates—neglected in Muller and Mendelsohn (2009)—for nitrogen oxide (NOx) emissions from many urban counties. Such estimates imply nonconvexities in air chemistry that complicate trading and could result in trades that increase emissions by both buyer and seller. Uncertainty in source-specific damages also creates rent-seeking opportunities and the potential for costly litigation. JEL: H53, Q53, Q58

10.1257/aer.102.1.602.abstractZh: 碳排放总量控制与交易制度的成本效益已得到广泛认可。Muller和Mendelsohn在2009年提出的建议，是用基于污染物及其来源边际损害估算的交易方式，取代传统的按吨数进行交易的方式。然而，该建议面临一些困难，比如对许多城市地区氮氧化物排放的边际损害估算存在不足——这一点在Muller和Mendelsohn（2009年）的研究中被忽略了。这种估算方式意味着空气化学过程中存在非凸性，这会使交易变得复杂，并可能导致买卖双方都增加排放。此外，针对特定来源的损害估算的不确定性，还会引发寻租行为，并可能引发昂贵的诉讼。JEL分类：H53, Q53, Q58

abstract.text: Fraas and Lutter raise two important points in their comment on Muller and Mendelsohn (2009): How to design policies for sources that yield negative marginal damages? How does statistical uncertainty in the marginal damages affect the trading ratios across emitters? We address both issues in this response. JEL: H53, Q53, Q58

10.1257/aer.102.1.608.abstractZh: Fraas和Lutter在他们对Muller和Mendelsohn（2009）的评论中提出了两个重要问题：如何为产生负边际损害的行为源设计政策？边际损害中的统计不确定性如何影响不同排放者的交易比率？我们在本文中探讨了这两个问题。JEL分类：H53, Q53, Q58

abstract.text: Micro-level data have had a profound influence on research in international trade over the last ten years. In many regards, this research agenda has been very successful. New stylized facts have been uncovered and new trade models have been developed to explain these facts. In this paper we investigate to what extent answers to new micro-level questions have affected answers to an old and central question in the field: how large are the welfare gains from trade? A crude summary of our results is: “So far, not much.” (JEL F11, F12)

10.1257/aer.102.1.94.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，微观层面的数据对国际贸易研究产生了深远的影响。在许多方面，这一研究议程取得了显著成果。新的典型事实被揭示出来，同时也有新的贸易模型被开发出来以解释这些事实。在本文中，我们探讨了对于新的微观层面问题的回答在多大程度上影响了对该领域一个古老而核心问题的回答：贸易带来的福利收益有多大？我们研究结果的粗略总结是：“到目前为止，并没有太大收获。”（JEL F11, F12）

abstract.text: The financial crisis has refocused attention on money and credit fluctuations, financial crises, and policy responses. We study the behavior of money, credit, and macroeconomic indicators over the long run based on a new historical dataset for 14 countries over the years 1870–2008. Total credit has increased strongly relative to output and money in the second half of the twentieth century. Monetary policy responses to financial crises have also been more aggressive, but the output costs of crises have remained large. Credit growth is a powerful predictor of financial crises, suggesting that policymakers ignore credit at their peril. JEL: E32, E44, E52, G01, N10, N20

10.1257/aer.102.2.1029.abstractZh: 金融危机再次将人们的注意力集中在货币和信贷波动、金融危机以及政策应对上。我们基于1870年至2008年间14个国家的历史数据集，研究了长期内货币、信贷和宏观经济指标的行为。在二十世纪下半叶，与产出和货币相比，总信贷水平显著增长。针对金融危机的政策应对也更为积极，但危机带来的产出损失仍然很大。信贷增长是金融危机的一个重要预测指标，这表明政策制定者在忽视信贷问题将面临风险。JEL: E32, E44, E52, G01, N10, N20

abstract.text: The joint dynamics of US net output, consumption, and (the market value of) foreign assets and liabilities, characterized empirically following Lettau and Ludvigson (2004), is shown to be consistent with current account theory. US consumption is virtually insulated from transitory shocks, while these contribute to variations in net output and gross foreign positions—consumption is smoothed against temporary fluctuations in returns. A single permanent shock—naturally interpreted as a supply shock—raises consumption swiftly while causing net output to adjust gradually. This leads to persistent, procyclical external deficits, while moving gross assets and liabilities in the same direction. JEL: E21, E23, F32, F34

10.1257/aer.102.2.1062.abstractZh: 根据Lettau和Ludvigson（2004年）的研究，美国净产出、消费以及外国资产和负债的市场价值之间的联合动态，与当前账户理论是一致的。美国的消费几乎不受暂时性冲击的影响，而这些冲击则会导致净产出和总外国资产的变化——消费能够平滑掉收益的临时波动。一次性的永久性冲击——自然被解释为供应冲击——会迅速提高消费，同时使净产出逐渐调整。这导致持续性的、顺周期的外部赤字，同时使总资产和负债朝同一方向变动。JEL分类：E21, E23, F32, F34

abstract.text: Purchasing power–adjusted incomes applied in cross-country comparisons are measured with bias. This paper estimates the purchasing power parity (PPP) bias in Penn World Table incomes and provides corrected incomes. The bias is substantial and systematic: the poorer a country, the more its income tends to be overestimated. Consequently, international income inequality is substantially underestimated. The methodological contribution is to exploit the analogies between PPP bias and the bias in consumer price index (CPI) numbers. The PPP bias and subsequent corrected incomes are measured by estimating Engel curves for food, an established method of measuring CPI bias. JEL: C43, D31, E31, O11, O12

10.1257/aer.102.2.1093.abstractZh: 在跨国比较中使用的购买力调整后的收入存在偏差。本文估算了宾州世界表格中收入的实际购买力平价（PPP）偏差，并提供了修正后的收入数据。这种偏差是显著且系统性的：一个国家的经济越贫困，其收入往往被高估。因此，国际收入不平等被严重低估了。本文的方法论贡献在于利用购买力平价偏差与消费者价格指数（CPI）数值偏差之间的相似性。通过估算食品 Engel 曲线来测量购买力平价偏差及修正后的收入数据，这是一种测量 CPI 偏差的成熟方法。JEL: C43, D31, E31, O11, O12

abstract.text: We use experimental measures of time discounting and risk aversion for villagers in south India to highlight behavioral features of microcredit, a financial tool designed to reduce poverty and fix credit market imperfections. The evidence suggests that microcredit contracts may do more than reduce moral hazard and adverse selection by imposing new forms of discipline on borrowers. We find that, conditional on borrowing from any source, women with present-biased preferences are more likely than others to borrow through microcredit institutions. Another particular contribution of microcredit may thus be to provide helpful structure for borrowers seeking self-discipline. JEL: G21, I38, O15, O16, O18

10.1257/aer.102.2.1118.abstractZh: 我们采用实验性方法测量了印度南部村民的时间贴现和风险厌恶倾向，以揭示微型信贷这一旨在减少贫困并修复信贷市场缺陷的金融工具的行为特征。研究结果表明，微型信贷合同通过施加新的约束机制，可能比单纯减少道德风险和不良选择更为有效。我们发现，在从任何来源借款的前提下，具有当前偏好倾向的女性比其他人更有可能通过微型信贷机构借款。因此，微型信贷的另一个重要作用可能是为寻求自我约束的借款人提供有效的支持结构。JEL分类：G21, I38, O15, O16, O18

abstract.text: The Internet has made consumer search easier, with consequences for prices, industry structure, and the kinds of products offered. We provide an industry model with strategic design choices that explores these issues. A polarized market structure results: some firms choose designs aimed at broad-based audiences, while others target narrow niches. We analyze the effect of reduced search costs, finding results consistent with the reported prevalence of niche goods and long-tail and superstar phenomena. In particular, the model suggests that long-tail effects arise when there is a wide range of potential designs, relative to vertical heterogeneity among firms. JEL: D11, D21, D83, L11, L86, M31

10.1257/aer.102.2.1140.abstractZh: 互联网使得消费者搜索变得更加便捷，这影响了价格、行业结构以及所提供产品的类型。我们提出了一个具有战略设计选择的行业模型，以探讨这些问题。市场结构呈现出两极分化：一些企业选择面向广泛受众的设计，而另一些则专注于狭窄的细分市场。我们分析了搜索成本降低的影响，发现结果与报道中的细分商品现象、长尾效应以及超级明星现象一致。特别是，该模型表明，当潜在设计种类繁多时，长尾效应就会显现出来，这与企业之间的垂直异质性有关。JEL: D11, D21, D83, L11, L86, M31

abstract.text: We examine whether and to what extent consolidation in the US health insurance industry has contributed to higher employer-sponsored insurance premiums. We exploit the differential impact across local markets of a national merger of two insurers to identify the causal effect of concentration on premiums. Using data for large groups, we estimate premiums in average markets were approximately seven percentage points higher by 2007 due to increases in local concentration from 1998–2006. We also find evidence consolidation facilitates the exercise of monopsonistic power vis-à-vis physicians, leading to reductions in their absolute employment and earnings relative to other healthcare workers. JEL: G22, I13

10.1257/aer.102.2.1161.abstractZh: 我们研究美国健康保险行业的合并在多大程度上导致了雇主赞助的保险费用上升。我们通过分析两家保险公司合并对各地市场的影响差异，来识别集中度对保险费用的影响。利用大型团体的数据，我们估计到2007年，由于1998年至2006年间本地集中度的增加，平均市场的保险费用大约上升了7个百分点。我们还发现，合并使得企业能够行使对医生的垄断权力，导致医生相对于其他医疗工作者的绝对就业量和收入减少。JEL: G22, I13

abstract.text: A real wage rate is a nominal wage rate divided by the price of a good and is a transparent measure of how much of the good an hour of work buys. It provides an important indicator of the living standards of workers, and also of the productivity of workers. In this paper I set out the conceptual basis for such measures, provide some historical examples, and then provide my own preliminary analysis of a decade long project designed to measure the wages of workers doing the same job in over 60 countries—workers at McDonald's restaurants. The results demonstrate that the wage rates of workers using the same skills and doing the same jobs differ by as much as 10 to 1, and that these gaps declined over the period 2000–2007, but with much less progress since the Great Recession. (JEL C81, C82, D24, J31, N30, O57)

10.1257/aer.102.2.617.abstractZh: 实际工资率是指名义工资率除以商品的价格，它直观地反映了每小时工作能够购买多少商品。这一指标是衡量工人生活水平以及工人生产效率的重要标准。在本文中，我阐述了此类测量的概念基础，列举了一些历史案例，并对一个持续了十年的项目进行了初步分析。该项目旨在测量60多个国家麦当劳餐厅中从事相同工作的工人的工资水平。研究结果表明，使用相同技能且从事相同工作的工人的工资率差异可达10倍之多，而且这一差距在2000年至2007年间有所缩小，但自大衰退以来进展明显放缓。（JEL C81, C82, D24, J31, N30, O57）

abstract.text: We measure how the bundling of television channels affects short-run welfare. We estimate an industry model of viewership, demand, pricing, bundling, and input-market bargaining using data on ratings, purchases, prices, bundles, and input costs. We conduct simulations of à la carte policies that require distributors to offer individual channels for sale to consumers. We estimate that negotiated input costs rise by 103.0 percent under à la carte. These higher input costs offset consumer benefits from purchasing individual channels. Mean consumer and total surplus change by an estimated —5.4 to 0.2 percent and —1.7 to 6.0 percent, respectively. (JEL D12, L11, L51, L82, M31)

10.1257/aer.102.2.643.abstractZh: 我们研究了电视频道捆绑销售对短期福利的影响。我们基于收视率、购买行为、价格、捆绑销售以及投入成本的数据，建立了一个涵盖观众数量、需求、定价、捆绑销售以及投入市场谈判的行业模型。我们模拟了需要分销商向消费者提供单独频道销售的单独频道政策。研究估计，在单独频道政策下，谈判达成的投入成本将上升103.0%。这些较高的投入成本抵消了消费者从购买单独频道中获得的收益。消费者平均剩余和总剩余分别变化了-5.4%到0.2%以及-1.7%到6.0%。（JEL D12, L11, L51, L82, M31）

abstract.text: Bundling is at the forefront of many policy debates as new technologies allow firms to implement more complex bundling arrangements. Realistic analyses of bundling—particularly between suppliers and retailers—require detailed data on both supply arrangements and consumer demand. We analyze firms' use of bundling as a vertical restraint (known as full-line forcing) using extensive supply and demand data from the video rental industry. Our model captures key details of the market that determine firms' contractual choices, and sheds light on the implications of these decisions. The empirical approach provides a model for how to analyze bundling when detailed data are available. (JEL D86, L14, L81, L82)

10.1257/aer.102.2.686.abstractZh: 捆绑销售在许多政策讨论中处于前沿，因为新技术使得企业能够实施更复杂的捆绑安排。对捆绑销售的现实分析——尤其是在供应商与零售商之间——需要关于供应安排和消费者需求的详细数据。我们利用视频租赁行业的广泛供应和需求数据，分析了企业使用捆绑销售作为垂直约束（即全产品线强制）的情况。我们的模型捕捉了决定企业合同选择的关键市场细节，并揭示了这些决策的影响。这种实证方法为在拥有详细数据的情况下如何分析捆绑销售提供了模型支持。（JEL D86, L14, L81, L82）

abstract.text: We study the experimental play of the repeated prisoner's dilemma when intended actions are implemented with noise. In treatments where cooperation is an equilibrium, subjects cooperate substantially more than in treatments without cooperative equilibria. In all settings there was considerable strategic diversity, indicating that subjects had not fully learned the distribution of play. Furthermore, cooperative strategies yielded higher payoffs than uncooperative strategies in the treatments with cooperative equilibria. In these treatments successful strategies were “lenient” in not retaliating for the first defection, and many were “forgiving” in trying to return to cooperation after inflicting a punishment. (JEL C72, C73, D81)

10.1257/aer.102.2.720.abstractZh: 我们研究了在行为实施过程中存在噪声的情况下，重复囚徒困境中的实验性博弈。在合作成为均衡的处理组中，受试者的合作行为明显多于没有合作均衡的处理组。在所有情况下，策略多样性都相当高，表明受试者尚未完全掌握博弈的分布规律。此外，在具有合作均衡的处理组中，采用合作策略能够获得更高的收益。在这些处理组中，成功的策略表现为在首次背叛时不进行报复，许多策略则表现为在施加惩罚后尝试恢复合作。（JEL C72, C73, D81）

abstract.text: This article studies optimal relational contracts when the value of the relationship between contracting parties is not commonly known. I consider a principal-agent setting where the principal has persistent private information about her outside option. I show that if the principal has the bargaining power, she wants to understate her outside option to provide strong incentives and then renege on promised payments, while if the uninformed agent has the bargaining power, the principal wants to overstate her outside option to capture more surplus. I characterize how information is revealed, how the relationship evolves, and how this depends on bargaining power. (JEL C78, D82, D83, D86)

10.1257/aer.102.2.750.abstractZh: 本文研究了在签约双方之间的关系价值并不为众人所知时的最优关系契约。我们考虑了一个委托-代理情境，其中委托人拥有关于其外部选择的持续私人信息。研究表明，如果委托人具有议价能力，她会低估自己的外部选择以提供强烈的激励，并随后违背承诺的支付；而如果信息不足的代理人具有议价能力，委托人则会高估自己的外部选择以获取更多的收益。文章还描述了信息如何被揭示、关系如何演变，以及这些因素如何取决于议价能力。（JEL C78, D82, D83, D86）

abstract.text: In markets for retail financial products and health services, consumers often rely on the advice of intermediaries to decide which specialized offering best fits their needs. Product providers, in turn, compete to influence the intermediaries' advice through hidden kickbacks or disclosed commissions. Motivated by the controversial role of these widespread practices, we formulate a model to analyze competition through commissions from a positive and normative standpoint. The model highlights the role of commissions in making the advisor responsive to supply-side incentives. We characterize situations when commonly adopted policies such as mandatory disclosure and caps on commissions have unintended welfare consequences. (JEL D21, D82, D83, G21, L15, L25)

10.1257/aer.102.2.780.abstractZh: 在零售金融产品和健康服务市场中，消费者通常依赖中介的建议来决定哪种专业服务最适合他们的需求。产品提供者则通过暗中给予回扣或公开收取佣金来影响中介的建议。鉴于这些普遍做法所引发的争议性影响，我们构建了一个模型，从积极和规范的角度分析通过佣金进行的竞争。该模型强调了佣金在使顾问对供给侧激励作出反应方面的作用。我们描述了诸如强制披露佣金上限等常见政策可能带来的意外福利后果的情况。（JEL D21, D82, D83, G21, L15, L25）

abstract.text: This article exploits data on the pattern of violence across regions and over time to estimate the impact of the peace process in Northern Ireland on house prices. After establishing a negative correlation between killings and house prices, we estimate the parameters of a Markov switching model with conflict and peace as latent states. We use the model to estimate the size of the peace dividend as captured in house price changes. (JEL D74, R23, R31)

10.1257/aer.102.2.810.abstractZh: 本文利用关于不同地区及时间跨度内暴力事件模式的数据，来估算北爱尔兰和平进程对房价的影响。在发现杀戮行为与房价之间存在负相关关系后，我们建立了一个马尔可夫切换模型，该模型将冲突与和平作为潜在状态。利用该模型，我们估算了和平红利的规模，即房价变化所反映的和平带来的收益。（JEL D74, R23, R31）

abstract.text: High-performance work systems give workers more discretion, thereby increasing effort productivity but also shirking opportunities. We show experimentally that screening for work attitude and labor market competition are causal determinants of the viability of high-performance work systems, and we identify the complementarities between discretion, rent-sharing, and screening that render them profitable. Two fundamentally distinct job designs emerge endogenously in our experiments: “bad” jobs with low discretion, low wages, and little rent-sharing, and “good” jobs with high discretion, high wages, and substantial rent-sharing. Good jobs are profitable only if employees can be screened, and labor market competition fosters their dissemination. (JEL D12, D82, J24, J31, J41, M12, M54)

10.1257/aer.102.2.834.abstractZh: 高性能工作体系赋予员工更多的自主权，从而提升了工作效率，但同时也可能错失一些机会。我们通过实验表明，工作态度筛选和劳动力市场竞争是高性能工作体系可行性的关键决定因素，并且我们发现了自主权、租金共享和筛选之间的互补关系，这些因素共同使得高性能工作体系具有盈利性。在我们的实验中，出现了两种截然不同的工作类型：“糟糕”的工作类型，员工自主权低、工资低、租金共享少；而“良好”的工作类型，员工自主权高、工资高、租金共享多。只有在对员工进行筛选的情况下，良好工作类型才具有盈利性，而劳动力市场的竞争则有助于这些工作类型的推广。（JEL D12, D82, J24, J31, J41, M12, M54）

abstract.text: To explore why bubbles frequently emerge in the experimental asset market model of Smith, Suchanek, and Williams (1988), we vary the fundamental value process (constant or declining) and the cash– to–asset value ratio (constant or increasing). We observe high mispricing in treatments with a declining fundamental value, while overvaluation emerges when coupled with an increasing C/A ratio. A questionnaire reveals that the declining fundamental value process confuses subjects, as they expect the fundamental value to stay constant. Running the experiment with a different context (“stocks of a depletable gold mine” instead of “stocks”) significantly reduces mispricing and overvaluation as it reduces confusion. (JEL C91, D14, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.102.2.865.abstractZh: 为了探究为什么在Smith、Suchanek和Williams（1988）提出的实验性资产市场模型中会出现泡沫现象，我们改变了基本价值过程（恒定或下降）以及现金与资产价值比率（恒定或增加）。我们发现，在基本价值下降的情况下，市场存在较高的误定价现象；而当C/A比率增加时，则会出现高估现象。问卷调查显示，基本价值下降的过程会让投资者感到困惑，因为他们预期基本价值会保持恒定。如果在不同的情境下进行实验（例如使用“可耗尽金矿的股票”而非“股票”），则可以显著减少误定价和高估现象，因为这样可以降低投资者的困惑程度。（JEL C91, D14, G11, G12）

abstract.text: This paper develops a model of industry dynamics where firms compete to acquire customers over time by disseminating information about themselves in the presence of random shocks to their efficiency. The properties of the model's stationary equilibrium are related to empirical regularities on firm and industry dynamics. As an application of the model, the effects of a decline in the cost of information dissemination on firm and industry dynamics are explored. (JEL D11, D83, L11, L81, M37)

10.1257/aer.102.2.884.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个行业动态模型，其中企业通过传播自身信息来争夺客户，同时面临效率的随机冲击。该模型静态均衡的特性与企业和行业动态中的实证规律相关。作为模型的应用，本文探讨了信息传播成本下降对企业和行业动态的影响。（JEL D11, D83, L11, L81, M37）

abstract.text: We study the evolution of both characteristics of reciprocity: the willingness to reward and the willingness to punish. First, both preferences for rewarding and preferences for punishing can survive provided that individuals interact within separate groups. Second, rewarders survive only in coexistence with self-interested preferences, but punishers either vanish or dominate the population entirely. Third, the evolution of preferences for rewarding and the evolution of preferences for punishing influence each other decisively. Rewarders can invade a population of self-interested players. The existence of rewarders enhances the evolutionary success of punishers, who then crowd out all other preferences. (JEL C71, C72, C73, D64, K42)

10.1257/aer.102.2.914.abstractZh: 我们研究了互惠特征的演变：奖励意愿和惩罚意愿。首先，只要个体在各自的群体中互动，奖励偏好和惩罚偏好都能得以维持。其次，奖励者只有在与自私偏好共存的情况下才能存活，而惩罚者则要么消失，要么完全主导群体。第三，奖励偏好和惩罚偏好的演变彼此之间存在决定性的影响。奖励者可以侵入自私玩家的群体。奖励者的存在增强了惩罚者的进化优势，从而使其他偏好被排挤出去。（JEL C71, C72, C73, D64, K42）

abstract.text: We use a series of field experiments in rural Burundi to examine the impact of exposure to conflict on social, risk, and time preferences. We find that conflict affects behavior: individuals exposed to violence display more altruistic behavior towards their neighbors, are more risk-seeking, and have higher discount rates. Large adverse shocks can thus alter savings and investments decisions, and potentially have long-run consequences—even if the shocks themselves are temporary. (JEL C93, D12, D74, 012, 017, 018)

10.1257/aer.102.2.941.abstractZh: 我们在布隆迪农村进行了一系列实地实验，以研究冲突暴露对社会、风险偏好和时间偏好的影响。研究发现，冲突会影响行为：暴露于暴力环境中的个体会表现出更多的利他行为，更倾向于冒险，并且折现率更高。因此，严重的负面冲击可能会改变储蓄和投资决策，并可能产生长期后果——即使这些冲击本身是暂时的。（JEL C93, D12, D74, 012, 017, 018）

abstract.text: An advantage of cap-and-trade programs over more prescriptive environmental regulation is that compliance flexibility and cost effectiveness can make more stringent emissions reductions politically feasible. However, when markets (versus regulators) determine where emissions occur, it becomes more difficult to assure that mandated emissions reductions are equitably achieved. We investigate these issues in the context of Southern California's RECLAIM program by matching facilities in RECLAIM with similar California facilities also in nonattainment areas. Our results indicate that average emissions fell 20 percent at RECLAIM facilities relative to our counterfactual. Furthermore, observed changes in emissions do not vary significantly with neighborhood demographic characteristics. (JEL H23, L51, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.102.2.965.abstractZh: 总量控制与交易计划相较于更为规范的环境监管，其优势在于能够提供更灵活的合规性和成本效益，从而使更严格的减排目标在政治上更具可行性。然而，当市场而非监管机构来决定排放发生地点时，确保强制性的减排目标得到公平实现就变得更加困难。我们通过将南加州RECLAIM计划中的设施与加州其他处于未达标地区的类似设施进行对比，来研究这些问题。研究结果表明，RECLAIM计划中的设施平均排放量相比对照组减少了20%。此外，观测到的排放变化与周边地区的人口特征并无显著关联。（JEL H23, L51, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: GDP growth is often measured poorly for countries and rarely measured at all for cities or subnational regions. We propose a readily available proxy: satellite data on lights at night. We develop a statistical framework that uses lights growth to augment existing income growth measures, under the assumption that measurement error in using observed light as an indicator of income is uncorrelated with measurement error in national income accounts. For countries with good national income accounts data, information on growth of lights is of marginal value in estimating the true growth rate of income, while for countries with the worst national income accounts, the optimal estimate of true income growth is a composite with roughly equal weights. Among poor-data countries, our new estimate of average annual growth differs by as much as 3 percentage points from official data. Lights data also allow for measurement of income growth in sub- and supranational regions. As an application, we examine growth in Sub Saharan African regions over the last 17 years. We find that real incomes in non-coastal areas have grown faster by 1/3 of an annual percentage point than coastal areas; non-malarial areas have grown faster than malarial ones by 1/3 to 2/3 annual percent points; and primate city regions have grown no faster than hinterland areas. Such applications point toward a research program in which "empirical growth" need no longer be synonymous with "national income accounts."

10.1257/aer.102.2.994.abstractZh: GDP增长往往难以准确衡量，对于城市或次国家级地区来说，这种衡量几乎是不可能的。我们提出了一种易于获取的替代指标：夜间灯光数据。我们开发了一个统计框架，利用灯光增长来补充现有的收入增长衡量方法，前提是使用观测到的灯光作为收入指标的测量误差与国民收入账户的测量误差不相关。对于拥有良好国民收入账户数据的国家来说，灯光增长信息在估算真实收入增长率时具有边际价值；而对于国民收入账户数据较差的国家，真实收入增长的最佳估计是一个加权平均值。在数据匮乏的国家中，我们新的平均年增长率与官方数据相差高达3个百分点。灯光数据还允许对次国家级和超国家级地区的收入增长进行测量。作为应用实例，我们研究了过去17年撒哈拉以南非洲地区的增长情况。我们发现，非沿海地区的实际收入增长率比沿海地区快了1/3个百分点；非疟疾地区的发展速度比疟疾地区快了1/3到2/3个百分点；而大都市地区的发展速度与腹地地区相当。这些应用表明，未来的研究不应再将“经验性增长”与“国民收入账户”等同起来。

abstract.text: The science of economics has some constraints and tensions that set it apart from other sciences. One reflection of these constraints and tensions is that, more than in most other scientific disciplines, it is easy to find economists of high reputation who disagree strongly with one another on issues of wide public interest. This may sug gest that economics, unlike most other scientific disciplines, does not really make progress. Its theories and results seem to come and go, always in hot dispute, rather than improving over time so as to build an increasing body of knowledge. There is some truth to this view; there are examples where disputes of earlier decades have been not so much resolved as replaced by new disputes. But though econom ics progresses unevenly, and not even monotonically, there are some examples of real scientific progress in economics. This essay describes one—the evolution since around 1950 of our understanding of how monetary policy is determined and what its effects are. The story described here is not a simple success story. It describes an ascent to higher ground, but the ground is still shaky. Part of the purpose of the essay is to remind readers of how views strongly held in earlier decades have since been shown to be mistaken. This should encourage continuing skepticism of consensus views and motivate critics to sharpen their efforts at looking at new data, or at old data in new ways, and generating improved theories in the light of what they see. We will be tracking two interrelated strands of intellectual effort: the methodol ogy of modeling and inference for economic time series, and the theory of policy influences on business cycle fluctuations. The starting point in the 1950s of the the ory of macroeconomic policy was Keynes's analysis of the Great Depression of the 1930s, which included an attack on the Quantity Theory of money. In the 1930s, interest rates on safe assets had been at approximately zero over long spans of time, and Keynes explained why, under these circumstances, expansion of the money sup ply was likely to have little effect. The leading American Keynesian, Alvin Hansen, included in his (1952) book A Guide to Keynes a chapter on money, in which he explained Keynes's argument for the likely ineffectiveness of monetary expansion in a period of depressed output. Hansen concluded the chapter with, Thus it is that modern countries place primary emphasis on fiscal policy, in whose service mone tary policy is relegated to the subsidiary role of a useful but necessary handmaiden. The methodology of modeling in the 1950s built on Jan Tinbergen's (1939) seminal book, which presented probably the first multiple-equation, statistically estimated economic time series model. His efforts drew heavy criticism. Keynes

10.1257/aer.102.4.1187.abstractZh: 经济学作为一门科学，存在一些与其他科学不同的限制和矛盾。这些限制和矛盾的一个体现是，与大多数其他科学学科相比，很容易找到一些声誉卓著的经济学家在涉及公众利益的问题上存在严重分歧。这可能会让人认为，经济学不像其他大多数科学学科那样能够取得真正的进步。它的理论和成果似乎总是处于争议之中，而不是随着时间的推移而不断改进，从而积累更多的知识。这种观点有一定的道理；有些例子表明，早期几十年的争议并没有得到解决，而是被新的争议所取代。不过，尽管经济学的进步并不均衡，甚至不是单调的，但确实有一些经济学领域取得科学进步的例子。本文描述了其中一个例子——自1950年左右以来，我们对货币政策如何形成及其影响的理解发生了哪些变化。这里所描述的故事并非简单的成功故事。它描绘了一个逐步上升的过程，但这一进程仍然不稳定。本文的部分目的是提醒读者，早期持有的观点后来被证明是错误的。这应该有助于持续对共识观点保持怀疑态度，并激励批评者以新的方式审视旧数据，或者根据新的发现来改进理论。我们将关注两个相互关联的研究领域：经济时间序列的建模和推断方法，以及政策对商业周期波动的影响理论。20世纪50年代，宏观经济政策理论的开端源于凯恩斯对1930年代大萧条的分析，其中对货币数量论提出了质疑。在1930年代，安全资产的利率长期保持在接近零的水平，凯恩斯解释了为何在这种情况下，货币供应量的扩张可能效果甚微。美国著名的凯恩斯主义者阿尔文·汉森在其1952年出版的《凯恩斯指南》一书中加入了一章关于货币的内容，他在书中阐述了凯恩斯关于在产出低迷时期货币扩张可能无效的观点。汉森在章节结尾总结道：“因此，现代国家将主要重点放在财政政策上，而货币政策则被置于次要地位，成为一种有用但必要的辅助手段。”20世纪50年代的建模方法建立在扬·廷伯根1939年出版的开创性著作基础上，该书提出了可能是第一个多方程统计估计经济时间序列模型。他的努力遭到了严厉的批评。凯恩斯

abstract.text: This paper reports an experiment in 640 Indonesian villages on three approaches to target the poor: proxy-means tests (PMT), where assets are used to predict consumption; community targeting, where villagers rank everyone from richest to poorest; and a hybrid. Defining poverty based on PPP$2 per-capita consumption, community targeting and the hybrid perform somewhat worse in identifying the poor than PMT, though not by enough to significantly affect poverty outcomes for a typical program. Elite capture does not explain these results. Instead, communities appear to apply a different concept of poverty. Consistent with this finding, community targeting results in higher satisfaction.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1206.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项在印度尼西亚640个村庄进行的实验，研究三种针对贫困群体的方法：代理手段测试（PMT），即利用资产来预测消费；社区定向，即让村民对从最富有到最贫穷的人进行排序；以及混合方法。以人均消费2印尼盾作为贫困的定义标准，社区定向和混合方法的识别效果略低于代理手段测试，但差距不足以显著影响典型项目的贫困成果。精英捕获理论无法解释这些结果。相反，社区似乎采用了不同的贫困概念。与这一发现一致的是，社区定向方法能够带来更高的满意度。

abstract.text: We use a randomized experiment and a structural model to test whether monitoring and financial incentives can reduce teacher absence and increase learning in India. In treatment schools, teachers' attendance was monitored daily using cameras, and their salaries were made a nonlinear function of attendance. Teacher absenteeism in the treatment group fell by 21 percentage points relative to the control group, and the children's test scores increased by 0.17 standard deviations. We estimate a structural dynamic labor supply model and find that teachers respond strongly to financial incentives. Our model is used to compute cost-minimizing compensation policies. (JEL I21, J31, J45, O15)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1241.abstractZh: 我们采用随机实验和结构模型来检验监控和财务激励措施是否能够减少教师的缺勤并提升印度的教育质量。在实验组中，教师的出勤情况通过摄像头每日进行监控，而他们的薪资则与出勤率呈非线性关系。与对照组相比，实验组的教师缺勤率下降了21个百分点，学生的测试成绩也提高了0.17个标准差。我们通过结构动态劳动力供给模型进行估算，发现教师对财务激励措施的反应非常积极。我们的模型还用于计算成本最低的薪酬政策。（JEL I21, J31, J45, O15）

abstract.text: We study the design of randomized controlled experiments when outcomes are significantly affected by experimental subjects' unobserved effort expenditure. While standard randomized controlled trials (RCTs) are internally consistent, the unobservability of effort compromises external validity. We approach trial design as a principal-agent problem and show that natural extensions of RCTs—which we call selective trials—can help improve external validity. In particular, selective trials can disentangle the effects of treatment, effort, and the interaction of treatment and effort. Moreover, they can help identify when treatment effects are affected by erroneous beliefs and inappropriate effort expenditure.(JEL C90, D82)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1279.abstractZh: 我们研究了在实验对象的未观测努力支出显著影响结果时，随机对照实验的设计问题。虽然标准的随机对照试验在内部上是一致的，但努力的不可观测性却影响了实验的外部有效性。我们将试验设计视为一个委托-代理问题，并表明随机对照试验的自然扩展形式——我们称之为选择性试验——可以帮助提高外部有效性。特别是，选择性试验能够分离出治疗、努力以及治疗与努力相互作用的影响。此外，它们还可以帮助识别治疗效果何时受到错误信念和不适当努力支出的影响。(JEL C90, D82)

abstract.text: We examine empirically the impact of ethnic divisions on conflict, by using a specification based on Esteban and Ray (2011). That theory links conflict intensity to three indices of ethnic distribution: polarization, fractionalization, and the Gini-Greenberg index. The empirical analysis verifies that these distributional measures are significant correlates of conflict. These effects persist as we introduce country-specific measures of group cohesion and of the importance of public goods, and combine them with the distributional measures exactly as described by the theory. (JEL D63, D74, J15, O15, O17)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1310.abstractZh: 我们通过基于Esteban和Ray（2011）的研究方法，实证分析了种族分化对冲突的影响。该理论将冲突强度与三个种族分布指标联系起来：两极分化、碎片化以及Gini-Greenberg指数。实证分析证实，这些分布指标是冲突的重要预测因素。当我们引入特定国家的群体凝聚力指标以及公共物品的重要性指标，并将它们与理论所描述的分布指标相结合时，这些效应仍然显著。（JEL D63, D74, J15, O15, O17）

abstract.text: Innovations to consumer confidence convey incremental information about economic activity far into the future. Does this reflect a causal effect of animal spirits on economic activity, or news about exogenous future productivity received by consumers? Using indirect inference, we study the impulse responses to confidence innovations in conjunction with an appropriately augmented New Keynesian model. While news, animal spirits, and pure noise all contribute to confidence innovations, the relationship between confidence and subsequent activity is almost entirely reflective of the news component. Confidence innovations are well characterized as noisy measures of changes in expected productivity growth over a relatively long horizon. (JEL D12, D83, D84, E12)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1343.abstractZh: 对消费者信心的创新传递了关于未来经济活动的逐步信息。这是否反映了动物精神对经济活动的因果效应，还是消费者接收到的关于未来生产力变化的消息？通过间接推断，我们研究了信心创新对后续活动的即时反应，并使用了适当扩展的新凯恩斯模型进行分析。虽然消息、动物精神和纯粹的噪音都会对信心创新产生影响，但信心与后续经济活动之间的关系几乎完全反映了消息成分的影响。信心创新可以被描述为对相对较长时间范围内预期生产力增长变化的噪声性度量。（JEL D12, D83, D84, E12）

abstract.text: That the employment rate appears to respond to changes in trend growth is an enduring macroeconomic puzzle. This paper shows that, in the presence of a return to experience, a slowdown in productivity growth raises reservation wages, thereby lowering aggregate employment. The paper develops new evidence that shows this mechanism is important for explaining the growth-employment puzzle. The combined effects of changes in aggregate wage growth and returns to experience account for all the increase from 1968 to 2006 in nonemployment among low-skilled men and for approximately half the increase in nonemployment among all men. (JEL E24, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1378.abstractZh: 就业率似乎对趋势增长的变化有反应，这是一个持久的宏观经济难题。本文指出，在经验回报存在的情况下，生产率增长的放缓会提高保留工资，从而降低总体就业水平。研究还提出了新的证据，表明这一机制对于解释增长与就业之间的矛盾关系非常重要。从1968年到2006年，总体工资增长的变化以及经验回报的变化共同导致了低技能男性非就业人数的增加，并且大约一半的所有男性非就业人数的增加也与此机制有关。（JEL E24, J24, J31）

abstract.text: We use unique depositor-level data for a bank that faced a run to understand the factors that affect depositor behavior. We find uninsured depositors are most likely to run. Deposit insurance helps, but is only partially effective. Bank-depositor relationships mitigate runs, suggesting that relationship with depositors help banks reduce fragility. In addition, we also find that social networks matter. Finally, we find long-term effects of a solvent bank run in that depositors who run do not return back to the bank. Our results help understand the underlying dynamics of bank runs and hold important policy implications. (JEL D12, G21, O16, Z13)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1414.abstractZh: 我们使用了一家遭遇挤兑的银行的独特储户级数据，以了解影响储户行为的因素。我们发现，未投保的储户最有可能进行挤兑。存款保险有所帮助，但效果有限。银行与储户之间的关系可以缓解挤兑，这表明与储户的关系有助于银行降低脆弱性。此外，我们还发现社交网络也起着重要作用。最后，我们发现，当一家银行发生挤兑时，进行挤兑的储户不会重新回到银行。我们的研究结果有助于理解银行挤兑的潜在动态，并具有重要的政策意义。（JEL D12, G21, O16, Z13）

abstract.text: In dynamic collective decision making, current decisions determine the future distribution of political power and influence future decisions. We develop a general framework to study this class of problems. Under acyclicity, we characterize dynamically stable states as functions of the initial state and obtain two general insights. First, a social arrangement is made stable by the instability of alternative arrangements that are preferred by sufficiently powerful groups. Second, efficiency-enhancing changes may be resisted because of further changes they will engender. We use this framework to analyze dynamics of political rights in a society with different types of extremist views. (JEL D71, D72, K10)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1446.abstractZh: 在动态集体决策中，当前的决策决定了政治权力的未来分配，并影响未来的决策。我们开发了一个通用框架来研究这类问题。在非循环性条件下，我们将动态稳定状态描述为初始状态的函数，并得出两个重要见解：首先，一个社会安排的稳定性源于那些被足够强大的群体所偏好的替代安排的不稳定性；其次，效率提升的变革可能会因它们引发的进一步变革而受到抵制。我们利用这一框架来分析具有不同类型极端观点的社会中的政治权利动态。（JEL D71, D72, K10）

abstract.text: The 1930s American Dust Bowl was an environmental catastrophe that greatly eroded sections of the Plains. The Dust Bowl is estimated to have immediately, substantially, and persistently reduced agricultural land values and revenues in more-eroded counties relative to less-eroded counties. During the Depression and through at least the 1950s, there was limited relative adjustment of farmland away from activities that became relatively less productive in more-eroded areas. Agricultural adjustments recovered less than 25 percent of the initial difference in agricultural costs for more-eroded counties. The economy adjusted predominantly through large relative population declines in more-eroded counties, both during the 1930s and through the 1950s. (JEL N32, N52, Q15, Q18, Q54)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1477.abstractZh: 1930年代的美国尘暴是一场环境灾难，严重破坏了大平原地区的土地。据估计，尘暴导致受破坏严重的县区的农业土地价值和收入立即、显著且持续地下降，相比之下，受破坏较轻的县区则没有如此严重的损失。在经济大萧条期间，直到至少20世纪50年代，人们几乎没有将农田从那些在受破坏地区生产力下降的活动中转移出去。受破坏严重的县区的农业调整效果仅恢复了初始农业成本差异的25%左右。在1930年代和20世纪50年代期间，受破坏严重的县区的经济调整主要通过大量人口流失来实现。（JEL N32, N52, Q15, Q18, Q54）

abstract.text: This study explores the determinants of ethnolinguistic diversity within as well as across countries shedding light on its geographic origins. The empirical analysis conducted across countries, virtual countries and pairs of contiguous regions establishes that geographic variability, captured by variation in regional land quality and elevation, is a fundamental determinant of contemporary linguistic diversity. The findings are consistent with the proposed hypothesis that differences in land endowments gave rise to location-specific human capital, leading to the formation of localized ethnicities.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1508.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了民族语言多样性在各国内部及跨国界的影响因素，并揭示了其地理起源。通过对各国、虚拟国家以及相邻地区之间的实证分析发现，地理差异——体现在地区土地质量和海拔的变化上——是当代语言多样性的基本决定因素。研究结果与提出的假设一致：不同的土地禀赋导致了特定地区的人力资本形成，进而促成了地方性的民族形成。

abstract.text: Liberalization of the European automobile distribution system in 2002 limits the ability of manufacturers to impose vertical restraints, leading to a substantial increase in competitive pressure among dealers. We estimate an equilibrium model of profit maximization to evaluate how dealers change their innovation adoption strategies following the elimination of exclusive territories. Using French data we evaluate the existence of complementarities between the adoption of software applications and the scale of production. Firms view these innovations as substitutes and concentrate their effort in one type of software as they expand their scale of production. Results are robust to the existence of unobserved heterogeneity. (JEL D24, K21, L21, L22, L62, O32)

10.1257/aer.102.4.1540.abstractZh: 2002年欧洲汽车分销系统的自由化限制了制造商实施纵向限制的能力，导致经销商之间的竞争压力显著增加。我们通过构建利润最大化均衡模型来评估在独家市场区域被取消后，经销商如何改变其创新采用策略。利用法国数据，我们评估了软件应用采用与生产规模之间的互补性。企业将这些创新视为替代品，并在扩大生产规模时专注于某一类型的软件。研究结果在存在未观测的异质性时依然稳健。（JEL D24, K21, L21, L22, L62, O32）

abstract.text: Using matched data on product-level prices and the producing firm's unit labor cost, we find a moderate pass-through of current idiosyncratic marginal-cost changes. Also, the response does not vary across firms facing very different idiosyncratic shock variances, but identical aggregate conditions. These results do not fit the predictions of Mackowiak and Wiederholt (2009). Neither do firms react strongly to predictable marginal-cost changes, as expected from Mankiw and Reis (2002). We find that firms consider both current and expected future marginal cost when setting prices. This points toward impediments to continuous price adjustments as a key driver of monetary non-neutrality.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1571.abstractZh: 通过产品层面价格和生产企业单位劳动成本的相关数据，我们发现当前特有的边际成本变化具有适度的传递效应。此外，这种反应并不因企业面临的不同特异性冲击而有所差异，只要总体条件相同。这些结果不符合Mackowiak和Wiederholt（2009）的预测。企业对于可预测的边际成本变化也没有像Mankiw和Reis（2002）所预期的那样做出强烈反应。我们发现，企业在定价时会同时考虑当前和预期的未来边际成本。这表明，持续的价格调整障碍是货币非中性性的关键驱动因素。

abstract.text: We present evidence on the term structure of the equity premium. We recover prices of dividend strips, which are short-term assets that pay dividends on the stock index every period up to period T and nothing thereafter. It is short-term relative to the index because the index pays dividends in perpetuity. We find that expected returns, Sharpe ratios, and volatilities on short-term assets are higher than on the index, while their CAPM betas are below one. Short-term assets are more volatile than their realizations, leading to excess volatility and return predictability. Our findings are inconsistent with many leading theories.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1596.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于股权溢价期限结构的相关证据。我们计算了股息支付资产的定价，这些资产是短期资产，在T期之前每期都会支付股票指数的股息，之后则不再支付。与指数相比，这些资产属于短期资产，因为指数会持续支付股息。我们发现，这些短期资产的预期回报、夏普比率和波动性都高于指数，而它们的资本资产定价模型系数低于1。这些短期资产的波动性高于其实际收益，导致过度波动性和回报的可预测性。我们的发现与许多主流理论并不一致。

abstract.text: Why did Finland experience, in 1991–1993, the deepest recession observed in an industrialized country since the 1930s? Using a dynamic general equilibrium model with labor frictions, we argue that the collapse of the Soviet-Finnish trade was a major contributor to the contraction. Finland's experience mirrors that of the transition economies of Eastern Europe, which suffered similar deep recessions coupled with institutional changes. By focusing on the Finnish case, we isolate the effects of the Finnish-Soviet trade collapse and shed new light on the sources of recessions in transition economies.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1619.abstractZh: 为什么芬兰在1991年至1993年间经历了自20世纪30年代以来工业化国家中最严重的经济衰退？通过采用包含劳动力摩擦的动态一般均衡模型进行分析，我们认为苏联与芬兰之间的贸易崩溃是导致经济收缩的主要因素之一。芬兰的经历与东欧转型经济体的情况相似，这些经济体也经历了类似的严重经济衰退，同时伴随着制度变革。通过聚焦芬兰的案例，我们能够分离出芬兰与苏联贸易崩溃的影响，并为转型经济体的经济衰退原因提供新的见解。

abstract.text: What determines reciprocity in employment relations? We conducted a controlled field experiment to measure the extent to which monetary and nonmonetary gifts affect workers' performance. We find that nonmonetary gifts have a much stronger impact than monetary gifts of equivalent value. We also observe that when workers are offered the choice, they prefer receiving money, but reciprocate as if they received a nonmonetary gift. This result is consistent with the common saying, “it's the thought that counts.” We underline this point by showing that monetary gifts can effectively trigger reciprocity if the employer invests more time and effort into the gift's presentation.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1644.abstractZh: 什么决定了雇佣关系中的互惠行为？我们进行了一项控制性实地实验，以衡量货币和非货币礼物对工人绩效的影响程度。我们发现，非货币礼物的影响比同等价值的货币礼物要强得多。我们还观察到，当工人有选择的权利时，他们更倾向于接受金钱，但他们的回应却像收到了非货币礼物一样。这一结果与“心意最重要”的说法一致。我们通过以下事实进一步强调了这一点：如果雇主在礼物赠送过程中投入更多的时间和精力，货币礼物就能有效地引发互惠行为。

abstract.text: The household's labor margin has a substantial effect on risk aversion, and hence asset prices, in dynamic equilibrium models even when utility is additively separable between consumption and labor. This paper derives simple, closed-form expressions for risk aversion that take into account the household's labor margin. Ignoring this margin can dramatically overstate the household's true aversion to risk. Risk premia on assets priced with the stochastic discount factor increase essentially linearly with risk aversion, so measuring risk aversion correctly is crucial for asset pricing in the model.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1663.abstractZh: 在动态均衡模型中，家庭的劳动边际对风险厌恶有着显著的影响，因此也会对资产价格产生影响，即使效用在消费和劳动之间是可加分的。本文推导出了考虑家庭劳动边际的风险厌恶的简洁封闭形式表达式。忽略这一边际会严重高估家庭对风险的真实厌恶程度。用随机折现因子定价资产时，风险溢价与风险厌恶程度呈线性增长关系，因此正确衡量风险厌恶对于模型中的资产定价至关重要。

abstract.text: Using micro-level data, we construct a credit spread index with considerable predictive power for future economic activity. We decompose the credit spread into a component that captures firm-specific information on expected defaults and a residual component–– the excess bond premium. Shocks to the excess bond premium that are orthogonal to the current state of the economy lead to declines in economic activity and asset prices. An increase in the excess bond premium appears to reflect a reduction in the risk-bearing capacity of the financial sector, which induces a contraction in the supply of credit and a deterioration in macroeconomic conditions.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1692.abstractZh: 通过微观层面的数据，我们构建了一个具有显著预测能力的信用利差指数，用于预测未来的经济活动。我们将信用利差分解为两部分：一部分反映企业特定情况下的违约预期信息；另一部分则是额外的债券溢价。与当前经济状况无关的冲击会导致额外的债券溢价下降，进而引发经济活动和资产价格的下跌。额外的债券溢价上升似乎表明金融部门的承担风险能力减弱，这会导致信贷供应收缩以及宏观经济状况恶化。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a search-and-matching model of unemployment in which jobs are rationed: the labor market does not clear in the absence of matching frictions. This job shortage arises in an economic equilibrium from the combination of some wage rigidity and diminishing marginal returns to labor. In recessions, job rationing is acute, driving the rise in unemployment, whereas matching frictions contribute little to unemployment. Intuitively in recessions, jobs are lacking, the labor market is slack, and recruiting is easy and inexpensive, so matching frictions do not matter much. In a calibrated model, cyclical fluctuations in the composition of unemployment are large.

10.1257/aer.102.4.1721.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个失业的搜索与匹配模型，其中工作机会是配给的：在没有匹配摩擦的情况下，劳动力市场不会实现均衡。这种工作短缺是由于工资刚性以及劳动边际收益递减的结合所导致的经济均衡现象。在经济衰退期间，工作配给现象尤为严重，导致失业率上升，而匹配摩擦对失业的影响较小。直观上，在经济衰退期间，工作机会不足，劳动力市场疲软，招聘既容易又便宜，因此匹配摩擦并不重要。在一个经过校准的模型中，失业构成的周期性波动较大。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines Adda and Cornaglia's (2006) evidence on the compensatory behavior of smokers who, in face of higher taxes, are found to reduce their consumption of cigarettes while maintaining their cotinine––a biomarker for nicotine––levels constant. This comment examines the robustness of the empirical findings in Adda and Cornaglia (2006) using: appropriate clustered standard errors, a larger sample from the same years and survey as the data in Adda and Cornaglia (2006), cigarette-prices instead of and in addition to cigarette-taxes, and sampling weights. The empirical findings of Adda and Cornaglia (2006) are not robust. Further, little systematic evidence of compensatory behavior is found among subsamples of smokers

10.1257/aer.102.4.1751.abstractZh: 本文重新探讨了Adda和Cornaglia（2006）关于吸烟者的补偿行为的研究。研究发现，尽管面临更高的税收，吸烟者仍会保持其尼古丁生物标志物——可替宁的水平不变，同时减少香烟的消费量。本文通过采用适当的聚类标准误差、更大规模的样本（与Adda和Cornaglia（2006）的研究年份和调查对象相同）、香烟价格而非仅税收作为调节变量，以及抽样权重等方法，对Adda和Cornaglia（2006）的研究结果进行了稳健性检验。结果表明，Adda和Cornaglia（2006）的研究结果并不稳健。此外，在吸烟者的子样本中也未发现明显的补偿行为。

abstract.text: We study the effects of network externalities within a protocol for matching faculty to offices in a new building. Using web and survey data on faculty's attributes and choices, we identify the different layers of the social network: institutional affiliation, coauthorships, and friendships. We quantify the effects of network externalities on choices and outcomes, disentangle the layers of the networks, and quantify their relative influence. Finally, we assess the protocol used from a welfare perspective. Our study suggests the importance and feasibility of accounting for network externalities in assignment problems and evaluates techniques that can be employed to this end. (JEL C78, C93, D62, D85, Z13)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1773.abstractZh: 我们研究了在网络外部性影响下的协议在将教职员工分配到新建筑内的办公室中的效果。通过收集教职员工属性及选择相关的网络数据和调查数据，我们识别出社交网络的不同层次：机构隶属关系、合作关系以及友谊关系。我们量化了网络外部性对选择和结果的影响，理清了网络中的不同层次，并评估了它们相对的影响力。最后，我们从福利的角度评估了所采用的协议。我们的研究表明，在分配问题中考虑网络外部性的重要性与可行性，并评估了可用于实现这一目标的技巧。（JEL C78, C93, D62, D85, Z13）

abstract.text: We propose an incentive scheme for educators that links compensation to the ranks of their students within comparison sets. Under certain conditions, this scheme induces teachers to allocate socially optimal levels of effort. Moreover, because this scheme employs only ordinal information, it allows education authorities to employ completely new assessments at each testing date without ever having to equate various assessments. This removes incentives for teachers to teach to a particular assessment form and eliminates opportunities to influence reward pay by corrupting assessment scales. Education authorities can employ separate no-stakes assessment systems to track trends in scaled measures of student achievement. (JEL I21, I28, J33, J45)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1805.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对教育者的激励方案，该方案将薪酬与学生在比较组中的排名挂钩。在某些条件下，该方案能够促使教师付出社会最优的努力水平。此外，由于该方案仅使用序数信息，因此教育当局可以在每次测试时采用全新的评估方式，而无需将各种评估方式进行等同处理。这消除了教师为迎合特定评估形式而教学的动力，也消除了通过篡改评估标准来影响奖励支付的机会。教育当局可以采用无风险评估系统来跟踪学生学业成就的量化指标的变化趋势。（JEL I21, I28, J33, J45）

abstract.text: During the age of mass migration (1850-1913), one of the largest migration episodes in history, the United States maintained a nearly open border, allowing the study of migrant decisions unhindered by entry restrictions. We estimate the return to migration while accounting for migrant selection by comparing Norway-to-US migrants with their brothers who stayed in Norway in the late nineteenth century. We also compare fathers of migrants and nonmigrants by wealth and occupation. We find that the return to migration was relatively low (70 percent) and that migrants from urban areas were negatively selected from the sending population. "Keep, ancient lands, your storied pomp!" cries she With silent lips. "Give me your tired, your poor, Your huddled masses yearning to breathe free, The wretched refuse of your teeming shore. Send these, the homeless, tempest-tost to me, I lift my lamp beside the golden door!"--Emma Lazarus (1883).

10.1257/aer.102.5.1832.abstractZh: 在大规模移民时代（1850-1913年），这是历史上规模最大的移民事件之一，美国保持了一个几乎开放的边境，使得研究移民决策不受入境限制的影响。我们通过比较从挪威移民到美国的移民与他们在十九世纪末留在挪威的兄弟，来估算移民的回报。我们还比较了移民与非移民的父亲的财富和职业状况。研究发现，移民的回报相对较低（为70%），而且来自城市地区的移民在出发地人口中属于被负面选择的群体。“保留那些古老的土地，它们拥有丰富的历史与荣光！”她用沉默的嘴唇这样呼喊。“把你们疲惫的人、贫穷的人、渴望自由的人群，还有你们拥挤海岸线上的可怜人，都送给我吧。把这些无家可归、在风暴中挣扎的人带到我这里来吧，我在金色的门前点亮我的灯火！”——艾玛·拉扎鲁斯（1883年）。

abstract.text: We examine the informal exchange of favors in societies such that any two individuals interact too infrequently to sustain exchange, but such that the social pressure of the possible loss of multiple relationships can sustain exchange. Patterns of exchange that are locally enforceable and renegotiation-proof necessitate that all links are “supported”: any two individuals exchanging favors have a common friend. In symmetric settings, such robust networks are “social quilts”: tree-like unions of completely connected subnetworks. Examining favor exchange networks in 75 villages in rural India, we find high levels of support and identify characteristics that correlate with support. (JEL D85, O12, O18, Z13)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1857.abstractZh: 我们研究了社会中非正式的互助交换现象。在这种社会中，任何两个个体之间的互动频率过低，无法维持交换行为，但由于可能失去多个关系所带来的社会压力，交换行为仍然得以持续。这种在局部可强制执行且无需重新协商的交换模式要求所有联系都得到“支持”：任何进行互助交换的两个个体都拥有一个共同的朋友。在对称性的环境中，这种强大的网络被称为“社会拼布”：由完全连接的子网络构成的树状联合体。通过对印度农村75个村庄中的互助交换网络进行研究，我们发现这种交换行为具有高度的支持性，并识别出与这种支持性相关的特征。（JEL D85, O12, O18, Z13）

abstract.text: We propose a new strategy for a pervasive problem in the hedonics literature: recovering hedonic prices in the presence of time-varying correlated unobservables. Our approach relies on an assumption about home buyer rationality, under which prior sales prices can be used to control for time-varying unobservable attributes of the house or neighborhood. Using housing transactions data from California's Bay Area between 1990 and 2006, we apply our estimator to recover marginal willingness to pay for reductions in three of the EPA's “criteria” air pollutants. Our findings suggest that ignoring bias from time-varying correlated unobservables considerably understates the benefits of a pollution reduction policy. (JEL D12, D84, Q53, Q58, R21)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1898.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种针对享乐经济学文献中普遍问题的新策略：在存在随时间变化的相关不可观测因素的情况下，恢复享乐价格。我们的方法基于一个关于购房者理性的假设，即可以利用先前的销售价格来控制房屋或社区随时间变化的不可观测属性。通过利用1990年至2006年间加州湾区房屋交易数据，我们应用该估计方法来恢复对EPA规定的三种空气污染物的减少的边际支付意愿。我们的研究结果表明，忽略随时间变化的相关不可观测因素的偏差会严重低估污染减少政策的效益。（JEL D12, D84, Q53, Q58, R21）

abstract.text: Using an instrumental variables strategy, we estimate the causal effect of income on children's math and reading achievement. Our identification derives from the large, nonlinear changes in the Earned Income Tax Credit. The largest of these changes increased family income by as much as 20 percent, or approximately $2,100, between 1993 and 1997. Our baseline estimates imply that a $1,000 increase in income raises combined math and reading test scores by 6 percent of a standard deviation in the short run. Test gains are larger for children from disadvantaged families and robust to a variety of alternative specifications. (JEL H24, H31, I21, I38, J13)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1927.abstractZh: 通过采用工具变量策略，我们估计了收入对儿童数学和阅读成绩的影响。我们的识别依据源于劳动收入税收抵免政策的巨大、非线性的变化。在1993年至1997年间，这一政策的最大变化使家庭收入增加了20%，约2,100美元。我们的基线估计表明，短期内，收入每增加1,000美元，数学和阅读测试成绩将提高6个标准差。对于来自弱势家庭的儿童来说，这种提升更为显著，且这种效应在不同替代模型下仍然成立。（JEL H24, H31, I21, I38, J13）

abstract.text: We consider competition between sellers selling multiple distinct products to a buyer having k slots. Under independent pricing, a pure strategy equilibrium often does not exist, and equilibrium in mixed strategy is never efficient. When bundling is allowed, each seller has an incentive to bundle his products, and an efficient “technology-renting” equilibrium always exists. Furthermore, in the case of digital goods or when sales below marginal cost are banned, all equilibria are efficient. Comparing the mixed-strategy equilibrium with the technology-renting equilibrium reveals that bundling often increases the buyer's surplus. Finally, we derive clear-cut policy implications.(JEL D43, D86, K21, L13, L14, L41, L82)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1957.abstractZh: 我们考虑了多个不同产品的卖家与拥有k个销售槽位的买家之间的竞争。在独立定价的情况下，通常不存在纯策略均衡，而混合策略均衡也从不具有效率。当允许捆绑销售时，每个卖家都有动机将其产品进行捆绑销售，此时总是存在高效的“技术租赁”均衡。此外，在数字商品的情况下，或者当销售行为被禁止低于边际成本时，所有均衡都是高效的。通过比较混合策略均衡和技术租赁均衡，我们发现捆绑销售通常会增加买家的收益。最后，我们得出了明确的政策启示。(JEL D43, D86, K21, L13, L14, L41, L82)

abstract.text: We propose a model of delegated portfolio management with career concerns. Investors hire fund managers to invest their capital either in risky bonds or in riskless assets. Some managers have superior information on default risk. Based on past performance, investors update beliefs on managers and make firing decisions. This leads to career concerns that affect managers' investment decisions, generating a countercyclical “reputational premium.” When default risk is high, return on bonds is high to compensate uninformed managers for the high risk of being fired. As default risk changes over time, the reputational premium amplifies price volatility. (JEL G11, G12, G23, L84)

10.1257/aer.102.5.1986.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含职业考量的委托投资组合管理模型。投资者雇佣基金经理来投资他们的资金，资金可以投资于风险较高的债券或无风险资产。一些基金经理在违约风险方面拥有更先进的信息。基于过往表现，投资者会更新对基金经理的看法，并做出解雇决策。这导致了职业考量对基金经理投资决策的影响，从而产生一种反周期性的“声誉溢价”。当违约风险较高时，债券收益率较高，以补偿那些不了解风险的基金经理所面临的高风险。随着违约风险随时间变化，声誉溢价会加剧价格波动。（JEL G11, G12, G23, L84）

abstract.text: Organ donations from deceased donors provide the majority of transplanted organs in the United States, and one deceased donor can save numerous lives by providing multiple organs. Nevertheless, most Americans are not registered organ donors despite the relative ease of becoming one. We study in the laboratory an experimental game modeled on the decision to register as an organ donor and investigate how changes in the management of organ waiting lists might impact donations. We find that an organ allocation policy giving priority on waiting lists to those who previously registered as donors has a significant positive impact on registration.

10.1257/aer.102.5.2018.abstractZh: 在美国，来自已故捐赠者的器官捐赠占移植器官总数的大部分，一位已故捐赠者可以通过提供多个器官来挽救许多生命。然而，尽管成为器官捐赠者相对容易，但大多数美国人并未进行登记。我们在实验室中开展了一项实验性研究，该研究基于决定成为器官捐赠者的决策，并探讨了器官等待名单管理方式的改变对捐赠行为的影响。研究发现，采用优先为之前已登记为捐赠者的人员分配器官的分配政策，能够显著促进人们进行登记。

abstract.text: In 2005, Hurricanes Katrina and Rita forced many children to relocate across the Southeast. While schools quickly enrolled evacuees, families in receiving schools worried about the impacts on incumbent students. We find no effect, on average, of the inflow of evacuees on achievement in Houston. In Louisiana we find little impact on average and we reject linear-in-means models. Moreover, we find that student achievement improves with high achieving peers and worsens with low achieving peers. Finally, an increase in the inflow of evacuees raised incumbent absenteeism and disciplinary problems in Houston's secondary schools. (JEL I21, Q54)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2048.abstractZh: 2005年，卡特里娜和丽塔飓风迫使许多儿童迁移到东南部地区。虽然学校迅速接纳了这些疏散儿童，但接收学校的家庭仍担心这对现有学生会产生影响。我们发现，疏散儿童的涌入对休斯顿学生的学业成绩平均而言没有显著影响。在路易斯安那州，我们也发现平均而言影响很小，因此我们排除了线性均值模型的可能性。此外，我们发现学生的学业成绩随着高成就同伴的影响而提高，而随着低成就同伴的影响而下降。最后，疏散儿童的增加导致休斯顿的中学学生缺勤率和纪律问题增加。（JEL I21, Q54）

abstract.text: Would people choose what they think would maximize their subjective well-being (SWB)? We present survey respondents with hypothetical scenarios and elicit both choice and predicted SWB rankings of two alternatives. While choice and predicted SWB rankings usually coincide in our data, we find systematic reversals. We identify factors-such as predicted sense of purpose, control over one's life, family happiness, and social status-that help explain hypothetical choice controlling for predicted SWB. We explore how our findings vary by SWB measure and by scenario. Our results have implications regarding the use of SWB survey questions as a proxy for utility.

10.1257/aer.102.5.2083.abstractZh: 人们是否会选择他们认为能最大化主观幸福感（SWB）的选项？我们向调查受访者提供了假设情景，并收集了他们对两个备选方案的选择与预测的SWB排名。虽然在我们的数据中，选择和预测的SWB排名通常是一致的，但我们发现了系统性的反转现象。我们发现，诸如预测到的目标感、对生活的控制感、家庭幸福和社会地位等因素，有助于解释在预测SWB的情况下人们的决策行为。我们还探讨了这些发现如何因SWB衡量方式和假设情景的不同而有所差异。我们的研究结果对于使用SWB调查问题作为效用的代理指标具有启示意义。

abstract.text: This paper provides a new theory of international capital flows. In a framework that integrates factor-proportions-based trade and financial capital flows, a novel force emerges: capital tends to flow toward countries that become more specialized in capital-intensive industries. This “composition” effect competes with the standard force that channels capital toward the location where it is scarcer. If the composition effect dominates, capital flows away from the country hit by a positive labor force/productivity shock—a flow “reversal.'' Extended to a quantitative framework, the model generates sizable current account imbalances between developing and developed countries broadly consistent with the data. (JEL F14, F21, F32, F41, L16, O19)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2111.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种关于国际资本流动的新理论。在一个整合了基于要素比例贸易和金融资本流动的框架中，出现了一个新的力量：资本倾向于流向那些在资本密集型产业中更为专业化的国家。这种“组合效应”与将资本引向资本稀缺地区的标准力量相竞争。如果组合效应占主导地位，资本就会从受到正向劳动力/生产率冲击的国家流出，形成一种“资本逆转”。在定量框架中，该模型揭示了发展中国家和发达国家之间显著的经常账户失衡现象，这些失衡与数据结果大致一致。（JEL F14, F21, F32, F41, L16, O19）

abstract.text: This paper studies an empirical model of spatial competition applied to gasoline markets. The main feature is to specify commuting paths as the “locations'' of consumers in a Hotelling-style model. As a result, spatial differentiation depends in an intuitive way on the structure of the road network and the direction of traffic flows. The model is estimated using panel data on the Quebec City gasoline market and used to evaluate the consequences of a recent vertical merger. Difference-in-difference and counterfactual simulation methods are compared, and the results, to a large extent, validate the assumptions of the demand model. (JEL G34, L13, L42, L81, Q41, R41)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2147.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个应用于汽油市场的空间竞争实证模型。其主要特点是将通勤路径指定为消费者在霍特林模型中的“位置”。因此，空间差异直观地取决于道路网络的结构和交通流动的方向。该模型使用魁北克市汽油市场的面板数据进行估计，并用于评估最近一次垂直合并的后果。通过比较差异分解法和反事实模拟方法，结果在很大程度上验证了需求模型的假设。（JEL G34, L13, L42, L81, Q41, R41）

abstract.text: The standard revealed preference argument relies on an implicit assumption that a decision maker considers all feasible alternatives. The marketing and psychology literatures, however, provide well-established evidence that consumers do not consider all brands in a given market before making a purchase (Limited Attention). In this paper, we illustrate how one can deduce both the decision maker's preference and the alternatives to which she pays attention and inattention from the observed behavior. We illustrate how seemingly compelling welfare judgments without specifying the underlying choice procedure are misleading. Further, we provide a choice theoretical foundation for maximizing a single preference relation under limited attention. (JEL D11, D81)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2183.abstractZh: 标准的显示偏好理论基于一个隐含假设，即决策者会考虑所有可行的选择。然而，市场营销和心理学领域的文献提供了充分证据，表明消费者在做出购买决策之前并不会考虑市场中的所有品牌（注意力有限）。在本文中，我们展示了如何根据观察到的行为来推断决策者的偏好以及她所关注和不关注的选项。我们还说明了，即使没有具体说明选择过程，看似合理的福利判断也可能是误导性的。此外，我们为在有限注意力下最大化单一偏好关系提供了选择理论上的基础。（JEL D11, D81）

abstract.text: Can heuristic information processing affect important product markets? Analyzing over 22 million wholesale used-car transactions, we find evidence of left-digit bias in the processing of odometer values, whereby individuals focus on the number's leftmost digits. The bias leads to discontinuous drops in sale prices at 10,000-mile odometer thresholds, along with smaller drops at 1,000-mile thresholds. These findings reveal that information-processing heuristics matter even in markets with large stakes and easily observed information. We model left-digit bias in an inattention framework and structurally estimate the inattention parameter. Empirical patterns suggest the results are driven by final customers rather than professional agents. (JEL D12, D44, D83, L81)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2206.abstractZh: 启发式信息处理是否会影响重要的产品市场？通过对超过2200万笔二手车批发交易的分析，我们发现在处理里程数时存在左位数字偏差现象，即个体倾向于关注数字的最左侧数字。这种偏差导致在10,000英里里程数阈值处销售价格出现断崖式下降，而在1,000英里阈值处则出现较小的下降。这些发现表明，即使在信息易于获取且风险较高的市场中，信息处理中的启发式思维仍然起着重要作用。我们在注意力缺失框架下对左位数字偏差进行了建模，并结构性地估计了注意力缺失参数。实证结果表明，这些现象是由最终消费者而非专业代理人所驱动的。（JEL D12, D44, D83, L81）

abstract.text: We use theory and field data to study the draft mechanism used to allocate courses at Harvard Business School. We show that the draft is manipulable in theory, manipulated in practice, and that these manipulations cause significant welfare loss. Nevertheless, we find that welfare is higher than under its widely studied strategyproof alternative. We identify a new link between fairness and welfare that explains why the draft performs well despite the costs of strategic behavior, and then design a new draft that reduces these costs. We draw several broader lessons for market design, regarding Pareto efficiency, fairness, and strategyproofness. (JEL D63, D82, I23)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2237.abstractZh: 我们利用理论和实地数据来研究哈佛商学院在课程分配中使用的草稿机制。我们发现，理论上草稿是可以被操纵的，实践中也确实被操纵了，而这些操纵导致了显著的福利损失。尽管如此，我们发现福利水平仍然高于被广泛研究的、经过验证的策略性替代方案。我们发现了公平与福利之间一个新的联系，这解释了为什么尽管存在策略性行为的成本，草稿机制仍然能够表现出良好的效果。随后，我们设计了一种新的草稿机制，以减少这些成本。我们对市场设计提出了几个更广泛的启示，涉及帕累托效率、公平性和策略性验证等方面。（JEL D63, D82, I23）

abstract.text: The empirical evidence on rational inattention lags the theoretical developments: micro evidence on one of the most immediate consequences of observation costs––the infrequent observation of state variables––is not available in standard datasets. We contribute to filling the gap using new household surveys. To match these data we modify existing models, shifting the focus from nondurable to durable consumption. The model features both observation and transaction costs and implies a mixture of time-dependent and state-dependent rules. Numerical simulations explain the frequencies of trading and observation of the median investor with small observation costs and larger transaction costs. (JEL D12, D14, E21, G11)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2272.abstractZh: 关于理性忽视的实证证据滞后于理论发展：关于观察成本最直接影响之一——对状态变量进行不频繁观察的情况——的微观证据在标准数据集中并不存在。我们通过新的家庭调查来填补这一空白。为了匹配这些数据，我们对现有模型进行了修改，将重点从非耐用品消费转向耐用品消费。该模型同时考虑了观察和交易成本，并假设存在时间依赖性和状态依赖性的规则组合。数值模拟解释了具有较小观察成本和较大交易成本的中等投资者进行交易和观察的频率。（JEL D12, D14, E21, G11）

abstract.text: We analyze the impact of monetary policy on the supply of bank credit. Monetary policy affects both loan supply and demand, thus making identification a steep challenge. We therefore analyze a novel, supervisory dataset with loan applications from Spain. Accounting for time-varying firm heterogeneity in loan demand, we find that tighter monetary and worse economic conditions substantially reduce loan granting, especially from banks with lower capital or liquidity ratios; responding to applications for the same loan, weak banks are less likely to grant the loan. Finally, firms cannot offset the resultant credit restriction by applying to other banks. (JEL E32, E44, E52, G21, G32)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2301.abstractZh: 我们分析了货币政策对银行信贷供应的影响。货币政策既影响信贷的供应，也影响需求，因此进行识别是一项艰巨的任务。因此，我们采用了一个新颖的监管数据集，该数据集包含了西班牙的贷款申请信息。考虑到企业贷款需求的时变异质性，我们发现更严格的货币政策和更糟糕的经济状况会显著减少信贷的发放，尤其是那些资本或流动性比率较低的银行；对于同一笔贷款的申请，实力较弱的银行不太可能批准该贷款。最后，企业无法通过向其他银行申请来抵消由此产生的信贷限制。（JEL E32, E44, E52, G21, G32）

abstract.text: Is skill dispersion a source of comparative advantage? In this paper we use microdata from the International Adult Literacy Survey to show that the effect of skill dispersion on trade flows is quantitatively similar to that of the aggregate endowment of human capital. In particular we investigate, and find support for, the hypothesis that countries with a more dispersed skill distribution specialize in industries characterized by lower complementarity of workers' skills. The result is robust to the introduction of controls for alternative sources of comparative advantage, as well as to alternative measures of industry-level skill complementarity. (JEL F14, F16, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2327.abstractZh: 技能分散是否是一种比较优势的来源？在本文中，我们利用国际成人识字调查的微数据表明，技能分散对贸易流动的影响在数量上与人类资本的总体禀赋效应相似。我们特别研究了这一假设，并发现该假设得到了支持：那些技能分布更为分散的国家会专门从事那些工人技能互补性较低的行业。这一结果在引入其他比较优势的控制变量以及采用不同的行业层面技能互补性衡量标准后仍然保持稳定。（JEL F14, F16, J24, J31）

abstract.text: This paper points to the important role that the elasticity of aggregate capital supply with respect to the net rate of return to capital plays for the efficiency of policymaking in a decentralized economy with mobile capital and spillovers among jurisdictions. In accordance with previous studies, we show that under the assumption of a fixed capital supply (zero capital supply elasticity) the decentralized policy choice is optimal. If the capital supply elasticity is strictly positive, however, capital tax rates are inefficiently low in the decentralized equilibrium. (JEL E22, E61, H25, H77)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2349.abstractZh: 本文指出，在具有流动资本和地区间溢出效应的分散化经济中，资本供给对资本净回报率弹性的变化在政策制定效率中起着重要作用。与以往的研究一致，我们表明在资本供给固定的假设下（即资本供给弹性为零），分散化的政策选择是最优的。然而，如果资本供给弹性严格为正，那么在分散化均衡状态下，资本税率会过低，从而导致效率低下。（JEL E22, E61, H25, H77）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effect on performance and earnings of delegating the wage choice to employees. Our results show that such delegation significantly increases effort levels. Moreover, we observe a Pareto improvement, as the earnings of both employers and employees increase when employers delegate than when they do not. Interestingly, we also find that the employees' performance under delegation is higher than under nondelegation, even for similar wages. While there is strong evidence that behavior reflects strategic considerations, this result also holds for one-shot interactions. A possible nonstrategic motivation explaining the positive reaction to delegation is a sense of enhanced responsibility. (JEL J31, J33, J41)

10.1257/aer.102.5.2358.abstractZh: 本文分析了将工资选择权委托给员工对绩效和收益的影响。我们的研究结果表明，这种委托方式显著提高了员工的努力程度。此外，我们还观察到帕累托改进现象，即当雇主进行委托时，雇主和员工的收益都会增加。有趣的是，我们发现即使在工资相似的情况下，员工在委托下的绩效也高于非委托情况。虽然有大量证据表明行为反映了策略性考虑，但这一结果也适用于一次性互动。一种可能的非策略性动机是责任感的增强，这可以解释对委托的积极反应。（JEL J31, J33, J41）

abstract.text: What is the impact of real estate prices on corporate investment? In the presence of financing frictions, firms use pledgeable assets as collateral to finance new projects. Through this collateral channel, shocks to the value of real estate can have a large impact on aggregate investment. To compute the sensitivity of investment to collateral value, we use local variations in real estate prices as shocks to the collateral value of firms that own real estate. Over the 1993–2007 period, the representative US corporation invests $0.06 out of each $1 of collateral. (JEL D22, G31, R30)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2381.abstractZh: 房地产价格对企业投资有何影响？在融资摩擦存在的情况下，企业会将可抵押资产作为抵押品来为新项目融资。通过这一抵押渠道，房地产价值的波动会对总体投资产生重大影响。为了计算投资对抵押品价值的敏感性，我们采用房地产价格的变化作为企业拥有房地产的抵押品价值的冲击因素。在1993年至2007年期间，代表性的美国企业每1美元的抵押品价值会投资0.06美元。（JEL D22, G31, R30）

abstract.text: Bayes' rule has two well-known limitations: 1) it does not model the reaction to zero-probability events; 2) a sizable empirical evidence documents systematic violations of it. We characterize axiomatically an alternative updating rule, the Hypothesis Testing model. According to it, the agent follows Bayes' rule if she receives information to which she assigned a probability above a threshold. Otherwise, she looks at a prior over priors, updates it using Bayes' rule for second-order priors, and chooses the prior to which the updated prior over priors assigns the highest likelihood. We also present an application to equilibrium refinement in game theory. (JEL D11, D81, D83)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2410.abstractZh: 贝叶斯规则有两个众所周知的局限性：1）它无法模拟对零概率事件的反应；2）大量实证证据显示该规则存在系统性违反现象。我们以一种公理化的方式描述了另一种更新规则——假设检验模型。根据该模型，如果代理人接收到被赋予高于某一阈值的概率的信息，她将遵循贝叶斯规则。否则，她会考虑一个先验概率，并使用贝叶斯规则对二阶先验概率进行更新，然后选择那个在更新后的先验概率中赋予最高可能性的先验概率。我们还展示了该模型在博弈论中的均衡优化应用。（JEL D11, D81, D83）

abstract.text: In this paper, we develop a method to estimate markups using plant-level production data. Our approach relies on cost-minimizing producers and the existence of at least one variable input of production. The suggested empirical framework relies on the estimation of a production function and provides estimates of plant-level mark-ups without specifying how firms compete in the product market. We rely on our method to explore the relationship between markups and export behavior. We find that markups are estimated significantly higher when controlling for unobserved productivity; that exporters charge, on average, higher markups and that markups increase upon export entry. (JEL D22, D24, F14, L11, L60)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2437.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们开发了一种利用工厂级生产数据来估算加价的方法。我们的方法基于成本最小化的生产者以及至少存在一个可变生产投入的前提。所提出的实证框架依赖于生产函数的估计，并能够在不指定企业如何在产品市场中竞争的情况下，估算出工厂级的加价。我们利用该方法探讨了加价与出口行为之间的关系。研究发现，在控制未观测到的生产率因素后，加价的估算值显著升高；出口商平均收取更高的加价，并且随着出口活动的增加，加价也会上升。（JEL D22, D24, F14, L11, L60）

abstract.text: We study the long-run evolution of brand preferences, using new data on consumers' life histories and purchases of consumer packaged goods. Variation in where consumers have lived in the past allows us to isolate the causal effect of past experiences on current purchases, holding constant contemporaneous supply-side factors. We show that brand preferences form endogenously, are highly persistent, and explain 40 percent of geographic variation in market shares. Counterfactuals suggest that brand preferences create large entry barriers and durable advantages for incumbent firms and can explain the persistence of early-mover advantage over long periods. (JEL D12, L11, M31, M37)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2472.abstractZh: 我们研究了品牌偏好的长期演变，使用了关于消费者生活史和消费品购买行为的新数据。通过研究消费者过去居住地的差异，我们能够分离出过去经历对当前购买行为的因果效应，同时保持当前供应方面的因素不变。我们发现，品牌偏好是内生形成的，具有高度持久性，并且可以解释市场份额的40%的地理差异。反事实分析表明，品牌偏好为现有企业创造了巨大的进入壁垒和持久的优势，并且可以解释早期进入者优势在长时间内的持久性。（JEL D12, L11, M31, M37）

abstract.text: We document a negative correlation, at business cycle frequencies, between the net job creation rate of large employers and the level of aggregate unemployment that is much stronger than for small employers. The differential growth rate of employment between initially large and small employers has an unconditional correlation of —0.5 with the unemployment rate, and varies by about 5 percent over the business cycle. We exploit several datasets from the United States, Denmark, and France, both repeated cross sections and job flows with employer longitudinal information, spanning the last four decades and several business cycles. We discuss implications for theories of factor demand. (JEL D22, E23, E32, J23, L25)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2509.abstractZh: 我们发现了一种负相关关系，这种关系在商业周期中表现为大型雇主的净就业创造率与总体失业率之间存在负相关，且这种负相关性对于小型雇主来说要弱得多。最初规模较大和较小的雇主之间就业增长率的差异与失业率之间存在无条件的负相关关系，其变化幅度约为5%。我们利用了来自美国、丹麦和法国的多个数据集，包括重复的横截面数据以及带有雇主纵向信息的就业流动数据，这些数据涵盖了过去四十年和多个商业周期。我们讨论了这一发现对要素需求理论的影响。（JEL D22, E23, E32, J23, L25）

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the role of specialized high-skilled labor in the disproportionate growth of the service sector. Empirically, the importance of skill-intensive services has risen during a period of increasing relative wages and quantities of high-skilled labor. We develop a theory in which demand shifts toward more skill-intensive output as productivity rises, increasing the importance of market services relative to home production. Consistent with the data, the theory predicts a rising level of skill, skill premium, and relative price of services that is linked to this skill premium. (JEL J24, L80, L90)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2540.abstractZh: 本文分析了专业高技能劳动力在服务业不成比例增长中的作用。从经验上看，在相对工资和高级技能劳动力数量增加期间，技能密集型服务的重要性有所上升。我们提出了一个理论模型，该模型认为随着生产力的提高，需求会转向更技能密集型的产出，从而提升了市场服务相对于国内生产的重要性。与数据一致的是，该理论预测了技能水平、技能溢价以及与服务相关的相对价格的上升，这些都与技能溢价有关。（JEL J24, L80, L90）

abstract.text: A model of public and private liquidity integrates financial intermediation theory with a New Monetarist monetary framework. Non-passive fiscal policy and costs of operating a currency system imply that an optimal policy deviates from the Friedman rule. A liquidity trap can exist in equilibrium away from the Friedman rule, and there exists a permanent nonneutrality of money, driven by an illiquidity effect. Financial frictions can produce a financial-crisis phenomenon that can be mitigated by conventional open market operations working in an unconventional manner. Private asset purchases by the central bank are either irrelevant or they reallocate credit and redistribute income. (JEL E13, E44, E52, E62, G01)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2570.abstractZh: 该模型将金融中介理论与新货币主义货币框架相结合，探讨了公共与私人流动性的关系。非被动性财政政策以及货币体系运营的成本意味着最优政策会偏离弗里德曼法则。在偏离弗里德曼法则的均衡状态下，可能存在流动性陷阱，并且由于流动性不足效应，货币存在永久的非中性。金融摩擦可能导致金融危机现象，而通过非传统的公开市场操作可以缓解这一问题。中央银行对私人资产的购买要么无关紧要，要么会重新分配信贷并重新分配收入。（JEL E13, E44, E52, E62, G01）

abstract.text: We analyze the extent to which individuals' choices over five employer-provided insurance coverage decisions and one 401(k) investment decision exhibit systematic patterns, as would be implied by a general utility component of risk preferences. We provide evidence consistent with an important domain-general component that operates across all insurance choices. We find a considerably weaker relationship between one's insurance decisions and 401(k) asset allocation, although this relationship appears larger for more "financially sophisticated" individuals. Estimates from a stylized coverage choice model suggest that up to thirty percent of our sample makes choices that may be consistent across all six domains.

10.1257/aer.102.6.2606.abstractZh: 我们分析了个体在五个雇主提供的保险选择以及一个401(k)投资决策上的选择是否存在系统性模式，这种模式符合风险偏好的一般效用成分所暗示的。我们发现了与所有保险选择相关的、具有领域普遍性的重要成分，这一成分的作用较为微弱。我们发现，个人的保险选择与401(k)资产分配之间的关系相对较弱，不过对于“财务较为成熟”的个体来说，这种关系似乎更为明显。基于一个简化的保险选择模型得出的估计表明，我们样本中有高达30%的个体做出的选择可能适用于所有六个领域。
