abstract.text: Under Medicare Part D, senior citizens choose prescription drug insurance offered by numerous private insurers. We examine nonpoor enrollees' actions in 2006 and 2007 using panel data. Our sample reduced overspending by $298 on average, with gains by 81 percent of them. The greatest improvements were by those who overspent most in 2006 and by those who switched plans. Decisions to switch depended on individuals' overspending in 2006 and on individual-specific effects of changes in their current plans. The oldest consumers and those initiating medications for Alzheimer's disease improved by more than average, suggesting that real-world institutions help overcome cognitive limitations.

10.1257/aer.102.6.2639.abstractZh: 在Medicare Part D的框架下，老年人可以选择由众多私人保险公司提供的处方药保险。我们使用面板数据研究了2006年和2007年非贫困参保者的行为。样本数据显示，他们的总支出平均减少了298美元，其中81%的参保者获得了收益。改善最显著的是那些在2006年支出最多的人以及那些更换保险计划的人。更换保险计划的决定取决于个人在2006年的过度支出情况，以及当前保险计划变更对个人产生的具体影响。年龄最大的消费者以及那些开始使用阿尔茨海默病相关药物的患者，其改善程度超过了平均水平，这表明现实中的制度有助于克服认知方面的限制。

abstract.text: We advance quantitative-theoretic models of sovereign debt by proving the existence of a downward sloping equilibrium price function for long-term debt and implementing a novel method to accurately compute it. We show that incorporating long-term debt allows the model to match Argentina's average external debt-to-output ratio, average spread on external debt, the standard deviation of spreads, and simultaneously improve upon the model's ability to account for Argentina's other cyclical facts. We also investigated the welfare properties of maturity length and showed that if the possibility of self-fulfilling rollover crises is taken into account, long-term debt is superior to short-term debt. (JEL E23, E32, F34, O11, O19)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2674.abstractZh: 我们提出了主权债务的定量理论模型，通过证明长期债务的均衡价格函数呈下降趋势，并采用一种新颖的方法进行精确计算。我们发现，将长期债务纳入模型后，能够匹配阿根廷的平均外债与产出比率、外债的利差、利差的标准差，同时提升模型对阿根廷其他周期性现象的解释能力。我们还研究了到期时长的福利属性，并表明如果考虑到自我实现的滚动危机的可能性，长期债务优于短期债务。（JEL E23, E32, F34, O11, O19）

abstract.text: I use bilateral import data to test for and quantify the importance of trade costs and asset market frictions in explaining the failure of perfect international consumption risk sharing. I find that while frictions in international asset markets significantly impede optimal consumption risk sharing between developed and developing countries over the period 1970–2000, developed countries are close to optimal risk sharing with each other. Trade costs, in contrast, significantly impede risk sharing for all countries. (JEL E21, E44, F14, F41, G15)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2700.abstractZh: 我使用双边进口数据来测试并量化贸易成本和资产市场摩擦在解释完美国际消费风险共享失败中的重要性。我发现，在1970年至2000年期间，国际资产市场中的摩擦显著阻碍了发达国家与发展中国家之间的最优消费风险共享，而发达国家之间则接近最优风险共享。相比之下，贸易成本显著阻碍了所有国家的风险共享。（JEL E21, E44, F14, F41, G15）

abstract.text: Motivated by the evidence that risk premia are large and countercyclical, this paper studies a tractable real business cycle model with a small risk of economic disaster, such as the Great Depression. An increase in disaster risk leads to a decline of employment, output, investment, stock prices, and interest rates, and an increase in the expected return on risky assets. The model matches well data on quantities, asset prices, and particularly the relations between quantities and prices, suggesting that variation in aggregate risk plays a significant role in some business cycles. (JEL E13, E32, E44, G32)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2734.abstractZh: 本文基于风险溢价较高且具有反周期特征的证据，研究了一个在轻微经济灾难风险下仍能运行的真实商业周期模型，例如大萧条时期。经济灾难风险的增加会导致就业、产出、投资、股价和利率的下降，同时增加风险资产的预期回报。该模型与数据在数量、资产价格方面的吻合度很高，尤其是数量与价格之间的关系，这表明总体风险的变化在某些商业周期中起着重要作用。（JEL E13, E32, E44, G32）

abstract.text: Suppose that providing incentives for a group of individuals in a strategic context requires a monitor to detect their deviations. What about the monitor's deviations? To address this question, I propose a contract that makes the monitor responsible for monitoring, and thereby provides incentives even when the monitor's observations are not only private, but costly, too. I also characterize exactly when such a contract can provide monitors with the right incentives to perform. In doing so, I emphasize virtual enforcement and suggest its implications for the theory of repeated games. (JEL C78, D23, D82, D86)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2767.abstractZh: 假设在战略背景下为一组个体提供激励需要有一个监督者来检测他们的行为偏差。那么监督者的行为偏差又该如何处理呢？为了解决这个问题，我提出了一个合同，该合同要求监督者负责监控行为，从而即使在监督者的观察结果不仅属于私人信息，而且成本较高的情况下，也能提供激励。我还详细描述了在什么情况下，这样的合同能够为监督者提供适当的激励以执行其职责。在此过程中，我强调了虚拟执行的重要性，并提出了其对重复博弈理论的影响。（JEL C78, D23, D82, D86）

abstract.text: Many business cycle models use a flat short-run Phillips curve, due to time-dependent pricing and strategic complementarities, to explain fluctuations in real output. But, in doing so, these models predict unrealistically high persistence and stability of US inflation in recent decades. We calculate “reset price inflation”—based on new prices chosen by the subsample of price changers—to dissect this discrepancy. We find that the models generate too much persistence and stability both in reset price inflation and in the way reset price inflation is converted into actual inflation. Our findings present a challenge to existing explanations for business cycles. (JEL E31, E52)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2798.abstractZh: 许多商业周期模型使用平坦的短期菲利普斯曲线来解释实际产出的波动，这种曲线是基于时间依赖的定价和战略互补性而得出的。然而，这些模型预测的美国通货膨胀在最近几十年中表现出不切实际的高度持久性和稳定性。我们基于价格变更者子样本选择的新价格来计算“重置价格通货膨胀”，以分析这一差异。我们发现，这些模型在重置价格通货膨胀以及重置价格通货膨胀转化为实际通货膨胀的过程中，都产生了过高的持久性和稳定性。我们的发现对现有的商业周期解释提出了挑战。（JEL E31, E52）

abstract.text: I examine physician agency in health care services in the context of the choice between brand-name and generic pharmaceuticals. I examine micro-panel data from Japan, where physicians can legally make profits by prescribing and dispensing drugs. The results indicate that physicians often fail to internalize patient costs, explaining why cheaper generics are infrequently adopted. Doctors respond to markup differentials between the two versions, indicating another agency problem. However, generics’ markup advantages are short-lived, which limits their impact on increasing generic adoption. Additionally, state dependence and heterogeneous doctor preferences affected generics' adoption. Policy makers can target these factors to improve static efficiency.

10.1257/aer.102.6.2826.abstractZh: 我研究了在品牌药品与仿制药选择背景下，医疗服务中的医生代理问题。我使用了来自日本的微观面板数据，在这些数据中，医生通过开处方和配药可以合法获得利润。研究结果表明，医生往往未能将患者成本内部化，这解释了为什么仿制药较少被采用。医生对两种药品之间的价格差异作出反应，这表明存在另一个代理问题。然而，仿制药的价格优势是短暂的，这限制了它们对提高仿制药采用率的影响。此外，州的依赖性以及医生的不同偏好也影响了仿制药的采用情况。政策制定者可以针对这些因素来提高静态效率。

abstract.text: Our paper examines whether the failure of unsophisticated investors to rebalance their portfolios can help to explain the countercyclical volatility of aggregate risk compensation in financial markets. To answer this question, we set up a model in which a large mass of investors do not rebalance their portfolio shares in response to aggregate shocks, while a smaller mass of active investors do. We find that intermittent rebalancers more than double the effect of aggregate shocks on the time variation in risk premia by forcing active traders to sell more shares in good times and buy more shares in bad times. (JEL D14, E32, G11, G12)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2859.abstractZh: 我们的论文探讨了不成熟的投资者未能重新平衡其投资组合的现象，是否可以有助于解释金融市场中整体风险补偿的逆向周期性波动。为了回答这个问题，我们建立了一个模型，其中大部分投资者不会根据整体市场冲击重新调整其投资组合的份额，而少数活跃投资者则会这样做。我们发现，那些定期重新平衡投资组合的投资者，通过迫使活跃交易者在行情好时卖出更多股票，在行情差时买入更多股票，使得整体市场冲击对风险溢价时间变化的影响增加了两倍以上。（JEL D14, E32, G11, G12）

abstract.text: Two players choose hawkish or dovish actions in a conflict game with incomplete information. An “extremist,” who can either be a hawk or a dove, attempts to manipulate decision making. If actions are strategic complements, a hawkish extremist increases the likelihood of conflict, and reduces welfare, by sending a public message which triggers hawkish behavior from both players. If actions are strategic substitutes, a dovish extremist instead sends a public message which causes one player to become more dovish and the other more hawkish. A hawkish (dovish) extremist is unable to manipulate decision making if actions are strategic substitutes (complements). (JEL D74, D82)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2897.abstractZh: 两位参与者在信息不完全的冲突游戏中选择鹰派或鸽派行动。一个“极端主义者”，可以是鹰派或鸽派，试图操纵决策过程。如果行为是战略互补的，鹰派极端主义者会通过发送公开信息来增加冲突的可能性，同时降低福利。如果行为是战略替代的，鸽派极端主义者则会发送公开信息，导致一个参与者变得更加鸽派，另一个参与者变得更加鹰派。如果行为是战略替代（互补）的，鹰派或鸽派极端主义者就无法操纵决策过程。（JEL D74, D82）

abstract.text: We implemented a randomized field experiment in Malawi examining borrower responses to being fingerprinted when applying for loans. This intervention improved the lender's ability to implement dynamic repayment incentives, allowing it to withhold future loans from past defaulters while rewarding good borrowers with better loan terms. As predicted by a simple model, fingerprinting led to substantially higher repayment rates for borrowers with the highest ex ante default risk, but had no effect for the rest of the borrowers. We provide unique evidence that this improvement in repayment rates is accompanied by behaviors consistent with less adverse selection and lower moral hazard. (JEL D14, D82, G21, O12, O16)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2923.abstractZh: 我们在马拉维实施了一项随机田野实验，研究借款人在申请贷款时被采集指纹的反应。这一干预措施提升了贷款机构实施动态还款激励的能力，使其能够拒绝向过去的违约者提供贷款，同时给予表现良好的借款人更好的贷款条件。正如一个简单的模型所预测的那样，指纹采集显著提高了违约风险最高的借款人的还款率，但对其他借款人则没有效果。我们的研究提供了独特的证据，表明这种还款率的提升伴随着减少逆向选择和降低道德风险的行为。（JEL D14, D82, G21, O12, O16）

abstract.text: Using a large dataset on web browsing and purchasing behavior we test to what extent consumers are searching in accordance to various search models. We find that the benchmark model of sequential search with a known price distribution can be rejected based on recall patterns found in the data as well as the absence of dependence of search decisions on prices. Our findings suggest fixed sample size search provides a more accurate description of search behavior. We then utilize the fixed sample size search model to estimate demand elasticities of online bookstores in an environment where store preferences are heterogeneous. (JEL D12, D83, L81)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2955.abstractZh: 我们利用一个关于网络浏览和购买行为的大型数据集，来测试消费者在多大程度上遵循各种搜索模型进行搜索。我们发现，基于已知价格分布的序列搜索模型可以被数据中的回忆模式以及搜索决策与价格无关的事实所否定。我们的研究结果表明，固定样本大小的搜索模型能够更准确地描述搜索行为。随后，我们利用固定样本大小的搜索模型来估计在线书店的需求弹性，这些书店的偏好具有异质性。（JEL D12, D83, L81）

abstract.text: We study the effect of disclosing information on peers' salaries on workers' job satisfaction and job search intentions. A randomly chosen subset of University of California employees was informed about a new website listing the pay of University employees. All employees were then surveyed about their job satisfaction and job search intentions. Workers with salaries below the median for their pay unit and occupation report lower pay and job satisfaction and a significant increase in the likelihood of looking for a new job. Above-median earners are unaffected. Differences in pay rank matter more than differences in pay levels. (JEL I23, J28, J31, J64)

10.1257/aer.102.6.2981.abstractZh: 我们研究了信息披露对同事薪资的影响，以及这种影响对工人工作满意度和求职意向的影响。我们随机选取了加州大学的部分员工，并告知他们有一个新的网站可以查看大学员工的薪资信息。之后，我们对所有员工进行了工作满意度和求职意向的调查。那些薪资低于所在单位和职业中位数的人，报告称他们的薪资较低，工作满意度也较低，并且寻求新工作的可能性显著增加。而薪资高于中位数的人则未受到显著影响。薪资等级的差异比薪资水平差异更为重要。（JEL I23, J28, J31, J64）

abstract.text: This paper studies the limitations of monetary policy in stimulating credit and investment. We show that, under certain circumstances, unconventional monetary policies fail in that liquidity injections into the banking sector are hoarded and not lent out. We use the term “credit traps” to describe such situations and show how they can arise due to the interplay between financing frictions, liquidity, and collateral values. We show that small contractions in monetary policy can lead to a collapse in lending. Our analysis demonstrates how quantitative easing may be useful in increasing collateral prices, bank lending, and aggregate investment. (JEL E44, E52, E58, G01)

10.1257/aer.102.6.3004.abstractZh: 本文研究了货币政策在刺激信贷和投资方面的局限性。我们指出，在某些情况下，非常规货币政策会失败，因为注入银行系统的流动性会被囤积而非用于借贷。我们使用“信贷陷阱”这一术语来描述这种情况，并揭示了这些陷阱如何由于融资摩擦、流动性和抵押品价值之间的相互作用而产生。我们的分析表明，货币政策的小幅紧缩可能导致借贷活动的崩溃。我们的研究还展示了量化宽松在提高抵押品价格、银行借贷和总体投资方面可能具有的作用。（JEL E44, E52, E58, G01）

abstract.text: We develop a stylized model of economic growth with bubbles in which changes in investor sentiment lead to the appearance and collapse of macroeconomic bubbles or pyramid schemes. These bubbles mitigate the effects of financial frictions. During bubbly episodes, unproductive investors demand bubbles while productive investors supply them. These transfers of resources improve economic efficiency thereby expanding consumption, the capital stock and output. When bubbly episodes end, there is a fall in consumption, the capital stock and output. We argue that the stochastic equilibria of the model provide a natural way of introducing bubble shocks into business cycle models. (JEL E22, E23, E32, E44, O41)

10.1257/aer.102.6.3033.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有泡沫的经济增长模型，其中投资者情绪的变化会导致宏观经济泡沫或金字塔式骗局的出现和崩溃。这些泡沫能够缓解金融摩擦的影响。在泡沫时期，非生产性投资者需求泡沫，而生产性投资者则提供这些泡沫。这种资源的转移提高了经济效率，从而扩大了消费、资本存量和产出。当泡沫时期结束时，消费、资本存量和产出都会下降。我们认为，该模型的随机均衡为将泡沫冲击引入商业周期模型提供了一种自然的方法。（JEL E22, E23, E32, E44, O41）

abstract.text: Acemoglu, Johnson, and Robinson's (2001) seminal article argues property-rights institutions powerfully affect national income, using estimated mortality rates of early European settlers to instrument capital expropriation risk. However, 36 of the 64 countries in the sample are assigned mortality rates from other countries, often based on mistaken or conflicting evidence. Also, incomparable mortality rates from populations of laborers, bishops, and soldiers—often on campaign—are combined in a manner that favors the hypothesis. When these data issues are controlled for, the relationship between mortality and expropriation risk lacks robustness, and instrumental-variable estimates become unreliable, often with infinite confidence intervals. (JEL D02, E23, F54, I12, N40, O43, P14)

10.1257/aer.102.6.3059.abstractZh: Acemoglu、Johnson和Robinson在2001年发表的开创性文章指出，产权制度对国民收入有着显著的影响，他们通过估算早期欧洲移民的死亡率来模拟资本被剥夺的风险。然而，在样本中的64个国家中，有36个国家的死亡率数据来自其他国家，这些数据往往基于错误或不一致的资料。此外，将劳工、主教和士兵的死亡率数据结合在一起时，往往有利于这一假设。当这些数据问题被控制住后，死亡率与剥夺风险之间的关系就不再具有稳健性，而作为工具变量的估计结果也变得不可靠，其置信区间往往无限大。（JEL D02, E23, F54, I12, N40, O43, P14）

abstract.text: Acemoglu, Johnson, and Robinson (2001) established that economic institutions today are correlated with expected mortality of European colonialists. David Albouy argues this relationship is not robust. He drops all data from Latin America and much of the data from Africa, making up almost 60 percent of our sample, despite much information on the mortality of Europeans in those places during the colonial period. He also includes a “campaign” dummy that is coded inconsistently; even modest corrections undermine his claims. We also show that limiting the effect of outliers strengthens our results, making them robust to even extreme versions of Albouy's critiques. (JEL D02, E23, F54, I12, N40, O43, P14)

10.1257/aer.102.6.3077.abstractZh: Acemoglu、Johnson和Robinson在2001年的研究中指出，当今的经济制度与欧洲殖民者的预期死亡率之间存在关联。David Albouy认为这种关系并不稳固。他排除了拉丁美洲的大部分数据以及非洲的大部分数据，这些数据占我们样本数据的近60%，尽管这些地区在殖民时期有大量关于欧洲人死亡率的信息。他还引入了一个“战役”虚拟变量，但对其编码不一致；即使是适度的修正也削弱了他的结论。我们还表明，限制异常值的影响能够增强我们的研究结果，使其即使面对Albouy批评的极端版本也能保持稳定。（JEL D02, E23, F54, I12, N40, O43, P14）

abstract.text: Immediately following a minimum wage hike, household income rises on average by about $250 per quarter and spending by roughly $700 per quarter for households with minimum wage workers. Most of the spending response is caused by a small number of households who purchase vehicles. Furthermore, we find that the high spending levels are financed through increases in collateralized debt. Our results are consistent with a model where households can borrow against durables and face costs of adjusting their durables stock. (JEL D12, D14, D91, J38)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3111.abstractZh: 在最低工资上调之后，有最低工资工人的家庭平均每季度收入增加约250美元，支出则增加约700美元。大部分支出增加是由少数家庭购买车辆所导致的。此外，我们发现这些高额的支出是通过增加抵押债务来融资的。我们的研究结果与一种模型相符，即家庭可以借用耐用消费品，并面临调整其耐用消费品库存的成本。（JEL D12, D14, D91, J38）

abstract.text: The rise of offshoring of intermediate inputs raises important questions for commercial policy. Do the distinguishing features of offshoring introduce novel reasons for trade policy intervention? Does offshoring create new problems of global policy cooperation whose solutions require international agreements with novel features? In this paper we provide answers to these questions, and thereby initiate the study of trade agreements in the presence of offshoring. We argue that the rise of offshoring will make it increasingly difficult for governments to rely on traditional GATT/WTO concepts and rules—such as market access, reciprocity and non-discrimination—to solve their trade-related problems. (JEL F12, F13, L24)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3140.abstractZh: 中间投入的离岸化趋势为商业政策提出了重要问题。离岸化的独特特征是否带来了新的贸易政策干预理由？离岸化是否引发了新的全球政策合作问题，这些问题需要具有新特征的国际协议来解决？在本文中，我们为这些问题提供了答案，并由此开始了对在离岸化背景下贸易协议的研究。我们认为，离岸化的兴起将使政府越来越难以依赖传统的GATT/WTO概念和规则——如市场准入、互惠和非歧视原则——来解决与贸易相关的问题。（JEL F12, F13, L24）

abstract.text: We examine how employers learn about worker productivity in a randomized pilot experiment which provided objective estimates of teacher performance to school principals. We test several hypotheses that support a simple Bayesian learning model with imperfect information. First, the correlation between performance estimates and prior beliefs rises with more precise objective estimates and more precise subjective priors. Second, new information exerts greater influence on posterior beliefs when it is more precise and when priors are less precise. Employer learning affects job separation and productivity in schools, increasing turnover for teachers with low performance estimates and producing small test score improvements. (JEL D83, I21, J24, J45)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3184.abstractZh: 我们通过一项随机试点实验来研究雇主如何了解工人的生产效率，该实验为学校校长提供了关于教师表现的客观评估。我们检验了几个假设，这些假设支持一个简单贝叶斯学习模型，该模型适用于信息不完全的情况。首先，随着客观评估的精确性和主观先验的精确性提高，绩效评估与先验信念之间的相关性也会增加。其次，当新信息更精确且先验信息不够精确时，新信息对后验信念的影响更大。雇主的学习行为会影响学校的岗位离职率和生产效率，导致绩效评估较低的教师离职率上升，并且测试成绩的提升幅度较小。（JEL D83, I21, J24, J45）

abstract.text: Premiums in health insurance markets frequently do not reflect individual differences in costs, either because consumers have private information or because prices are not risk rated. This creates inefficiencies when consumers self-select into plans. We develop a simple econometric model to study this problem and estimate it using data on small employers. We find a welfare loss of 2-11 percent of coverage costs compared to what is feasible with risk rating. Only about one-quarter of this is due to inefficiently chosen uniform contribution levels. We also investigate the reclassification risk created by risk rating individual incremental premiums, finding only a modest welfare cost.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3214.abstractZh: 在健康保险市场中，保险费往往无法反映个体间的成本差异，这可能是由于消费者拥有私人信息，也可能是因为价格没有进行风险评级。当消费者自行选择保险计划时，这种情况会导致效率低下。我们开发了一个简单的计量经济模型来研究这个问题，并使用小型雇主的数据进行估算。研究发现，与风险评级方式相比，保险覆盖成本会损失2%到11%的福利。其中，大约四分之一的损失是由于选择不当的统一缴费水平造成的。我们还研究了风险评级对个体增量保费带来的重新分类风险，发现其带来的福利成本仅为适度水平。

abstract.text: Mortgage loans are leading examples of transactions where experts on one side of the market take advantage of consumers' lack of knowledge and experience. We study the compensation that borrowers pay to mortgage brokers for assistance from application to closing. Two findings support the conclusion that confused borrowers overpay for brokers' services: (i) A model of effective shopping shows that borrowers sacrifice at least $1,000 by shopping from too few brokers. (ii) Borrowers who compensate their brokers with both cash and a commission from the lender pay twice as much as similar borrowers who pay no cash. (JEL D12, D14, G21)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3249.abstractZh: 抵押贷款是市场一方专家利用消费者缺乏知识和经验的典型例子。我们研究了借款人为从申请到完成交易过程中获得经纪人的帮助而支付的补偿。两项研究发现支持了这样的结论：让借款人困惑的经纪人会收取过高的费用：(i) 有效的购物模型表明，如果借款人从太少的经纪人那里选择服务，至少会损失1000美元。(ii) 那些用现金和贷款机构提供的佣金来补偿经纪人的借款人，其支付金额是那些不使用现金的类似借款人的两倍。(JEL D12, D14, G21)

abstract.text: In the microdata underlying US trade price indexes, 40 percent of products are replaced before a single price change is observed and 70 percent are replaced after two price changes or fewer. A price index that focuses on price changes for identical items may, therefore, miss an important component of price adjustment occurring at the time of product replacements. We provide a model of this “product replacement bias” and quantify its importance using US data. Accounting for product replacement bias, long-run exchange rate “pass-through” is substantially higher than conventional estimates suggest, and the terms of trade are substantially more volatile. (JEL F14, F31)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3277.abstractZh: 在支撑美国贸易价格指数的微观数据中，有40%的产品在单次价格变动之前就被替换，而70%的产品在两次或更少次价格变动后被替换。因此，一个仅关注相同商品价格变动的价格指数可能会忽略在产品替换时发生的价格调整这一重要因素。我们提出了这种“产品替换偏差”的模型，并使用美国数据量化了其重要性。考虑到产品替换偏差，长期汇率的“传递效应”远高于传统估计值，贸易条件也更为不稳定。（JEL F14, F31）

abstract.text: This paper experimentally investigates the effects of a costly punishment option on cooperation and social welfare in long, finitely repeated public good contribution games. In a perfect monitoring environment, increasing the severity of the potential punishment monotonically increases average net payoffs. In a more realistic imperfect monitoring environment, we find a U-shaped relationship. Access to a standard punishment technology in this setting significantly decreases net payoffs, even in the long run. Access to a severe punishment technology leads to roughly the same payoffs as with no punishment option, as the benefits of increased cooperation offset the social costs of punishing. (JEL C92, H41, K42)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3317.abstractZh: 本文通过实验研究，探讨了高成本惩罚选项对长期有限重复的公共物品贡献博弈中的合作行为和社会福利的影响。在完美监控环境下，增加潜在惩罚的严厉程度会单调地提高平均净收益。而在更现实的 imperfect 监控环境下，我们发现存在 U 形关系。在这种环境下，即使从长远来看，采用标准惩罚技术也会显著降低净收益。而采用严厉的惩罚技术，所带来的收益大致与没有惩罚选项时相同，因为增加合作的好处抵消了惩罚带来的社会成本。（JEL C92, H41, K42）

abstract.text: Experimentally elicited discount rates are frequently higher than what seems reasonable for economic decision-making. Such high rates are often attributed to present-biased discounting. A well-known bias of standard measurements is the assumption of linear consumption utility. Attempting to correct this bias using measures of risk aversion to identify concavity, researchers find reasonable discounting but at the cost of exceptionally high utility function curvature. We present a new methodology for identifying time preferences, both discounting and curvature, from simple allocation decisions. We find reasonable levels of both discounting and curvature and, surprisingly, dynamically consistent time preferences. (JEL C91, D12, D81)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3333.abstractZh: 实验得出的折现率通常高于经济决策中看似合理的水平。这种较高的折现率往往被归因于当前偏好的折现方式。标准测量方法中的一个常见偏差是假设消费效用是线性的。研究人员试图通过风险厌恶度量来纠正这一偏差，以识别效用函数的凹性，但他们发现合理的折现率存在，但代价是效用函数曲率异常高。我们提出了一种新方法，从简单的分配决策中识别时间偏好，包括折现率和曲率。我们发现折现率和曲率都处于合理水平，并且令人惊讶的是，时间偏好在动态上是一致的。（JEL C91, D12, D81）

abstract.text: Risk and time are intertwined. The present is known while the future is inherently risky. This is problematic when studying time preferences since uncontrolled risk can generate apparently present-biased behavior. We systematically manipulate risk in an intertemporal choice experiment. Discounted expected utility performs well with risk, but when certainty is added common ratio predictions fail sharply. The data cannot be explained by prospect theory, hyperbolic discounting, or preferences for resolution of uncertainty, but seem consistent with a direct preference for certainty. The data suggest strongly a difference between risk and time preferences. (JEL C91 D81 D91)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3357.abstractZh: 风险与时间是相互交织的。当下是可知的，而未来本质上充满风险。这在研究时间偏好时是一个问题，因为不受控制的风险可能会导致看似偏向当下的行为。我们在跨期选择实验中系统地操纵了风险。在存在风险的情况下，折现期望效用表现良好，但当确定性增加时，常见比率预测会显著失效。这些数据无法用前景理论、超线性折扣或偏好解决不确定性来解释，而似乎与对确定性的直接偏好一致。数据强烈表明风险与时间偏好之间存在差异。（JEL C91 D81 D91）

abstract.text: We propose a collective labor supply model with household production that generalizes a model of Blundell, Chiappori and Meghir (2005). Adults'preferences not only depend on own leisure and individual private consumption of market goods. They also depend on the consumption of domestic goods, which are produced by combining market goods with individuals'time. A new identification result, which uses production shifters, is developed. We apply our model to unique data on Dutch couples with children. Our application uses a novel estimation strategy that builds upon the familiar two-stage allocation representation of the collective model.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3377.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个集体劳动供给模型，该模型包含了家庭生产的内容，这一模型是对Blundell、Chiappori和Meghir（2005年）模型的扩展。成年人的偏好不仅取决于自身的闲暇时间和对个人市场商品的私人消费，还取决于对国内商品的消费，而国内商品是通过将市场商品与个人时间相结合来生产的。我们开发了一种新的识别方法，该方法使用了生产转换变量。我们将我们的模型应用于荷兰有孩子的夫妇的独特数据上。我们的应用采用了一种新颖的估计策略，该策略基于集体模型熟悉的双阶段分配表示法。

abstract.text: This paper explores the links between exports, export destinations, and skill utilization. We identify two mechanisms behind these links: differences across destinations in quality valuation and in exporting required services, activities that are intensive in skilled labor. Depending on the characteristics of the source country (income, language), the theories suggest a skill-bias in export destinations. We test the theory using a panel of Argentine manufacturing firms. We find that Argentine firms exporting to high-income countries hired more skilled workers than other exporters and domestic firms. Instead, we cannot identify any causal effect of exporting per se on skill utilization. (JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3406.abstractZh: 本文探讨了出口、出口目的地与技能利用之间的关系。我们发现了这两种关系背后的两种机制：不同目的地在质量评估方面的差异，以及出口所需服务的特殊性，这些服务活动需要大量技能型人才。根据来源国的特征（如收入、语言），相关理论表明出口目的地存在技能偏好现象。我们通过阿根廷制造企业的数据来验证这一理论。研究发现，与国内企业相比，向高收入国家出口的阿根廷企业雇佣了更多技能型人才。然而，我们未能发现出口行为本身对技能利用有任何直接的因果效应。（JEL F14, F16, J24, L60, O14, O19）

abstract.text: Agents face a coordination problem akin to the adoption of a network technology. A principal announces investment subsidies that, at minimal cost, attain a given likelihood of successful coordination. Optimal subsidies target agents who impose high externalities on others and on whom others impose low externalities. Based on the analysis of the role of strategic uncertainty in coordination processes, we provide a methodology that can be used to find the optimal targets for a variety of interventions in a large class of coordination problems with heterogeneous agents. (JEL D81, D82, D83, O33)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3439.abstractZh: 各主体面临一个类似于采用网络技术的协调问题。一个主体宣布投资补贴，这些补贴以最低成本实现一定的成功协调概率。最优补贴应针对那些对他人产生高外部性，而他人对其产生低外部性的主体。基于战略不确定性在协调过程中作用的分析，我们提供了一种方法，可用于找到在具有异质主体的大量协调问题中的各种干预措施的最佳目标。(JEL D81, D82, D83, O33)

abstract.text: We show that large retailers, competing with smaller stores that carry a narrower range, can exercise market power by pricing below cost some of the products also offered by the smaller rivals, in order to discriminate multistop shoppers from one-stop shoppers. Loss leading thus appears as an exploitative device rather than as an exclusionary instrument, although it hurts the smaller rivals as well; banning below-cost pricing increases consumer surplus, rivals' profits, and social welfare. Our insights extend to industries where established firms compete with entrants offering fewer products. They also apply to complementary products such as platforms and applications. (JEL L11, L13, L81)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3462.abstractZh: 我们指出，大型零售商通过与销售范围较窄的小型商店竞争，可以通过对部分产品定价低于成本来行使市场力量，从而区分多站购物者和一站式购物者。这种定价策略实际上是一种剥削手段，而非排斥工具，尽管它也会对小型竞争对手造成伤害；禁止低于成本定价反而会增加消费者剩余、竞争对手的利润以及社会福利。我们的见解同样适用于那些由老牌企业与提供较少产品的新进入者竞争的行业。这些见解也适用于诸如平台和应用程序等互补产品领域。（JEL L11, L13, L81）

abstract.text: Separate identification of the price and quantity of human capital has important implications for understanding key issues in economics. Price and quantity series are derived for four education levels. The price series are highly correlated and they exhibit a strong secular trend. Three resulting implications are explored: the rising college premium is found to be driven more by relative quantity than relative price changes, life-cycle wage profiles are readily interpretable as reflecting optimal human capital investment paths using the estimated price series, and adjusting the labor input for quality increases dramatically reduces the contribution of MFP to growth. (JEL D91, I20, J24, J31, O47)

10.1257/aer.102.7.3483.abstractZh: 分别确定人力资本的价格和数量对于理解经济学中的关键问题具有重要意义。针对四个教育水平，分别推导出价格与数量的序列。这些价格序列之间存在高度相关性，并表现出明显的长期趋势。研究提出了三个重要结论：大学教育的溢价上升更多是由相对数量的变化而非相对价格的变化所驱动；使用估计的价格序列可以很容易地解释生命周期工资模式，这些模式反映了最优的人力资本投资路径；调整劳动力投入的质量可以显著减少边际产品法对经济增长的贡献。（JEL D91, I20, J24, J31, O47）

abstract.text: Researchers have scrutinized foreign aid's effects on poverty and growth, but anecdotal evidence suggests that donors often use aid for other ends. We test whether donors use bilateral aid to influence elections in developing countries. We find that recipient country administrations closely aligned with a donor receive more aid during election years, while those less aligned receive less. Consistent with our interpretation, this effect holds only in competitive elections, is absent in US aid flows to non-government entities, and is driven by bilateral alignment rather than incumbent characteristics.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3516.abstractZh: 研究人员已经仔细研究了外援对贫困和经济增长的影响，但一些案例表明，捐助者往往将外援用于其他目的。我们研究了捐助者是否利用双边援助来影响发展中国家的选举。研究发现，与捐助者关系紧密的受援国政府在选举年获得的援助更多，而关系较疏远的受援国政府获得的援助较少。与我们的解释一致，这种效应仅在竞争性选举中显现，在美国对非政府实体的援助中不存在，并且这种效应是由双边关系而非现任政府特征所驱动的。

abstract.text: We use a model of human capital investment and activity choice to explain facts describing gender differentials in the levels and returns to human capital investments. These include the higher return to and level of schooling, the small effect of healthiness on wages, and the large effect of healthiness on schooling for females relative to males. The model incorporates gender differences in the level and responsiveness of brawn to nutrition in a Roy-economy setting in which activities reward skill and brawn differentially. Empirical evidence from rural Bangladesh provides support for the model and the importance of the distribution of brawn.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3531.abstractZh: 我们采用人力资本投资与活动选择模型来解释关于性别差异在人力资本投资水平和回报方面的现象。这些差异包括女性更高的教育回报和水平、健康状况对工资的影响较小，以及健康状况对女性教育水平的较大影响。该模型考虑了性别差异在体力与营养之间的响应程度，并假设在技能与体力不同的奖励机制下，经济活动对两者的评价也有所不同。来自孟加拉国农村地区的实证证据支持了该模型，并强调了体力分布的重要性。

abstract.text: We study experimentally a new two-player game: each player requests an amount between 11 and 20 shekels. He receives the requested amount and if he requests exactly one shekel less than the other player, he receives an additional 20 shekels. Level-k reasoning is appealing due to the natural starting point (requesting 20) and the straightforward best-response operation. Nevertheless, almost all subjects exhibit at most three levels of reasoning. Two variants of the game demonstrate that the depth of reasoning is not increased by enhancing the attractiveness of the level-0 strategy or by reducing the cost of undercutting the other player.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3561.abstractZh: 我们实验性地研究了一种新的双人游戏：每位玩家请求11到20舍克尔的金额。如果他请求的金额比另一位玩家少正好1舍克尔，他就能额外获得20舍克尔。由于起始点（请求20舍克尔）的自然性以及直接的最佳响应操作，层次化推理方法显得很有吸引力。然而，几乎所有参与者最多只能表现出三个层次的推理。该游戏的两种变体表明，通过增强0层次策略的吸引力或降低击败其他玩家的成本，并不会增加推理的深度。

abstract.text: We use recruitment into a laboratory experiment in Kolkata, India to analyze how social networks select individuals for jobs. The experiment allows subjects to refer actual network members for casual jobs as experimental subjects under exogenously varied incentive contracts. We provide evidence that some workers, those who are high ability, have useful information about the abilities of members of their social network. However, the experiment also shows that social networks provide incentives to refer less qualified workers, and firms must counterbalance these incentives in order to effectively use existing employees to help overcome their screening problem.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3574.abstractZh: 我们在印度加尔各答进行了一项实验室实验，以分析社交网络如何选择个体从事工作。该实验让受试者能够在外生变化的激励契约下，推荐实际网络成员从事临时工作。我们发现，一些能力较高的工人能够掌握有关其社交网络成员能力的有用信息。然而，实验还表明，社交网络会激励人们推荐能力较低的工人，因此企业必须采取相应措施来抵消这些激励，以便有效利用现有员工，从而解决筛选问题。

abstract.text: This paper uses a rich panel dataset of Spanish manufacturing firms (1990–2006) and a propensity score reweighting estimator to show that multinational firms acquire the most productive domestic firms, which, on acquisition, conduct more product and process innovation (simultaneously adopting new machines and organizational practices) and adopt foreign technologies, leading to higher productivity. We propose a model of endogenous selection and innovation in heterogeneous firms that explains both the observed selection patterns and the innovation decisions. Further, we show in the data that innovation upon acquisition is associated with the increased market scale provided by the parent firm.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3594.abstractZh: 本文利用西班牙制造企业的丰富面板数据集（1990–2006年）和倾向得分重加权估计方法，表明跨国企业收购了最具生产力的国内企业。这些被收购的企业在收购后进行了更多的产品和工艺创新（同时采用新的机器和组织实践），并引入了国外技术，从而提高了生产力。我们提出了一个关于异质企业内生选择与创新的模型，该模型能够解释观察到的选择模式和创新决策。此外，我们的数据分析表明，收购后的创新与母公司提供的更大市场规模有关。

abstract.text: Teacher performance evaluation has become a dominant theme in school reform efforts. Yet, whether evaluation changes the performance of teachers, the focus of this paper, is unknown. Instead, evaluation has largely been studied as an input to selective dismissal decisions. We study mid-career teachers for whom we observe an objective measure of productivity—value-added to student achievement—before, during, and after evaluation. We find teachers are more productive in post-evaluation years, with the largest improvements among teachers performing relatively poorly ex-ante. The results suggest teachers can gain information from evaluation and subsequently develop new skills, increase long-run effort, or both.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3628.abstractZh: 教师绩效评估已成为学校改革中的核心主题。然而，评估是否真的能够改变教师的绩效，正是本文研究的重点。实际上，评估在很大程度上被视作选择性解雇决策的一个因素。本研究针对的是职业生涯中的教师，我们观察到他们在评估前后，其对学生学业成就的贡献度——即生产力——存在客观衡量指标。研究发现，评估后的几年里，教师的生产力有所提升，其中那些评估前表现较差的教师改进幅度最大。结果表明，教师可以从评估中获得信息，并据此发展新的技能，增加长期努力，或者两者兼而有之。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the impact of pollution on worker productivity by relating exogenous daily variations in ozone with productivity of agricultural workers as recorded under piece rate contracts. We find robust evidence that ozone levels well below federal air quality standards have a significant impact on productivity. These results suggest that, in contrast to common characterizations of environmental protection as a tax on producers, environmental protection can also be viewed as an investment in human capital, and thus a tool for promoting economic growth.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3652.abstractZh: 本文通过将臭氧浓度的日变化与农业工人的生产率联系起来，评估了污染对工人生产率的影响。我们发现，低于联邦空气质量标准的臭氧浓度对生产率有显著影响。这些结果表明，与将环境保护视为对生产者的征税这一常见看法不同，环境保护也可以被视为对人类资本的投资，因此是一种促进经济增长的工具。

abstract.text: Recent crises have seen large spikes in asset price risk. We propose an explanation for such panics based on self-fulfilling shifts in beliefs about risk. A negative link between the current level and the future risk of an asset price leads to a circular relationship between the stochastic process of asset price risk and the price itself. Self-fulfilling shifts in perceived risk can be coordinated around a pure sunspot or around a macro fundamental. In a risk panic, a macro fundamental can be a focal point that affects both the magnitude of the panic and subsequent shifts in perceived risk.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3674.abstractZh: 最近的危机中，资产价格风险出现了大幅上升。我们提出了一种解释这种恐慌的理论，认为这种恐慌源于对风险信念的自我实现转变。资产价格当前水平与未来风险之间的负相关关系，导致了资产价格风险的随机过程与价格本身之间的循环关系。对风险感知的自我实现转变可以围绕一个纯粹的太阳黑子或宏观基本面来协调。在风险恐慌中，宏观基本面可以成为影响恐慌程度及随后感知风险变化的焦点。

abstract.text: Using life insurance holdings by age, sex, and marital status, we infer how individuals value consumption in different demographic stages. We estimate equivalence scales and bequest motives simultaneously within a fully specified model where agents face US demographics and save and purchase life insurance. Our findings indicate that individuals are very caring for dependents, that economies of scale are large, that children are very costly (or yield very high marginal utility), that wives with children produce lots of home goods, and that females display habits from marriage, while men do not. These findings contrast sharply with standard equivalence scales.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3701.abstractZh: 通过按年龄、性别和婚姻状况划分的人寿保险持有量，我们推断个体在不同人口阶段对消费的价值评估。我们在一个完全明确的模型中同时估计了等价比率和遗赠动机，其中参与者面临美国的人口统计数据，并进行储蓄和购买人寿保险。我们的研究发现表明，个体对依赖者非常关心，规模经济效应很大，子女的成本很高（或边际效用很高），有孩子的妻子会大量生产家庭用品，女性表现出婚姻带来的习惯，而男性则没有这种表现。这些发现与标准的等价比率模型形成了鲜明对比。

abstract.text: Washington's “revolving door”––the movement from government service into the lobbying industry––is regarded as a major concern for policy-making. We study how ex-government staffers benefit from the personal connections acquired during their public service. Lobbyists with experience in the office of a US Senator suffer a 24 percent drop in generated revenue when that Senator leaves office. The effect is immediate, discontinuous around the exit period, and long-lasting. Consistent with the notion that lobbyists sell access to powerful politicians, the drop in revenue is increasing in the seniority of and committee assignments power held by the exiting politician.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3731.abstractZh: 华盛顿的“旋转门”现象——即从政府工作转行进入游说行业的过程——被视为政策制定中的一个主要问题。我们研究了前政府工作人员如何在公共服务期间获得的个人关系中获得利益。有美国参议员办公室工作经验的游说者，在该参议员离职后，其产生的收入会下降24%。这种影响是立即发生的，在离职期间呈现不连续性的特点，并且持续时间较长。与游说者通过出售对有权势政治人物的接触权这一观点一致的是，收入下降的程度随着离职政治家所担任的职务的级别和委员会权力的大小而增加。

abstract.text: In a series of studies employing a variety of approaches, we have found that the potential impact of climate change on US agriculture is likely negative. Deschênes and Greenstone (2007) report dramatically different results based on regressions of agricultural profits and yields on weather variables. The divergence is explained by (1) missing and incorrect weather and climate data in their study; (2) their use of older climate change projections rather than the more recent and less optimistic projections from the Fourth Assessment Report; and (3) difficulties in their profit measure due to the confounding effects of storage.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3749.abstractZh: 在一系列采用多种方法的研究中，我们发现气候变化对美国农业的潜在影响可能是负面的。Deschênes和Greenstone（2007）基于农业利润和产量与天气变量之间的回归分析得出了截然不同的结果。这种差异可以归因于以下原因：（1）他们的研究中存在缺失或错误的天气和气候数据；（2）他们使用了较旧的气候变化预测，而不是《第四次评估报告》中更为近期且较为悲观的预测；（3）由于储存带来的干扰效应，他们的利润衡量方法存在困难。

abstract.text: Fisher et al. (2012)––henceforth, FHRS––have uncovered coding and data errors in our paper, Deschênes and Greenstone (2007), henceforth, DG. We acknowledge and are embarrassed by these mistakes. We are grateful to FHRS for uncovering them. We hope that this Reply will also contribute to advancing the literature on the vital question of the impact of climate change on the US agricultural sector.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3761.abstractZh: Fisher等人（2012年）——以下简称FHRS——在我们的论文《Deschênes和Greenstone（2007）》中发现了编码和数据错误，以下简称DG。我们承认这些错误，并为此感到尴尬。我们感谢FHRS的发现。我们希望这篇回复也能为推进关于气候变化对美国农业部门影响这一重要问题的研究做出贡献。

abstract.text: This comment highlights different ways of coding crisis episodes in Cerra and Saxena (2008) (CS). The comment shows that the coding used for civil war implies a misrepresentation of its impact. A correct coding of civil war reveals that the average civil war leads to a loss in output of 18 percent. This makes civil wars more devastating than all other crisis studied by CS.

10.1257/aer.102.7.3774.abstractZh: 该评论指出了Cerra和Saxena（2008）在描述危机事件时的不同编码方式。评论指出，用于描述内战的编码方式未能准确反映内战的影响。正确的编码显示，平均而言，内战会导致产出减少18%。这使得内战比Cerra和Saxena研究中的所有其他危机更为破坏性。

abstract.text: When it is not clear that an ill patient needs to be hospitalized, he or she may be placed "under observation" in a hospital for further evaluation and short-term treatment. These hospital observation services, often a kind of halfway point between emergency department treatment and full inpatient admission, have become a hotly debated policy issue and subject of lawsuits. Using Medicare enrollment and claims data nationwide, we documented a rising trend in the prevalence and duration of hospital observation services in the fee-for-service Medicare population during 2007-09, accompanied by a downward shift in inpatient admissions. As a result, the ratio of observation stays to inpatient admissions increased 34 percent, from an average of 86.9 observation stay events per 1,000 inpatient admissions per month in 2007 to 116.6 in 2009. Medicare beneficiaries were increasingly subjected to hospital observation care and treated as outpatients instead of inpatients, which can expose them to greater out-of-pocket expenses if they are eventually admitted to skilled nursing facilities. Additionally, the nearly one million beneficiaries receiving observation services each year were, on average, being held in observation for a longer period of time per episode-some for longer than seventy-two hours. The prevalence of observation services varied greatly across geographic regions and hospitals. This may be an unintended consequence of Medicare payment policies designed to constrain hospital admissions. Additional research is needed to pinpoint the drivers and consequences of this phenomenon, as is more clarity in clinical practice and Medicare policy guidelines regarding observation care.

10.1377/hlthaff.2012.0129.abstractZh: 当不清楚某位病情严重的患者是否需要住院治疗时，可以将其“置于观察状态”，以便进一步评估并进行短期治疗。这种医院观察服务通常介于急诊治疗与全面住院治疗之间，已成为一个备受争议的政策问题，并引发了诸多诉讼。通过全国范围内的Medicare登记和索赔数据，我们发现2007-2009年间，接受医院观察服务的患者比例和持续时间呈上升趋势，而住院人数则出现下降。因此，观察住院的比例增加了34%，从2007年每月每1000次住院中平均有86.9次观察住院，增加到2009年的116.6次。Medicare受益人越来越多地接受医院观察治疗，被当作门诊患者而非住院患者，这可能会导致他们最终需要支付更高的自付费用，尤其是当他们最终被转入专业护理机构时。此外，每年接受观察服务的近100万受益人，每次观察停留的时间平均更长，有些甚至超过72小时。不同地区和医院的观察服务普及程度差异很大。这可能是由于Medicare支付政策旨在限制住院人数所导致的意外后果。需要进一步的研究来确定这一现象的驱动因素和后果，同时也需要临床实践和Medicare政策指南对观察治疗有更明确的规范。

abstract.text: Seven provider organizations in Massachusetts entered the Blue Cross Blue Shield Alternative Quality Contract in 2009, followed by four more organizations in 2010. This contract, based on a global budget and pay-for-performance for achieving certain quality benchmarks, places providers at risk for excessive spending and rewards them for quality, similar to the new Pioneer Accountable Care Organizations in Medicare. We analyzed changes in spending and quality associated with the Alternative Quality Contract and found that the rate of increase in spending slowed compared to control groups, more so in the second year than in the first. Overall, participation in the contract over two years led to savings of 2.8 percent (1.9 percent in year 1 and 3.3 percent in year 2) compared to spending in nonparticipating groups. Savings were accounted for by lower prices achieved through shifting procedures, imaging, and tests to facilities with lower fees, as well as reduced utilization among some groups. Quality of care also improved compared to control organizations, with chronic care management, adult preventive care, and pediatric care within the contracting groups improving more in year 2 than in year 1. These results suggest that global budgets with pay-for-performance can begin to slow underlying growth in medical spending while improving quality of care.

10.1377/hlthaff.2012.0327.abstractZh: 2009年，马萨诸塞州有七家医疗服务机构加入了蓝十字蓝盾替代质量合同计划，2010年又有四家机构加入。该合同基于全球预算和绩效付费机制，旨在实现特定的质量标准，但同时也使医疗服务机构面临过度支出的风险，并因质量提升而获得奖励，这与Medicare中的新先锋责任护理组织类似。我们分析了替代质量合同计划对支出和质量的影響，发现支出增长的速度相比对照组有所放缓，尤其是在第二年更为明显。总体而言，两年间参与该计划的医疗服务机构相比未参与该计划的机构，节省了2.8%的支出（第一年节省1.9%，第二年节省3.3%）。节省的支出主要源于通过将检查、影像和测试转移到费用较低的机构而降低的成本，以及某些群体的医疗使用率降低。与对照组相比，参与该计划的医疗服务机构的护理质量也有所提高，其中慢性护理管理、成人预防护理和儿科护理在两年内的改善幅度大于第一年。这些结果表明，基于绩效付费的全球预算机制可以在减缓医疗支出的基础增长的同时，提高护理质量。

abstract.text: In response to low take-up, many public schools have experimented with moving breakfast from the cafeteria to the classroom. We examine whether such a program increases performance as measured by standardized test scores, grades and attendance rates. We exploit quasi-random timing of program implementation that allows for a difference-in-differences identification strategy. Our main identification assumption is that schools where the program was introduced earlier would have evolved similarly to those where the program was introduced later. We find that in-class breakfast increases both math and reading achievement by about one-tenth of a standard deviation relative to providing breakfast in the cafeteria. Moreover, we find that these effects are most pronounced for low performing, free-lunch eligible, Hispanic, and low BMI students. We also find some improvements in attendance for high achieving students but no impact on grades.

10.3386/w17720.abstractZh: 由于接受度较低，许多公立学校尝试将早餐从食堂转移到教室。我们研究这样的计划是否能够通过标准化测试成绩、成绩和出勤率等指标来提高学生的表现。我们利用准随机的时间点实施计划，从而可以采用差异-差异识别策略。我们的主要假设是，较早引入该计划的学校与较晚引入该计划的学校在发展过程中会表现出相似的趋势。我们发现，在教室提供早餐比在食堂提供早餐能使数学和阅读成绩提高约一个标准差。此外，这些效果在成绩较差、有免费午餐资格、属于西班牙裔以及BMI较低的学生中最为明显。我们还发现，成绩较好的学生在出勤率方面有所改善，但并未对成绩产生显著影响。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of nursing home unionization on numerous labor, establishment, and consumer outcomes using a regression discontinuity design. We find negative effects of unionization on staffing levels and no decline in care quality, suggesting positive labor productivity effects. Some evidence suggests that nursing homes in less competitive local product markets and those with lower union density at the time of election experienced stronger union employment effects. Unionization appears to raise wages for a given worker while also shifting the composition of the workforce away from higher-earning workers. By combining credible identification of union effects, a comprehensive set of outcomes over time with measures of market-level characteristics, this study generates some of the best evidence available on many controversial questions in the economics of unions. Furthermore, it generates evidence from the service sector, which has grown in importance and where evidence has been thin.

10.3386/w17733.abstractZh: 本文采用回归不连续设计，研究了养老院工会化对劳动力、机构及消费者诸多结果的影响。研究发现，工会化对人员配置水平有负面影响，但护理质量并未下降，这表明工会化对劳动生产率有积极影响。部分证据表明，在竞争较小的本地市场中，以及选举时工会密度较低的养老院，工会化对员工就业的影响更为显著。工会化似乎会提高特定工人的工资，同时使劳动力队伍的构成从高收入工人转向其他类型工人。通过结合对工会效应的可信识别、随时间变化的综合结果以及市场层面特征的测量，本研究为工会经济学中许多有争议的问题提供了一些最有力的证据。此外，该研究还提供了来自服务行业的证据，该行业的重要性日益凸显，而相关证据此前较为匮乏。

abstract.text: In this review we synthesize what is known about the relationship between education and health. A large number of studies from both rich and poor countries show that education is associated with better health. While previous work has thought of the effect of education separately for rich and poor countries, we argue that there are insights to be gained by integrating the two. For example, education is associated with lower malnutrition in most countries, but in richer countries the educated have lower BMIs whereas in poor countries the educated have higher BMIs. This suggests that the behaviors associated with better health differ depending on the level of development. We illustrate this approach by comparing the effects of education on various health and health behaviors around the world, to generate hypotheses about why education is so often (but not always) predictive of health. Finally, we review the empirical evidence on the relationship between education and health, paying particular attention to causal evidence and evidence on mechanisms linking education to better health.

10.3386/w17738.abstractZh: 在这篇综述中，我们总结了关于教育与健康之间关系的现有研究。来自富裕国家和贫困国家的大量研究表明，教育与更好的健康状况之间存在关联。虽然以往的研究分别探讨了富裕国家和贫困国家中教育的影响，但我们认为，将两者结合起来可以获得更多见解。例如，在大多数国家，教育与较低的营养不良程度相关；但在富裕国家，受过教育的人拥有较低的体重指数，而在贫困国家，受过教育的人则拥有较高的体重指数。这表明，与更好健康相关的行为因发展水平的不同而有所差异。我们通过比较世界各地教育对各种健康及健康行为的影响，来阐释这一观点，从而提出关于为何教育常常（但并非总是）能够预测健康状况的假设。最后，我们回顾了关于教育与健康之间关系的实证证据，特别关注了教育与更好健康之间的因果关系以及机制方面的证据。

abstract.text: The Thai 30 Baht program was one of the largest health system reforms ever undertaken by a low-middle income country. In addition to lowering the cost of care for the previously uninsured in public facilities, it also entailed a fourfold increase in funding provided to hospitals to care for the poorest 30% of the population (who were already publicly insured). For the previously uninsured, we find that the 30 Baht program led to increased health care utilization, as well as a shift from private to public sources of care. But, we find a larger increase for the poor who were previously publicly insured, especially amongst infants and women of childbearing age. Using vital statistics records, we find that the increased access to healthcare by the publicly insured poor led to a reduction in their infant mortality of at least 6.5 per 1,000 births. This suggests significant improvements in infant mortality rates can be achieved through increased access to healthcare services for the poor and marginalized groups.

10.3386/w17739.abstractZh: 泰国30泰铢计划是低中等收入国家历史上规模最大的医疗系统改革之一。除了降低此前未参保人群在公共医疗机构的就医成本外，该计划还增加了医院的资金投入，以更好地照顾最贫困的30%人口（这些人群原本已享有公共保险）。对于此前未参保的人群来说，30泰铢计划导致了医疗服务的利用率上升，同时也促使他们从私人医疗转向公共医疗。而对于原本已享有公共保险的同款贫困人群来说，这种转变更为显著，尤其是在婴儿和育龄妇女中。通过人口统计数据分析发现，公共保险覆盖下的贫困人群获得更多医疗服务后，其婴儿死亡率至少降低了6.5例/1000例出生。这表明，通过为贫困和边缘化群体提供更多医疗服务，可以显著改善婴儿死亡率。

abstract.text: We implement an empirical test for selection into health insurance using changes in coverage induced by the introduction of mandated health insurance in Massachusetts. Our test examines changes in the cost of the newly insured relative to those who were insured prior to the reform. We find that counties with larger increases in insurance coverage over the reform period face the smallest increase in average hospital costs for the insured population, consistent with adverse selection into insurance before the reform. Additional results, incorporating cross-state variation and data on health measures, provide further evidence for adverse selection.

10.3386/w17748.abstractZh: 我们通过对马萨诸塞州强制实施医疗保险后保险覆盖范围的变化进行实证测试，来研究选择加入医疗保险的情况。我们的测试考察了新加入保险的人群与改革前已投保人群在成本上的差异。研究发现，在改革期间保险覆盖范围增加幅度较大的县，参保人群的平均医院费用增长幅度最小，这与改革前保险中的逆向选择现象一致。此外，结合各州之间的差异以及健康指标数据，进一步证明了逆向选择的存在。

abstract.text: I examine the effect of pharmaceutical innovation on the functional status of nursing home residents using cross-sectional, patient-level data from the 2004 National Nursing Home Survey. This was the first public-use survey of nursing homes that contains detailed information about medication use, and it contains better data on functional status than previous surveys. Residents using newer medications and a higher proportion of priority-review medications were more able to perform all five activities of daily living (ADLs), controlling for age, sex, race, marital status, veteran status, where the resident lived prior to admission, primary diagnosis at the time of admission, up to 16 diagnoses at the time of the interview, sources of payment, and facility fixed effects. The ability of nursing home residents to perform activities of daily living is positively related to the number of "new" (post-1990) medications they consume, but unrelated to the number of old medications they consume. If 2004 nursing home residents had used only old medications, the fraction of residents with all five ADL dependencies would have been 58%, instead of 50%. During the period 1990-2004, pharmaceutical innovation reduced the functional limitations of nursing home residents by between 1.2% and 2.1% per year.

10.3386/w17750.abstractZh: 我使用2004年全国养老院调查中的横断面、患者级数据，研究了药品创新对养老院居民功能状态的影响。这是首次针对养老院进行的公共用途调查，其中包含了关于用药使用的详细信息，并且其关于功能状态的数据比之前的调查更为准确。使用较新药物以及较多优先审查药物的老居民，在控制年龄、性别、种族、婚姻状况、退伍军人身份、入住前居住地点、入住时的主要诊断、访谈时的最多16种诊断、支付来源以及设施固定效应等因素后，他们执行日常生活活动的能力与所使用的“新”药物数量呈正相关，但与旧药物的数量无关。如果2004年的养老院居民仅使用旧药物，那么能够完全执行所有五项日常生活活动的居民比例将仅为58%，而不是50%。在1990至2004年期间，药品创新每年使养老院居民的功能限制减少了1.2%至2.1%。

abstract.text: A complete account of the U.S. child care subsidy system requires an understanding of its implications for both parental and child well-being. Although the effects of child care subsidies on maternal employment and child development have been recently studied, many other dimensions of family well-being have received little attention. This paper attempts to fill this gap by examining the impact of child care subsidy receipt on maternal health and the quality of child-parent interactions. The empirical analyses use data from three nationally representative surveys, providing access to numerous measures of family well-being. In addition, we attempt to handle the possibility of non-random selection into subsidy receipt by using several identification strategies both within and across the surveys. Our results consistently indicate that child care subsidies are associated with worse maternal health and poorer interactions between parents and their children. In particular, subsidized mothers report lower levels of overall health and are more likely to show symptoms consistent with anxiety, depression, and parenting stress. Such mothers also reveal more psychological and physical aggression toward their children and are more likely to utilize spanking as a disciplinary tool. Together, these findings suggest that work-based public policies aimed at economically disadvantaged mothers may ultimately undermine family well-being.

10.3386/w17774.abstractZh: 要全面了解美国的儿童保育补贴制度，就必须了解其对父母和儿童福祉的影响。虽然最近有研究探讨了儿童保育补贴对母亲就业和儿童发展的影响，但家庭福祉的许多其他方面却鲜受关注。本文试图通过研究儿童保育补贴领取情况对母亲健康和亲子互动质量的影响来填补这一空白。实证分析使用了三项具有全国代表性的调查数据，从而能够获取大量关于家庭福祉的衡量指标。此外，我们尝试通过多种识别策略来处理补贴领取的非随机性选择问题，这些策略既适用于同一调查内部，也适用于不同调查之间的比较。我们的研究结果一致表明，儿童保育补贴与母亲健康状况的恶化以及父母与子女之间的互动质量下降有关。具体而言，获得补贴的母亲整体健康状况较差，更可能出现焦虑、抑郁和育儿压力等症状。这些母亲还表现出更多的心理和身体上的攻击行为，并且更可能使用打屁股作为管教手段。综上所述，这些发现表明，针对经济弱势母亲的公共政策可能会最终损害家庭福祉。

abstract.text: Although previous research has not always found that boys and girls are treated differently in rural India, son-biased stopping rules imply that estimates of the effect of gender on parental investments are likely to be biased because girls systematically end up in larger families. We propose a novel identification strategy for overcoming this bias. We document that boys receive significantly more childcare time than girls. In addition boys are more likely to be breastfed longer, and to be given vaccinations and vitamin supplementation. We then present suggestive evidence that the differential treatment of boys is neither due to their greater needs nor to the effect of anticipated family size.

10.3386/w17781.abstractZh: 尽管之前的研究并未始终发现印度农村地区的男孩和女孩受到不同的对待，但偏向儿子的停止规则意味着，关于性别对父母投资影响的估计可能存在偏差，因为女孩通常会组成更大的家庭。我们提出了一种新颖的识别策略来克服这种偏差。我们发现，男孩获得的育儿时间明显多于女孩。此外，男孩更有可能接受更长时间的母乳喂养，以及更多的疫苗接种和维生素补充。我们进一步提供了一些证据，表明男孩受到的差别待遇并非由于他们的需求更大，也不是由于预期的家庭规模所致。

abstract.text: We conducted a unique randomized experiment to estimate the impact of alternative cash transfer delivery mechanisms on household demand for routine preventative health services in rural Burkina Faso. The two-year pilot program randomly distributed cash transfers that were either conditional or unconditional and were given to either mothers or fathers. Families under the conditional cash transfer schemes were required to obtain quarterly child growth monitoring at local health clinics for all children under 60 months old. There were no such requirements under the unconditional programs. Compared with control group households, we find that conditional cash transfers significantly increase the number of preventative health care visits during the previous year, while unconditional cash transfers do not have such an impact. For the conditional cash transfers, transfers given to mothers or fathers showed similar magnitude beneficial impacts on increasing routine visits.

10.3386/w17785.abstractZh: 我们开展了一项独特的随机实验，旨在评估不同现金转移方式对布基纳法索农村家庭对常规预防性健康服务需求的影響。这项为期两年的试点项目随机分配了有条件或无条件的现金转移，这些转移分别发放给母亲或父亲。有条件现金转移计划下的家庭需要每季度在当地卫生诊所进行儿童生长监测，适用于所有60个月以下的儿童。而无条件现金转移计划则没有此类要求。与对照组家庭相比，我们发现有条件现金转移显著增加了前一年的预防性健康护理次数，而无条件现金转移则没有这种效果。对于有条件现金转移而言，无论发放给母亲还是父亲，都能产生类似的促进常规就诊次数的积极影响。

abstract.text: An extensive literature in medicine investigates the health consequences of early childhood television watching. However, this literature does not address the issue of reverse causation, i.e., does early childhood television watching cause specific health outcomes or do children more likely to have these health outcomes watch more television? This paper uses a natural experiment to investigate the health consequences of early childhood television watching and so is not subject to questions concerning reverse causation. Specifically, we use repeated cross-sectional data from 1972 through 1992 on county-level mental retardation rates, county-level autism rates, and county-level children's cable-television subscription rates to investigate how early childhood television watching affects the prevalence of mental retardation and autism. We find a strong negative correlation between average county-level cable subscription rates when a birth cohort is below three and subsequent mental retardation diagnosis rates, but a strong positive correlation between the same cable subscription rates and subsequent autism diagnosis rates. Our results thus suggest that early childhood television watching has important positive and negative health consequences.

10.3386/w17786.abstractZh: 医学领域的广泛文献研究了幼儿时期观看电视对健康的影响。然而，这些文献并未探讨反向因果关系的问题，即幼儿时期观看电视是否会导致特定的健康结果，还是说更有可能出现这些健康结果的儿童更频繁地观看电视？本文通过自然实验来研究幼儿时期观看电视对健康的影响，因此不受反向因果关系问题的限制。具体来说，我们使用了1972年至1992年间关于县级智力障碍率、县级自闭症率以及县级儿童有线电视订阅率的重复横截面数据，来研究幼儿时期观看电视如何影响智力障碍和自闭症的患病率。研究发现，当某个出生群体的儿童年龄小于三岁时，平均县级有线电视订阅率与后续的智力障碍诊断率之间存在强烈的负相关关系，而同一订阅率与后续的自闭症诊断率之间则存在强烈的正相关关系。因此，我们的研究结果表明，幼儿时期观看电视对健康有着重要的正面和负面影响。

abstract.text: A number of behaviours influence health in a non-monotonic way. Physical activity and alcohol consumption, for instance, may be beneficial to one's health in moderate but detrimental in large quantities. We develop a demand-for-health framework that incorporates the feature of a physiologically optimal level. An individual may still choose a physiologically non-optimal level, because of the trade-off in his or her preferences for health versus other utility-affecting commodities. However, any deviation from the physiologically optimal level will be punished with respect to health. A set of steady-state comparative statics is derived regarding the effects on the demand for health and health-related behaviour, indicating that individuals react differently to exogenous changes, depending on the amount of the health-related behaviour they demand. We also show (a) that a steady-state equilibrium is a saddle-point and (b) that the physiologically optimal level may be a steady-state equilibrium for the individual. Our analysis suggests that general public-health policies may, to some extent, be counterproductive due to the responses induced in part of the population.

10.3386/w17789.abstractZh: 许多行为以非单调的方式影响健康。例如，体力活动和酒精消费在适量时可能对健康有益，但在大量摄入时则可能有害。我们提出了一个需求-健康框架，该框架包含了生理最优水平的特征。个体仍可能选择一个生理上非最优的水平，因为他们在健康与其他影响效用的商品之间的偏好存在权衡。然而，任何偏离生理最优水平的举动都会对健康产生负面影响。我们推导出了关于健康需求及相关行为影响的稳态比较静态模型，表明个体对外部变化的反应不同，这取决于他们所要求的健康相关行为的强度。我们还表明：(a)稳态均衡是一个鞍点；(b)生理最优水平可能是个体的稳态均衡。我们的分析表明，由于部分人群产生的反应，公共卫生政策在某种程度上可能是适得其反的。

abstract.text: We investigate whether individuals exhibit forward looking behavior in their response to the non-linear pricing common in health insurance contracts. Our empirical strategy exploits the fact that employees who join an employer-provided health insurance plan later in the calendar year face the same initial ("spot") price of medical care but a higher expected end-of-year ("future") price than employees who join the same plan earlier in the year. Our results reject the null of completely myopic behavior; medical utilization appears to respond to the future price, with a statistically significant elasticity of medical utilization with respect to the future price of -0.4 to -0.6. To try to quantify the extent of forward looking behavior, we develop a stylized dynamic model of individual behavior and calibrate it using our estimated behavioral response and additional data from the RAND Health Insurance Experiment. Our calibration suggests that the elasticity estimate may be substantially smaller than the one implied by fully forward-looking behavior, yet it is sufficiently high to have an economically significant effect on the response of annual medical utilization to a non-linear health insurance contract. Overall, our results point to the empirical importance of accounting for dynamic incentives in analyses of the impact of health insurance on medical utilization.

10.3386/w17802.abstractZh: 我们研究了个体在应对健康保险合同中常见的非线性定价时是否表现出前瞻性行为。我们的实证策略利用了这样一个事实：在日历年的后期加入雇主提供的健康保险计划的员工，面临的是相同的初始（“当前”）医疗价格，但预计的年末（“未来”）价格却高于在年初加入同一计划的员工。我们的研究结果否定了完全短视行为的假设；医疗使用似乎会针对未来价格做出反应，医疗使用与未来价格之间的弹性在-0.4到-0.6之间，且具有统计学意义。为了量化前瞻性行为的程度，我们开发了一个个体行为的动态模型，并使用我们估计的行为反应以及RAND健康保险实验的额外数据对其进行校准。我们的校准结果表明，弹性估计值可能远低于完全前瞻性行为所暗示的值，但这一数值仍然足够高，足以对年度医疗使用对非线性健康保险合同的反应产生经济上的显著影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了在分析健康保险对医疗使用影响时，考虑动态激励因素的重要性。

abstract.text: For the last decade we have been using double-blind survey techniques and randomized sampling to construct management data on over 10,000 organizations across twenty countries. On average, we find that in manufacturing American, Japanese, and German firms are the best managed. Firms in developing countries, such as Brazil, China and India tend to be poorly managed. American retail firms and hospitals are also well managed by international standards, although American schools are worse managed than those in several other developed countries. We also find substantial variation in management practices across organizations in every country and every sector, mirroring the heterogeneity in the spread of performance in these sectors. One factor linked to this variation is ownership. Government, family, and founder owned firms are usually poorly managed, while multinational, dispersed shareholder and private-equity owned firms are typically well managed. Stronger product market competition and higher worker skills are associated with better management practices. Less regulated labor markets are associated with improvements in incentive management practices such as performance based promotion.

10.3386/w17850.abstractZh: 在过去的十年里，我们采用了双盲调查技术和随机抽样方法，对二十个国家中超过10,000家组织的管理数据进行了研究。平均而言，我们发现美国的、日本的以及德国的企业在管理方面表现最佳。而像巴西、中国和印度这样的发展中国家的企业则往往管理不善。按照国际标准，美国的零售企业和医院也管理得相当不错，不过美国的学校管理状况不如其他几个发达国家。我们还发现，每个国家每个行业的企业在管理实践上存在显著差异，这反映了这些行业绩效分布的多样性。其中一个与这种差异相关的因素是所有权结构。政府、家族以及创始人拥有的企业通常管理不善，而跨国企业、分散的股东企业以及私募股权企业则通常管理得较好。更强的产品市场竞争和更高的员工技能水平与更好的管理实践相关。监管较少的劳动力市场则与激励管理实践的改进相关，比如基于绩效的晋升制度。

abstract.text: Household demand for actuarially unfair insurance against small risks has long puzzled economists. One way to potentially rationalize this demand is to recognize that (non-life) insurance is an incentive-compatible means of engaging an expert buyer. To quantify the benefits of expert buying, we compare prices paid by the insured and uninsured for health care. In categories of health care where uncompensated care is more difficult to obtain (drugs, doctor office visits, and hospital outpatient visits), we find that insurers pay 10-20% less than the uninsured. For forms of care where payment by the uninsured is more likely to be negotiated after services are rendered (hospitalizations and emergency room visits) the uninsured pay about 30% less on average, due largely to the nontrivial share of uninsured who pay 5% or less of their billed charges. At least in settings where free services are difficult to obtain, expert buying is an important benefit of insurance. We discuss the implications of the delegated-purchasing view of insurance for con-sumer-driven health insurance and for self-insurance by employers.

10.3386/w17857.abstractZh: 家庭对小额风险的非人寿保险的需求长期以来一直困扰着经济学家。一种可能的解释是，非人寿保险是一种激励相容的方式，可以吸引专家买家参与。为了量化专家购买带来的好处，我们比较了被保险人和未投保者在医疗保健方面的支付价格。在那些未补偿的医疗服务难以获得的领域（如药品、医生门诊和医院门诊），我们发现保险公司的支付金额比未投保者低10-20%。而在那些未投保者在服务完成后更有可能通过谈判降低支付价格的医疗服务领域（如住院和急诊就诊），未投保者的平均支付金额大约低30%，这主要是由于有相当一部分未投保者支付的金额仅为账单金额的5%或更低。至少在免费服务难以获得的情境下，专家购买确实是保险的一个重要好处。我们讨论了委托购买视角对消费者主导的医疗保险以及雇主自保的影响。

abstract.text: HIV-prevention strategies have yielded only limited success so far in slowing down the AIDS epidemic. This paper examines novel intervention strategies that use incentives to discourage risky sexual behaviors. Widely-adopted conditional cash transfer programs that offer payments conditioning on easily monitored behaviors, such as well-child health care visits have shown positive impact on health outcomes. Similarly, contingency management approaches have successfully used outcome-based rewards to encourage behaviors that aren't easily monitored, such as stopping drug abuse. These strategies have not been used in the sexual domain, so we assess how incentives can be used to reduce risky sexual behavior. After discussing theoretical pathways, we discuss the use of sexual-behavior incentives in the Tanzanian RESPECT trial. There, participants who tested negative for sexually transmitted infections are eligible for outcome-based cash rewards. The trial was well-received in the communities, with high enrollment rates and over 90% of participants viewing the incentives favorably. After one year, 57% of enrollees in the "low-value" reward arm stated that the cash rewards "very much" motivated sexual behavioral change, rising to 79% in the "high-value" reward arm. Despite its controversial nature, we argue for further testing of such incentive-based approaches to encouraging reductions in risky sexual behavior.

10.3386/w17865.abstractZh: 迄今为止，HIV预防策略在减缓艾滋病疫情方面取得的成效有限。本文探讨了利用激励措施来抑制危险性行为的新型干预策略。广泛采用的条件性现金转移计划，通过提供与易于监控的行为相关的报酬，如儿童健康护理服务，已显示出对健康结果的积极影响。同样，应急管理方法也成功地利用基于结果的奖励措施来鼓励那些不易监控的行为，如停止药物滥用。这些策略尚未应用于性领域，因此我们评估了如何利用激励措施来减少危险性行为。在讨论了理论途径之后，我们讨论了在坦桑尼亚RESPECT试验中运用性行为激励措施的情况。在该试验中，未检测出性传播感染的参与者有资格获得基于结果的现金奖励。该试验在社区中受到了好评，报名人数众多，超过90%的参与者认为这种激励措施是有益的。一年后，在“低价值”奖励组中，57%的参与者表示现金奖励“非常”促使了性行为的改变，而在“高价值”奖励组中这一比例上升到了79%。尽管这种方法存在争议，但我们仍然主张进一步测试这种基于激励的方法来促进危险性行为的减少。

abstract.text: Medicare continues to implement payment reforms that shift reimbursement from fee-for-service towards episode-based payment, affecting average and marginal reimbursement. We contrast the effects of two reforms for home health agencies. The Home Health Interim Payment System in 1997 lowered both types of reimbursement; our conceptual model predicts a decline in the likelihood of use and costs, both of which we find. The Home Health Prospective Payment System in 2000 raised average but lowered marginal reimbursement with theoretically ambiguous effects; we find a modest increase in use and costs. We find little substantive effect of either policy on readmissions or mortality.

10.3386/w17870.abstractZh: Medicare持续实施支付改革，将报销方式从按服务收费转变为按病例收费，这影响了平均报销率和边际报销率。我们对比了两项改革对家庭健康服务机构的影响。1997年的家庭健康临时支付系统降低了两种类型的报销率；我们的理论模型预测了使用率和成本都会下降，而实际上我们也观察到了这种情况。2000年的家庭健康预期支付系统提高了平均报销率，但降低了边际报销率，其效果理论上存在不确定性；我们发现使用率和成本略有增加。我们发现这两项政策对再入院率和死亡率几乎没有实质性影响。

abstract.text: This paper reports an experiment in over 3,000 Indonesian villages designed to test the role of performance incentives in improving the efficacy of aid programs. Villages in a randomly-chosen one-third of subdistricts received a block grant to improve 12 maternal and child health and education indicators, with the size of the subsequent year's block grant depending on performance relative to other villages in the subdistrict. Villages in remaining subdistricts were randomly assigned to either an otherwise identical block grant program with no financial link to performance, or to a pure control group. We find that the incentivized villages performed better on health than the non-incentivized villages, particularly in less developed areas, but found no impact of incentives on education. We find no evidence of negative spillovers from the incentives to untargeted outcomes, and no evidence that villagers manipulated scores. The relative performance design was crucial in ensuring that incentives did not result in a net transfer of funds toward richer areas. Incentives led to what appear to be more efficient spending of block grants, and led to an increase in labor from health providers, who are partially paid fee-for-service, but not teachers. On net, between 50-75% of the total impact of the block grant program on health indicators can be attributed to the performance incentives.

10.3386/w17892.abstractZh: 本文报道了一项在3000多个印度尼西亚村庄进行的实验，旨在测试绩效激励在提升援助项目效果中的作用。实验中，随机选取了三分之一的村庄获得专项拨款，用于改善12项母婴健康和教育指标。后续年度的拨款金额取决于该村庄相对于其他村庄的绩效表现。其余村庄则被随机分配到另一个与绩效无关的拨款项目，或者作为纯对照组。研究发现，接受激励的村庄在健康方面的表现优于未接受激励的村庄，尤其是在发展较为落后的地区。然而，激励措施对教育方面的影响并不明显。我们没有发现激励措施对未受激励的项目的负面溢出效应，也没有证据表明村民篡改了评分结果。相对绩效设计确保了激励措施不会导致资金向富裕地区转移。激励措施使得专项拨款的支出更加高效，并增加了提供健康服务的人员的数量，这些人员是按服务收费的方式获得报酬的，但教师并未因此增加。总体而言，专项拨款项目在健康指标方面的总影响中，有50%到75%可以归因于绩效激励措施。

abstract.text: In 2006, Massachusetts passed health care reform legislation designed to achieve nearly universal coverage through a combination of insurance market reforms, mandates, and subsidies that later served as the model for national reform. Using data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System, we provide evidence that health care reform in Massachusetts led to better overall self-assessed health. Various robustness checks and placebo tests support a causal interpretation of the results. We also document improvements in several determinants of overall health: physical health, mental health, functional limitations, joint disorders, and body mass index. Next, we show that the effects on overall health were strongest among those with low incomes, non-whites, near-elderly adults, and women. Finally, we use the reform to instrument for health insurance and estimate a sizeable impact of coverage on health.

10.3386/w17893.abstractZh: 2006年，马萨诸塞州通过了医疗改革立法，旨在通过保险市场改革、强制规定和补贴等手段实现几乎全民覆盖，这一模式后来成为全国改革的典范。利用行为风险因素监测系统的数据，我们发现马萨诸塞州的医疗改革显著提升了民众的自我评估健康状况。多种稳健性检验和安慰剂测试支持这一结果的因果解释。我们还发现，整体健康的多个指标都有所改善：身体健康、心理健康、功能限制、关节疾病以及体重指数。此外，我们发现对整体健康的影响在低收入人群、非白人、接近老年的人群以及女性中最为显著。最后，我们利用这一改革作为健康保险的工具变量，估计了保险覆盖对健康的显著影响。

abstract.text: Life expectancy at birth, estimated from United States period life tables, has been shown to vary systematically and widely by region and race. We use the same tables to estimate the probability of survival from birth to age 70 (S70), a measure of mortality more sensitive to disparities and more reliably calculated for small populations, to describe the variation and identify its sources in greater detail to assess the patterns of this variation. Examination of the unadjusted probability of S70 for each US county with a sufficient population of whites and blacks reveals large geographic differences for each race-sex group. For example, white males born in the ten percent healthiest counties have a 77 percent probability of survival to age 70, but only a 61 percent chance if born in the ten percent least healthy counties. Similar geographical disparities face white women and blacks of each sex. Moreover, within each county, large differences in S70 prevail between blacks and whites, on average 17 percentage points for men and 12 percentage points for women. In linear regressions for each race-sex group, nearly all of the geographic variation is accounted for by a common set of 22 socio-economic and environmental variables, selected for previously suspected impact on mortality; R2 ranges from 0.86 for white males to 0.72 for black females. Analysis of black-white survival chances within each county reveals that the same variables account for most of the race gap in S70 as well. When actual white male values for each explanatory variable are substituted for black in the black male prediction equation to assess the role explanatory variables play in the black-white survival difference, residual black-white differences at the county level shrink markedly to a mean of -2.4% (+/-2.4); for women the mean difference is -3.7 % (+/-2.3).

10.3386/w17901.abstractZh: 根据美国的生命表数据估算的出生时的预期寿命在不同地区和种族之间存在系统性且显著的差异。我们使用相同的生命表来估算从出生到70岁的生存概率，这一指标更能反映死亡率的差异，并且对于小规模人群来说计算更为可靠。通过更详细地分析这些差异及其来源，我们可以评估这种差异的模式。对每一个拥有足够多白人和黑人人口的美国县进行未调整后的70岁生存概率分析后发现，各种族-性别群体之间存在显著的地理差异。例如，出生在最健康的10%县的白人男性有77%的概率能够活到70岁，而出生在最不健康的10%县的白人男性则只有61%的概率能够活到70岁。白人女性和黑人女性也面临类似的地理差异。此外，在每个县内，黑人和白人在70岁生存概率上也存在显著差异，男性平均相差17个百分点，女性则相差12个百分点。在针对各种族-性别群体的线性回归分析中，几乎所有地理差异都可以用一组22个社会经济和环境变量来解释，这些变量被选中是因为它们被认为对死亡率有影响；R²值从白人男性的0.86到黑人女性的0.72不等。对每个县内黑人与白人生存概率的分析表明，这些变量同样解释了70岁生存概率上的种族差异。当将实际白人男性的各解释变量值替换为黑人，用于评估这些解释变量在黑人与白人生存差异中的作用时，县级层面的黑人-白人差异显著缩小，平均差异降至-2.4%（±2.4）；对于女性而言，平均差异为-3.7%（±2.3）。

abstract.text: Violence is one of the leading social problems in the United States. The development of appropriate public policies to curtail violence is confounded by the relationship between alcohol and violence. In this paper, we estimate the propensity of alcohol control policies to reduce the perpetration and victimization of criminal violence. We measure violence with data on individual level victimizations from the U.S. National Crime Victimization Survey. We examine the effects of a number of different alcohol control policies in reducing violent crime. These policies include the retail price of beer, drunk driving laws and penalties, keg laws, and serving and selling laws. We find some evidence of a negative relationship between alcohol prices and the probability of alcohol or drug related assault victimizations. However, we find no strong evidence that other alcohol policies are effective in reducing violent crimes. These results provide policy makers with guidance on potential approaches for reducing violence through alcohol beverage control.

10.3386/w17918.abstractZh: 暴力是美国的主要社会问题之一。制定适当的公共政策以遏制暴力行为，却受到酒精与暴力之间关系的干扰。本文我们估计了酒精控制政策在减少犯罪暴力行为的实施和受害方面的效果。我们通过美国全国犯罪受害调查中的个人层面受害数据来衡量暴力行为。我们研究了多种酒精控制政策在减少暴力犯罪方面的效果，这些政策包括啤酒的零售价格、酒驾法律及处罚、桶装啤酒法律以及供应和销售法律。我们发现酒精价格与酒精或毒品相关袭击受害概率之间存在负相关关系。然而，我们没有发现其他酒精政策在减少暴力犯罪方面具有显著效果。这些结果为政策制定者提供了通过酒精饮料控制来减少暴力的潜在方法指导。

abstract.text: We examine the effects of a major Swedish educational reform, that increased the years of compulsory schooling, on mortality and health. Using the gradual phase-in of the reform between 1949 and 1962 across municipalities, we estimate insignificant effects of the reform on mortality in the affected cohorts. From the confidence intervals we can rule out effects larger than 1-1.4 months of increased life expectancy. We find no significant impacts on mortality for individuals of low SES backgrounds, on deaths that are more likely to be affected by behavior, on hospitalizations, and consumption of prescribed drugs.

10.3386/w17932.abstractZh: 我们研究了瑞典一项重大教育改革的影响，该改革增加了义务教育年限，对其对死亡率和健康的影响进行了研究。通过对比1949年至1962年间各市镇改革逐步实施的情况，我们发现该改革对受影响群体的死亡率影响并不显著。从置信区间来看，其增加寿命预期的效果不超过1-1.4个月。我们发现，对于低社会经济背景的个体来说，该改革对死亡率没有显著影响，对于更可能受行为影响的死亡事件、住院情况以及处方药的使用也没有显著影响。

abstract.text: We model the labor market impact of the three key provisions of the recent Massachusetts and national "mandate-based" health reforms: individual and employer mandates and expansions in publicly-subsidized coverage. Using our model, we characterize the compensating differential for employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI) -- the causal change in wages associated with gaining ESHI. We also characterize the welfare impact of the labor market distortion induced by health reform. We show that the welfare impact depends on a small number of "sufficient statistics" that can be recovered from labor market outcomes. Relying on the reform implemented in Massachusetts in 2006, we estimate the empirical analog of our model. We find that jobs with ESHI pay wages that are lower by an average of $6,058 annually, indicating that the compensating differential for ESHI is only slightly smaller in magnitude than the average cost of ESHI to employers. Because the newly-insured in Massachusetts valued ESHI, they were willing to accept lower wages, and the deadweight loss of mandate-based health reform was less than 5% of what it would have been if the government had instead provided health insurance by levying a tax on wages.

10.3386/w17933.abstractZh: 我们模拟了最近马萨诸塞州及全国“强制性”健康改革中三项关键条款对劳动力市场的影响：个人和雇主的强制要求，以及公共补贴覆盖范围的扩大。利用我们的模型，我们描述了雇主赞助的健康保险所带来的补偿性差异——即获得雇主赞助的健康保险所带来的工资变化。我们还分析了健康改革引发的劳动力市场扭曲对福利的影响。我们发现，这种影响取决于少数几个可以从劳动力市场结果中推断出的“充分统计量”。以2006年马萨诸塞州实施的改革为例，我们估算了模型的实证模型。研究发现，拥有雇主赞助健康保险的工作岗位，其工资平均每年低6,058美元，这表明雇主赞助健康保险所带来的补偿性差异仅略低于雇主承担的健康保险平均成本。由于马萨诸塞州的新参保者重视雇主赞助健康保险，他们愿意接受较低的工资，而基于强制性的健康改革所带来的无谓损失不到政府通过征收工资税提供健康保险时预期损失的5%。

abstract.text: Endogenous patient sorting across hospitals can confound performance comparisons. This paper provides a new lens to compare hospital performance for emergency patients: plausibly exogenous variation in ambulance-company assignment. Ambulances are effectively randomly assigned to patients in the same area based on rotational dispatch mechanisms. Using Medicare data from 2002-2008, we show that ambulance company assignment importantly affects hospital choice for patients in the same zip code. Using data for New York state from 2000-2006 that matches exact patient addresses to hospital discharge records, we show that patients who live very near each other but on either side of ambulance-dispatch boundaries go to different types of hospitals. Both strategies show that higher-cost hospitals have significantly lower one-year mortality rates compared to lower-cost hospitals. We find that common indicators of hospital quality, such as indicators for "appropriate care" for heart attacks, are generally not associated with better patient outcomes. On the other hand, we find that measures of "leading edge" hospitals, such as teaching hospitals and hospitals that quickly adopt the latest technologies, are associated with better outcomes, but have little impact on the estimated mortality-hospital cost relationship. We also find that hospital procedure intensity is a key determinant of the mortality-cost relationship, suggesting that treatment intensity, and not differences in quality reflected in prices, drives much of our findings. The evidence also suggests that there are diminishing returns to hospital spending and treatment intensity.

10.3386/w17936.abstractZh: 医院之间的内生性患者分配可能会混淆绩效比较。本文提供了一种新的视角来比较医院对急诊患者的处理情况：救护车公司分配中的潜在外生变异。救护车实际上是根据轮班机制随机分配给同一区域的患者。利用2002-2008年的Medicare数据，我们发现救护车公司的分配对同地区患者的医院选择有重要影响。通过2000-2006年纽约州的数据，我们发现居住距离非常近但位于救护车分配边界两侧的患者会前往不同类型的医院。这两种情况都表明，成本较高的医院在一年内的死亡率明显低于成本较低的医院。我们发现，诸如“适当护理”等医院质量的常见指标通常与更好的患者结果无关。另一方面，我们发现诸如教学医院和快速采用最新技术的医院等“领先型”医院的指标与更好的结果相关，但对死亡率与成本关系的估计影响较小。我们还发现，医院的治疗强度是死亡率与成本关系的关键决定因素，这表明治疗强度而非价格反映的质量差异才是推动我们研究结果的主要因素。这些证据还表明，医院的治疗强度存在递减效应。

abstract.text: In this paper we study the efficient allocation of health resources across individuals. We focus on the relation between health resources and income (taken as a proxy for productivity). In particular we determine the efficient level of the health care social safety net for the indigent. We assume that individuals have different life cycle profiles of productivity. Health care increases survival probability. We adopt the classical approach of welfare economics by considering how a central planner with an egalitarian (ex-ante) perspective would allocate resources. We show that, under the efficient allocation, health care spending increases with labor productivity, but only during the working years. Post retirement, everyone would get the same health care. Quantitatively, we find that the amount of inequality across the income distribution in the data is larger that what would be justified solely on the basis of production efficiency, but not drastically so. As a rough summary, in U.S. data top to bottom spending ratios are about 1.5 for most of the life cycle. Efficiency implies a decline from about 2 (at age 25) to 1 at retirement. We find larger inefficiencies in the lower part of the income distribution and in post retirement ages.
