10.3386/w17937.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了健康资源在个体之间的有效分配问题。我们重点关注健康资源与收入之间的关系（收入被视为生产力的代理指标）。具体来说，我们确定了贫困人群在医疗社会保障体系中的有效水平。我们假设个体在生产力方面具有不同的生命周期特征。医疗保健能够增加生存概率。我们采用福利经济学的经典方法，考虑了一个具有平等主义（事前）视角的中央规划者如何分配资源。研究表明，在有效分配下，医疗保健支出会随着劳动生产率的增加而增加，但仅在工作期间如此。退休后，每个人都会获得相同的医疗保健。从数量上看，我们发现数据中的收入分布不平等程度大于单纯基于生产效率所合理化的程度，但差距并不明显。粗略总结来说，在美国的数据中，大部分生命周期的支出比率约为1.5。效率意味着从25岁时的约2下降到退休时的1。我们发现，在收入分布较低部分和退休后年龄段，效率更低。

abstract.text: Both under- and over-treatment of communicable diseases are public bads. But efforts to decrease one run the risk of increasing the other. Using rich experimental data on household treatment-seeking behavior in Kenya, we study the implications of this tradeoff for subsidizing life-saving antimalarials sold over-the-counter at retail drug outlets. We show that a very high subsidy (such as the one under consideration by the international community) dramatically increases access, but nearly half of subsidized pills go to patients without malaria. We study two ways to better target subsidized drugs: reducing the subsidy level and introducing rapid malaria tests over-the-counter.

10.3386/w17943.abstractZh: 无论是低估还是高估传染病的治疗需求，都属于公共健康问题。但减少其中一种治疗需求的做法可能会增加另一种需求。利用肯尼亚家庭寻求治疗行为的丰富实验数据，我们研究了这种权衡对补贴在零售药店非处方销售的救命抗疟药的影响。研究表明，极高的补贴（如国际社会正在考虑的这种补贴）会显著增加获取机会，但近一半的补贴药品被无疟疾患者所使用。我们研究了两种更好地定向补贴药物的方法：降低补贴水平以及引入快速抗疟检测服务。

abstract.text: Using data from the NLSY97 we analyze the impact of education on health behaviors, measured by smoking and heavy drinking. Controlling for health knowledge does not influence the impact of education on health behaviors, supporting the productive efficiency hypothesis. Although cognition, as measured by test scores, appears to have an effect on the relationship between education and health behaviors, this effect disappears once the models control for family fixed effects. Similarly, the impact of education on smoking and heavy drinking is the same between those with and without a learning disability, suggesting that cognition is not likely to be a significant factor in explaining the impact of education on health behaviors.

10.3386/w17949.abstractZh: 我们利用NLSY97的数据来分析教育对健康行为的影响，具体表现为吸烟和酗酒。在控制健康知识因素后，教育对健康行为的影响并未发生变化，这支持了生产效率假说。尽管通过测试成绩衡量的认知能力似乎对教育与健康行为之间的关系有影响，但在控制家庭固定效应后，这种影响消失了。同样，教育对吸烟和酗酒的影响在有无学习障碍的人群中是相同的，这表明认知能力不太可能是解释教育对健康行为影响的重要因素。

abstract.text: This paper examines two aspects of teen childbearing in the United States. First, it reviews and synthesizes the evidence on the reasons why teen birth rates are so uniquely high in the United States and especially in some states. Second, it considers why and how it matters. We argue that economists' typical explanations are unable to account for any sizable share of the geographic variation. We describe some recent analysis indicating that the combination of being poor and living in a more unequal (and less mobile) location, like the United States, leads young women to choose early, non-marital childbearing at elevated rates, potentially because of their lower expectations of future economic success. Consistent with this view, the most rigorous studies on the topic find that teen childbearing has very little, if any, direct negative economic consequence. If it is explained by the low economic trajectory that some young women face, then it makes sense that having a child as a teen would not be an additional cause of poor economic outcomes. These findings lead us to conclude that the high rate of teen childbearing in the United States matters mostly because it is a marker of larger, underlying social problems.

10.3386/w17965.abstractZh: 本文探讨了美国青少年生育的两个方面。首先，本文回顾并综合了关于为何美国尤其是某些州的青少年生育率如此高的原因的证据。其次，本文探讨了这一现象为何以及为何重要。我们认为，经济学家通常的解释无法解释地理差异中的大部分情况。一些最新的分析表明，贫困以及生活在更加不平等且流动性较低的环境中（如美国），会导致年轻女性选择较早进行非婚生育，这可能是由于她们对未来经济成功的期望较低。与这一观点一致的是，最严谨的研究发现，青少年生育几乎没有直接的负面经济后果。如果这一现象是由一些年轻女性面临的经济困境所解释的，那么她们在青少年时期生育并不会进一步导致经济状况恶化。这些发现使我们得出结论：美国青少年生育率的高企主要是一个更大的社会问题的标志。

abstract.text: Beginning in the mid-2000s, the incidence of drug shortages rose, especially for generic injectable drugs such as anesthetics and chemotherapy treatments. We examine whether reimbursement changes contributed to the shortages, focusing on a reduction in Medicare Part B reimbursement to providers for drugs. We hypothesize that lower reimbursement put downward pressure on manufacturers’ prices which reduced manufacturers’ incentives to invest in capacity, reliability, and new launches. We show that, after the policy change, shortages rose more for drugs with (i) higher shares of patients insured by Medicare, (ii) greater decreases in provider reimbursement, and (iii) greater decreases in manufacturer prices.

10.3386/w17987.abstractZh: 自2000年代中期开始，药品短缺现象日益严重，尤其是像麻醉剂和化疗药物这类仿制注射药物。我们研究了报销政策的改变是否导致了这些短缺现象，重点关注了医疗保险计划B对医疗服务提供者的报销减少。我们假设较低的报销标准给制造商带来了价格压力，从而降低了制造商在产能、可靠性和新产品开发方面的投资意愿。研究表明，在政策改变之后，以下三类药物的短缺现象更为严重：(i) 由医疗保险计划承保的患者比例较高的药物；(ii) 医疗服务提供者报销减少幅度较大的药物；以及(iii) 制造商价格下降幅度较大的药物。

abstract.text: We study whether prompts to form and recall a plan can increase individuals' responsiveness to reminders to make and attend beneficial appointments. At four companies, all employees due for a colonoscopy were randomly assigned to receive either a control mailing or a treatment mailing. The mailings were identical except that the control mailing included a blank sticky note while the treatment mailing included a sticky note that prompted the recipient to write down the appointment date for a colonoscopy and the name of the doctor who would conduct the procedure. During the seven-month follow-up period, 7.2% of treatment employees received a colonoscopy compared to 6.2% of control employees, a statistically significant difference that is roughly equal to the variation in compliance associated with a 10 percent increase in the fraction of the procedure's cost covered by insurance. The treatment effect was largest for demographic groups judged to be at the highest risk of failing to receive a colonoscopy due to forgetfulness.

10.3386/w17995.abstractZh: 我们研究了促使人们制定并回忆计划是否可以提高个体对提醒做出有益预约的响应能力。在四家公司中，所有即将接受结肠镜检查的员工被随机分配接受对照邮件或实验邮件。这两类邮件在内容上是相同的，但对照邮件中有一张空白便签，而实验邮件则包含一张便签，提示收件人写下结肠镜检查的预约日期以及执行该检查的医生姓名。在七个月的随访期间，接受实验邮件的员工中有7.2%接受了结肠镜检查，而对照邮件的员工中这一比例为6.2%。这一显著差异与因忘记而未能接受结肠镜检查的风险成正比，这一差异大致相当于因保险覆盖费用增加10%而导致的依从性变化。对于因健忘而最有可能无法接受结肠镜检查的人群来说，实验邮件的效果最为显著。

abstract.text: This paper exploits a unique ongoing experiment to analyze the effects of early rearing conditions on physical and mental health in a sample of rhesus monkeys (Macaca mulatta). We analyze the health records of 231 monkeys which were randomly allocated at birth across three rearing conditions: Mother Rearing, Peer Rearing, and Surrogate Peer Rearing. We show that the lack of a secure attachment relationship in the early years engendered by adverse rearing conditions has detrimental long-term effects on health which are not compensated by a normal social environment later in life.

10.3386/w18002.abstractZh: 本文利用一项独特的持续实验，分析早期抚养条件对恒河猴（Macaca mulatta）身体和心理健康的影响。我们分析了231只猴子的健康记录，这些猴子在出生时被随机分配到三种抚养环境中：由母亲抚养、由同伴抚养以及由替代同伴抚养。研究表明，由于不良抚养条件导致的早期缺乏安全依恋关系，会对健康产生长期负面影响，而正常的社会环境无法弥补这些影响。

abstract.text: While the prevalence of smokeless tobacco (ST) is low relative to smoking, the distribution of ST use is highly skewed with consumption concentrated among certain segments of the population (rural residents, males, whites, low-educated individuals). Furthermore, there is suggestive evidence that use has trended upwards recently for groups that have traditionally been at low risk of using ST, and thus started to diffuse across demographics. This study provides the first estimates, at the national level, of the effects of magazine advertising on ST use. The focus on magazine advertising is significant given that ST manufacturers have been banned from using other conventional media since the 1986 Comprehensive ST Act and the 1998 ST Master Settlement Agreement. This study is based on the 2003-2009 waves of the National Consumer Survey (NCS), a unique data source that contains extensive information on the reading habits of individuals, matched with magazine-specific advertising information over the sample period. This allows detailed and salient measures of advertising exposure at the individual level and addresses potential bias due to endogeneity and selective targeting. We find consistent and robust evidence that exposure to ST ads in magazines raises ST use, especially among males, with an estimated elasticity of 0.06. There is suggestive evidence that both ST taxes and cigarette taxes reduce ST use, indicating contemporaneous complementarity between these tobacco products. Sub-analyses point to some differences in the advertising and tax response across segments of the population. The effects from this study inform the debate on the cost and benefits of ST use and its potential to be a tool in overall tobacco harm reduction.

10.3386/w18003.abstractZh: 虽然无烟烟草的使用率相对于吸烟来说较低，但其分布却存在高度偏斜，使用主要集中在某些人群群体中，如农村居民、男性、白人以及教育程度较低的个体。此外，有证据表明，那些传统上使用无烟烟草风险较低的群体，其使用率近年来有所上升，这表明无烟烟草的使用范围正在逐渐扩大。本研究首次在全国范围内估算了杂志广告对无烟烟草使用的影响。由于自1986年《全面无烟烟草法案》和1998年《无烟烟草主协议》实施以来，无烟烟草制造商被禁止使用其他传统媒体，因此关注杂志广告尤为重要。本研究基于2003-2009年的全国消费者调查数据，该数据来源独特，包含有关个人阅读习惯的详细信息，同时还有样本期间特定杂志的广告信息。这使得我们能够详细且准确地衡量个人层面的广告暴露情况，并避免了由于内生性和选择性目标定位带来的潜在偏差。我们发现，杂志中的无烟烟草广告确实会增加无烟烟草的使用率，尤其是在男性中，估计的弹性为0.06。此外，有证据表明，无烟烟草税和香烟税都能减少无烟烟草的使用，这表明这两种烟草产品之间存在互补性。子分析还指出，不同人群在广告和税收反应上存在一些差异。本研究的结果为关于无烟烟草使用的成本和收益的讨论提供了依据，同时也为将其作为减少整体烟草危害的工具提供了依据。

abstract.text: We use data from Sierra Leone where a substantial education program provided increased access to education for primary-school age children but did not benefit children who were older. We exploit the variation in access to the program generated by date of birth and the variation in resources between various districts of the country. We find that the program has increased educational attainment and that an increase in education has changed women's preferences. An increase in schooling, triggered by the program, had an impact on women's attitudes towards matters that impact women's health and on attitudes regarding violence against women. An increase in education has also reduced the number of desired children by women and increased their propensity to use modern contraception and to be tested for AIDS. While education makes women more intolerant of practices that conflict with their well-being, increased education has no impact on men's attitudes towards women's well-being.

10.3386/w18016.abstractZh: 我们研究了塞拉利昂的案例，该国的教育项目为小学年龄的儿童提供了更多的教育机会，但并未惠及年龄较大的儿童。我们利用了出生日期差异以及该国不同地区之间资源差异所导致的项目接受程度的变化。研究发现，该项目提高了教育水平，而教育水平的提高也改变了女性的偏好。该项目引发的受教育程度提升，对女性对影响健康问题的态度以及针对女性的暴力行为态度产生了影响。教育水平的提高还减少了女性生育的意愿，并增加了她们使用现代避孕措施和接受艾滋病检测的可能性。虽然教育使女性更难以接受与自身福祉相冲突的行为，但教育水平的提高并未影响男性对女性福祉的态度。

abstract.text: Greater patient cost-sharing could help reduce the fiscal pressures associated with insurance expansion by reducing the scope for moral hazard. But it is possible that low-income recipients are unable to cut back on utilization wisely and that, as a result, higher cost-sharing will lead to worse health and higher downstream costs through hospitalizations. We use exogenous variation in the copayments faced by low-income enrollees in the Massachusetts' Commonwealth Care program to study these effects. We estimate separate price elasticities of demand by type of service (hospital care, drugs, outpatient care). Overall, we find price elasticities of about -0.15 for this low-income population -- fairly similar to elasticities calculated for higher-income populations in other settings. These elasticities are somewhat larger for the chronically sick and older enrollees. A substantial portion of the decline in utilization comes from some patients cutting back on use completely, but we find no (detectable) evidence of offsetting increases in hospitalizations or emergency department visits in response to the higher copayments, either overall or for the chronically ill in particular.

10.3386/w18023.abstractZh: 更高的患者费用分担可以帮助减少与保险扩展相关的财政压力，通过减少道德风险的可能性来实现。但是，低收入参保者可能无法明智地减少医疗使用，因此，更高的费用分担可能会导致健康状况恶化，并增加住院费用。我们利用马萨诸塞州Commonwealth Care计划中低收入参保者面临的自付费用变化来研究这些影响。我们分别估算了不同服务类型（医院护理、药品、门诊护理）的需求价格弹性。总体而言，我们发现这一低收入群体的需求价格弹性约为-0.15，与其他情况下高收入群体的弹性相当。对于长期患病和年龄较大的参保者，这些弹性略高。使用减少的相当一部分来自一些患者完全停止使用医疗服务，但我们没有发现由于更高的自付费用而导致住院或急诊就诊数量增加的证据，无论是整体情况还是针对长期患病者而言。

abstract.text: The US health care sector is, by most accounts, extraordinarily inefficient. Health information technology (IT) has been championed as a tool that can transform health care delivery. Recently, the federal government has taken an active role in promoting health IT diffusion. There is little systematic analysis of the causal impact of health IT on productivity or whether private and public returns to health IT diverge thereby justifying government intervention. We estimate the parameters of a value-added hospital production function correcting for endogenous input choices in order to assess the private returns hospitals earn from health IT. Despite high marginal products, the potential benefits from expanded IT adoption are modest. Over the span of our data, health IT inputs increased by more than 210% and contributed about 6% to the increase in value-added. Virtually all the increase in value-added is attributable to the increased use of inputs{there was little change in hospital multi-factor productivity. Not-for-profits invested more heavily and differently in IT than for-profit hospitals. Finally, we find no evidence of labor complementarities or network externalities from health IT.

10.3386/w18025.abstractZh: 美国医疗保健行业被普遍认为效率极低。健康信息技术被视作能够改变医疗保健提供方式的重要工具。最近，联邦政府积极推动了健康信息技术的普及。然而，对于健康信息技术对生产力的影响以及私人与公共部门从健康信息技术中获得的收益是否存在差异，从而是否值得政府干预，目前缺乏系统的分析。我们估算了增值医院生产函数的参数，并考虑了内生性投入选择的影响，以评估医院从健康信息技术中获得的私人收益。尽管边际产品很高，但扩大信息技术应用的潜在收益却相当有限。在我们的数据范围内，健康信息技术的投入增加了210%以上，但仅贡献了约6%的增值增长。几乎所有的增值增长都归因于投入的增加，而医院的多因素生产率几乎没有变化。非营利组织在信息技术上的投资比营利性医院更为密集且方式不同。最后，我们没有发现健康信息技术具有劳动力互补性或网络外部性的证据。

abstract.text: This study examined the impact of the 2009 federal tobacco excise tax increase on the use of cigarettes and smokeless tobacco products among youth using the Monitoring the Future survey, a nationally representative survey of 8th, 10th, and 12th grade students. The results of this analysis showed that this tax increase had a substantial short-term impact. The percentage of students who reported smoking in the past 30 days dropped between 9.7% and 13.3% immediately following the tax increase, depending on model specifications, and the percentage of students who reported using smokeless tobacco products dropped between 16% and 24%. It is estimated that there would have been approximately 220,000 - 287,000 more current smokers and 135,000 - 203,000 more smokeless tobacco users among middle school and high school students (age 14 - 18) in the United States in May 2009 had the federal tax not increased in April 2009. The long-term projected number of youth prevented from smoking or using smokeless tobacco that resulted from the 2009 federal tax increase could be much larger given the resulting higher tobacco prices would deter more and more children from initiating smoking and smokeless tobacco use over time.

10.3386/w18026.abstractZh: 本研究通过“监测未来”调查，考察了2009年联邦烟草消费税上调对青少年使用香烟和无烟烟草产品的影响。该调查是对全国8年级、10年级和12年级学生的代表性调查。分析结果显示，这一税收上调在短期内产生了显著影响。根据模型估计，在税收上调后，过去30天内吸烟的学生比例立即下降了9.7%至13.3%，而使用无烟烟草产品的学生比例则下降了16%至24%。据估计，如果2009年4月没有上调联邦烟草消费税，美国14至18岁的中学生和高中生中，当前吸烟者的数量将增加约220,000至287,000人，使用无烟烟草产品的数量将增加约135,000至203,000人。鉴于2009年联邦税收上调导致的烟草价格上升，长期来看，因税收上调而避免吸烟或使用无烟烟草的青少年数量可能会更多。

abstract.text: It is conventional wisdom that it is possible to reduce exposure to indoor air pollution, improve health outcomes, and decrease greenhouse gas emissions in the rural areas of developing countries through the adoption of improved cooking stoves. This belief is largely supported by observational field studies and engineering or laboratory experiments. However, we provide new evidence, from a randomized control trial conducted in rural Orissa, India (one of the poorest places in India), on the benefits of a commonly used improved stove that laboratory tests showed to reduce indoor air pollution and require less fuel. We track households for up to four years after they received the stove. While we find a meaningful reduction in smoke inhalation in the first year, there is no effect over longer time horizons. We find no evidence of improvements in lung functioning or health and there is no change in fuel consumption (and presumably greenhouse gas emissions). The difference between the laboratory and field findings appear to result from households' revealed low valuation of the stoves. Households failed to use the stoves regularly or appropriately, did not make the necessary investments to maintain them properly, and usage rates ultimately declined further over time. More broadly, this study underscores the need to test environmental and health technologies in real-world settings where behavior may temper impacts, and to test them over a long enough horizon to understand how this behavioral effect evolves over time.

10.3386/w18033.abstractZh: 传统观点认为，通过采用改进的烹饪炉具，可以在发展中国家的农村地区减少室内空气污染，改善健康状况，并降低温室气体排放。这一观点得到了大量观察性实地研究和工程或实验室实验的支持。然而，我们在印度奥里萨邦（印度最贫困的地区之一）进行的一项随机对照试验提供了新的证据，该试验表明，一种常用的改进型炉具能够减少室内空气污染，并且所需的燃料更少。我们在这些家庭使用炉具后的四年内进行了跟踪调查。虽然在第一年我们发现吸烟量显著减少，但在更长时间内并未观察到效果。我们没有发现肺功能或健康状况的改善，燃料消耗也没有变化（因此温室气体排放也可能没有变化）。实验室和实地研究结果之间的差异似乎是由于家庭对改进型炉具的估值较低所致。这些家庭未能定期或正确使用炉具，也没有进行必要的投资来维护炉具，因此使用率随着时间的推移进一步下降。更广泛地说，这项研究强调了需要在真实环境中测试环境和技术对健康的影響，并需要在足够长的时间范围内进行测试，以了解这种行为效应如何随时间演变。

abstract.text: This paper builds on the methods of local instrumental variables developed by Heckman and Vytlacil (1999, 2001, 2005) to estimate person-centered treatment (PeT) effects that are conditioned on the person's observed characteristics and averaged over the potential conditional distribution of unobserved characteristics that lead them to their observed treatment choices. PeT effects are more individualized than conditional treatment effects from a randomized setting with the same observed characteristics. PeT effects can be easily aggregated to construct any of the mean treatment effect parameters and, more importantly, are well-suited to comprehend individual-level treatment effect heterogeneity. The paper presents the theory behind PeT effects, studies their finite-sample properties using simulations and presents a novel analysis of treatment evaluation in health care.

10.3386/w18056.abstractZh: 本文基于Heckman和Vytlacil（1999年、2001年、2005年）开发的局部工具变量方法，用于估计以个人特征为条件的个人中心处理效应。这些效应考虑了个人观察到的特征，并平均了导致他们选择特定处理的潜在未观察到的特征分布。与个人在具有相同观察到的特征的情况下从随机化设置中获得的条件处理效应相比，个人中心处理效应更具个性化。这些效应可以很容易地汇总，以构建任何平均处理效应参数，并且更适用于理解个体层面的处理效应异质性。本文阐述了个人中心处理效应背后的理论，通过模拟研究了它们的有限样本性质，并提出了一种新颖的医疗保健领域处理评估分析方法。

abstract.text: Employment-contingent health insurance creates incentives for ill workers to remain employed at a sufficient level (usually full-time) to maintain access to health insurance coverage. We study employed married women, newly diagnosed with breast cancer, comparing labor supply responses to breast cancer diagnoses between women dependent on their own employment for health insurance and women with access to health insurance through their spouse's employer. We find evidence that women more dependent on their own job for health insurance reduce their labor supply by less after a diagnosis of breast cancer - the estimate difference is about 5.5 to 7 percent. Women's subjective responses to questions about working more to maintain health insurance are consistent with the conclusions from observed behavior.

10.3386/w18060.abstractZh: 基于就业条件的健康保险为患病工人提供了保持一定就业水平（通常是全职）以继续享受健康保险覆盖的激励。我们研究了已婚女性新诊断出乳腺癌后的劳动力供给反应，比较了那些依赖自身工作获得健康保险的女性和通过配偶雇主获得健康保险的女性的反应。我们发现，更依赖自身工作获得健康保险的女性在乳腺癌诊断后减少劳动力供给的程度较小，估计差异约为5.5%到7%。女性对为维持健康保险而增加工作的主观反应与观察到的行为结果一致。

abstract.text: A growing literature suggests that stressful events in pregnancy can have negative effects on birth outcomes. Some of the estimates in this literature may be affected by small samples, omitted variables, endogenous mobility in response to disasters, and errors in the measurement of gestation, as well as by a mechanical correlation between longer gestation and the probability of having been exposed. We use millions of individual birth records to examine the effects of exposure to hurricanes during pregnancy. The data allow us to measure outcomes precisely and to follow the same mother over time; we also suggest estimation methods that correct for omitted unobserved fixed characteristics of the mother, endogenous moving in response to storms, and the above mentioned correlation between gestation length and exposure. We find that exposure to a hurricane during pregnancy increases the probability of complications of labor and delivery, and of abnormal conditions of the newborn such as being on a ventilator more than 30 minutes and meconium aspiration syndrome. Although we do not directly measure stress, our results are supportive of the idea that stressful events in pregnancy can damage the health of the fetus. However our results suggest that the effects may be subtle and not readily apparent in terms of widely-used metrics such as birth weight and gestation.

10.3386/w18070.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究表明，妊娠期间的压力事件可能对分娩结果产生负面影响。这些研究中的一些结果可能受到样本规模较小、遗漏变量、对灾难的反应导致的行为变化以及妊娠时间测量误差的影响，此外，妊娠时间长短与暴露风险之间可能存在机械性关联。我们利用数百万份个体出生记录来研究妊娠期间遭遇飓风的影响。这些数据使我们能够精确测量结果，并持续跟踪同一位母亲的情况；我们还提出了一些估计方法，以纠正母亲未观察到的固定特征、因风暴而发生的动态变化以及上述妊娠时间长短与暴露风险之间的关联。我们发现，妊娠期间遭遇飓风会增加分娩并发症的风险，以及新生儿出现异常情况的概率，例如需要使用呼吸机超过30分钟或发生胎粪吸入综合征。虽然我们无法直接测量压力，但我们的研究结果支持这样的观点：妊娠期间的压力事件可能会损害胎儿的健康。不过，我们的研究结果表明，这些影响可能较为微妙，在使用诸如出生体重和妊娠时间等广泛使用的指标时并不容易察觉。

abstract.text: Previous studies estimate the average effect of cigarette price on body mass index (BMI), with recent research showing that their different methodologies all point to a negative effect after several years. This literature, however, ignores the possibility that the effect could vary throughout the BMI distribution or across socioeconomic and demographic groups due to differences in underlying preferences for health or risks for obesity. We evaluate heterogeneity in the long-run impact of cigarette price on BMI by performing quantile regressions and stratifying the sample by race, education, age, and sex. Cigarette price has a highly heterogeneous negative effect that is more than three times as strong at high BMI levels - where weight loss is most beneficial for health - than at low levels. The effects are also strongest for blacks, college graduates, middle-aged adults, and women. We also assess the implications for disparities, conduct robustness checks, and evaluate potential mechanisms.

10.3386/w18087.abstractZh: 先前的研究估计了香烟价格对体重指数（BMI）的平均影响，最近的研究表明，不同研究方法都表明在几年后存在负面影响。然而，这些研究忽略了这种影响可能在BMI分布的不同区间或不同社会经济和人口群体中有所不同，因为人们对健康的偏好或肥胖的风险存在差异。我们通过进行分位数回归，并根据种族、教育水平、年龄和性别对样本进行分层，来评估香烟价格对BMI长期影响的异质性。结果显示，香烟价格对BMI的负面影响具有高度异质性，在BMI较高时——即体重减轻对健康最为有益的时候——这种影响是较低水平时的三倍多。这种影响在黑人、大学毕业生、中年人和女性中最为明显。我们还评估了这种差异对不平等的影响，进行了稳健性检验，并探讨了潜在的机制。

abstract.text: We analyze consumer demand and model the effect of pricing regulation under imperfect competition using data from the Massachusetts health insurance exchange. We identify consumer demand using coarse insurer pricing strategies. There is substantial heterogeneity in preferences by consumer type, with younger consumers twice as price sensitive as older consumers. As a result, older consumers face higher markups over costs. Modified community rating links prices for consumers that differ in both costs and preferences. Constrained prices are not simply the population-weighted average of unconstrained prices, because community rating changes the marginal consumer firms face. Tightening rating regulations transfers resources from low cost to high cost consumers, but also reduces firm profits and increases overall consumer surplus. We use our model to examine other insurance regulations. For instance, minimum loss ratios (designed to limit firm profits) will also alter the transfers between consumers. Moreover, risk adjustment will be insufficient to equalize prices across consumer types, as markups still differ. As a result, without a mandate, the market can unravel due to differences in preferences alone

10.3386/w18089.abstractZh: 我们分析了消费者需求，并利用马萨诸塞州健康保险交易所的数据，对不完全竞争下价格管制的影响进行了建模。我们通过保险公司的定价策略来识别消费者需求。不同消费者类型的偏好存在显著差异，年轻消费者的价格敏感度是老年消费者的两倍。因此，老年消费者面临更高的成本加成。修改后的社区评级机制会调整那些在成本和偏好上都存在差异的消费者的价格。受限价格并非无限制价格的人口加权平均值，因为社区评级改变了边际消费者所面临的状况。收紧评级规定会将资源从低成本消费者转移到高成本消费者，但同时也会降低企业利润并增加整体消费者剩余。我们使用我们的模型来考察其他保险法规的影响。例如，最低损失比率（旨在限制企业利润）也会改变消费者之间的资源转移。此外，风险调整措施不足以使不同消费者类型之间的价格趋于一致，因为成本加成仍然存在差异。因此，如果没有强制规定，市场可能会因为偏好差异而崩溃。

abstract.text: This paper examines the implicit health insurance households receive from the ability to declare bankruptcy. Exploiting cross-state and within-state variation in asset exemption law, I show that uninsured households with greater seizable assets make higher out-of-pocket medical payments, conditional on the amount of care received. In turn, I find that households with greater wealth-at-risk are more likely to hold health insurance. The implicit insurance from bankruptcy distorts the insurance coverage decision. Using a microsimulation model, I calculate that the optimal Pigovian penalties are similar on average to the penalties under the Affordable Care Act (ACA).

10.3386/w18105.abstractZh: 本文探讨了家庭因能够申请破产而获得的隐性健康保险福利。通过对比不同州以及同一州内资产豁免法律的变化，我发现拥有较大可变现资产的未投保家庭在获得医疗服务时，需要承担更高的自付医疗费用。同时，我发现，风险较高的家庭更有可能持有健康保险。破产带来的隐性保险扭曲了保险选择决策。通过微观模拟模型计算，我们发现最优的庇古式惩罚与《平价医疗法案》规定的惩罚大致相当。

abstract.text: Insurance induces a well-known tradeoff between the welfare gains from risk protection and the welfare losses from moral hazard. Empirical work traditionally estimates each side of the tradeoff separately, potentially yielding mutually inconsistent results. I develop a nonlinear budget set model of health insurance that allows for the calculation of both sides of the tradeoff simultaneously, allowing for a relationship between moral hazard and risk protection. An important feature of this model is that it considers nonlinearities in the consumer budget set that arise from deductibles, coinsurance rates, and stoplosses that alter moral hazard as well as risk protection relative to no insurance. I illustrate the properties of my model by estimating it using data on employer sponsored health insurance from a large firm. Within my empirical context, the average deadweight losses from moral hazard substantially outweigh the average welfare gains from risk protection. However, the welfare impact of moral hazard and risk protection are both small relative to transfers from the government through the tax preference for employer sponsored health insurance and transfers from some agents to other agents through a common premium.

10.3386/w18108.abstractZh: 保险会引发一个众所周知的权衡：风险保障带来的福利增益与道德风险带来的福利损失之间存在着矛盾。传统的实证研究通常分别估算这一权衡的双方，这可能导致结果相互矛盾。我提出了一种非线性预算集模型来描述健康保险，该模型能够同时计算权衡的双方，从而揭示道德风险与风险保障之间的关系。该模型的一个重要特点是，它考虑了由免赔额、共保费率和止损机制引起的消费者预算集的非线性变化，这些变化会改变道德风险以及风险保障的效果，使其相对于无保险情况有所不同。我通过一家大型企业的雇主赞助健康保险数据来估算该模型的特性。在我的实证背景下，道德风险带来的平均无谓损失远远超过了风险保障带来的平均福利增益。然而，与政府通过税收优惠对雇主赞助健康保险提供的转移支付，以及某些主体通过共同保费向其他主体提供的转移支付相比，道德风险与风险保障对福利的影响都相对较小。

abstract.text: The overuse of medical services including antibiotics is often blamed on Physician Induced Demand. But since this theory is about physician motivations, it is difficult to test. We conduct an audit study in which physician financial incentives, beliefs about what patients want, and desires to reciprocate for a small gift are systematically varied. We find that all of these treatments reduce antibiotics prescriptions, suggesting that antibiotics abuse in China is not driven by patients actively demanding antibiotics, by physicians believing that patients want antibiotics, or by physicians believing that antibiotics are in the best interests of their patients, but is largely driven by financial incentives. Our results also show that physician behavior can be significantly influenced by the receipt of a token gift, such as a pen.

10.3386/w18153.abstractZh: 医疗服务的过度使用，包括抗生素的滥用，通常被认为是医生主动需求的结果。但由于这一理论涉及医生的动机，因此难以进行验证。我们开展了一项审计研究，在研究中系统地改变了医生的财务激励、医生对病人需求的认知以及医生希望回赠小礼物的愿望等因素。研究发现，所有这些因素都能减少抗生素的处方量，这表明中国抗生素的滥用并非由病人主动要求使用抗生素、医生认为病人需要抗生素，或者医生认为抗生素符合患者的最佳利益所驱动，而主要是由财务激励所推动。我们的结果还表明，医生的行为会受到收到象征性礼物（如钢笔）的显著影响。

abstract.text: We study the Medicare Part D prescription drug insurance program as a bellwether for designs of private, non-mandatory health insurance markets, focusing on the ability of consumers to evaluate and optimize their choices of plans. Our analysis of administrative data on medical claims in Medicare Part D suggests that less than 10 percent of individuals enroll in plans that are ex post optimal with respect to total cost (premiums and co-payments). Relative to the benchmark of a static decision rule, similar to the Plan Finder provided by the Medicare administration, that conditions next year's plan choice only on the drugs consumed in the current year, enrollees lost on average about $300 per year. These numbers are hard to reconcile with decision costs alone; it appears that unless a sizeable fraction of consumers value plan features other than cost, they are not optimizing effectively.

10.3386/w18166.abstractZh: 我们研究了Medicare Part D处方药保险计划，将其视为私人、非强制性的健康保险市场设计的风向标，重点关注消费者评估和优化选择计划的能力。我们对Medicare Part D医疗索赔的行政数据分析表明，只有不到10%的参与者选择那些在总成本（保费和共付额）方面事后最优的计划。与Medicare管理部门提供的类似计划筛选器这一静态决策规则相比，仅基于当年所消费的药物来制定明年计划选择的方案，参与者平均每年会损失约300美元。这些数字很难仅通过决策成本来解释；看来，除非相当一部分消费者重视除成本之外的计划特性，否则他们并没有真正实现最优选择。

abstract.text: We provide a detailed analysis of the incidence, duration and determinants of claims made on private Long Term Disability (LTD) policies using a database of approximately 10,000 policies and 1 million workers from a major LTD insurer. We document that LTD claims rates are much lower than claims rates on the public analogue to LTD, the Social Security Disability Insurance program, yet LTD policies have a much higher return-to-work rate among initial claimants. Nevertheless, our analysis indicates that the impact of moral hazard on LTD claims is substantial. Using within firm, over time variation in plan parameters, we find that a higher replacement rate and a shorter waiting time to benefits receipt--also known as the Elimination Period or EP--significantly increase the likelihood that workers claim LTD. About sixty percent of the effect of a longer EP is due to censoring of shorter claims, while the remainder is due to deterrence: workers facing a longer EP are less likely to claim benefits for impairments that would lead to a only a brief period of LTD receipt. This deterrence effect is equally large among high and low-income workers, suggesting that moral hazard rather than liquidity underlies the behavioral response. Consistent with this interpretation, the response of LTD claims to plan parameters is driven primarily by the behavior of the healthiest disabled, those who would return to work after receiving LTD.

10.3386/w18172.abstractZh: 我们利用一家主要长期残疾保险公司的约10,000份保单和100万名工人的数据库，对私人长期残疾保险保单索赔的发生率、持续时间和决定因素进行了详细分析。我们发现，长期残疾保险保单的索赔率远低于公共类似保险计划——社会保障残疾保险计划的索赔率，然而长期残疾保险保单的工人重返工作岗位的比例要高得多。不过，我们的分析表明，道德风险对长期残疾保险索赔的影响相当显著。通过考察企业内部保单参数的随时间变化，我们发现更高的替代率和更短的领取福利等待期——也称为消除期或EP——显著增加了工人提出长期残疾保险索赔的可能性。大约60%的等待期延长效应是由于较短的索赔被忽略所致，其余部分则是因为威慑作用：面临更长的等待期的工人不太可能为那些仅会导致短暂长期残疾的障碍提出索赔。这种威慑效应在高收入和低收入工人中同样显著，这表明行为反应背后的原因是道德风险而非流动性问题。与这一解释一致的是，长期残疾保险索赔对保单参数的反应主要由最健康的残疾人的行为所驱动，这些人在获得长期残疾保险后通常会重返工作岗位。

abstract.text: The behavioral economic model presented in this paper argues that the effect of advertising and price differ by past consumption levels. The model predicts that advertising is more effective in reducing consumption at high past consumption levels but less effective at low past consumption levels. Conversely, the model predicts that higher prices are effective in reducing consumption at low past consumption levels but less effective at high past consumption levels. Unlike the models used in most prior studies, this model predicts that the effects of policy on average consumption and on the upper end of the distribution are different. Both FMM and Quantile models were estimated. The results from these regressions show that heavy drinkers are more responsive to advertising and less responsive to price than are moderate drinkers. The empirical evidence also supports the assumption that education is a proxy for self-regulation. The key conclusions are that restrictions on advertising are targeted at heavy drinkers and are an underutilized alcohol control policy. Higher excise taxes on alcohol reduce consumption by moderate drinkers and are of less importance in reducing heavy consumption.

10.3386/w18180.abstractZh: 本文提出的行为经济模型认为，广告和价格对消费的影响因过去的消费水平而异。该模型预测，广告在较高过去消费水平下更能有效减少消费，而在较低过去消费水平下则效果较差。相反，该模型指出，较高的价格在较低过去消费水平下能减少消费，但在较高过去消费水平下效果则较差。与大多数先前使用的模型不同，该模型预测，政策对平均消费和收入分配高端的影响是不同的。文中同时使用了FMM模型和分位数模型进行估计。回归结果显示，酗酒者对广告的反应比适度饮酒者更敏感，而对价格的反应则较弱。实证证据也支持教育作为自我调节代理的假设。主要结论是，对广告的限制应针对酗酒者，这是一种未被充分利用的酒精控制政策。对酒精征收更高的消费税可以减少适度饮酒者的消费，但在减少酗酒方面的重要性较低。

abstract.text: The controversies surrounding gun control policies have recently moved to the forefront of public's attention in the United States and elsewhere. Since 2005, eighteen states in the United States have passed laws extending the right to self-defense with no duty to retreat to any place a person has a legal right to be, and several additional states are debating the adoption of similar legislation. Despite the implications that these laws may have for public safety, there has been little empirical investigation of their impact on crime and victimization. In this paper, we use monthly data from the U.S. Vital Statistics to examine how Stand Your Ground laws affect homicides and firearm injuries. We identify the impact of these laws by exploiting variation in the effective date of these laws across states over time. Our results indicate that Stand Your Ground laws are associated with a significant increase in the number of homicides among whites, especially white males. According to our estimates, between 28 and 33 additional white males are killed each month as a result of these laws. We find no consistent evidence to suggest that these laws increase homicides among blacks. Auxiliary analysis using data from the Supplemental Homicide Reports indicates that our results are not driven by the killings of assailants. We also find that the stand your ground laws are not related to non-homicide deaths, which should not respond to gun laws. Finally, we analyze data from the Health Care Utilization Project to show that these laws are also associated with a significant increase in emergency room visits and hospital discharges related to firearm inflicted injuries. Taken together, these findings raise serious doubts against the argument that Stand Your Ground laws make public safer.

10.3386/w18187.abstractZh: 围绕枪支管制政策的争议最近在美国及其他国家成为公众关注的焦点。自2005年以来，美国有18个州通过了法律，允许人们行使自卫权，而不必退回到任何法律允许其停留的地方。此外，还有几个州正在讨论是否采纳类似的立法。尽管这些法律可能对公共安全产生影响，但关于它们对犯罪和受害情况的影响，目前缺乏实证研究。在本文中，我们利用美国人口统计数据的月度数据，研究“自卫权”法律对凶杀案和枪伤的影响。我们通过分析各州这些法律生效日期的变化，来识别这些法律的影响。研究结果表明，“自卫权”法律与白人尤其是白人男性的凶杀案数量显著增加有关。根据我们的估计，由于这些法律，每月有28到33名白人男性因此丧生。我们没有发现任何一致的证据表明这些法律会增加黑人的凶杀案数量。使用补充凶杀报告的数据进行的辅助分析表明，我们的结果并非由袭击者的死亡所驱动。我们还发现，“自卫权”法律与非凶杀死亡无关，而后者不应受到枪支法律的影响。最后，我们通过健康护理利用项目的数据分析表明，这些法律还与因枪伤而前往急诊室和出院的人数显著增加有关。综合这些发现，这些结果对“自卫权”法律是否使公众更加安全的观点提出了严重质疑。

abstract.text: We study the health insurance and labor market implications of the recent Affordable Care Act (ACA) provision that allows dependents to remain on parental policies until age 26 using data from the Survey of Income and Program Participation (SIPP). Our comparison of outcomes for young adults aged 19-25 with those who are older and younger, before and after the law, shows a high take-up of parental coverage, resulting in substantial reductions in uninsurance and other forms of coverage. We also find preliminary evidence of increased labor market flexibility in the form of reduced work hours.

10.3386/w18200.abstractZh: 我们研究了《平价医疗法案》中一项新规定的对医疗保险和劳动力市场的影响。该规定允许受抚养人在26岁之前继续享受父母的医疗保险。我们通过《收入与计划参与调查》的数据，对比了19-25岁年轻人与年龄更大或更小的人在法律实施前后的情况。结果显示，父母医疗保险的覆盖率很高，从而显著减少了无保险情况和其他形式的保险需求。我们还发现了初步证据表明，法律实施后劳动力市场的灵活性有所提高，表现为工作时间的减少。

abstract.text: It has been previously shown that for sufficiently large pools of patient-donor pairs, (almost) efficient kidney exchange can be achieved by using at most 3-way cycles, i.e. by using cycles among no more than 3 patient-donor pairs. However, as kidney exchange has grown in practice, cycles among n>3 pairs have proved useful, and long chains initiated by non-directed, altruistic donors have proven to be very effective. We explore why this is the case, both empirically and theoretically. We provide an analytical model of exchange when there are many highly sensitized patients, and show that large cycles of exchange or long chains can significantly increase efficiency when the opportunities for exchange are sparse. As very large cycles of exchange cannot be used in practice, long non-simultaneous chains initiated by non-directed donors significantly increase efficiency in patient pools of the size and composition that presently exist. Most importantly, long chains benefit highly sensitized patients without harming low-sensitized patients.

10.3386/w18202.abstractZh: 先前的研究表明，对于数量足够多的患者-捐赠者配对，通过使用最多3对之间的循环，可以实现（几乎）高效的肾脏交换。然而，随着肾脏交换实践的不断发展，使用超过3对之间的循环也被证明是有用的，而由非定向、无私的捐赠者发起的长链循环也被证明非常有效。我们从实证和理论的角度探讨了这一现象的原因。我们提出了一个分析模型，用于描述在有许多高度敏感患者的交换情况，并表明，在交换机会稀缺的情况下，大规模循环或长链交换可以显著提高效率。由于实践中无法使用非常大规模的循环，因此由非定向捐赠者发起的长非同时链交换在现有规模和质量的患者配对中显著提高了效率。最重要的是，长链交换对高度敏感的患者有益，而不会对低敏感患者造成伤害。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the health impact of a central piece in the U.S. safety net for families with children: the Earned Income Tax Credit. Using tax-reform induced variation in the federal EITC, we examine the impact of the credit on infant health outcomes. We find that increased EITC income reduces the incidence of low birth weight and increases mean birth weight. For single low education (<= 12 years) mothers, a policy-induced treatment on the treated increase of $1000 in EITC income is associated with 6.7 to 10.8% reduction in the low birth weight rate, with larger impacts for births to African American mothers. These impacts are evident with difference-in-difference models and event study analyses. Our results suggest that part of the mechanism for this improvement in birth outcomes is the result of more prenatal care and less negative health behaviors (smoking). We find little role for changes in health insurance. We contribute to the literature by establishing that an exogenous increase in income can improve health, and illustrating a health impact of a non-health program. More generally, we demonstrate the potential for positive external benefits of the social safety net.

10.3386/w18206.abstractZh: 本文评估了美国儿童家庭安全网中一项核心政策——劳动收入税收抵免对健康的积极影响。通过分析税收改革导致的联邦劳动收入税收抵免的变化，我们研究了该政策对婴儿健康结果的影响。研究发现，增加劳动收入税收抵免会降低低出生体重的发生率，并提高平均出生体重。对于教育程度较低的单身母亲（≤12年），政策带来的1000美元劳动收入增加与低出生体重率降低6.7%至10.8%相关，对于非裔美国母亲来说，这种影响更为显著。这些影响通过差异模型法和事件研究分析得到了验证。我们的研究结果表明，这种出生结果改善的部分机制是由于产前护理的增加以及负面健康行为（如吸烟）的减少。我们发现健康保险的变化对改善健康状况的影响很小。我们的研究为文献提供了新证据，表明外生收入增加可以改善健康，并证明了非健康项目对健康的积极影响。更普遍地说，我们展示了社会安全网可能带来的积极外部效益。

abstract.text: This paper uses recently released data from a national longitudinal sample to present new evidence of the longer term effects of adolescent depression on labor market outcomes. Results suggest reductions in labor force attachment of approximately 5 percentage points and earnings reductions of approximately 20% for individuals with depressive symptoms as an adolescent. These effects are only partially reduced when controlling for channels operating through educational attainment, adult depressive symptoms, or co-occurring illnesses. Further, the unique structure of the data allows for high-school fixed effects as well as suggestive evidence using sibling comparisons, which allows controls for potentially important unobserved heterogeneity. Overall, the results suggest that the links between adolescent depression and labor market outcomes are quite robust and important in magnitude, suggesting that there may be substantial labor market returns to further investments in treatment opportunities during adolescence.

10.3386/w18216.abstractZh: 本文利用最近发布的全国纵向样本数据，提出了青少年抑郁对劳动力市场结果长期影响的新证据。研究结果表明，有抑郁症状的青少年，其劳动力参与度大约减少了5个百分点，收入则减少了约20%。当控制通过教育程度、成人抑郁症状或共病疾病的影响时，这些影响仅部分减弱。此外，数据的独特结构使得高中固定效应得以体现，同时通过兄弟姐妹比较得出的证据也表明，可以控制潜在的重要未观测异质性。总体而言，研究结果表明，青少年抑郁与劳动力市场结果之间的联系非常稳健且影响显著，这表明在青少年时期进一步投资治疗机会可能会带来显著的劳动力市场回报。

abstract.text: Prevention of mother-to-child transmission of HIV (PMTCT) is the single most effective HIV prevention intervention in practice today. Nonetheless, little reliable empirical evidence exists on the behavioral effects of PMTCT. This paper documents the rapid expansion of access to PMTCT in Zambia during the period 2000-2007 and provides some of the first evidence on the change in reproductive behavior associated with PMTCT scale-up. The results of a primarily descriptive analysis suggest that PMTCT may have generated increases in knowledge about PMTCT and MTCT, large reductions in child mortality and pregnancy rates, and smaller changes in breastfeeding rates. However, additional research is required to address the potential endogeneity of PMTCT availability.

10.3386/w18226.abstractZh: 预防母婴传播艾滋病（PMTCT）是当今实践中最有效的艾滋病预防干预措施。然而，关于PMTCT行为效应的可靠实证证据却很少。本文记录了2000至2007年间赞比亚获得PMTCT服务的迅速扩展情况，并提供了一些关于与PMTCT普及相关的生殖行为变化的初步证据。主要描述性分析的结果表明，PMTCT可能增加了人们对PMTCT和母婴传播的认识，大幅降低了儿童死亡率和妊娠率，同时母乳喂养率的变化较小。不过，还需要进一步的研究来探讨PMTCT普及可能带来的内生性问题。

abstract.text: Recent military engagements in Iraq (OIF) and Afghanistan (OEF) raise questions about the effects on service members of overseas deployment, which can include service in a combat or war zone, exposure to casualties, or both. The 2010 National Survey of Veterans, which asked a broad cross section of living veteran cohorts about deployment to OEF/OIF and combat exposure, provides some new insights into short and long-term relationships between characteristics of military service and outcomes. Analysis of these data suggests that the impacts of deployment and combat on the current socioeconomic well-being of returning OEF/OIF veterans may be relatively small, but the effects of combat exposure on self-reported health and other nonpecuniary indicators of their well-being appear to be negative. Among older veteran cohorts, where there is clearer sorting into treatment and control groups because of strong variation in combat exposure by year of birth, patterns are broadly similar. These results are consistent with a veterans compensation system that replaces lost earnings but does not necessarily compensate for other harms associated with combat exposure such as mental health trauma.

10.3386/w18227.abstractZh: 最近在伊拉克（OIF）和阿富汗（OEF）的军事行动引发了关于海外服役对军人影响的问题，这可能包括在战区服役、面临伤亡风险，或两者兼有。2010年进行的全国退伍军人调查，向不同群体的退伍军人询问了他们参与OEF/OIF作战的经历及其对当前社会经济状况的影响，这为研究军事服役特征与结果之间的短期和长期关系提供了一些新的见解。数据分析表明，海外服役和作战对返回OEF/OIF战区的退伍军人的当前社会经济状况的影响可能相对较小，但作战经历对军人自我报告的健康状况及其他非经济福祉指标的影响似乎是不利的。在年龄较大的退伍军人群体中，由于出生年份对作战经历的影响存在明显差异，因此可以将他们划分为实验组和对照组，其模式大致相似。这些结果与一种退伍军人补偿制度相符，该制度可以弥补因作战而损失的收入，但未必能够弥补与作战相关的其他伤害，如心理健康创伤。

abstract.text: This study exploits the October 2008 economic crisis in Iceland to identify the effects of a macroeconomic downturn on a range of health behaviors. Using longitudinal survey data that include pre- and post- reports from the same individuals, we investigate the effects of the crisis on smoking, heavy drinking, dietary behaviors, sleep, and other health behaviors and investigate changes in work hours, real income, wealth, and mental health as potential mediators. We also consider the role of prices in shaping health behaviors and compute participation elasticities for the various behaviors. We find that the crisis led to reductions in all health-compromising behaviors examined and that it led to reductions in certain health-promoting behaviors but increases in others. The individual-level mediators explained some, but not all of the effects. We infer that price increases played a large role in the effects of the crisis on health behaviors.

10.3386/w18233.abstractZh: 本研究利用2008年10月冰岛的经济危机，探讨宏观经济衰退对一系列健康行为的影响。通过包含同一人群在危机前后的调查数据，我们研究了危机对吸烟、酗酒、饮食行为、睡眠及其他健康行为的影响，并探讨了工作时间、实际收入、财富和心理健康的变化作为潜在的中介因素。我们还考虑了价格在塑造健康行为中的作用，并计算了各种行为的参与弹性。研究发现，危机导致所有对健康有害的行为减少，而某些促进健康的行为了增加。个体层面的中介因素解释了部分而非全部的影响。我们推断，价格上涨在危机对健康行为的影响中起到了重要作用。

abstract.text: I examine the impact of pharmaceutical innovation, as measured by the vintage (world launch year) of prescription drugs used, on longevity using longitudinal, country-level data on 30 developing and high-income countries during the period 2000-2009. I control for fixed country and year effects, real per capita income, the unemployment rate, mean years of schooling, the urbanization rate, real per capita health expenditure (public and private), the DPT immunization rate among children ages 12-23 months, HIV prevalence and tuberculosis incidence. The estimates indicate that life expectancy at all ages and survival rates above age 25 increased faster in countries with larger increases in drug vintage (measured in three different ways), ceteris paribus, and that the increase in life expectancy at birth due to the increase in the fraction of drugs consumed that were launched after 1990 was 1.27 years--73% of the actual increase in life expectancy at birth.

10.3386/w18235.abstractZh: 我研究了药品创新的影響，通过处方药的上市年份来衡量，这种影响对寿命的影响。研究使用了2000年至2009年间30个发展中国家和高收入国家的纵向国家级数据。我控制了固定国家和年份效应、实际人均收入、失业率、平均受教育年限、城市化率、实际人均医疗支出（公共和私人）、12-23个月儿童中的DPT免疫率、HIV感染率和结核病发病率。估计结果显示，在其他条件相同的情况下，药品上市年份增加幅度较大的国家，各个年龄段的预期寿命和25岁以上人群的存活率增长更快。由于1990年后上市的药物比例增加，出生时的预期寿命增加了1.27年，占实际出生时预期寿命增长的73%。

abstract.text: Autism is a developmental disorder characterized by impairments in social interaction, communication, and restricted or repetitive behaviors. This previously rare condition has dramatically increased in prevalence from 0.5 in 1000 children during the 1970s to 11.3 in 1000 children in 2008. Using data from the California Department of Developmental Services, we study how changes in the number of autism cases at each of the 21 regional development centers affected local wages and quantity of auxiliary health providers. We focus on this subset of health providers because, unlike physicians and psychologists who can diagnose autism, these workers cannot induce their own demand. If the incidence of autism is increasing independently of other mental disorders, then the demand for auxiliary health providers should increase, leading to higher wages and an increase in the number of these providers over time, else the increase in autism diagnosis is merely displacing other mental disorders. Using wages and provider counts from the American Community Survey, we find a 100% increase in the number of autism cases increases the wage of auxiliary health workers over non-autism health occupations by 8 to 11 percent and the number of providers by 7 to 15 percent the following year. Further, we find that four additional autism cases reduces the number of mild mental retardation cases by one, but is not found to have a statistically significant effect on the level of cerebral palsy or epilepsy.

10.3386/w18238.abstractZh: 自闭症是一种发育障碍，其特征是社交互动、沟通能力的受损，以及行为上的局限性或重复性。这种以前较为罕见的疾病，其发病率从20世纪70年代的每1000名儿童中0.5例，增加到2008年的每1000名儿童中11.3例。我们利用加利福尼亚州发展服务部门的数据，研究21个地区发展中心中自闭症病例数量的变化对当地工资和辅助医疗服务提供者数量的影响。我们重点关注这类医疗服务提供者，因为与能够诊断自闭症的医生和心理学家不同，这些工作人员无法自行吸引需求。如果自闭症发病率的增加与其他精神障碍无关，那么对辅助医疗服务提供者的需求应该会增加，从而导致工资提高以及这些提供者的数量增加；否则，自闭症诊断的增加可能只是取代了其他精神障碍。通过美国社区调查中的工资数据和服务提供者数量数据，我们发现，每增加100例自闭症病例，辅助医疗服务提供者的工资会相应增加8%至11%，而提供者的数量则会增加7%至15%。此外，我们还发现，每增加4例自闭症病例，轻度智力障碍的病例数量会减少1例，但这一因素对脑瘫或癫痫的发病率并没有统计学上的显著影响。

abstract.text: Although independent unobserved heterogeneity--variables that affect the dependent variable but are independent from the other explanatory variables of interest--do not affect the point estimates or marginal effects in least squares regression, they do affect point estimates in nonlinear models such as logit and probit models. In these nonlinear models, independent unobserved heterogeneity changes the arbitrary normalization of the coefficients through the error variance. Therefore, any statistics derived from the estimated coefficients change when additional, seemingly irrelevant, variables are added to the model. Odds ratios must be interpreted as conditional on the data and model. There is no one odds ratio; each odds ratio estimated in a multivariate model is conditional on the data and model in a way that makes comparisons with other results difficult or impossible. This paper provides new Monte Carlo and graphical insights into why this is true, and new understanding of how to interpret fixed effects models, including case control studies. Marginal effects are largely unaffected by unobserved heterogeneity in both linear regression and nonlinear models, including logit and probit and their multinomial and ordered extensions.

10.3386/w18252.abstractZh: 尽管在最小二乘回归中，独立且未观测到的异质性——即影响因变量但与其他解释变量独立的变量——并不会影响点估计或边际效应，但在非线性模型（如逻辑回归和Probit模型）中，它们确实会影响点估计。在这些非线性模型中，独立且未观测到的异质性会改变系数的任意标准化方式，从而影响误差方差。因此，当模型中加入额外的、看似无关的变量时，从估计的系数中得出的任何统计量都会发生变化。比值比必须根据数据和模型进行解释。不存在单一的比值比；在多元模型中估计的每个比值比都是基于数据和模型的条件，这使得与其他结果的比较变得困难或不可能。本文提供了关于这一现象的新蒙特卡洛和图形分析，并提出了如何解释固定效应模型的新见解，包括病例对照研究。在线性回归以及包括逻辑回归、Probit模型及其多项分类和有序扩展在内的非线性模型中，边际效应基本上不受未观测到的异质性的影响。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effects of friends' health behaviors, smoking and drinking, on own health behaviors for adolescents while controlling for the effects of correlated unobservables between those friends. Specifically, the effect of friends' health behaviors is identified by comparing similar individuals who have the same friendship opportunities because they attend the same school and make similar friendship choices, under the assumption that the friendship choice reveals information about an individual's unobservables. We combine this identification strategy with a cross-cohort, within school design so that the model is identified based on across grade differences in the clustering of health behaviors within specific friendship patterns. Finally, we use the estimated information on correlated unobservables to examine longitudinal data on the on-set of health behaviors, where the opportunity for reverse causality should be minimal. Our estimates for both behavior and on-set are very robust to bias from correlated unobservables.

10.3386/w18253.abstractZh: 本文在控制朋友之间相关不可观测变量的影响后，估计了朋友的健康行为（如吸烟和饮酒）对青少年自身健康行为的影响。具体而言，通过比较具有相同友谊机会的相似个体，这些个体因就读同一所学校且做出相似的友谊选择，从而识别出朋友健康行为的影响。我们假设友谊选择能够揭示个体不可观测变量的信息。我们结合这种识别策略与跨队列、校内设计的研究方法，使得模型能够基于特定友谊模式下健康行为的年级差异进行识别。最后，我们利用关于相关不可观测变量的估计信息，来检验健康行为起始阶段的纵向数据，此时反向因果关系的可能性应较小。我们对行为和行为起始阶段的估计结果，在受到相关不可观测变量偏差的影响时仍然非常稳健。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates one of the first implemented provisions of the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (ACA) which permits young adults up to age 26 to enroll as dependents on a parent's private health plan. The paper also considers how the interaction between prior state laws expanding dependent coverage to young adults and the ACA affected young adult coverage. Using data from the Current Population Survey for calendar years 2004-2010, we apply a difference-in-differences framework to estimate how these provisions affected coverage of eligible young adults compared to slightly older adults. Our findings indicate that controlling for state laws, early implementation of the ACA increased young adult dependent coverage by 5.3 percentage points and resulted in a 3.5 percentage point decline in their uninsured rate. The interaction between state laws and the ACA suggests that the increase in dependent coverage and decline in the uninsured rate may have been greater among young adults who were targeted by both the ACA and state laws.

10.3386/w18254.abstractZh: 本文评估了《患者保护与可负担医疗保健法案》中最早实施的条款之一，该条款允许26岁以下的年轻人作为父母的私人健康计划的受抚养人进行参保。文章还探讨了先前州法律将受抚养人保险覆盖范围扩展到年轻人这一举措与《可负担医疗保健法案》之间的相互作用，以及这种互动对年轻人保险覆盖的影响。利用2004至2010年期间的当前人口调查数据，我们采用差异-差异框架来估计这些条款对符合条件的年轻人与稍年长成年人保险覆盖情况的影响。研究发现，在控制州法律因素后，《可负担医疗保健法案》的早期实施使年轻人的受抚养人保险覆盖率增加了5.3个百分点，同时使他们的无保险率下降了3.5个百分点。州法律与《可负担医疗保健法案》之间的相互作用表明，对于同时受到《可负担医疗保健法案》和州法律影响的年轻人来说，保险覆盖率的提升和无保险率的下降幅度可能更大。

abstract.text: By exploiting a unique health insurance benefit design, we provide novel evidence on the causal association between outpatient and inpatient care. Our results indicate that greater outpatient spending was associated with more hospital admissions: a $100 increase in outpatient spending was associated with a 2.7% increase in the probability of having an inpatient event and a 4.6% increase in inpatient spending among enrollees in our sample. Moreover, we present evidence that the increase in hospital admissions associated with greater outpatient spending was for conditions in which it is plausible to argue that the physician and patient could exercise discretion.

10.3386/w18255.abstractZh: 通过利用一种独特的健康保险福利设计，我们提供了关于门诊和住院护理之间因果关系的新的证据。我们的研究结果表明，较高的门诊支出与更多的住院病例相关：在我们的样本患者中，门诊支出增加100美元，住院事件的概率会相应增加2.7%，而住院支出则会增加4.6%。此外，我们还发现，与较高门诊支出相关的住院病例增多，通常出现在那些可以认为医生和患者能够行使自主权的疾病中。

abstract.text: Willingness to pay for air quality is a function of health and the costly defensive investments that contribute to health, but there is little research assessing the empirical importance of defensive investments. The setting for this paper is a large US emissions cap and trade market - the NOx Budget Trading Program (NBP) - that has greatly reduced NOx emissions since its initiation in 2003. Using rich quasi-experimental variation, we find that the reductions in NOx emissions decreased the number of summer days with high ozone levels by about 25%. The NBP also led to reductions in expenditures on prescription pharmaceutical expenditures of about 1.9%. Additionally, the summer mortality rate declined by approximately 0.5%, indicating that there were about 2,200 fewer premature deaths per summer, mainly among individuals 75 and older. The monetized value of the reductions in pharmaceutical purchases and mortality rates are each roughly $900 million annually, suggesting that defensive investments are a significant portion of willingness to pay for air quality. Finally, we cautiously conclude that the reductions in ozone are the primary channel for these reductions in defensive investments and mortality rates, which indicates that willingness to pay for ozone reductions is larger than previously understood.

10.3386/w18267.abstractZh: 愿意为改善空气质量支付费用与健康状况以及有助于健康的昂贵防御性投资有关，但关于防御性投资的实际影响的研究却很少。本文研究的是美国的一个大型排放限额交易市场——氮氧化物预算交易计划（NBP），该计划自2003年启动以来，显著减少了氮氧化物的排放。通过丰富的准实验数据，我们发现氮氧化物排放减少使得夏季臭氧水平较高的天数减少了约25%。NBP还使处方药支出减少了约1.9%。此外，夏季死亡率下降了约0.5%，这意味着每年大约有2,200例过早死亡减少，主要发生在75岁及以上的人群中。药物购买和死亡率降低所带来的货币价值每年约为9亿美元，这表明防御性投资在人们愿意为改善空气质量支付费用中占据了重要比例。最后，我们谨慎地得出结论，臭氧水平的降低是这些防御性投资和死亡率降低的主要途径，这表明人们愿意为减少臭氧污染支付费用的意愿比之前认为的要大。

abstract.text: Using a sample of sibling pairs from the PSID-CDS, we examine the effects of sibling health status on early educational outcomes. We find that sibling developmental disability and externalizing behavior ar associated with reductions in math and language achievement Estimated spillovers for developmental disability are large and robust to both a rich set of family-level controls and a fixed effects analysis that exploits the availability of in-sample cousins. Our results suggest the importance of siblings in the determination of children's human capital as well as the potential for typically uncounted benefits to improving children's health through family multiplier effects

10.3386/w18279.abstractZh: 我们采用PSID-CDS中的兄弟姐妹样本，研究了兄弟姐妹健康状况对早期教育成果的影响。研究发现，发育性残疾和外化行为与数学和语言能力的下降有关。对于发育性残疾的影响，其溢出效应较大，且这一效应不受多种家庭层面控制变量的影响，同时，利用样本中的堂兄弟姐妹数据进行的固定效应分析也证实了这一结论。我们的研究结果表明，兄弟姐妹在决定儿童人力资本方面起着重要作用，同时，通过家庭乘数效应，兄弟姐妹还可能带来未被充分计算的改善儿童健康的潜在好处。

abstract.text: Across a wide set of non-group insurance markets, applicants are rejected based on observable, often high-risk, characteristics. This paper argues private information, held by the potential applicant pool, explains rejections. I formulate this argument by developing and testing a model in which agents may have private information about their risk. I first derive a new no-trade result that theoretically explains how private information could cause rejections. I then develop a new empirical methodology to test whether this no-trade condition can explain rejections. The methodology uses subjective probability elicitations as noisy measures of agents beliefs. I apply this approach to three non-group markets: long-term care, disability, and life insurance. Consistent with the predictions of the theory, in all three settings I find significant amounts of private information held by those who would be rejected; I find generally more private information for those who would be rejected relative to those who can purchase insurance; and I show it is enough private information to explain a complete absence of trade for those who would be rejected. The results suggest private information prevents the existence of large segments of these three major insurance markets.

10.3386/w18282.abstractZh: 在众多非团体保险市场中，申请者往往因为一些可观察到的、通常具有高风险的特征而被拒绝。本文认为，潜在申请者所持有的私人信息是导致被拒绝的原因。我通过构建并测试一个模型来阐述这一论点，该模型假设代理人拥有关于自身风险情况的私人信息。首先，我推导出一个新的无交易结果，从理论上解释了私人信息如何导致被拒绝。随后，我开发了一种新的实证方法，以检验这种无交易条件是否真的能够解释被拒绝现象。该方法采用主观概率估计作为代理人信念的噪声度量。我将这种方法应用于三个非团体市场：长期护理、残疾和人寿保险。与理论预测一致，我在这三个市场中都发现，那些将被拒绝的人持有大量的私人信息；与能够购买保险的人相比，被拒绝的人通常拥有更多的私人信息；而且，这些私人信息足以解释为什么那些将被拒绝的人完全没有进行任何交易。结果表明，私人信息阻止了这三个主要保险市场中的大量细分市场的发展。

abstract.text: The majority of private health insurance in the U.S. is administered or issued by for-profit insurers, but little is known about how for-profit status affects outcomes. We find that plausibly exogenous increases in local for-profit market share induced by conversions of Blue Cross and Blue Shield affiliates in 11 states (and 28 distinct geographic markets) had no significant impact on average premiums, uninsurance rates, or medical loss ratios. However, we do find significant increases in Medicaid enrollment and a reallocation of medical spending toward rivals of BCBS. Moreover, in markets where the converting BCBS affiliate had substantial market share, fully-insured premiums for employer plans increased significantly. The results suggest that the welfare effects of subsidies for new not-for-profit insurers, such as those in the Affordable Care Act, are likely to depend on entrants' eventual market share.

10.3386/w18286.abstractZh: 在美国，大多数私人健康保险由营利性保险公司管理或发行，但关于营利性地位如何影响结果，我们知之甚少。我们发现，11个州（以及28个不同的地理市场）中，蓝十字和蓝盾附属机构转为营利性机构后，当地营利性市场份额的显著增加，并未对平均保费、未投保率或医疗损失比率产生显著影响。然而，我们确实发现，医疗补助的参保人数显著增加，且医疗支出向蓝十字蓝盾的竞争对手转移。此外，在那些转为营利性机构的蓝十字蓝盾拥有较大市场份额的市场中，雇主计划的完全保险保费显著上升。这些结果表明，针对新非营利性保险公司的补贴所带来的福利效应，可能取决于这些新进入者最终的市场份额。

abstract.text: There is great interest in evaluating the impact of private equity investments on innovation and economic growth. However, there is no direct empirical evidence on the effects of such transactions on the innovation strategies of entrepreneurial firms. We fill this gap by examining a rich project-level data set consisting of entrepreneurial firms receiving Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) program research awards. We find that SBIR firms attracting private equity investments are significantly more likely to license and sell their technology rights and engage in collaborative research and development agreements. Our results suggest that private equity investments accelerate the development and commercialization of research-based technologies, thus contributing to economic growth. We conclude that both public investments and private investments are key to innovation performance.

10.3386/w18297.abstractZh: 目前，对于私募股权投资对创新和经济增长的影响评估存在很大的兴趣。然而，关于此类交易对创业企业创新策略影响的直接实证证据却十分缺乏。我们通过分析一个包含创业企业接受小型企业创新研究计划研究资助的丰富项目级数据集来填补这一空白。研究发现，获得私募股权投资的SBIR企业更有可能许可和销售其技术权利，并参与合作研发协议。我们的结果表明，私募股权投资能够加速基于研究的技术的开发和商业化，从而促进经济增长。我们得出结论，公共投资和私人投资都对创新绩效至关重要。

abstract.text: In an attempt to alleviate the shortfall in organs and bone marrow available for transplants, many U.S. states passed legislation providing leave to organ and bone marrow donors and/or tax benefits for live and deceased organ and bone marrow donations and to employers of donors. We exploit cross-state variation in the timing and passage of such legislation to analyze its impact on organ donations by living and deceased persons, on measures of the quality of the organs transplanted, and on the number of bone marrow donations. We find that these provisions did not have a significant impact on the quantity of organs donated. The leave legislation, however, did have a positive impact on bone marrow donations. We also find some evidence of a positive impact on the quality of organ transplants, measured by post-transplant survival rates. Our results suggest that these types of legislation work for moderately invasive procedures such as bone marrow donation, but may be too low for organ donation, which is riskier and more burdensome to the donor.

10.3386/w18299.abstractZh: 为了缓解可用于移植的器官和骨髓的短缺问题，许多美国州通过了相关立法，为器官和骨髓捐赠者提供豁免，并为活体和已故器官及骨髓捐赠者提供税收优惠，同时给予捐赠者的雇主相应的优惠政策。我们利用各州在立法时机和通过时间上的差异，来分析这些立法对活体和已故人士器官捐赠的影响、移植器官的质量以及骨髓捐赠数量的影响。研究发现，这些规定对器官捐赠数量并没有显著影响。不过，豁免条款对骨髓捐赠确实产生了积极影响。我们还发现了一些证据表明，这些立法对器官移植的质量也有积极影响，主要体现在移植后的存活率上。我们的结果表明，这类立法对于像骨髓捐赠这样相对较为温和的手术是有效的，但对于器官捐赠来说可能效果有限，因为器官捐赠风险更高，对捐赠者来说也更为负担。

abstract.text: This paper uses a policy discontinuity to identify the immediate and long-term effects of public health insurance coverage during childhood. Our identification strategy exploits a unique feature of several early Medicaid expansions that extended eligibility only to children born after September 30, 1983. This feature resulted in a large discontinuity in the lifetime years of Medicaid eligibility of children at this birthdate cutoff. Those with family incomes at or just below the poverty line had close to five more years of eligibility if they were born just after the cutoff than if they were born just before. We use this discontinuity in eligibility to measure the impact of public health insurance on mortality by following cohorts of children born on either side of this cutoff from childhood through early adulthood. We examine changes in rates of mortality by the underlying causes of death, distinguishing between deaths due to internal and external causes. We also examine outcomes separately for black and white children. Our analysis shows that black children were more likely to be affected by the Medicaid expansions and gained twice the amount of eligibility as white children. We find a substantial effect of public eligibility during childhood on the later life mortality of black children at ages 15-18. The estimates indicate a 13-20 percent decrease in the internal mortality rate of black teens born after September 30, 1983. We find no evidence of an improvement in the mortality of white children under the expansions.

10.3386/w18309.abstractZh: 本文利用政策不连续性来识别儿童时期公共健康保险覆盖的即时和长期影响。我们的识别策略利用了几次早期医疗补助扩展的一个独特特征，这些扩展仅适用于1983年9月30日之后出生的儿童。这一特征导致在这一出生截止日期之后的儿童在终身享受医疗补助的年限上出现了显著的不连续性。那些家庭收入处于或略低于贫困线的儿童，如果在截止日期之后出生，他们将比在截止日期之前出生多享受近五年的医疗补助资格。我们利用这一资格不连续性来衡量公共健康保险对死亡率的影响，通过跟踪在这一截止日期前后出生的儿童从童年到成年早期的过程。我们研究了因内部和外部原因导致的死亡率的变化，并分别考察了黑人和白人儿童的结果。我们的分析表明，黑人儿童更有可能受到医疗补助扩展的影响，并且获得的医疗补助资格是白人儿童的两倍。我们发现，儿童时期获得公共健康保险对15-18岁黑人儿童的后期死亡率有显著的影响。估计结果显示，1983年9月30日之后出生的黑人青少年内部死亡率下降了13-20%。我们没有发现白人儿童在扩展期间死亡率有所改善的证据。

abstract.text: Taller workers are paid higher wages. A prominent explanation for this pattern is that physical growth and cognitive development share childhood inputs, inducing a correlation between adult height and two productive skills: strength and intelligence. This paper explores the relative roles of strength and intelligence in explaining the labor market height premium in Mexico. While cognitive test scores account for a limited share of the height premium, roughly half of the premium can be attributed to the educational and occupational choices of taller workers. Taller workers obtain more education and sort into occupations with greater intelligence requirements and lower strength requirements, suggesting that the height premium partly reflects a return to cognitive skill.

10.3386/w18318.abstractZh: 高个子工人获得的工资更高。这一现象的一个主要解释是，身体成长和认知发展在童年时期有共同的投入，导致成年身高与两种生产技能——力量和智力——之间存在相关性。本文探讨了力量和智力在解释墨西哥劳动力市场中身高溢价方面的相对作用。虽然认知测试分数对身高溢价的贡献有限，但大约一半的溢价可以归因于高个子工人的教育和职业选择。高个子工人接受更多的教育，并选择需要更高智力但力量要求较低的职业，这表明身高溢价部分反映了对认知技能的回报。

abstract.text: There is a general consensus among policymakers that raising tobacco taxes reduces cigarette consumption. However, evidence that tobacco taxes reduce adult smoking is relatively sparse. In this paper, we extend the literature in two ways: using data from the Current Population Survey Tobacco Use Supplements we focus on recent, large tax changes, which provide the best opportunity to empirically observe a response in cigarette consumption, and employ a novel paired difference-in-differences technique to estimate the association between tax increases and cigarette consumption. Estimates indicate that, for adults, the association between cigarette taxes and either smoking participation or smoking intensity is negative, small and not usually statistically significant. Our evidence suggests that increases in cigarette taxes are associated with small decreases in cigarette consumption and that it will take sizable tax increases, on the order of 100%, to decrease adult smoking by as much as 5%.

10.3386/w18326.abstractZh: 政策制定者普遍认为，提高烟草税可以减少香烟消费。然而，关于烟草税能否减少成人吸烟行为的证据相对较少。在本文中，我们从两个方面扩展了相关研究：一方面利用《当前人口调查》中关于烟草使用的补充数据，重点关注近期的大规模税收调整，因为这些调整提供了观察香烟消费变化的最佳机会；另一方面采用一种新的配对差异-差异技术来估计税收增加与香烟消费之间的关联。研究结果表明，对于成年人而言，香烟税与吸烟参与率或吸烟强度之间的关联是负面的、较小的，并且通常不具有统计学意义。我们的研究结果表明，提高香烟税会导致香烟消费略有下降，而要实现成人吸烟量减少5%以上，则需要高达100%的税收增加。

abstract.text: Childhood exposure to even low levels of lead can adversely affect neurodevelopment, behavior, and cognitive performance. This paper investigates the link between lead exposure and student achievement in Massachusetts. Panel data analysis is conducted at the school-cohort level for children born between 1991 and 2000 and attending 3rd and 4th grades between 2000 and 2009 at more than 1,000 public elementary schools in the state. Massachusetts is well-suited for this analysis both because it has been a leader in the reduction of childhood lead levels and also because it has mandated standardized achievement tests in public elementary schools for almost two decades. The paper finds that elevated levels of blood lead in early childhood adversely impact standardized test performance, even when controlling for community and school characteristics. The results imply that public health policy that reduced childhood lead levels in the 1990s was responsible for modest but statistically significant improvements in test performance in the 2000s, lowering the share of children scoring unsatisfactory on standardized tests by 1 to 2 percentage points. Public health policy targeting lead thus has clear potential to improve academic performance, with particular promise for children in low income communities.

10.3386/w18327.abstractZh: 儿童时期即使暴露于较低水平的铅也会对神经发育、行为和认知表现产生不利影响。本文研究了铅暴露与马萨诸塞州学生学业成绩之间的关系。采用面板数据分析方法，对1991年至2000年间出生的儿童进行了研究，这些儿童在2000年至2009年间就读于该州1000多所公立小学的三年级和四年级。马萨诸塞州非常适合进行这项分析，因为它在降低儿童铅暴露水平方面处于领先地位，并且该州在公立小学中实施了标准化学业测试近二十年。研究结果表明，即使控制了社区和学校特征，儿童早期血液中的铅含量较高仍会对标准化测试成绩产生负面影响。研究结果表明，1990年代实施的降低儿童铅暴露水平的公共卫生政策在2000年代对测试成绩产生了适度但具有统计学意义的改善，使在标准化测试中成绩不理想的儿童比例降低了1到2个百分点。因此，针对铅污染的公共卫生政策显然具有改善学业表现的潜力，尤其是对来自低收入社区的儿童来说。

abstract.text: Next year marks the 40th anniversary of the U.S. Supreme Court decision in Roe v. Wade. We use unique data on abortions performed in New York State from 1971-1975 to analyze the impact of legalized abortion in New York on abortion and birth rates of non-residents. We estimate that abortion rates declined by 12.0 percent for every hundred miles a woman lived from New York in the years before Roe. If Roe were overturned average travel distance to the nearest abortion provider would increase by 157 miles in the 31 states expected to prohibit abortion. Under this scenario abortion rates would fall by 14.9 percent nationally, resulting in at most, 178,800 additional births or 4.2 percent of the U.S. total in 2008. A ban in 17 states would result in a 6.0 percent decline in abortions and at most, 1.7 percent rise in births.

10.3386/w18338.abstractZh: 明年将是美国最高法院在罗诉韦德案中作出裁决的40周年。我们利用1971至1975年间纽约州堕胎数据的独特资料，分析纽约州堕胎合法化对非居民堕胎率和出生率的影响。研究估计，在罗诉韦德案之前的几年里，女性从纽约出发，每距离纽约100英里，堕胎率就会下降12.0%。如果罗诉韦德案被推翻，预计在31个禁止堕胎的州，前往最近的堕胎机构的平均旅行距离将增加157英里。在这种情况下，全国堕胎率将下降14.9%，导致2008年新增出生人数最多为178,800人，占美国总出生人数的4.2%。而在17个州实施禁令的话，堕胎率将下降6.0%，出生率最多仅上升1.7%。

abstract.text: In response to the dramatic rise in childhood obesity, the Centers for Disease Control (CDC) and other organizations have advocated increasing the time that elementary school children spend in physical education (PE) classes. However, little is known about the effect of PE on child weight. This paper measures that effect by instrumenting for child PE time with state policies, using data from the Early Childhood Longitudinal Study, Kindergarten Cohort (ECLS-K) for 1998-2004. Results from IV models indicate that PE lowers BMI z-score and reduces the probability of obesity among 5th graders (in particular, boys), while the instrument is insufficiently powerful to reliably estimate effects for younger children. This represents some of the first evidence of a causal effect of PE on youth obesity, and thus offers at least some support to the assumptions behind the CDC recommendations. We find no evidence that increased PE time crowds out time in academic courses or has spillovers to achievement test scores.

10.3386/w18341.abstractZh: 针对儿童肥胖问题的急剧上升，疾病控制与预防中心（CDC）及其他机构建议增加小学生参加体育课程的时间。然而，关于体育对儿童体重的影响，目前了解甚少。本文通过利用1998-2004年幼儿纵向研究的数据，利用州政策来量化体育时间对儿童体重的影响。实证模型的结果表明，体育活动可以降低5年级学生的BMI评分，并减少肥胖的风险（尤其是男孩）。不过，这种量化方法在评估年幼儿童的影响方面还不够有力。这代表了关于体育对青少年肥胖具有因果效应的首批证据，因此至少为CDC的建议提供了部分支持。我们没有发现增加体育时间会挤占学术课程的时间，或者会对学业成绩产生负面影响。

abstract.text: Much of what we know about the marginal effect of pollution on infant mortality is derived from developed country data. However, given the lower levels of air pollution in developed countries, these estimates may not be externally valid to the developing country context if there is a nonlinear dose relationship between pollution and mortality or if the costs of avoidance behavior differs considerably between the two contexts. In this paper, we estimate the relationship between pollution and infant mortality using data from Mexico. We find that an increase of 1 parts per billion in carbon monoxide (CO) over the last week results in 0.0032 deaths per 100,000 births, while a 1 μg/m3 increase in particulate matter (PM10) results in 0.24 infant deaths per 100,000 births. Our estimates for PM10 tend to be similar (or even smaller) than the U.S. estimates, while our findings on CO tend to be larger than those derived from the U.S. context. We provide suggestive evidence that a non-linearity in the relationship between CO and health explains this difference.

10.3386/w18349.abstractZh: 我们对污染对婴儿死亡率边际效应的了解大多来自发达国家的数据。然而，由于发达国家的空气污染水平较低，如果这些污染与死亡率之间存在非线性剂量关系，或者避免污染行为的成本在这两个环境中存在显著差异，那么这些估计结果可能不适用于发展中国家的实际情况。在本文中，我们使用墨西哥的数据来估计污染与婴儿死亡率之间的关系。我们发现，过去一周一氧化碳浓度每增加10亿分之一，会导致每10万例出生中有0.0032例死亡；而颗粒物浓度每增加1微克/立方米，会导致每10万例出生中有0.24例死亡。我们对颗粒物浓度的估计结果与美国的结果相似（甚至更低），而我们对一氧化碳浓度的估计结果则比美国的数据更为显著。我们有理由认为，一氧化碳与健康之间的关系存在非线性，这一因素可以解释这种差异。

abstract.text: I use the Medicare Part D prescription drug insurance market to examine the dynamics of firm interaction with consumers on an insurance exchange. Enrollment data show that consumers face switching frictions leading to inertia in plan choice, and a regression discontinuity design indicates initial defaults have persistent effects. In the absence of commitment to future prices, theory predicts firms respond to inertia by raising prices on existing enrollees, while introducing cheaper alternative plans. The complete set of enrollment and price data from 2006 through 2010 confirms this prediction: older plans have approximately 10% higher premiums than comparable new plans.

10.3386/w18359.abstractZh: 我利用Medicare Part D处方药保险市场来研究公司与消费者在保险交易所互动的动态。注册数据显示，消费者面临转换障碍，导致计划选择上的惯性现象；回归 discontinuity 设计表明，初始的默认行为具有持久影响。在缺乏对未来价格的承诺的情况下，理论预测公司会针对惯性现象，对现有注册用户提高价格，同时推出更便宜的替代计划。2006年至2010年的完整注册和价格数据证实了这一预测：较旧的计划保费比类似的新计划高出约10%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of exposure to higher unemployment rates in the pre-retirement years on subsequent mortality. Although past research has found that recessions reduce contemporaneous mortality, these short-term effects may reverse over time, particularly for older workers. If workers experience an economic downturn in their late 50s, they may face several years of reduced employment and earnings before "retiring" when they reach Social Security eligibility at age 62. They also may experience lost health insurance, and therefore higher financial barriers to health care, through age 65, when Medicare becomes available. All of these experiences could contribute to weaker long-term health outcomes. To examine these hypotheses, we use Vital Statistics mortality data between 1969 and 2008 to generate age-specific cohort survival probabilities at older ages. We then link these survival probabilities to labor market conditions at earlier ages. We also use data from the 1980-2010 March Current Population Surveys and the 1991-2010 Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System surveys to explore potential mechanisms for this health effect. Our results indicate that experiencing a recession in one's late 50s leads to a reduction in longevity. We also find that this exposure leads to several years of reduced employment, health insurance coverage, and health care utilization which may contribute to the lower long-term likelihood of survival.

10.3386/w18361.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在退休前的几年中，较高的失业率对后续死亡率的影响。尽管过去的研究发现经济衰退会降低当时的死亡率，但这些短期效应可能会随时间逆转，尤其是对于年长的工人而言。如果工人在50多岁末期经历经济衰退，他们可能会在达到62岁、符合社会保障资格时面临数年的就业减少和收入下降。此外，他们还可能失去健康保险，因此在65岁获得医疗保险之前，医疗保健方面的经济障碍会更高。所有这些经历都可能导致长期健康结果的恶化。为了验证这些假设，我们使用了1969年至2008年的生命统计死亡数据，以计算不同年龄段的群体生存概率。然后，我们将这些生存概率与早期的年龄劳动力市场状况联系起来。我们还使用了1980-2010年的3月当前人口调查数据和1991-2010年的行为风险因素监测系统调查数据，以探讨这种健康效应的潜在机制。我们的研究结果表明，在50多岁末期经历经济衰退会导致寿命缩短。我们还发现，这种经历会导致数年的就业减少、健康保险覆盖率的降低以及医疗保健利用的减少，这些因素可能共同导致长期生存概率的降低。

abstract.text: A growing literature documents the links between long-term outcomes and health in the fetal period, infancy, and early childhood. Much of this literature focuses on rich countries, but researchers are increasingly taking advantage of new sources of data and identification to study the long reach of childhood health in developing countries. Health in early life may be a more significant determinant of adult outcomes in these countries because health insults are more frequent, the capacity to remediate is more limited, and multiple shocks may interact. However, the underlying relationships may also be more difficult to measure, given significant mortality selection. We survey recent evidence on the adult correlates of early-life health and the long-term effects of shocks due to disease, famine, malnutrition, pollution, and war.

10.3386/w18371.abstractZh: 越来越多的研究文献揭示了胎儿期、婴儿期和幼儿期健康状况与长期结果之间的联系。这些研究大多集中在富裕国家，但研究人员越来越多地利用新的数据来源和识别方法，来研究发展中国家儿童健康的深远影响。在这些国家，早期健康可能是决定成人结果的更重要因素，因为健康问题的发生更为频繁，恢复能力更为有限，而且多种冲击可能会相互作用。然而，由于显著的死亡选择效应，这些关系可能更难以测量。我们综述了关于早期健康与成人相关因素的最新研究，以及疾病、饥荒、营养不良、污染和战争等冲击对长期影响的探讨。

abstract.text: This paper compares the relative impact of two road safety interventions in the Kenyan minibus or matatu sector: a top down set of regulatory requirements known as the Michuki Rules and a consumer empowerment intervention. We use very detailed insurance claims data on three classes of vehicles to implement a difference-in-differences estimation strategy to measure the impact of the Michuki Rules. Despite strong political leadership and dedicated resources, we find no statistically significant effect of the Michuki Rules on accident rates. In contrast, the consumer empowerment intervention that didn't rely on third party enforcement has very large and significant effects on accident rates. Our intent-to-treat estimates suggest reductions in accident rates of at least 50%. Our analysis suggests that in institutionally weak environments, innovative consumer-driven solutions might provide an alternative solution to low quality service provision.

10.3386/w18378.abstractZh: 本文比较了肯尼亚小型客车行业中的两种交通安全干预措施的相对影响：一种是由上层制定的监管要求，即“Michuki规则”，另一种则是通过消费者赋权实现的干预措施。我们使用了关于三类车辆的详细保险索赔数据，采用差异-差异估计策略来衡量“Michuki规则”的影响。尽管有强有力的政治领导和充足的资源投入，我们发现“Michuki规则”对事故率并没有产生显著的统计影响。相比之下，不依赖第三方执行的消费者赋权干预措施对事故率产生了巨大且显著的影响。我们的治疗组估计结果显示，事故率至少减少了50%。我们的分析表明，在制度薄弱的环境中，创新的消费者驱动解决方案可能为低质量的服务提供替代方案。

abstract.text: Many literatures investigate the causal impact of income on economic outcomes, for example in the context of intergenerational transmission or well-being and health. Some studies have proposed to use employer wage differentials and in particular industry affiliation as an instrument for income. We demonstrate that industry affiliation is correlated with fixed individual characteristics, specifically parents' education and own height, conditional on the covariates typically controlled for in these studies. These results suggest that there is selection into industries based on unobservables. As a result the exclusion restriction in many IV studies of this type is likely violated.

10.3386/w18384.abstractZh: 许多文献研究了收入对经济结果的因果影响，例如在代际传递或福祉与健康的背景下。一些研究提出使用雇主工资差异，特别是行业归属作为收入的衡量指标。我们的研究表明，在通常控制这些研究中的协变量条件下，行业归属与固定的个人特征相关，特别是父母的教育程度和个人的身高。这些结果表明，行业选择可能是基于不可观测因素进行的。因此，这类工具变量研究中可能存在的排除限制可能会被违反。

abstract.text: A growing body of literature examines the cross price elasticities between different health care services. For example, increasing the patient out of pocket price for some health care services increases the utilization of other health care services. Yet, the literature has generally ignored the connection between cost sharing for health care services and labor market outcomes. This paper examines the direction and magnitude of the reduced form relationship between patient cost-sharing and work loss following methods used to study the impact of cost-sharing and medical spending, finding a positive, quantitatively meaningful association between cost-sharing and hours absent. We find no such association between cost-sharing and the probability of incurring short-term disability days. This suggests that the cross-market ramifications of higher patient cost sharing extend beyond other health care services to include broad labor market outcomes.

10.3386/w18402.abstractZh: 越来越多的文献研究不同医疗服务之间的交叉价格弹性。例如，增加某些医疗服务的患者自付费用会提高其他医疗服务的利用率。然而，这些文献通常忽略了医疗服务成本分担与劳动力市场结果之间的联系。本文通过研究成本分担和医疗支出对劳动力市场影响的方法，探讨了患者成本分担与工作损失之间的反向关系及其程度，发现成本分担与缺勤小时数之间存在积极且具有统计学意义的关系。然而，我们并未发现成本分担与短期残疾天数概率之间存在这种关联。这表明，较高的患者成本分担对其他医疗服务的影响不仅限于医疗服务领域，还涉及更广泛的劳动力市场结果。

abstract.text: We project the effects of declining smoking and increasing obesity on mortality in the United States over the period 2010-2040. Data on cohort behavioral histories are integrated into these projections. Future distributions of body mass indices are projected using transition matrices applied to the initial distribution in 2010. In addition to projections of current obesity, we project distributions of obesity when cohorts were age 25. To these distributions we apply death rates by current and age-25 obesity status observed in the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey, 1988-2006. Projections of the effects of smoking are based on observed relations between cohort smoking patterns and cohort death rates from lung cancer. We find that both changes in smoking and in obesity are expected to have large effects on mortality. For males, the reductions in smoking have larger effects than the rise in obesity throughout the projection period. By 2040, male life expectancy at age 40 is expected to have gained 0.92 years from the combined effects.
