abstract.text: According to standard theory, the set of implementable outcome functions is reduced if the mechanism or contract can be renegotiated ex post.In some cases contracts can achieve nothing and so, for example, the holdup problem may be severe.This paper shows that if the mechanism is designed in such a way that sending a message involves a small cost (e.g., the opportunity cost of time spent attending a hearing) then ex post renegotiation essentially does not restrict the set of implementable functions.Any Pareto-efficient, bounded social choice function can be implemented in subgame-perfect equilibrium, for any strictly positive message cost.

10.3982/ecta8772.abstractZh: 根据标准理论，如果机制或合同可以事后重新协商，那么可实施的结果函数集合就会减少。在某些情况下，合同可能毫无成效，因此，例如，信息延迟问题可能会非常严重。本文表明，如果机制的设计使得发送消息的成本很低（例如，参加听证会的时间机会成本），那么事后重新协商实际上并不会限制可实施的函数集合。任何帕累托有效、有界的社会选择函数都可以在子博弈完美均衡中被实施，前提是消息成本严格为正。

abstract.text: We show by example that empirical likelihood and other commonly used tests for moment restrictions are unable to control the (exponential) rate at which the probability of a Type I error tends to zero unless the possible distributions for the observed data are restricted appropriately. From this, it follows that for the optimality claim for empirical likelihood in Kitamura (2001) to hold, additional assumptions and qualifications are required. Under stronger assumptions than those in Kitamura (2001), we establish the following optimality result: (i) empirical likelihood controls the rate at which the probability of a Type I error tends to zero and (ii) among all procedures for which the probability of a Type I error tends to zero at least as fast, empirical likelihood maximizes the rate at which the probability of a Type II error tends to zero for most alternatives. This result further implies that empirical likelihood maximizes the rate at which the probability of a Type II error tends to zero for all alternatives among a class of tests that satisfy a weaker criterion for their Type I error probabilities.

10.3982/ecta8773.abstractZh: 我们通过实例表明，经验似然法以及其他常用的矩限制检验方法无法控制第一类错误概率趋于零的速率（以指数形式表示），除非对观测数据的可能分布进行适当限制。由此可推断，为了使Kitamura在2001年提出的经验似然法最优性假设成立，需要额外的假设和限定条件。在比Kitamura提出的假设更为严格的条件下，我们得出了以下最优性结论：(i) 经验似然法能够控制第一类错误概率趋于零的速率；(ii) 在所有第一类错误概率趋于零的检验方法中，经验似然法能够最大化第二类错误概率趋于零的速率，适用于大多数情况。这一结果进一步表明，对于满足较弱第一类错误概率标准的检验类，经验似然法能够最大化第二类错误概率趋于零的速率。

abstract.text: In this paper, we derive and experimentally test a theoretical model of speculation in multi-period asset markets with public information flows. The speculation arises from the traders' heterogeneous posteriors as they make different inferences from sequences of public information. This leads to overpricing in the sense that price exceeds the most optimistic belief about the real value of the asset. We find evidence of speculative overpricing in both incomplete and complete markets, where the information flow is a gradually revealed sequence of imperfect public signals about the state of the world. We also find evidence of asymmetric price reaction to good news and bad news, another feature of equilibrium price dynamics under our model. Markets with a relaxed short-sale constraint exhibit less overpricing.

10.3982/ecta8781.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们推导并实验性地测试了一个关于具有公共信息流的多期资产市场中的投机行为的理论模型。投机行为源于交易者的不同后验假设，他们根据公共信息序列做出不同的推断。这导致了过度定价现象，即价格超过了投资者对资产真实价值的最乐观估计。我们在不完全市场和完全市场中都发现了投机性过度定价的证据，其中信息流是一系列逐渐揭示的、关于世界状态的不完全公共信号。我们还发现，价格对好消息和坏消息的反应是不对称的，这是我们模型下均衡价格动态的另一个特征。在放松了卖空限制的市场中，过度定价现象较少出现。

abstract.text: We study the existence of dynamic equilibria with endogenously complete markets in continuous-time, heterogenous agents economies driven by diffusion processes. Our main results show that under appropriate conditions on the transition density of the state variables, market completeness can be deduced from the primitives of the economy. In particular, we prove that a sufficient condition for market completeness is that the volatility of dividends be invertible and provide higher order conditions that apply when this condition fails as is the case in the presence of fixed income securities. In contrast to previous research, our formulation does not require that securities pay terminal dividends, and thus allows for both finite and infinite horizon economies.

10.3982/ecta8783.abstractZh: 我们研究了在连续时间、异质代理人经济中，由扩散过程驱动且市场内生完备的动态均衡的存在性。我们的主要结果表明，在状态变量转换密度的适当条件下，市场完备性可以从经济的基本要素中推导出来。特别地，我们证明了市场完备性的一个充分条件是红利的波动性必须是可逆的，并且提供了当这一条件不成立时的高阶条件，比如在固定收益证券存在的情况下。与以往的研究不同，我们的模型不需要证券支付期末红利，因此适用于有限期限和无限期限的经济体系。

abstract.text: This paper studies a dynamic model of perfectly competitive price posting under demand uncertainty. Firms must produce output in advance. After observing aggregate sales in prior periods, firms post prices for their unsold output. In each period, the demand of a new batch of consumers is randomly activated. Existing customers who have not yet bought and then new customers arrive at the market in random order, observe the posted prices, and either purchase at the lowest available price or delay their purchase decision. We construct a sequential equilibrium in which the output produced and its allocation across consumers is efficient. Thus consumers endogenously sort themselves efficiently, with the highest valuations purchasing first. Transaction prices in each period rise continuously, as firms become more optimistic about demand, followed by a market correction. By the last period, prices are market clearing.

10.3982/ecta8806.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个在需求不确定性下的完全竞争价格发布的动态模型。企业必须提前生产产品。在观察了前期的总销售量后，企业会为其未售出的产品定价。在每个时期，一批新的消费者的需求会随机出现。尚未购买的现有客户以及新客户会以随机顺序进入市场，他们会观察已标价的产品，并在最低价格时购买或推迟购买决策。我们构建了一个序贯均衡模型，在该模型中，生产的产量及其在消费者之间的分配是高效的。因此，消费者会自我高效地排序，估值最高的消费者会首先购买。每个时期的交易价格会持续上升，因为企业对需求变得更加乐观，随后市场会出现调整。到了最后一个时期，价格将达到市场清算水平。

abstract.text: We present a model for the equilibrium movement of capital between asset markets that are distinguished only by the levels of capital invested in each. Investment in that market with the greatest amount of capital earns the lowest risk premium. Intermediaries optimally trade off the costs of intermediation against fees that depend on the gain they can offer to investors for moving their capital to the market with the higher mean return. The bargaining power of an investor depends on potential access to alternative intermediaries. In equilibrium, the speeds of adjustment of mean returns and of capital between the two markets are increasing in the degree to which capital is imbalanced between the two markets, and can be reduced by competition among intermediaries.

10.3982/ecta8822.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个模型，用于描述资本在资产市场之间的均衡流动。这些市场之间的区别在于各自投入的资本水平。在资本投入最多的市场中，投资获得的风险溢价最低。中介机构会优化地权衡中介成本与费用之间的关系，这些费用取决于它们能够向投资者提供的收益，以促使投资者将资本转移到平均回报较高的市场。投资者的议价能力取决于其能否获得其他中介机构的服务。在均衡状态下，平均回报的变化速度以及资本在这两个市场之间的流动速度，会随着资本在这两个市场之间不平衡程度的增加而加快，而通过中介机构之间的竞争，这种不平衡程度可以得到缓解。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a dynamic politico-economic theory of fiscal policy in a world comprising a set of small open economies, whose driving force is the intergenerational conflict over debt, taxes, and public goods. Subsequent generations of voters choose fiscal policy through repeated elections. The presence of young voters induces fiscal discipline, that is, low taxes and low debt accumulation. The paper characterizes the Markov-perfect equilibrium of the voting game in each economy, as well as the stationary equilibrium debt distribution and interest rate of the world economy. The equilibrium can reproduce some salient features of fiscal policy in modern economies.

10.3982/ecta8910.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个动态的政治经济理论，用于解释由一系列小型开放经济体组成的世界中的财政政策。这一理论的驱动力源于代际之间关于债务、税收和公共物品的冲突。后续的选民通过反复的选举来选择财政政策。年轻选民的存在促进了财政纪律，即低税收和低债务积累。本文描述了每个经济体中的投票游戏的马尔可夫完美均衡，以及整个经济体的静态均衡债务分配和利率。该均衡能够再现现代经济中财政政策的某些显著特征。

abstract.text: Empirical evidence suggests that perfectionism can affect choice behavior. When striving for perfection, a person can desire to keep normatively appealing options feasible even if she persistently fails to use these options later. For instance, she can “pay not to go to the gym,” as in DellaVigna and Malmendier (2006). By contrast, some perfectionists may avoid normatively important tasks for fear of negative self-evaluation of their performance. This paper models perfectionist behaviors in Gul and Pesendorfer's (2001) menu framework where agents may be tempted to deviate from their long-term normative objectives. In addition to self-control costs, I identify a utility component that reflects emotional costs and benefits of perfectionism. My model is derived from axioms imposed on preferences over menus in an essentially unique way.

10.3982/ecta8941.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，完美主义会影响选择行为。在追求完美的过程中，一个人可能会希望保持那些符合规范要求的选项，即使这些选项后来一直未能被使用。例如，一个人可能会“选择不去健身房锻炼”，正如DellaVigna和Malmendier在2006年所提出的案例。相比之下，一些完美主义者可能会因为害怕对自己的表现进行负面评价而避免那些具有规范意义的任务。本文在Gul和Pesendorfer的菜单框架中模拟了完美主义行为，其中个体可能会偏离其长期的规范目标。除了自我控制成本之外，我还引入了一个效用成分，以反映完美主义的情感成本和收益。我的模型是基于对菜单偏好的一系列公理，这些公理以独特的方式被提出。

abstract.text: We consider tests of a simple null hypothesis on a subset of the coefficients of the exogenous and endogenous regressors in a single-equation linear instrumental variables regression model with potentially weak identification. Existing methods of subset inference (i) rely on the assumption that the parameters not under test are strongly identified, or (ii) are based on projection-type arguments. We show that, under homoskedasticity, the subset Anderson and Rubin (1949) test that replaces unknown parameters by limited information maximum likelihood estimates has correct asymptotic size without imposing additional identification assumptions, but that the corresponding subset Lagrange multiplier test is size distorted asymptotically.

10.3982/ecta8953.abstractZh: 我们考虑在一个包含外生和内生回归系数子集的简单零假设检验上，该模型为单方程线性工具变量回归模型，可能存在弱识别问题。现有的子集推断方法要么依赖于未检验参数被强识别的假设，要么基于投影型论证。我们证明，在同方差条件下，用有限信息最大似然估计替代未知参数的Anderson和Rubin（1949）子集检验在渐近意义上具有正确的大小，而不需要额外的识别假设，但相应的拉格朗日乘数子集检验在渐近意义上大小失真。

abstract.text: While vote-buying is common, little is known about how politicians determine who to target. We argue that vote-buying can be sustained by an internalized norm of reciprocity. Receiving money engenders feelings of obligation. Combining survey data on vote-buying with an experiment-based measure of reciprocity, we show that politicians target reciprocal individuals. Overall, our findings highlight the importance of social preferences in determining political behavior.

10.3982/ecta9035.abstractZh: 虽然收买选票的行为很常见，但关于政治家如何决定针对谁却知之甚少。我们认为，收买选票的行为可以通过一种内化的互惠规范来维持。接受金钱会让人产生义务感。通过结合关于收买选票行为的调查数据和基于实验的互惠度量方法，我们发现政治家会针对具有互惠意愿的个体。总体而言，我们的研究结果强调了社会偏好在决定政治行为中的重要性。

abstract.text: It is generally presumed that stronger legal enforcement of lender rights increases credit access for all borrowers because it expands the set of incentive compatible loan contracts. This result relies on an assumption that the supply of credit is infinitely elastic. In contrast, with inelastic supply, stronger enforcement generates general equilibrium effects that may reduce credit access for small borrowers and expand it for wealthy borrowers. In a firm-level panel, we find evidence that an Indian judicial reform that increased banks' ability to recover nonperforming loans had such an adverse distributive impact.

10.3982/ecta9038.abstractZh: 通常认为，加强对贷款人权益的法律保护会增加所有借款人的信贷获取能力，因为这扩大了激励相容的贷款合同范围。这一结论基于一个假设，即信贷供应具有无限弹性。相反，在信贷供应缺乏弹性的情况下，加强法律保护可能会产生总体均衡效应，这种效应可能会减少小借款人的信贷获取能力，而扩大富人的信贷获取能力。在企业的层面研究中，我们发现一项印度司法改革提高了银行收回不良贷款的能力，但这一改革却产生了不利的分配效应。

abstract.text: This paper studies endogenous risk-taking by embedding a concern for status (relative consumption) into an otherwise conventional model of economic growth. We prove that if the intertemporal production function is strictly concave, an equilibrium must converge to a unique steady state in which there is recurrent endogenous risk-taking. (The role played by concavity is clarified by considering a special case in which the production function is instead convex, in which there is no persistent risk-taking.) The steady state is fully characterized. It displays features that are consistent with the stylized facts that individuals both insure downside risk and gamble over upside risk, and it generates similar patterns of risk-taking and avoidance across environments with quite different overall wealth levels. Endogenous risk-taking here is generally Pareto-inefficient. A concern for status thus implies that persistent and inefficient risk-taking hinders the attainment of full equality.

10.3982/ecta9042.abstractZh: 本文通过将对地位的关注（相对消费）融入传统的经济增长模型中，研究内生性风险承担行为。我们证明，如果跨期生产函数具有严格凹性，则均衡将收敛于一个唯一的稳定状态，在这种状态下存在持续的内生性风险承担行为。（通过考虑生产函数为凸的情况，可以阐明凹性所起的作用，在这种情况下不存在持续的风险承担行为。）该稳定状态具有完整的特征描述。它表现出与个体既对下行风险进行保险，又对上行风险进行赌博这一典型特征一致的特征，并且能够在整体财富水平差异较大的环境中产生类似的风险承担与规避行为。这里的内生性风险承担通常具有帕累托无效性。因此，对地位的关注意味着持续且低效的风险承担会阻碍完全平等的实现。

abstract.text: How can price elasticities be identified when agents face optimization frictions such as adjustment costs or inattention? I derive bounds on structural price elasticities that are a function of the observed effect of a price change on demand, the size of the price change, and the degree of frictions. The degree of frictions is measured by the utility losses agents tolerate to deviate from the frictionless optimum. The bounds imply that frictions affect intensive margin elasticities much more than extensive margin elasticities. I apply these bounds to the literature on labor supply. The utility costs of ignoring the tax changes used to identify intensive margin labor supply elasticities are typically less than 1% of earnings. As a result, small frictions can explain the differences between micro and macro elasticities, extensive and intensive margin elasticities, and other disparate findings. Pooling estimates from existing studies, I estimate a Hicksian labor supply elasticity of 0.33 on the intensive margin and 0.25 on the extensive margin after accounting for frictions.

10.3982/ecta9043.abstractZh: 当代理人面临诸如调整成本或注意力不集中的优化障碍时，如何确定价格弹性呢？我推导出了结构价格弹性的界限，这些界限取决于价格变化对需求的观察效应、价格变化的幅度以及障碍的程度。障碍的程度通过代理人对偏离无障碍最优状态的效用损失来衡量。这些界限表明，障碍对密集边际弹性的影响远大于对广泛边际弹性的影响。我将这些界限应用于关于劳动力供应的文献中。用于确定密集边际劳动力供应弹性的忽略税收变化的效用成本通常低于收入的1%。因此，小的障碍可以解释微观和宏观弹性、广泛边际和密集边际弹性以及其他不同研究结果之间的差异。通过汇总现有研究的估计结果，我在考虑障碍因素后，估计出密集边际的希克斯劳动供应弹性为0.33，广泛边际的弹性为0.25。

abstract.text: This paper discusses a consistent bootstrap implementation of the likelihood ratio (LR) co-integration rank test and associated sequential rank determination procedure of Johansen (1996). The bootstrap samples are constructed using the restricted parameter estimates of the underlying vector autoregressive (VAR) model that obtain under the reduced rank null hypothesis. A full asymptotic theory is provided that shows that, unlike the bootstrap procedure in Swensen (2006) where a combination of unrestricted and restricted estimates from the VAR model is used, the resulting bootstrap data are I(1) and satisfy the null co-integration rank, regardless of the true rank. This ensures that the bootstrap LR test is asymptotically correctly sized and that the probability that the bootstrap sequential procedure selects a rank smaller than the true rank converges to zero. Monte Carlo evidence suggests that our bootstrap procedures work very well in practice.

10.3982/ecta9099.abstractZh: 本文讨论了一种一致的Bootstrap方法，用于实施似然比协整秩检验以及Johansen（1996）提出的相关序贯秩确定程序。Bootstrap样本是通过在降秩零假设下获得的底层向量自回归（VAR）模型的受限参数估计值来构建的。文中提供了一个完整的渐近理论，表明与Swensen（2006）中使用的Bootstrap方法不同，后者结合了VAR模型中的无限制估计和受限估计，我们的Bootstrap数据满足I(1)性质，并且符合零假设下的协整秩，无论真实秩如何。这确保了Bootstrap似然比检验在渐近意义上具有正确的显著性，并且Bootstrap序贯程序选择出的秩小于真实秩的概率趋于零。蒙特卡洛模拟结果表明，我们的Bootstrap方法在实践中效果非常好。

abstract.text: This paper shows that information imperfections and common values can solve coordination problems in multicandidate elections. We analyze an election in which (i) the majority is divided between two alternatives and (ii) the minority backs a third alternative, which the majority views as strictly inferior. Standard analyses assume voters have a fixed preference ordering over candidates. Coordination problems cannot be overcome in such a case, and it is possible that inferior candidates win. In our setup the majority is also divided as a result of information imperfections. The majority thus faces two problems: aggregating information and coordinating to defeat the minority candidate. We show that when the common value component is strong enough, approval voting produces full information and coordination equivalence: the equilibrium is unique and solves both problems. Thus, the need for information aggregation helps resolve the majority's coordination problem under approval voting. This is not the case under standard electoral systems.

10.3982/ecta9111.abstractZh: 本文指出，信息的不完善性和共同价值观可以解决多候选人选举中的协调问题。我们分析了一个选举案例，其中（i）多数派分为两个候选方案，而（ii）少数派支持第三个候选方案，多数派认为该方案明显劣于其他方案。标准分析假设选民对候选人有固定的偏好排序。在这种情况下，协调问题无法得到解决，劣质的候选人仍有可能获胜。在我们的模型中，多数派也因信息的不完善而分裂。因此，多数派面临两个挑战：信息聚合和协调以击败少数派候选人。我们证明，当共同价值观足够强时，赞成投票能够产生完全的信息和协调效果：均衡是唯一的，并能解决这两个问题。因此，信息聚合的需求有助于在赞成投票下解决多数派的协调问题。而在标准选举制度下，情况并非如此。

abstract.text: We introduce and derive the asymptotic behavior of a new measure constructed from high-frequency data which we call the realized Laplace transform of volatility. The statistic provides a nonparametric estimate for the empirical Laplace transform function of the latent stochastic volatility process over a given interval of time and is robust to the presence of jumps in the price process. With a long span of data, that is, under joint long-span and infill asymptotics, the statistic can be used to construct a nonparametric estimate of the volatility Laplace transform as well as of the integrated joint Laplace transform of volatility over different points of time. We derive feasible functional limit theorems for our statistic both under fixed-span and infill asymptotics as well as under joint long-span and infill asymptotics which allow us to quantify the precision in estimation under both sampling schemes.

10.3982/ecta9133.abstractZh: 我们介绍并推导了一种基于高频数据构建的新测度的渐近行为，我们将其称为波动性的实现拉普拉斯变换。该统计量能够为非参数方式估计给定时间间隔内潜在随机波动过程的经验拉普拉斯变换函数，并且对价格过程中的跳跃现象具有鲁棒性。在长时间跨度数据的情况下，即在联合长跨度与填充渐近条件下，该统计量可用于构建波动性的拉普拉斯变换的非参数估计，以及不同时间点上的波动性联合拉普拉斯变换的估计。我们推导出了该统计量在固定跨度与填充渐近条件以及联合长跨度与填充渐近条件下的可行函数极限定理，这些定理使我们能够在两种抽样方案下量化估计的精度。

abstract.text: Weinstein and Yildiz (2007) have shown that in static games, only very weak predictions are robust to perturbations of higher order beliefs. These predictions are precisely those provided by interim correlated rationalizability (ICR). This negative result is obtained under the assumption that agents have no information on payoffs. This assumption is unnatural in many settings. It is therefore natural to ask whether Weinstein and Yildiz's results remain true under more general information structures. This paper characterizes the “robust predictions” in static and dynamic games, under arbitrary information structures. This characterization is provided by an extensive form solution concept: interim sequential rationalizability (ISR). In static games, ISR coincides with ICR and does not depend on the assumptions on agents' information. Hence the “no information” assumption entails no loss of generality in these settings. This is not the case in dynamic games, where ISR refines ICR and depends on the details of the information structure. In these settings, the robust predictions depend on the assumptions on agents' information. This reveals a hitherto neglected interaction between information and higher order uncertainty, raising novel questions of robustness.

10.3982/ecta9159.abstractZh: Weinstein和Yildiz在2007年的研究中指出，在静态博弈中，只有非常弱的预测对更高阶的信念扰动具有鲁棒性。这些预测正是通过中期相关可理性化（ICR）来提供的。这一负面结果是在假设代理人对收益信息一无所知的情况下得出的。在许多情况下，这种假设是不自然的。因此，自然会问，在更一般的信息结构下，Weinstein和Yildiz的研究结果是否仍然成立。本文对静态和动态博弈中的“鲁棒预测”进行了描述，这些描述适用于任意信息结构。这种描述是通过扩展形式解概念来提供的：中期序列可理性化（ISR）。在静态博弈中，ISR与ICR一致，并且不依赖于代理人信息假设。因此，在这种情况下的“无信息”假设并不会导致普遍性的丧失。但在动态博弈中，ISR会进一步完善ICR，并且依赖于信息结构的细节。在这种情况下，鲁棒预测取决于代理人信息假设。这揭示了信息与更高阶不确定性之间迄今被忽视的相互作用，同时也提出了关于鲁棒性的新问题。

abstract.text: Stochastic sequential bargaining models (Merlo and Wilson (1995, 1998)) have found wide applications in different fields including political economy and macroeconomics due to their flexibility in explaining delays in reaching an agreement. This paper presents new results in nonparametric identification and estimation of such models under different data scenarios.

10.3982/ecta9167.abstractZh: 随机序贯讨价还价模型（Merlo和Wilson，1995年，1998年）因其在解释达成协议过程中的延迟现象方面的灵活性，被广泛应用于包括政治经济学和宏观经济学在内的多个领域。本文提出了在多种数据情景下，对这些模型进行非参数识别与估计的新方法。

abstract.text: We study a dynamic setting in which stochastic information (news) about the value of a privately informed seller's asset is gradually revealed to a market of buyers. We construct an equilibrium that involves periods of no trade or market failure. The no-trade period ends in one of two ways: either enough good news arrives, restoring confidence and markets reopen, or bad news arrives, making buyers more pessimistic and forcing capitulation that is, a partial sell-off of low-value assets. Conditions under which the equilibrium is unique are provided. We analyze welfare and efficiency as they depend on the quality of the news. Higher quality news can lead to more inefficient outcomes. Our model encompasses settings with or without a standard static adverse selection problem—in a dynamic setting with sufficiently informative news, reservation values arise endogenously from the option to sell in the future and the two environments have the same equilibrium structure.

10.3982/ecta9278.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个动态环境，在这个环境中，关于私人知情卖家资产价值的随机信息逐渐被市场中的买家所知晓。我们构建了一个包含无交易或市场失灵时期的均衡状态。无交易时期以两种方式结束：要么有足够的好消息出现，恢复市场信心并重新开放市场；要么出现坏消息，使买家更加悲观，从而被迫放弃部分低价值资产。我们提供了均衡状态唯一性的条件。我们分析了福利和效率如何依赖于新闻的质量。质量更高的新闻可能导致更低效的结果。我们的模型涵盖了存在或不存在标准静态逆向选择问题的情形——在信息足够丰富的动态环境中，保留价值会从未来出售的选项中内生地产生，这两种环境具有相同的均衡结构。

abstract.text: We study the random Strotz model, a version of the Strotz (1955) model with uncertainty about the nature of the temptation that will strike. We show that the random Strotz representation is unique and characterize a comparative notion of “more temptation averse.” Also, we demonstrate an unexpected connection between the random Strotz model and a generalization of the Gul–Pesendorfer (GP) (2001) model of temptation which allows for the temptation to be uncertain and which we call random GP. In particular, a preference over menus has a random GP representation if and only if it also has a representation via a random Strotz model with sufficiently smooth uncertainty about the intensity of temptation. We also show that choices of menus combined with choices from menus can distinguish the random GP and random Strotz models.

10.3982/ecta9280.abstractZh: 我们研究了随机Strotz模型，这是Strotz（1955）模型的一个版本，其中对诱惑的性质存在不确定性。我们证明了随机Strotz表示是唯一的，并描述了“更厌恶诱惑”的相对概念。此外，我们揭示了随机Strotz模型与Gul-Pesendorfer（GP）（2001）模型的一种意外联系，该模型允许诱惑具有不确定性，我们将其称为随机GP模型。特别地，如果对菜单的偏好具有随机GP表示，当且仅当它也具有通过随机Strotz模型表示的偏好，且对诱惑强度的不确定性足够平滑。我们还表明，菜单选择与菜单中的选择相结合可以区分随机GP模型和随机Strotz模型。

abstract.text: We study elections that simultaneously decide multiple issues, where voters have independent private values over bundles of issues. The innovation is in considering nonseparable preferences, where issues may be complements or substitutes. Voters face a political exposure problem: the optimal vote for a particular issue will depend on the resolution of the other issues. Moreover, the probabilities that the other issues will pass should be conditioned on being pivotal. We prove that equilibrium exists when distributions over values have full support or when issues are complements. We then study large elections with two issues. There exists a nonempty open set of distributions where the probability of either issue passing fails to converge to either 1 or 0 for all limit equilibria. Thus, the outcomes of large elections are not generically predictable with independent private values, despite the fact that there is no aggregate uncertainty regarding fundamentals. While the Condorcet winner is not necessarily the outcome of a multi-issue election, we provide sufficient conditions that guarantee the implementation of the Condorcet winner.

10.3982/ecta9294.abstractZh: 我们研究同时决定多个问题的选举，其中选民对各个问题组合有独立的私人价值观。我们的创新之处在于考虑了不可分离的偏好，即各个问题可能是互补或替代的。选民面临一个政治曝光问题：某个特定问题的最佳投票结果将取决于其他问题的解决情况。此外，其他问题通过的概率应取决于它们是否具有关键性。我们证明，当价值分布具有完全支持时，或者当各个问题是互补关系时，均衡是存在的。然后，我们研究了包含两个问题的大型选举。存在一个非空的开放分布集合，其中任一问题的通过概率不会收敛到1或0，这适用于所有极限均衡情况。因此，尽管基本因素没有总体不确定性，但大型选举的结果并不容易用独立的私人价值观来预测。虽然康德赛特获胜者不一定是一个多问题选举的结果，但我们提供了充分条件来保证康德赛特获胜者的实现。

abstract.text: We consider model based inference in a fractionally cointegrated (or cofractional) vector autoregressive model with a restricted constant term, ¿, based on the Gaussian likelihood conditional on initial values. The model nests the I(d) VAR model. We give conditions on the parameters such that the process X_{t} is fractional of order d and cofractional of order d-b; that is, there exist vectors ß for which ß'X_{t} is fractional of order d-b, and no other fractionality order is possible. We define the statistical model by 0<b=d, but conduct inference when the true values satisfy b0¿1/2 and d0-b0<1/2 for which ß0'X_{t}+¿0' is (asymptotically) a mean zero stationary process and ¿0 can be estimated consistently. Our main technical contribution is the proof of consistency of the maximum likelihood estimators. To this end we prove weak convergence of the conditional likelihood as a continuous stochastic process in the parameters when errors are i.i.d. with suitable moment conditions and initial values are bounded. When the limit is deterministic this implies uniform convergence in probability of the conditional likelihood function. If the true value b0>1/2, we prove that the limit distribution of (ß',¿')' is mixed Gaussian and for the remaining parameters it is Gaussian. The limit distribution of the likelihood ratio test for cointegration rank is a functional of fractional Brownian motion of type II extended by u^{-(d0-b0)}. If b0<1/2 all limit distributions are Gaussian or chi-squared.

10.3982/ecta9299.abstractZh: 我们研究了基于模型的推断问题，该问题涉及一个具有受限常数项的分数协整（或分数协分数）向量自回归模型，并基于初始值条件下的高斯似然函数进行推断。该模型包含了I(d) VAR模型。我们给出了参数满足某些条件时，过程X_{t}为d阶分数且为d-b阶分数协分数的条件，即存在向量ß，使得ß'X_{t}为d-b阶分数，且不存在其他可能的分数阶数。我们通过0<b=d来定义统计模型，但在真实值满足b0¿1/2且d0-b0<1/2的情况下进行推断，此时ß0'X_{t}+¿0'渐近地是一个均值为零的平稳过程，且¿0可以一致估计。我们的主要技术贡献是证明了最大似然估计量的一致性。为此，我们证明了在误差独立同分布且具有适当的矩条件以及初始值有界的情况下，条件似然函数作为参数的连续随机过程时的弱收敛性。当极限为确定性分布时，这意味着条件似然函数在概率上一致收敛。如果真实值b0>1/2，我们证明了(ß',¿')'的极限分布是混合高斯分布，对于其余参数，其极限分布是高斯分布。协整秩的似然比检验的极限分布是第二类分数布朗运动的函数，该函数通过u^{-(d0-b0)}进行扩展。如果b0<1/2，所有极限分布都是高斯分布或卡方分布。

abstract.text: In nonlinear panel data models, the incidental parameter problem remains a challenge to econometricians. Available solutions are often based on ingenious, model-specific methods. In this paper, we propose a systematic approach to construct moment restrictions on common parameters that are free from the individual fixed effects. This is done by an orthogonal projection that differences out the unknown distribution function of individual effects. Our method applies generally in likelihood models with continuous dependent variables where a condition of non-surjectivity holds. The resulting method-of-moments estimators are root-N consistent (for fixed T) and asymptotically normal, under regularity conditions that we spell out. Several examples and a small-scale simulation exercise complete the paper.

10.3982/ecta9311.abstractZh: 在非线性面板数据模型中，偶然参数问题仍然是计量经济学家面临的挑战。现有的解决方案通常基于巧妙的、针对特定模型的办法。在本文中，我们提出了一种系统性的方法，用于构建不受个体固定效应影响的共同参数的矩限制条件。这是通过正交投影来消除个体效应未知分布函数的差异来实现的。我们的方法适用于具有连续因变量的似然模型，其中满足非满射条件。在规定的常规条件下，所得到的矩估计量具有根N一致性（对于固定的T），并且渐近正态。文中还通过几个例子和小型模拟实验对方法进行了验证。

abstract.text: The delta method and continuous mapping theorem are among the most extensively used tools in asymptotic derivations in econometrics. Extensions of these methods are provided for sequences of functions that are commonly encountered in applications and where the usual methods sometimes fail. Important examples of failure arise in the use of simulation-based estimation methods such as indirect inference. The paper explores the application of these methods to the indirect inference estimator (IIE) in first order autoregressive estimation. The IIE uses a binding function that is sample size dependent. Its limit theory relies on a sequence-based delta method in the stationary case and a sequence-based implicit continuous mapping theorem in unit root and local to unity cases. The new limit theory shows that the IIE achieves much more than (partial) bias correction. It changes the limit theory of the maximum likelihood estimator (MLE) when the autoregressive coefficient is in the locality of unity, reducing the bias and the variance of the MLE without affecting the limit theory of the MLE in the stationary case. Thus, in spite of the fact that the IIE is a continuously differentiable function of the MLE, the limit distribution of the IIE is not simply a scale multiple of the MLE, but depends implicitly on the full binding function mapping. The unit root case therefore represents an important example of the failure of the delta method and shows the need for an implicit mapping extension of the continuous mapping theorem.

10.3982/ecta9350.abstractZh: Delta方法和连续映射定理是计量经济学中用于渐近推导的最常用工具之一。这些方法被扩展应用于常见函数序列，尤其是在常规方法有时失效的情况下。在基于模拟的估计方法（如间接推断）的使用中，会出现重要的失效案例。本文探讨了这些方法在一级自回归估计中间接推断估计器中的应用。间接推断估计器使用了一个依赖于样本量的约束函数。其极限理论在平稳情况下依赖于基于序列的Delta方法，在单位根和局部单位情况下则依赖于基于序列的隐式连续映射定理。新的极限理论表明，间接推断估计器不仅能实现（部分）偏差校正，还能改变最大似然估计器的极限理论，当自回归系数处于局部单位情况下，可以减小最大似然估计器的偏差和方差，而不影响平稳情况下最大似然估计器的极限理论。因此，尽管间接推断估计器是最大似然估计器的连续可微函数，但其极限分布并非简单地是最大似然估计器的比例倍数，而是隐式依赖于完整的约束函数映射。因此，单位根情况代表了Delta方法失效的一个重要例子，这也表明需要扩展连续映射定理以包含隐式映射。

abstract.text: This paper considers local and global multiple-prior representations of ambiguity for preferences that are (i) monotonic, (ii) Bernoullian, that is, admit an affine utility representation when restricted to constant acts, and (iii) locally Lipschitz continuous. We do not require either certainty independence or uncertainty aversion. We show that the set of priors identified by Ghirardato, Maccheroni, and Marinacci's (2004) “unambiguous preference” relation can be characterized as a union of Clarke differentials. We then introduce a behavioral notion of “locally better deviation” at an act and show that it characterizes the Clarke differential of the preference representation at that act. These results suggest that the priors identified by these preference statements are directly related to (local) optimizing behavior.

10.3982/ecta9367.abstractZh: 本文探讨了局部和全局多重先验表示法，用于处理具有以下特性的偏好：①单调性；②伯努利性，即在限制为恒定行为时允许仿射效用表示；③局部利普希茨连续性。我们并不要求先验具有确定性独立性或不确定性厌恶特性。我们证明了由Ghirardato、Maccheroni和Marinacci在2004年提出的“无歧义偏好”关系所确定的先验集合，可以描述为Clarke微分的并集。随后，我们引入了“局部更优偏差”的行为概念，并证明它表征了该偏好表示在该行为下的Clarke微分。这些结果表明，由这些偏好陈述所确定的先验与（局部）优化行为直接相关。

abstract.text: This paper examines the problem of testing and confidence set construction for one-dimensional functions of the coefficients in autoregressive (AR(p)) models with potentially persistent time series. The primary example concerns inference on impulse responses. A new asymptotic framework is suggested and some new theoretical properties of known procedures are demonstrated. I show that the likelihood ratio (LR) and LR± statistics for a linear hypothesis in an AR(p) can be uniformly approximated by a weighted average of local-to-unity and normal distributions. The corresponding weights depend on the weight placed on the largest root in the null hypothesis. The suggested approximation is uniform over the set of all linear hypotheses. The same family of distributions approximates the LR and LR± statistics for tests about impulse responses, and the approximation is uniform over the horizon of the impulse response. I establish the size properties of tests about impulse responses proposed by Inoue and Kilian (2002) and Gospodinov (2004), and theoretically explain some of the empirical findings of Pesavento and Rossi (2007). An adaptation of the grid bootstrap for impulse response functions is suggested and its properties are examined.

10.3982/ecta9371.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在具有潜在持久性时间序列的自回归（AR(p)）模型中，对系数的一维函数进行测试和置信集构建的问题。主要示例涉及对脉冲响应的推断。本文提出了一种新的渐近框架，并展示了已知程序的一些新理论特性。我们证明，在AR(p)模型中，对于线性假设，似然比（LR）和LR±统计量可以统一地近似为局部到单位分布与正态分布的加权平均值。相应的权重取决于对零假设中最大根的权重分配。所提出的近似方法适用于所有线性假设。同一系列分布也可以近似用于关于脉冲响应的检验，且这种近似在脉冲响应的范围内是统一的。我们建立了Inoue和Kilian（2002年）以及Gospodinov（2004年）提出的关于脉冲响应的检验的显著性属性，并从理论上解释了Pesavento和Rossi（2007年）的一些实证发现。本文还提出了一种针对脉冲响应函数的网格自助法的改编方法，并对其特性进行了研究。

abstract.text: We study the question of whether local incentive constraints are sufficient to imply full incentive compatibility in a variety of mechanism design settings, allowing for probabilistic mechanisms. We give a unified approach that covers both continuous and discrete type spaces. On many common preference domains—including any convex domain of cardinal or ordinal preferences, single-peaked ordinal preferences, and successive single-crossing ordinal preferences—local incentive compatibility (suitably defined) implies full incentive compatibility. On domains of cardinal preferences that satisfy a strong nonconvexity condition, local incentive compatibility is not sufficient. Our sufficiency results hold for dominant-strategy and Bayesian Nash solution concepts, and allow for some interdependence in preferences.

10.3982/ecta9454.abstractZh: 我们研究了局部激励约束是否足以在多种机制设计场景中实现完全激励兼容性，这些场景包括概率性机制。我们提出了一种统一的方法，适用于连续型和离散型偏好空间。在许多常见的偏好领域——包括任何凸型基数或序数偏好、单峰序数偏好以及连续单交叉序数偏好——适当定义的局部激励兼容性能够实现完全激励兼容性。但对于满足强非凸性条件的基数偏好领域，局部激励兼容性并不足。我们的充分性结果表明，即使存在偏好间的相互依赖，局部激励约束也足以实现完全激励兼容性。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the properties of standard estimators, tests, and confidence sets (CS's) for parameters that are unidentified or weakly identified in some parts of the parameter space. The paper also introduces methods to make the tests and CS's robust to such identification problems. The results apply to a class of extremum estimators and corresponding tests and CS's that are based on criterion functions that satisfy certain asymptotic stochastic quadratic expansions and that depend on the parameter that determines the strength of identification. This covers a class of models estimated using maximum likelihood (ML), least squares (LS), quantile, generalized method of moments, generalized empirical likelihood, minimum distance, and semi-parametric estimators. The consistency/lack-of-consistency and asymptotic distributions of the estimators are established under a full range of drifting sequences of true distributions. The asymptotic sizes (in a uniform sense) of standard and identification-robust tests and CS's are established. The results are applied to the ARMA(1, 1) time series model estimated by ML and to the nonlinear regression model estimated by LS. In companion papers, the results are applied to a number of other models.

10.3982/ecta9456.abstractZh: 本文分析了在参数空间的部分区域中参数未被识别或弱识别时，标准估计量、检验和置信集的性质。文章还提出了一些方法，使这些检验和置信集能够适应这种识别问题。研究结果适用于一类极值估计量及其相应的检验和置信集，这些估计量和检验基于满足某些渐近随机二次展开条件的准则函数，并且取决于决定识别强度的参数。这些模型包括使用最大似然法、最小二乘法、分位数法、广义矩法、广义经验似然法、最小距离法以及半参数估计法进行估计的模型。在一系列变化的真实分布序列下，建立了估计量的一致性/非一致性和渐近分布。同时，还确定了标准检验和具有识别适应性的置信集的渐近大小（在均匀意义上）。这些结果已应用于通过最大似然法估计的ARMA(1,1)时间序列模型，以及通过最小二乘法估计的非线性回归模型。在配套论文中，这些结果还被应用于其他一些模型。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of market size on the ability of price to aggregate traders' private information. To account for heterogeneity in correlation of trader values, a Gaussian model of double auction is introduced that departs from the standard information structure based on a common (fundamental) shock. The paper shows that markets are informationally efficient only if correlations of values coincide across all bidder pairs. As a result, with heterogeneously interdependent values, price informativeness may not increase monotonically with market size. As a necessary and sufficient condition for the monotonicity, price informativeness increases with the number of traders if the implied reduction in (the absolute value of) an average correlation statistic of an information structure is sufficiently small.

10.3982/ecta9573.abstractZh: 本文研究了市场规模对价格聚合交易者私人信息能力的影响。为了考虑交易者价值相关性的异质性，本文引入了一个基于双重拍卖的高斯模型，该模型不同于基于共同（基本）冲击的标准信息结构。研究表明，只有当所有出价者之间的价值相关性一致时，市场才具有信息效率。因此，在价值具有异质性的相互依赖情况下，价格的信息含量可能不会随市场规模的增加而单调增加。作为价格信息含量单调增加的必要充分条件，如果信息结构中平均相关性统计量的减少幅度足够小，那么价格信息含量就会随着交易者数量的增加而增加。

abstract.text: For a finite game with perfect recall, a refinement of its set of Nash equilibria selects closed connected subsets, called solutions. Assume that each solution's equilibria use undominated strategies and some of its equilibria are quasi-perfect, and that all solutions are immune to presentation effects; namely, if the game is embedded in a larger game with more pure strategies and more players such that the original players' feasible mixed strategies and expected payoffs are preserved regardless of what other players do, then the larger game's solutions project to the original game's solutions. Then, for a game with two players and generic payoffs, each solution is an essential component of the set of equilibria that use undominated strategies, and thus a stable set of equilibria as defined by Mertens (1989).

10.3982/ecta9579.abstractZh: 对于一个具有完美回忆的有限博弈，对其纳什均衡集合的细化会选出封闭的、连通的子集，这些子集被称为解。假设每个解中的均衡策略未被支配，且部分均衡是准完美的，并且所有解都不受呈现效应的影响；也就是说，如果博弈嵌入在一个更大的博弈中，该更大博弈包含更多纯策略以及更多的参与者，以至于原始参与者的可行混合策略和预期收益在不受其他参与者行为影响的情况下得以保留，那么更大博弈的解就会映射到原始博弈的解上。因此，对于一个有两个参与者和通用收益值的博弈，每个解都是使用未被支配策略的均衡集合中的一个基本组成部分，从而构成了一个由Mertens（1989）定义的稳定均衡集合。

abstract.text: We report an experiment on effects of varying institutional format and dynamic structure of centipede games and Dutch auctions. Centipede games with a clock format unravel, as predicted by theory but not reported in previous literature on two-player tree-format centipede games. Dutch auctions with a tree format produce bids close to risk neutral Nash equilibrium bids, unlike previous literature on clock-format Dutch auctions. Our data provide a new, expanded set of stylized facts which may provide a foundation for unified modeling of play in a class of games that includes centipede games and Dutch auctions.

10.3982/ecta9589.abstractZh: 我们报告了一项关于不同制度格式和动态结构对蜈蚣博弈及荷兰拍卖影响的实验。按照理论预测的，采用时钟格式的蜈蚣博弈会发生变化，但之前关于两人树形格式的蜈蚣博弈的文献并未提及这一点。采用树形格式的荷兰拍卖所产生的出价接近风险中性的纳什均衡出价，这与之前关于时钟格式荷兰拍卖的文献有所不同。我们的数据提供了一组新的、扩展的模型化事实，这些事实可能为包括蜈蚣博弈和荷兰拍卖在内的一类博弈的统一建模提供基础。

abstract.text: This paper studies the behavior, under local misspecification, of several confidence sets (CSs) commonly used in the literature on inference in moment (in)equality models. We propose the amount of asymptotic confidence size distortion as a criterion to choose among competing inference methods. This criterion is then applied to compare across test statistics and critical values employed in the construction of CSs. We find two important results under weak assumptions. First, we show that CSs based on subsampling and generalized moment selection (Andrews and Soares (2010)) suffer from the same degree of asymptotic confidence size distortion, despite the fact that asymptotically the latter can lead to CSs with strictly smaller expected volume under correct model specification. Second, we show that the asymptotic confidence size of CSs based on the quasi-likelihood ratio test statistic can be an arbitrary small fraction of the asymptotic confidence size of CSs based on the modified method of moments test statistic.

10.3982/ecta9604.abstractZh: 本文研究了在局部误设条件下，文献中常用于矩不等式模型推断的几种置信集的行为。我们提出了一种基于渐近置信度失真程度的准则，用于选择不同的推断方法。该准则被应用于比较构建置信集时所使用的各种检验统计量和临界值。在弱假设下，我们发现了两个重要结果。首先，我们表明基于子抽样和广义矩选择方法的置信集（Andrews和Soares (2010)）存在相同程度的渐近置信度失真，尽管在正确的模型设定下，后者所得到的置信集在期望体积上可能更小。其次，我们指出，基于准似然比检验统计量的置信集的渐近置信度，可能仅为基于修正矩方法检验统计量的置信集的渐近置信度的任意小比例。

abstract.text: This paper argues that in the presence of intersectoral input-output linkages, microeconomic idiosyncratic shocks may lead to aggregate fluctuations. In particular, it shows that, as the economy becomes more disaggregated, the rate at which aggregate volatility decays is determined by the structure of the network capturing such linkages. Our main results provide a characterization of this relationship in terms of the importance of different sectors as suppliers to their immediate customers as well as their role as indirect suppliers to chains of downstream sectors. Such higher-order interconnections capture the possibility of “cascade effects” whereby productivity shocks to a sector propagate not only to its immediate downstream customers, but also indirectly to the rest of the economy. Our results highlight that sizable aggregate volatility is obtained from sectoral idiosyncratic shocks only if there exists significant asymmetry in the roles that sectors play as suppliers to others, and that the “sparseness” of the input-output matrix is unrelated to the nature of aggregate fluctuations.

10.3982/ecta9623.abstractZh: 本文认为，在部门间投入产出联系存在的情况下，微观经济上的特异性冲击可能导致总体波动。具体而言，随着经济变得更加分散化，总体波动衰减的速度取决于捕捉这些联系的网络结构。我们的主要研究结果描述了这种关系，即不同部门作为直接客户的供应商的重要性，以及它们作为下游部门间接供应商的角色。这种更高层次的联系使得“级联效应”成为可能，即一个部门的生产率冲击不仅会传播到其直接下游客户，还会间接影响整个经济。我们的研究结果表明，只有当部门作为其他部门供应商的角色存在显著的不对称性时，才会产生较大的总体波动；而投入产出矩阵的“稀疏性”与总体波动的性质无关。

abstract.text: We develop results for the use of LASSO and Post-LASSO methods to form firststage predictions and estimate optimal instruments in linear instrumental variables (IV) models with many instruments, p, that apply even when p is much larger than the sample size, n.We rigorously develop asymptotic distribution and inference theory for the resulting IV estimators and provide conditions under which these estimators are asymptotically oracle-efficient.In simulation experiments, the LASSO-based IV estimator with a data-driven penalty performs well compared to recently advocated many-instrument-robust procedures.In an empirical example dealing with the effect of judicial eminent domain decisions on economic outcomes, the LASSObased IV estimator substantially reduces estimated standard errors allowing one to draw much more precise conclusions about the economic effects of these decisions.Optimal instruments are conditional expectations; and in developing the IV results, we also establish a series of new results for LASSO and Post-LASSO estimators of non-parametric conditional expectation functions which are of independent theoretical and practical interest.Specifically, we develop the asymptotic theory for these estimators that allows for non-Gaussian, heteroscedastic disturbances, which is important for econometric applications.By innovatively using moderate deviation theory for self-normalized sums, we provide convergence rates for these estimators that are as sharp as in the homoscedastic Gaussian case under the weak condition that log p = o(n 1/3 ).Moreover, as a practical innovation, we provide a fully data-driven method for choosing the user-specified penalty that must be provided in obtaining LASSO and Post-LASSO estimates and establish its asymptotic validity under non-Gaussian, heteroscedastic disturbances.

10.3982/ecta9626.abstractZh: 我们开发了使用LASSO和Post-LASSO方法形成第一阶段预测以及估计具有多个工具变量模型的理想工具变量的结果，这些模型即使当工具变量的数量远大于样本量时，也能适用。我们严格推导了这些工具变量估计量的渐近分布和推断理论，并提出了这些估计量在渐近意义上具有高效性的条件。在模拟实验中，基于LASSO的工具变量估计量在数据驱动的惩罚项方面表现良好，与最近提出的多工具变量鲁棒性方法相比具有明显优势。在一个涉及司法征用决定对经济结果影响的实证案例中，基于LASSO的工具变量估计量显著降低了估计的标准误差，使得人们能够更精确地了解这些决定的经济影响。理想工具变量是条件期望；在推导工具变量结果的过程中，我们还为LASSO和Post-LASSO估计量建立了一系列关于非参数条件期望函数的新结果，这些结果在理论和实际应用上都具有重要的意义。具体来说，我们为这些估计量开发了渐近理论，能够处理非高斯、异方差的扰动，这对于计量经济学应用非常重要。通过创新性地使用适度偏差理论来处理自标准化求和问题，我们为这些估计量提供了收敛速率，这些速率在同方差高斯情况下的精度相当，前提是log p = o(n 1/3)。此外，作为一种实用创新，我们提供了一种完全数据驱动的方法来选择用户指定的惩罚项，这对于获得LASSO和Post-LASSO估计量是必要的，并且我们在非高斯、异方差扰动条件下证明了其渐近有效性。

abstract.text: The dual self-model of self-control with one-period lived short-run selves is excessively sensitive to the timing of shocks and to the interpolation of additional “noaction” time periods in between the dates when decisions are made. We show that when short-run selves have a random length of time this excess sensitivity goes away. We consider both linear and convex cost of self-control models, illustrating the theory through a series of examples. We examine when opportunities to consume will be avoided or delayed; we consider the way in which the marginal interest declines with delay, and we examine how preference “reversals ” depend on the timing of information. To accommodate the combination of short time periods and convex costs of self control we extend the model to treat willpower as a cognitive resource that is limited in the short run.

10.3982/ecta9655.abstractZh: 自我控制的双重自我模型在短期自我层面对于冲击发生的时机以及决策日期之间额外“无行动”时间段的插入非常敏感。我们发现，当短期自我的持续时间是随机的时，这种过度敏感性就会消失。我们考虑了线性凸形自我控制模型，并通过一系列例子来阐释这一理论。我们研究了消费机会何时会被避免或延迟；考虑了边际兴趣随延迟而下降的情况，以及偏好“逆转”如何取决于信息的时机。为了适应短时间段与凸形自我控制成本的组合，我们扩展了模型，将意志力视为一种在短期内有限的认知资源。

abstract.text: In this paper, we propose a method to evaluate the effect of a counterfactual change in the unconditional distribution of a single covariate on the unconditional distribution of an outcome variable of interest. Both fixed and infinitesimal changes are considered. We show that such effects are point identified under general conditions if the covariate affected by the counterfactual change is continuously distributed, but are typically only partially identified if its distribution is discrete. For the latter case, we derive informative bounds, making use of the available information. We also discuss estimation and inference.

10.3982/ecta9671.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种方法，用于评估单个协变量无条件分布的反事实变化对目标结果变量无条件分布的影响。我们考虑了固定变化和微小变化两种情况。我们表明，在一般条件下，如果受反事实变化影响的协变量具有连续分布，那么这种影响是可以精确识别的；但如果其分布是离散的，则通常只能部分识别。对于后一种情况，我们利用现有信息推导出有信息量的界限。我们还讨论了估计和推断的问题。

abstract.text: This paper examines the incentives offered by frictionless markets to innovate asset-backed securities by owners who maximize the assets' values. Assuming identical preferences across investors with heterogeneous risk-sharing needs, we characterize economies in which competition provides insufficient incentives to innovate so that, in equilibrium, financial markets are incomplete in all (pure strategy) equilibria, even when innovation is essentially costless. Thus, value maximization does not generally result in complete markets.

10.3982/ecta9837.abstractZh: 本文探讨了无摩擦市场为那些旨在最大化资产价值的投资者所提供的创新资产支持证券的激励措施。假设不同投资者的偏好相同，但风险分担需求存在差异，我们描述了一种经济现象：竞争不足以激发创新的动力，因此在均衡状态下，即使创新几乎不需要成本，金融市场仍然是不完整的。因此，价值最大化通常并不会导致市场的完全性。

abstract.text: I propose a new mechanism design approach to the problem of ranking standard auctions with two heterogeneous bidders. A key feature of the approach is that it may be possible to rank two auctions even if neither dominates the other for all combinations of types. The approach simplifies the analysis and unifies results in the existing literature. Roughly speaking, the first-price auction is more profitable than the second-price auction when the strong bidder's distribution is flatter and more disperse than the weak bidder's distribution. Applications include auctions with one-sided externalities. Moreover, contrary to previous work, reserve prices are easily handled. Finally, the method can be extended to some environments with many bidders.

10.3982/ecta9859.abstractZh: 我提出了一种新的机制设计方法，用于解决具有两个异质投标人的标准拍卖排名问题。该方法的一个关键特点是，即使两种拍卖在所有的类型组合中都不占主导地位，我们仍然可以对它们进行排名。该方法简化了分析过程，并将现有文献中的结果进行了统一。大致来说，当强势投标者的分布比弱势投标者的分布更平坦、更分散时，第一价格拍卖比第二价格拍卖更有利可图。该方法适用于存在单边外部性的拍卖场景。此外，与以往的研究不同，该方法可以轻松处理保留价格问题。最后，该方法还可以扩展到具有大量投标人的环境中。

abstract.text: Two players announce bargaining postures to which they may become committed and then bargain over the division of a surplus. The share of the surplus that a player can guarantee herself under first-order knowledge of rationality is determined (as a function of her probability of becoming committed), as is the bargaining posture that she must announce in order to guarantee herself this much. This “maxmin ” share of the surplus is large relative to the probability of becoming committed (e.g., it equals 30 % if the commitment probability is 1 in 10, and equals 13 % if the commitment probability is 1 in 1000), and the corresponding bargaining posture simply demands this share plus compensation for any delay in reaching agreement.

10.3982/ecta9865.abstractZh: 两位参与者宣布他们可能承诺的谈判立场，然后就剩余财产的分配进行协商。在一级理性认知下，一个参与者能够确保自己获得的剩余财产份额取决于她承诺的可能性，以及为了获得这一份额而必须宣布的谈判立场。这种“最大最小”的剩余财产份额相对于承诺的可能性来说是比较大的（例如，如果承诺的可能性是十分之一，那么份额为30%；如果承诺的可能性是千分之一，那么份额为13%）。相应的谈判立场则要求获得这一份额，并额外支付因达成协议延迟而产生的补偿。

abstract.text: The single crossing property plays a crucial role in economic theory, yet there are important instances where the property cannot be directly assumed or easily derived. Difficulties often arise because the property cannot be aggregated: the sum or convex combination of two functions with the single crossing property need not have that property. We introduce a new condition characterizing when the single crossing property is stable under aggregation, and also identify sufficient conditions for the preservation of the single crossing property under multidimensional aggregation. We use our results to establish properties of objective functions (convexity, logsupermodularity), the monotonicity of optimal decisions under uncertainty, and the existence of monotone equilibria in Bayesian games.

10.3982/ecta9869.abstractZh: 单一交叉性质在经济学理论中起着至关重要的作用，但在某些重要情况下，这一性质无法被直接假设或轻易推导出来。之所以会出现困难，是因为这一性质无法被聚合：具有单一交叉性质的两个函数的总和或凸组合不一定也具有该性质。我们引入了一个新的条件，用来描述在聚合作用下单一交叉性质是否稳定，并且确定了在多维聚合下保持单一交叉性质的充分条件。我们利用这些结果来建立目标函数的性质（如凸性、超模块性）、在不确定性下的最优决策的单调性，以及贝叶斯博弈中单调均衡的存在性。

abstract.text: We propose a model of monopolistic competition with additive preferences and variable marginal costs. Using the concept of “relative love for variety,” we provide a full characterization of the free-entry equilibrium. When the relative love for variety increases with individual consumption, the market generates pro-competitive effects. When it decreases, the market mimics anti-competitive behavior. The constant elasticity of substitution is the only case in which all competitive effects are washed out. We also show that our results hold true when the economy involves several sectors, firms are heterogeneous, and preferences are given by the quadratic utility and the translog.

10.3982/ecta9986.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个具有加性偏好和可变边际成本的垄断竞争模型。利用“对多样性的相对喜爱”这一概念，我们对自由进入均衡进行了全面的描述。当对多样性的相对喜爱随着个人消费的增加而增加时，市场会产生促进竞争的效果；而当这种喜爱减少时，市场则表现出反竞争行为。只有在替代弹性恒定的情况下，所有的竞争效应才会被抵消。我们还表明，当经济涉及多个部门、企业具有异质性，且偏好由二次效用函数及translog模型描述时，我们的结果仍然成立。

abstract.text: Executive Overview For the past decade we have been using double-blind survey techniques and randomized sampling to construct management data on more than 10,000 organizations across 20 countries. On average, we find that in manufacturing American, Japanese, and German firms are the best managed. Firms in developing countries, such as Brazil, China, and India, tend to be poorly managed. American retail firms and hospitals are also well managed by international standards, although American schools are worse managed than those in several other developed countries. We also find substantial variation in management practices across organizations in every country and every sector, mirroring the wide spread of productivity and profitability within industries. One factor linked to this variation is ownership. Government and founder-owned firms are usually poorly managed, while multinational, dispersed shareholder, and private-equity-owned firms are typically well managed. Family-owned firms are badly managed if run by family members compared with similar family-owned firms run by external CEOs. Stronger product market competition and higher worker skills are associated with better management practices. Less regulated labor markets are associated with improvements in incentive management practices such as performance-based promotion.

10.5465/amp.2011.0077.abstractZh: 执行概述 在过去的十年中，我们采用了双盲调查技术和随机抽样方法，对20个国家超过10,000家组织的管理数据进行了研究。平均而言，我们发现美国的、日本的以及德国的企业在管理方面表现最佳。而像巴西、中国和印度这样的发展中国家企业则往往管理不善。按照国际标准，美国的零售企业和医院也管理得相当不错，不过美国的学校管理状况不如其他几个发达国家。我们还发现，每个国家每个行业的企业在管理实践上都存在显著差异，这反映了各行业内部生产力和盈利能力的差异。导致这种差异的一个因素是所有权结构。政府控股或创始人直接管理的企业通常管理不善，而由跨国公司、分散的股东或私人资本控股的企业则通常管理得较好。如果家族成员经营家族企业，其管理状况通常较差，相比之下，由外部首席执行官管理的类似家族企业则管理得更好。更强的产品市场竞争和更高的员工技能水平与更好的管理实践相关。监管较少的劳动力市场则与激励管理实践的改进相关，例如基于绩效的晋升制度。

abstract.text: Executive Overview In this paper I look at the last three decades of predominantly American research literature on strategic human resource management from three dimensions: (1) development of theory with predictive accuracy and robust conclusions, (2) production of actionable and value-added managerial principles, and (3) accurate portrayal of the historical origins and development of this area of management scholarship and practice. After an extensive reading of the literature, I conclude that strategic human resource management researchers as a group deserve a D to F grade on all three dimensions. Among the problems are an overreliance on knowledge areas and perspectives pertaining to the internal dimension of organizations and management (e.g., strategy, psychology, and organizational behavior) and too little attention paid to those areas and perspectives dealing with the external dimension (e.g., economics, industrial/employment relations, and the macro side of sociology). I suggest an economics-based framework as a possible way forward; a less normative-driven research program would also be helpful.

10.5465/amp.2012.0037.abstractZh: 执行概述 在本文中，我回顾了过去三十年中关于战略人力资源管理的美国研究文献，从三个维度进行分析：（1）理论的发展具有预测准确性和稳健的结论；（2）提出了可操作且具有价值的管理原则；（3）准确描述了这一管理学术与实践领域的历史起源和发展。经过对文献的广泛阅读，我得出结论，战略人力资源管理研究者作为一个群体，在三个维度上都应得到D到F级的评价。存在的问题包括过度依赖与组织和管理内部维度相关的知识领域和视角（如战略、心理学和组织行为），而对与组织和管理外部维度相关的领域和视角的关注不足（如经济学、工业/就业关系以及社会学的宏观层面）。我建议采用基于经济学的框架作为可能的解决方案；一个较少以规范为导向的研究计划也会有所帮助。

abstract.text: The relationship between the quality of health care and the extent of competition amongst providers has been the subject of intense policy interest and debate. As part of the ESHCRU programme we are undertaking a set of related investigations into this relationship in the hospital sector, in primary care (general practices) and in social care.

https://openalex.org/W118611882.abstractZh: 医疗保健的质量与医疗服务提供者之间的竞争程度之间的关系一直是政策研究和讨论的热点话题。作为ESHCRU项目的一部分，我们正在对医院部门、初级保健机构以及社会护理领域中的这一关系进行一系列相关研究。
